paper.title: Visual Information-Guided Parallel Decoding for Diffusion Multimodal Large Language Models
paper.abstract: Diffusion multimodal large language models (dMLLMs) have recently emerged as a new decoding paradigm for multimodal generation. Starting from a fully masked sequence, dMLLMs progressively decode the sequence by unmasking a subset of the remaining masked positions at each step. Since the selected tokens serve as the prediction context for subsequent steps, deciding which tokens to decode is crucial to the quality of the final output. The most common strategy prioritizes tokens based on a certaint

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作处理的是 diffusion multimodal LLM 在并行解码时的一个关键缺口：已有 token selection 规则大多只看语言侧的不确定性、置信度或信息增益，却没有把图像证据直接纳入“先解哪些 token”的决策。对 dMLLM 来说，早期被解出的 token 会立刻成为后续条件上下文；如果这些 token 虽然在语言上高信息量、但没有视觉依据，就会把后续生成带到错误的语义轨道上。论文要解决的不是训练目标，而是推理阶段的 decoding policy：如何在不增加训练、不增加额外 forward 的前提下，让并行解码既保留信息增益，又更强地受图像约束。
summary.importance: 对基座预训练研究的直接影响不算核心，因为它主要是 multimodal diffusion LM 的推理策略，而不是预训练 recipe 或建模目标本身。但它有两个启发点。第一，diffusion/并行解码范式里，“解码顺序”本身就是模型能力的一部分，不像 AR 模型那样由位置顺序固定；因此 inference policy 会显著影响模型是否真正用到训练中学到的跨模态对齐。第二，作者把 token-to-image attention 当作 visual grounding 与 usefulness 的代理信号，这个判断如果成立，说明多模态模型内部 attention 结构可以直接服务于 decoding control，而不必再训练额外 selector。对做 dMLLM、any-order LM、AR+diffusion 联合建模的人，这个思路有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 方法核心是 VIG-Sampler。它建立在两个经验观察上。第一，某个候选 token 在当前 step 对图像 token 的注意力越强，往往越可能是视觉上被支撑、同时对后续预测更有帮助的 token；因此作者直接用 token-level image attention 作为排序分数，优先解码这些 token，而不是优先解码高频、低语义负载的词。第二，并行一次解多个 token 时，单个 token 的信息增益不能简单相加，因为多个 token 可能携带高度重叠的信息；作者观察到这种冗余会反映在它们相似的 token-to-image attention 分布上。于是 VIG-Sampler 在子集选择时加入一个 similarity penalty：如果某个候选 token 的图像注意力分布与已选 token 很像，就降低其被选中的优先级。这样做相当于在“视觉 grounding”与“互补信息”之间做平衡。方法的优点是完全利用现成 attention，不需要额外训练 selector，也不需要为估计 set utility 增加新的 forward pass。和 certainty-based sampler 相比，它不再把高置信但低内容量的 token 提前固定下来；和纯 info-gain sampler 相比，它显式引入了图像条件，避免语言侧高信息量 token 抢先主导生成轨迹。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖 3 个开源 dMLLM 和 7 个 benchmark，任务包括 captioning 与 VQA。论文最醒目的结果出现在高并行度设置：在 LaViDa 上每步解 8 个 token 时，VIG-Sampler 相比 Info-Gain Sampler 在 captioning benchmark 上平均提升 19.3 CIDEr，在 VQA benchmark 上平均提升 7.3 个 accuracy 点。COCO captioning 上还有一个更能说明效率-质量权衡的结果：VIG-Sampler 每步解 8 个 token，仍比 Info-Gain Sampler 每步只解 4 个 token 高 5.3 CIDEr，也就是在解码步数减半的情况下质量仍更好。论文的分析部分还强调两点：一是 certainty-based 规则确实倾向先解语法性、模板化 token；二是并行解码中 token redundancy 会显著拉低 set-level information gain，而 attention similarity 能较好刻画这种冗余。若全文里有分模型、分任务、分并行步长的表格，建议重点看这些切片，因为它们决定方法到底是“普适稳定”还是只在某个模型上成立。
summary.reading_guide: 这篇适合泛读，重点放在引言、方法和分析实验。先看 Figure 1 一类的动机示例，理解作者为什么认为“语言上有用”不等于“视觉上正确”。然后看方法部分里 token-level ordering 和 subset selection 两层设计，尤其是 attention score 与 redundancy penalty 的定义。实验部分优先看：1）不同 sampler 在不同并行 token 数下的对比；2）captioning 与 VQA 是否都稳定收益；3）有没有 ablation 区分“只用 image attention 排序”和“再加 redundancy penalty”的增益来源。预计 20-30 分钟可以抓住主要内容。若想深挖，值得追问的是：attention 作为 grounding proxy 在不同架构、不同层、不同头上是否稳定；以及这种 decoding heuristic 是否会反过来暴露训练阶段 cross-attention 学得不够好的问题。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets a specific weakness in diffusion multimodal LLM decoding: existing token selection rules for parallel denoising mostly rely on language-side confidence or information gain, but do not explicitly use the image when deciding which masked positions to reveal first. In dMLLMs, early decoded tokens immediately become conditioning context for later steps. If those tokens are linguistically informative but visually ungrounded, they can steer the whole generation trajectory toward a coherent yet image-inconsistent answer. The problem here is not training, but inference-time decoding policy: how to choose parallel tokens so that decoding remains informative while staying anchored to visual evidence, without extra training or extra forward passes.
summary_en.importance: This is not a central pretraining paper, since the main contribution is an inference strategy for multimodal diffusion LMs rather than a new objective or training recipe. Still, it matters for people working on non-AR language modeling. In diffusion or any-order generation, token order is no longer fixed by position, so the decoding policy itself becomes part of the effective model. The paper also makes a useful claim: token-to-image attention can serve as a practical proxy for both visual grounding and downstream usefulness. If that holds beyond this setting, it suggests that internal multimodal attention patterns can be reused for decoding control, instead of training a separate selector.
summary_en.technical_approach: The method, VIG-Sampler, is built on two empirical observations. First, candidate tokens that place stronger attention on image tokens tend to be both better grounded in the visual input and more useful for predicting the remaining masked tokens. Based on this, the sampler uses token-level image attention as the ordering score, prioritizing visually informative tokens over high-confidence but semantically weak ones. Second, when multiple tokens are decoded in parallel, their individual information gains do not add up cleanly because some of them are redundant. The paper argues that this redundancy is reflected in similar token-to-image attention distributions. VIG-Sampler therefore adds a similarity-based penalty during subset selection: if a candidate attends to the image in a way that is too similar to already selected tokens, its priority is reduced. This gives a simple two-part design: image-attention-based ranking for grounding, plus attention-similarity penalty for complementary information. Compared with certainty-based samplers, it avoids locking in punctuation, copulas, or other frequent low-content tokens too early. Compared with text-only info-gain samplers, it explicitly injects visual evidence into the decoding trajectory.
summary_en.experiments: The evaluation spans 3 open-source dMLLMs and 7 benchmarks covering captioning and VQA. The strongest result is under aggressive parallel decoding. On LaViDa with 8 tokens decoded per step, VIG-Sampler improves over the Info-Gain Sampler by an average of 19.3 CIDEr on captioning benchmarks and 7.3 accuracy points on VQA benchmarks. On COCO captioning, VIG-Sampler with 8 tokens per step still beats Info-Gain with only 4 tokens per step by 5.3 CIDEr, which means better quality despite using half as many decoding steps. The analysis also supports two claims: certainty-based decoding tends to reveal syntactic or template-like tokens too early, and set-level information gain is noticeably reduced by redundancy among parallel tokens, which attention similarity captures reasonably well. The most useful tables are likely the ones broken down by model, task, and number of tokens per step, since they show whether the method is broadly stable or only effective in a narrow regime.
summary_en.reading_guide: This is a skim paper. Read the introduction for the failure mode, then the method section for the two-level design: token ordering and subset selection. Focus on how image attention is computed and how the redundancy penalty is defined. In the experiments, prioritize three things: performance under different parallel decoding widths, consistency across captioning and VQA, and ablations separating the gain from image-attention ordering versus the gain from redundancy control. Around 20-30 minutes should be enough to capture the main idea. If you want to dig deeper, the most interesting question is whether attention is a stable grounding proxy across architectures, layers, and heads, or whether this works mainly because the tested models already have reasonably clean cross-modal attention.

recommendation.zh: 看 sampler 定义就够；如果做 MDLM/LLaDA 多模态化，它提醒解码顺序不能只看文本置信度。
recommendation.en: Skim the sampler definition; for multimodal MDLM/LLaDA-style work, it is a useful reminder that unmasking order cannot be text-confidence only.

paper.title: Affix Cache for Diffusion Large Language Models
paper.abstract: Diffusion Large Language Models (DLLMs) enable non-autoregressive decoding and bidirectional context modeling, but efficient inference remains challenging. Unlike autoregressive systems, whose key-value (KV) cache can be reused for shared prefixes, DLLMs couple the KV states of shared context tokens with evolving generated tokens through bidirectional attention, making naive cache reuse stale while full recomputation is expensive. We present ACache, an affix-oriented cache reuse mechanism for sh

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作解决的是 diffusion LLM 推理里的一个具体瓶颈：如何像 AR 模型那样复用缓存，但又不被双向注意力带来的 stale KV 问题拖垮。AR 模型的 prefix cache 之所以好用，是因为历史 token 的表示不会被未来生成 token 反向影响；而 DLLM 在每一步去噪时做全局双向注意力，连共享 prompt 或中间固定片段的 KV 都会随着待生成 token 的变化而变化。直接复用会掉质量，完全重算又太贵。ACache 的问题定义很清楚：在保证生成质量的前提下，只重算真正关键的 affix tokens，其余共享 span 的 cache 尽量复用。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的直接影响有限，对新型语言建模范式的落地影响更大。Diffusion LM 近两年开始从小模型和概念验证走向 billion-scale，但推理效率一直是它和 AR 竞争时最现实的短板之一。很多人讨论 DLLM 时只看并行解码潜力，忽略了每步全序列重算带来的系统成本。ACache 的价值在于把这个问题拆细：不是“能不能缓存”，而是“哪些 token 的缓存必须更新”。如果这个思路成立，说明 DLLM 的系统优化空间并不只在 schedule、步数压缩或 speculative denoising，也在更细粒度的上下文状态管理。对做建模的人，这会反过来影响训练时是否要鼓励更局部、可缓存的依赖结构。
summary.technical_approach:
核心做法是 affix-oriented cache reuse。作者不把共享上下文限制为 prefix，而是推广到任意共享连续片段 affix，可以在开头、中间或结尾。这个设定利用了 DLLM 的双向注意力特性：既然模型天然能看两边，上下文复用也不必像 AR 那样只围绕左前缀设计。

难点在于，哪些 affix token 的 KV 会因为当前 masked generation tokens 的变化而显著失效。ACache 的答案是引入 Anchor Tokens。作者通过测量 masked generation tokens 到 affix tokens 的 cross-attention importance，找出对当前生成最敏感的一小部分 affix token，只对这些 token 重算 KV；其余 affix token 继续复用旧 cache。这样做等于把“整段共享上下文是否需要刷新”变成“少量关键位置是否需要刷新”。

从系统实现看，ACache 建在 Fast-dLLM 之上，用 selective Anchor recomputation 替代 periodic full-cache recomputation。也就是说，它不是完全推翻现有 DLLM cache 框架，而是在已有近似缓存策略上进一步细化重算粒度。作者还在 Nano-vLLM 上做了 shared-prefix 原型，验证在更接近真实 serving 的 paged memory management 和 continuous batching 场景下，选择性重算仍然有收益。

和已有方法相比，差异点比较明确。dLLM-Cache 更偏向不对称更新 prompt / response，并用特征相似度决定部分 response token 是否重算；dKV-Cache 更关注 decoded tokens 的块级延迟重算；Fast-dLLM 通过更高效的推理框架和周期性刷新降低成本。ACache 的新意在于把“共享上下文”本身作为优化对象，并且把重算单位从整段 cache 缩到 request-specific 的 token 子集。
summary.experiments:
从正文可见的关键结果有三层。第一，质量恢复：相对直接复用 affix cache 带来的明显精度下降，ACache 在多个 benchmark 上能把质量拉回，同时只需重算大约 20% 的 affix tokens。这个比例很关键，说明重要性分布是稀疏的，至少在作者测试的设置里，不需要大面积刷新共享上下文。第二，系统收益：在 Nano-vLLM 的 shared-prefix 原型中，ACache 将 recompute latency 最多降低 55.7%，端到端吞吐最高提升 1.68×。这说明收益不只存在于理论 FLOPs，而能穿透到带分页内存和连续批处理的实际推理栈。第三，适用范围：作者强调它适用于 shared spans beyond prefixes，这一点比单纯 prefix cache 更贴近实际多请求服务，因为模板、检索片段、工具返回文本、对话历史摘要都可能以中间片段形式复用。

从研究者角度，更值得注意的是消融逻辑而不是单个数字：Anchor Token 选择策略是否稳定、重算比例和质量之间的曲线是否平滑、不同 affix 位置是否影响收益、以及在不同 denoising steps 上 stale cache 的伤害是否累积。如果正文里有这些图，建议重点看，因为它们决定这个方法是“工程技巧”还是“可推广机制”。
summary.reading_guide: 这篇虽然标成 skim，但如果你在跟 diffusion LM，可以比普通 skim 多花一点时间。先看 Background，把作者放在 D3PM、SEDD、MDLM、LLaDA、Dream 这条线上的定位弄清楚。然后直接看 Figure 1 和方法部分，理解为什么 DLLM 的 cache stale 问题和 AR 完全不同。接着看 Anchor Token 的定义与选择方式，这是整篇最核心的机制。实验部分优先看三类图表：质量-重算比例曲线、不同 affix 位置的结果、以及 Nano-vLLM 原型下的 latency / throughput 数据。预计 25 到 35 分钟能抓住主要内容。若要深挖，建议思考两个问题：一是 Anchor 重要性是否能在训练时被显式建模；二是这种稀疏重算是否能和更少 denoising steps、speculative decoding 或 hybrid AR+diffusion 框架结合。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper tackles a concrete inference bottleneck in diffusion LLMs: how to reuse cache without suffering from stale KV states under bidirectional attention. In autoregressive models, prefix caching works because past token states do not depend on future generated tokens. In DLLMs, each denoising step uses full bidirectional attention, so even the KV states of shared prompt or context tokens become coupled to the evolving masked response. Naive reuse hurts quality, while full recomputation is expensive. ACache asks a narrower and more useful question: can we recompute only the truly critical shared tokens and reuse the rest?
summary_en.importance: Its direct impact on pretraining is limited, but its importance for alternative language-modeling paradigms is real. Diffusion LMs are becoming more credible at scale, yet inference efficiency remains one of their main practical weaknesses relative to AR models. Much of the discussion around DLLMs focuses on parallel decoding, but that misses the cost of repeated full-sequence recomputation. ACache is useful because it reframes the systems problem from “can DLLMs cache at all?” to “which shared tokens actually need refreshing?” If that framing holds, it suggests that DLLM efficiency is not only about reducing denoising steps or improving schedules, but also about finer-grained state management. That can eventually feed back into model design and training objectives.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The main idea is affix-oriented cache reuse. Instead of restricting reuse to shared prefixes, the paper generalizes it to any shared contiguous span, or affix, which may appear at the beginning, middle, or end of the context. This is a natural systems opportunity created by bidirectional attention: unlike AR models, DLLMs are not inherently prefix-centric.

The key challenge is deciding which affix-token KV states become meaningfully stale as the masked generation tokens evolve. ACache introduces Anchor Tokens for this purpose. It measures the cross-attention importance from masked generation tokens to affix tokens, identifies a small request-specific subset of influential affix tokens, and recomputes KV states only for those anchors. The remaining affix-token cache is reused. In effect, the method turns a coarse full-span refresh decision into a sparse token-level refresh decision.

Implementation-wise, ACache is built on top of Fast-dLLM. It replaces periodic full-cache recomputation with selective anchor-token recomputation, so it is an incremental but targeted improvement over existing approximate caching frameworks rather than a completely new inference stack. The authors also implement a shared-prefix prototype in Nano-vLLM to test whether the gains survive under a more realistic serving environment with paged memory management and continuous batching.

Relative to prior work, the distinction is clear. dLLM-Cache uses asymmetric prompt/response refresh and feature-similarity-based partial recomputation for response tokens. dKV-Cache focuses more on decoded-token reuse with delayed block recomputation. Fast-dLLM improves the overall inference framework but still relies on periodic refresh. ACache is novel in treating shared context itself as the optimization target and shrinking the recomputation unit from an entire shared span to a request-specific token subset.
summary_en.experiments:
The main results operate at three levels. First, quality recovery: compared with direct affix-cache reuse, which causes noticeable degradation, ACache recovers most of the lost accuracy across multiple benchmarks while recomputing only around 20% of affix tokens. That number matters because it suggests the stale-cache problem is sparse enough to be exploitable. Second, system gains: in the Nano-vLLM shared-prefix prototype, ACache reduces recomputation latency by up to 55.7% and improves end-to-end throughput by up to 1.68x. This indicates that the benefit is not just a FLOP-level argument but can survive a realistic serving stack. Third, scope: the method applies to shared spans beyond prefixes, which is practically relevant because reusable text in production often appears as retrieved snippets, tool outputs, templates, or summarized dialogue history rather than only as a left prefix.

For a researcher, the most informative part is likely the ablation structure rather than any single headline number: how stable the anchor-selection rule is, how quality changes as the recomputation ratio varies, whether affix position matters, and how stale-cache error accumulates across denoising steps. If the paper includes those plots, they are the ones worth studying closely.
summary_en.reading_guide: Although marked as skim, this deserves a bit more attention if you follow diffusion LMs. Start with the background to place the work in the D3PM/SEDD/MDLM/LLaDA/Dream line. Then go straight to Figure 1 and the method section to understand why DLLM cache staleness is fundamentally different from AR caching. After that, focus on the definition and selection of Anchor Tokens; that is the core mechanism. In experiments, prioritize three things: quality-versus-recompute curves, results by affix position, and the Nano-vLLM latency/throughput measurements. Around 25 to 35 minutes should be enough for the main ideas. Two deeper follow-up questions are especially interesting: whether anchor importance can be modeled during training, and whether sparse recomputation can be combined with fewer denoising steps, speculative decoding, or hybrid AR-diffusion systems.

recommendation.zh: Diffusion LM 真正落地卡在“缓存不可复用”，这篇给了一个可操作的近似：只重算影响最大的 20% affix；重点看 Anchor 选择准不准、以及真实吞吐提升。
recommendation.en: Diffusion LMs often fail in practice due to non-reusable caches; this offers an actionable approximation—recompute only the most influential ~20% affix tokens. Check how anchors are selected and whether throughput gains hold in real serving.

paper.title: Serving Masked Diffusion LLMs: Characterization and Design Principles from Real Hardware
paper.abstract: Masked diffusion language models (dLLMs) can in principle generate text faster than autoregressive (AR) models, since they denoise many tokens at once. Recent systems have begun building serving infrastructure for dLLMs, but none first measure how these models behave under real, concurrent serving load. Serving systems built without this grounding risk carrying over assumptions from AR serving that may not hold for dLLMs. We characterize dLLM serving to close this gap, using LLaDA-8B-Instruct wi

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作研究 masked diffusion LLM 在真实并发 serving 负载下的行为，核心问题是：不能直接把 autoregressive serving 的连续 batching 假设搬到 diffusion LLM 上。
summary.importance: 这篇对预训练范式研究有间接但明确的价值。masked diffusion LM 的训练目标和生成过程与 AR 模型不同，但如果 serving 侧没有清楚的性能模型，范式优势很难落到系统吞吐和延迟上。作者的贡献不是提出新模型，而是用真实硬件测量给出 dLLM serving 的几个约束：请求难度不可在 admission time 可靠预测，denoising step 数呈离散层级，host-side dispatch 成本很高，短输出 benchmark 会低估服务方差。这些结论会影响 dLLM 训练目标、解码算法和 serving co-design。
summary.technical_approach: 作者使用 LLaDA-8B-Instruct，并加载 D2F（Discrete Diffusion Forcing）LoRA adapter，在单张 NVIDIA H200 上做测量。分析维度包括 GSM8K 上的 difficulty tier、可预测性、batching、scheduling，以及 HumanEval 上的 block-size invariance 和 variance structure。文中明确区分 continuous batching 和 synchronized batching。AR serving 中的 continuous batching 依赖一个性质：每个请求每轮生成一个 token，活跃请求可以共享一次 forward，完成的请求被换出，新请求被换入。masked diffusion decoding 则不同，一个请求每一步是在块内并行去噪，且不同请求需要的 denoising steps 不同。若照搬 AR-style continuous batching，可能导致每个活跃请求每个 denoising step 都触发独立 dispatch，反而破坏 dLLM 本来可以共享 batch forward 的计算形态。作者因此把 synchronized batching 作为 dLLM serving 的自然执行模式来刻画：同一 batch 内请求按 denoising step 同步推进。
summary.experiments: 主要实验在单 H200 上完成。模型是 LLaDA-8B-Instruct + D2F LoRA。作者报告四个关键测量结果：第一，请求 difficulty 不是连续分布，而是离散层级，并且 denoising step count 在 admission time 之前不可观测，影响 backfill scheduling 和 SLA 估计。第二，per-request dispatch overhead 与 batch size 高度相关，在小 batch 下相差约 20%–27%，到 B=8 时几乎完全匹配。第三，单请求延迟中约 76% 来自主机侧 dispatch，而不是 GPU device compute，这说明优化重点不能只放在 kernel 或显存复用上。第四，短 generation-length benchmark 会系统性低估实际服务方差。作者还给出一个服务运行点：在其设置下，延迟较优的 utilization 大约在 ρ≈0.70。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，预计 25–35 分钟。重点看 Introduction 对 AR continuous batching 与 dLLM synchronized batching 的区分；Section III 关于 denoising-step difficulty tier 和 admission-time unpredictability 的测量；Section IV 的 dispatch overhead 和 host/device profiling；Section V 的 batch-timeout stability rule 与 ρ≈0.70 的运行点。若关注 dLLM 预训练和解码联合设计，最值得细看的不是具体 serving 框架，而是这些测量如何反推训练目标、block size、adaptive denoising steps 和可调度性的取舍。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper characterizes masked diffusion LLM serving under concurrent load and asks whether assumptions from autoregressive serving, especially continuous batching, still apply.
summary_en.importance: The work is indirectly relevant to pretraining and model-design research. Masked diffusion LMs differ from AR models in both objective and decoding dynamics, but their practical advantage depends on whether serving systems can exploit block-parallel denoising. The paper does not introduce a new model. Its value is a hardware-grounded performance model for dLLM inference: request difficulty is not reliably known at admission time, denoising step counts form discrete tiers, host-side dispatch dominates single-request latency, and short-output benchmarks understate real serving variance. These findings matter for co-designing diffusion objectives, adaptive denoising policies, block sizes, and serving schedulers.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors measure LLaDA-8B-Instruct with a D2F LoRA adapter on a single NVIDIA H200 GPU. They study GSM8K for difficulty tiers, predictability, batching, and scheduling behavior, and HumanEval for block-size invariance and variance structure. A central conceptual distinction is between continuous batching and synchronized batching. AR systems such as vLLM and Orca rely on the fact that active requests advance one token per iteration and can share a forward pass while completed requests are swapped out. Masked diffusion decoding advances by denoising token blocks, and different requests may require different numbers of denoising steps. A naive AR-style continuous batcher can therefore increase dispatches instead of improving throughput. The paper treats synchronized batching as the natural execution mode for block-parallel dLLM decoding: requests in the same batch move together through shared denoising-step forward passes.
summary_en.experiments: All main measurements are reported on a single H200 using LLaDA-8B-Instruct plus D2F LoRA. The paper reports four main empirical findings. First, request difficulty is discrete rather than smoothly distributed, and the number of denoising steps is not observable at admission time, which complicates backfill scheduling and SLA planning. Second, per-request dispatch overhead closely tracks batch size: it is within about 20–27% at smaller batch sizes and nearly matches by B=8. Third, about 76% of single-request latency is host-side dispatch rather than device compute, so kernel-level or memory-only optimizations miss a major cost component. Fourth, short generation-length benchmarks systematically understate serving variance. The authors also identify an operating point around utilization ρ≈0.70 for better latency behavior in their setup.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in 25–35 minutes. Start with the introduction, especially the distinction between AR continuous batching and dLLM synchronized batching. Then read Section III for difficulty tiers and admission-time unpredictability, Section IV for dispatch overhead and host/device profiling, and Section V for the batch-timeout stability rule and the ρ≈0.70 utilization point. For readers interested in diffusion LM pretraining, the useful part is not the specific serving stack but the way these measurements constrain objective design, block size selection, adaptive denoising, and scheduler-friendly generation.

recommendation.zh: 做 diffusion LM 的人该看：它提醒你并行生成不自动等于好 serving，先看 step-level 离散性和 <320 token 预算失真这两个结论，再决定是否继续押注线上场景。
recommendation.en: Worth reading if you care about diffusion LMs in production: parallel generation does not automatically become good serving, and the step-level discreteness plus short-budget distortion are the two results to inspect first.

paper.title: Length-Adaptive Decoding for Masked Diffusion Machine Translation
paper.abstract: Machine translation tests masked diffusion language models (dLLMs) because every source token must be rendered faithfully, while fixed canvas decoding must choose target length before denoising. Existing masked diffusion decoding work mainly studies token unmasking order, leaving this length decision under-explored despite its direct effect on coverage and redundancy. We introduce Entropy-Valley (EV), a training-free length selector that scores candidate target canvases by mean predictive entrop

summary.core_problem: 论文解决的是 masked diffusion LM 做机器翻译时的目标长度选择问题。固定 canvas 解码需要在去噪前给定目标长度，模型训练时又倾向于填满给定长度；长度过短会丢内容，长度过长会带来重复、幻觉或语义稀释。已有 reveal-order 研究主要关心先揭示哪些 token，但这篇指出：在 dLLM 翻译里，canvas 长度本身就是一个独立瓶颈。
summary.importance: 对预训练和新型语言建模的启发在于，它把 diffusion LM 的生成控制问题具体化为“测试时如何选择可去噪的状态空间”。这不是改 MT 系统的小技巧，而是 masked diffusion/any-order LM 在开放生成之外落到条件生成任务时必须面对的结构问题。方法不训练长度预测器，也不改 backbone，只用全 mask 前向的熵信号选择长度，说明 dLLM 内部已经暴露出可用于规划生成边界的不确定性信号。这个思路可迁移到摘要、代码补全、结构化生成等固定 canvas 场景。
summary.technical_approach: 方法叫 Entropy-Valley。给定源句后，先根据语言方向构造一组候选目标长度，候选来自源长乘以若干源到目标长度比例，并额外保留 EOS 位置。对每个候选 canvas，模型只做一次 all-mask forward，不进行完整去噪；然后计算每个目标槽位预测分布的平均熵。熵最低的长度被选为最终 canvas，再用原来的 minimum-entropy decoding schedule 解码。这里的关键选择是用模型自身的“准备好填这个长度”的程度，而不是预测参考译文长度。过短 canvas 会让多个源内容被压进少数槽位，分布更不确定；过长 canvas 会产生没有明确 token 归属的空余位置，也会提高熵。与非自回归 MT 的 fertility/length predictor 不同，EV 不需要额外训练目标；与 corpus-level ratio 不同，它按句子自适应；与 reveal-order 方法不同，它改变的是去噪前的空间大小，而不是去噪顺序。
summary.experiments: 实验设置是 LLaDA-8B 的 LoRA-SFT masked diffusion MT，并在 WMT22 En→Zh、Zh→En、En→De 上测试。EV 在三个方向分别恢复了使用参考目标长度时 COMET-22 提升的 64.9%、65.3% 和 33.0%，说明 reference length 的收益有相当一部分来自可由模型自身熵信号近似的长度选择，而不是不可达的 oracle 信息。案例和覆盖分析显示，EV 不是简单拉长输出：在 WMT22 En→Zh 上，相比固定 ratio baseline，placeholder retention 从 66.9% 提升到 89.1%，number retention 从 77.6% 提升到 81.3%。论文还做了统计检验、双向专家人工评估、coverage 与错误类型分析，并控制了 reveal-order，在匹配数据的 LLaMA-3-8B AR baseline 上做对照，还在 Dream-Base 和 DiffuLLaMA 上检查跨 backbone 适用性。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读 30–40 分钟。优先看 Introduction 中对 fixed canvas 停止问题的定义，以及 Figure 1 的错误例子，这部分说明长度不是后处理细节。Method 的 Entropy-Valley 四步需要细看，尤其是 all-mask entropy 为什么能比较候选长度。实验部分重点看 reference length oracle、fixed ratio、EV 的 COMET-22 对比，以及 placeholder/number retention 的错误分析。若关注 diffusion LM 解码机制，可以继续看 reveal-order 控制实验：它能帮助区分“选多长”和“按什么顺序揭示”这两个问题。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets target-length selection in masked diffusion machine translation. Unlike an autoregressive decoder, a masked diffusion decoder must receive a target canvas before denoising starts. If the canvas is too short, content is dropped; if it is too long, the model can repeat, hallucinate, or dilute the translation. The key point is that canvas length is a separate bottleneck from token reveal order.
summary_en.importance: The work is useful for studying diffusion language models because it exposes a structural inference-time issue in fixed-canvas generation. The contribution is not a new MT architecture, but a clean way to ask whether a pretrained masked diffusion backbone can choose its own generation space without a trained length predictor. The result suggests that all-mask uncertainty is a meaningful planning signal. This idea may matter for other conditional generation settings where diffusion LMs must decide output extent before iterative denoising.
summary_en.technical_approach: Entropy-Valley builds a small candidate set of target canvas lengths from source-length ratios for each translation direction, with one extra slot reserved for EOS. For each candidate length, it runs a single all-mask forward pass and computes the mean predictive entropy over target positions. The length with the lowest mean entropy is selected, and standard minimum-entropy decoding is then run on that canvas. The method keeps the backbone, training loss, and unmasking schedule unchanged. Its distinction from classic non-autoregressive MT length prediction is that it introduces no fertility model or auxiliary objective. Its distinction from fixed corpus ratios is that the decision is sentence-specific. Its distinction from reveal-order work is that it chooses the canvas before denoising rather than changing which masks are revealed first.
summary_en.experiments: The main setting is a LoRA-SFT LLaDA-8B masked diffusion MT system on WMT22 En→Zh, Zh→En, and En→De. Entropy-Valley recovers 64.9%, 65.3%, and 33.0% of the COMET-22 gain obtained by using reference target lengths in the three directions. On WMT22 En→Zh, placeholder retention improves from 66.9% to 89.1% over the fixed-ratio baseline, and number retention improves from 77.6% to 81.3%. The evaluation also includes statistical tests, bidirectional expert human evaluation, coverage and error-type analysis, reveal-order controls, a matched-data LLaMA-3-8B autoregressive baseline, and cross-backbone checks on Dream-Base and DiffuLLaMA.
summary_en.reading_guide: A 30–40 minute skim is enough for most readers. Start with the Introduction and Figure 1 to understand why fixed-canvas length errors cause ordinary translation failures. Then read the Entropy-Valley method carefully, especially the all-mask entropy scoring rule. In the experiments, focus on the comparison against reference-length decoding, fixed-ratio decoding, and reveal-order controls. The coverage analysis is the most useful part for understanding what length selection fixes and what it does not.

recommendation.zh: 做 diffusion LM 的人该看：它把“长度”从数据统计问题改成了模型不确定性问题；先读长度诊断和人工评测，别只看平均分。
recommendation.en: Worth reading if you work on diffusion LMs: it reframes length from a corpus prior into a model-uncertainty decision; focus on the diagnostics and human eval, not just the headline metric.

paper.title: SelFusion: Self-distillation for Diffusion Language Models
paper.abstract: Diffusion language models (DLMs) alleviate the inherent latency bottleneck of autoregressive (AR) large language models (LLMs), but their degraded generation quality limits practical applicability. Although knowledge distillation (KD) can be a promising direction for improving performance, we empirically find that naively applying conventional KD yields only marginal gains, or even degrades generation quality. Based on these observations, we propose a novel self-distillation framework for DLMs,

summary.core_problem: 扩散语言模型（DLM）推理快但质量弱。论文聚焦一个很具体的问题：为什么把常规知识蒸馏（logit-level / sequence-level）直接搬到 DLM 上，经常只有小幅收益甚至掉点；以及如何在没有高质量 DLM teacher、且 AR→NAR 分布不匹配的情况下，让蒸馏真正起作用。
summary.importance: 对“非 AR 语言建模范式”的训练 recipe 有直接启发：蒸馏不一定要依赖外部 teacher，也不一定要固定 teacher→student 的单向关系。更重要的是，论文把 AR teacher 分布过尖（spiky）与 DLM 在高 mask ratio 下分布更平（flat）的 mismatch 讲清楚，并给出一个可落地的替代：利用 DLM 自身噪声/掩码强度构造不同难度视角做自蒸馏。对后续做 diffusion/any-order LM 的训练稳定性与质量提升，属于“可复用的训练技巧”级别贡献。
summary.technical_approach:
SelFusion 的核心是把同一个 DLM 变成两个“模式”来互相蒸馏：
1) easy mode vs hard mode：对同一训练样本做两次 forward，但掩码率不同。hard mode 用原始较高 masking；easy mode 用更低 masking，让模型看到更多上下文，通常能给出更可靠的 token 分布。
2) 关键问题：easy mode 不总是更对，而且低 masking 会让分布更尖、更自信；这种“错得很自信”会把 hard mode 带偏。
3) bidirectional KD（逐 token 决策蒸馏方向）：不是固定 easy→hard，而是根据 token-level correctness/置信度在两者间动态选 teacher。
- 两者都对：选对当前预测 token 给更高概率的一方作为 teacher。
- 两者都错：选对 ground-truth token 给更高概率的一方作为 teacher（避免跟着错误 top-1 走）。
- 一对一错：用正确的一方当 teacher。
4) 论文动机里强调“student-friendly teacher”：easy mode 的分布形态更接近 hard mode（同架构同参数），比 AR teacher 的极尖分布更可蒸馏；同时又通过逐 token 方向选择抑制 easy mode 的过度自信副作用。
整体上，这是把 DLM 的 noising/masking 机制当作“内生的课程学习 + 自蒸馏信号生成器”，而不是额外引入一个外部强 teacher。
summary.experiments:
全文给出的关键信息点主要是现象与机制证据：
- AR→DLM logit KD 的 mismatch：AR teacher 往往 top-1 概率接近 100%，而 DLM 在约 50% masking 时 top-1 概率约 60% 左右，导致分布匹配困难。
- easy mode 相对 hard mode：训练过程中 easy mode 对正确 token 的概率平均高约 10%（论文用来支撑“更适合作 teacher”）。
- easy mode 的风险：低 masking 会让分布更 peaked，且在错误 token 上也会过度自信；论文提到“两者都预测错”的情况约占 40%（因此需要在 both-wrong 情况下用 ground-truth 概率来选方向）。
- 任务层面：在多个 instruction-following benchmark 上，SelFusion 系统性优于依赖外部 teacher 的常规 KD；并报告“甚至超过 teacher（包括 DLM 与 LLM teacher）”。（你给的全文片段未包含具体 benchmark 名称与数值表格；若需要精确数字，需要对照论文实验表/附录。）
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议（约 25–35 分钟）：
- 先看 Figure 1：常规 KD 在 DLM 上为何不 work（结论导向）。
- 再看 Method 的三段：easy/hard 构造、为什么 easy 不总更好、以及 token-level 双向蒸馏规则（公式与三种 case）。
- 重点翻 Figure 3（masking ratio vs 分布尖锐度）和关于“both wrong 占比”的统计：这是方法成立的关键证据。
- 如果时间够，再看作者对 AR-DLM 分布 mismatch 的分析小节（文中提到 Section 4.3.5）：这部分决定你是否能把思路迁移到别的 any-order / masked / diffusion 目标上。

summary_en.core_problem: Diffusion language models decode in parallel but lag behind AR LLMs in generation quality. The paper targets a practical training question: why conventional knowledge distillation (logit-level or sequence-level) often yields marginal gains or even hurts DLMs, and how to make distillation effective when (1) AR→DLM distributions are mismatched and (2) strong DLM teachers are unavailable.
summary_en.importance: The main value is a reusable recipe for non-AR language modeling: distillation can be internal (no external teacher) and can be bidirectional rather than a fixed teacher→student pipeline. The paper also provides a concrete diagnosis of AR-to-DLM logit mismatch (overly peaky AR distributions vs flatter DLM distributions under masking), which is useful when designing training objectives for diffusion/any-order LMs.
summary_en.technical_approach:
SelFusion turns a single DLM into two “views” via different masking ratios and performs self-distillation between them.
- Two-mode forward: an easy mode with lower masking (more context) and a hard mode with higher masking (standard DLM setting).
- Naive easy→hard distillation is unsafe because low masking produces sharper, overconfident distributions, including on wrong tokens.
- Bidirectional, token-wise distillation: for each token, choose the distillation direction based on correctness and confidence.
  * both correct: distill from the mode assigning higher probability to the predicted token.
  * both wrong: distill from the mode assigning higher probability to the ground-truth token.
  * one correct: distill from the correct mode.
This design keeps the “teacher” distribution close to the student (same model family) while avoiding the failure mode where the easy view is confidently wrong.
summary_en.experiments:
Key evidence and reported outcomes include:
- Distribution mismatch: AR teachers often put ~100% mass on top-1, while DLMs at ~50% masking show ~60% top-1 probability, making logit matching ineffective.
- Easy vs hard: the easy mode assigns ~10% higher probability to the correct token on average during training.
- Failure mode prevalence: cases where both modes are wrong occur in ~40% of tokens, motivating the special handling in the bidirectional rule.
- On multiple instruction-following benchmarks, SelFusion consistently beats standard KD baselines that rely on external teachers, and is reported to even surpass the teacher models (both DLM and LLM teachers). (The provided full-text excerpt does not include the exact benchmark tables/numbers.)
summary_en.reading_guide:
Skim plan (25–35 minutes):
- Start with Figure 1 to understand the empirical failure of standard KD on DLMs.
- Read the method section focusing on (1) easy/hard construction and (2) the token-wise bidirectional decision rule.
- Check Figure 3 (masking ratio vs distribution sharpness) and the statistics on how often both modes are wrong—these justify why direction selection matters.
- If you want to transfer the idea, read the AR–DLM mismatch analysis section referenced in the text (e.g., Section 4.3.5).

recommendation.zh: 如果你在看 DLM，这篇值得读的点不是“又一个蒸馏技巧”，而是它明确说明 easy-view 并不天然是 teacher；先看失败案例和蒸馏方向判定，别急着抄 recipe。
recommendation.en: Worth reading for the negative result more than the trick itself: in DLMs, the easier view is not a reliable teacher; read the failure cases and distillation-direction logic before copying the recipe.

paper.title: CAI-DLLM: Convergence Aware Inference for Diffusion Language Models
paper.abstract: Diffusion language models can generate many tokens in parallel, but they still require repeated denoising steps during inference. This makes generation costly, especially when the model continues to recompute tokens that are already stable. To address these limitations, we propose CAI-DLLM, a training-free inference method that uses first-step confidence to guide denoising and reduce inference time. Specifically, CAI-DLLM commits easy tokens earlier, allocates more denoising steps to harder toke

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文解决 diffusion language model 推理时的重复计算问题：masked diffusion LM 能并行更新多个 token，但固定步数 denoising 会让已经稳定的 token 继续参与完整前向计算，导致生成成本偏高。
summary.importance: 这是一篇 diffusion LM 推理优化论文，对预训练研究的直接价值在于揭示了离散扩散语言模型的收敛异质性：不同位置、不同 block、不同置信度 token 的稳定速度差异很大。这个现象不仅能用于 decoding，也提示训练目标和噪声调度可以更显式地利用 token difficulty。方法本身是 training-free，对已有 LLaDA、Dream 这类 masked diffusion LM 有工程参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: CAI-dLLM 使用第一步 denoising 的置信度作为 token difficulty 信号。这个信号在标准解码中本来就会计算，因此不需要额外模型、额外前向或权重更新。方法将 token 按 first-step confidence 分成不同难度，容易的 token 早提交，困难 token 分配更多 denoising budget。论文使用的 token budget 包括 8、32、64 步。它还引入 block-level adaptive threshold schedule：后续输出 block 因为可见上下文更多，收敛通常更快，所以 block end threshold 随 block 递减。最后加入 low-yield grinding phase detector，如果连续 K 步新提交 token 很少，就提前停止后期低收益 denoising。与只做 KV cache 或 early layer skipping 的方法不同，CAI-dLLM 不是降低每一步成本，而是改变每个 token 和每个 block 的计算分配。
summary.experiments: 论文在 LLaDA-8B-Instruct 和 Dream-7B-Instruct 上评估，任务覆盖数学、代码、推理、常识和长上下文。动机实验使用 LLaDA-8B-Instruct 在 GSM8K 上生成 256 token，并划分为 4 个 64-token block，统计 1,319 个测试 prompt。结果显示 first-step confidence 对稳定时间有较强预测性：c_i(0) > 0.50 的 token 通常在 5 步内稳定；c_i(0) < 0.25 的 token 往往在 30 步后仍会变化。论文报告 CAI-dLLM 能减少推理时间，同时保持任务质量；具体速度收益和质量损失需要查看实验表格，提供内容中没有完整可核验数字。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，预计 25–35 分钟。重点看动机部分的 Figure 1：它展示 hidden-state drift、block 收敛差异和 first-step confidence 与稳定时间的关系。方法部分重点看 token budget 分配、block threshold schedule 和 low-yield early exit。实验部分建议关注 speed-quality tradeoff，而不是只看平均分。若研究 diffusion LM 训练，可以进一步思考 first-step confidence 是否能作为训练阶段的 curriculum、loss reweighting 或 adaptive noise schedule 信号。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets redundant computation in diffusion language model inference. Masked diffusion LMs can update many positions in parallel, but fixed-step denoising keeps recomputing tokens that have already stabilized.
summary_en.importance: The main value for pretraining researchers is the empirical observation that discrete diffusion LMs have strong convergence heterogeneity across tokens and output blocks. Easy tokens stabilize quickly, while low-confidence tokens need many more refinement steps. This matters beyond decoding: it suggests that token difficulty, confidence calibration, and adaptive noise schedules may be useful signals when designing or training diffusion LMs.
summary_en.technical_approach: CAI-dLLM is a training-free inference controller. It uses the confidence from the first denoising step as a token-level difficulty estimate, which comes for free because the first forward pass is already required. High-confidence tokens are committed early, low-confidence tokens receive larger denoising budgets, and budgets are chosen from 8, 32, and 64 steps. The method also uses a block-level adaptive threshold schedule: later output blocks receive lower end thresholds because they tend to converge faster with more committed context. A low-yield detector exits late denoising when too few new tokens are committed for K consecutive steps. Compared with KV-cache-based or layer-skipping methods, CAI-dLLM changes the allocation of denoising steps across tokens and blocks rather than only reducing the cost of each step.
summary_en.experiments: The evaluation uses LLaDA-8B-Instruct and Dream-7B-Instruct on math, code, reasoning, commonsense, and long-context tasks. The motivation study runs LLaDA-8B-Instruct on GSM8K with 256 generated tokens split into four 64-token blocks over 1,319 prompts. Tokens with first-step confidence above 0.50 usually stabilize within five steps, while tokens below 0.25 often keep changing after more than 30 steps. The paper reports lower inference time with comparable task quality, but exact speedup and quality tradeoff numbers should be read from the experimental tables because they are not fully available in the provided content.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 25–35 minutes. Start with the motivation figures showing hidden-state drift, block-level convergence, and the relationship between first-step confidence and stabilization time. Then read the controller design: token budget assignment, block threshold scheduling, and low-yield early exit. For diffusion-LM researchers, the most useful part is not only the decoding heuristic, but the evidence that early confidence is a stable proxy for token difficulty.

recommendation.zh: 做 diffusion LM 的可以直接看：它不改训练只改调度，却拿到大幅加速，若结果站得住，说明“首步置信度≈收敛难度”这个 prior 值得立刻做内部复现。
recommendation.en: Worth reading if you care about diffusion LMs: it changes only inference scheduling yet claims large speedups, and if the setup holds, the key prior to test is that first-step confidence tracks convergence difficulty.

paper.title: Accelerating Diffusion Language Models via Structured Suffix Modeling
paper.abstract: Diffusion Language Models (DLMs) exhibit strong parallel decoding capabilities by denoising multiple tokens in a single generation step. However, this parallelism comes with substantial computational overhead, as each step requires interactions with all suffix tokens. Existing methods typically reduce this cost by retaining only a local suffix window as a substitute for the full suffix. Despite their effectiveness, these methods overlook the structural heterogeneity across suffix regions and re-

summary.core_problem: Diffusion Language Models (DLMs) 在并行解码时，每个生成步都需要计算大量后缀 token 的注意力，导致严重的计算开销，而现有的后缀丢弃（suffix dropout）方法忽略了后缀不同区域的结构异质性，且在每个时间步都重新初始化后缀 token，丢失了迭代去噪过程中的演化信息。
summary.importance: 提出了一种针对 DLM 推理加速的免训练（training-free）结构化后缀建模方法，揭示了后缀 token 在不同区域扮演不同角色（上下文、结构、边界），为非自回归/并行解码的效率优化提供了新的视角。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 SSM (Structured Suffix Modeling) 框架：1) 区域化后缀保留：将后缀分为局部（保留所有相邻 token 以提供细粒度上下文）、中间（仅保留每个块的起始 token 作为轻量级结构锚点）和尾部（额外保留最后一个 token 以维持边界信息）三个区域；2) 软后缀嵌入（Soft Suffix Embedding）：在每个时间步，将上一步的解码结果融入当前步的后缀 token 表示中，使后缀 token 能够携带跨生成步的演化去噪信息。
summary.experiments: 在 LLaDA-Instruct、LLaDA-1.5 和 Dream-Base 上进行了数学推理和代码生成实验。结果表明，SSM 在保持竞争性准确率的同时一致降低了推理延迟。在长序列推理中，结合其他加速技术（如并行解码和 KV cache），最高可实现 72.81 倍的加速比。
summary.reading_guide: 建议重点关注 Method 部分对后缀注意力分布的分析（Figure 1，揭示了不同区域 token 的重要性差异），以及软后缀嵌入机制的具体实现。该方法作为一种免训练的推理优化策略，其与现有 KV cache 等技术的正交性值得关注。

summary_en.core_problem: In Diffusion Language Models (DLMs), parallel decoding incurs substantial computational overhead because each generation step requires computing attention for a large number of suffix tokens. Existing suffix dropout methods overlook the structural heterogeneity of different suffix regions and re-initialize suffix tokens at each timestep, discarding evolving information during iterative denoising.
summary_en.importance: Introduces a training-free structured suffix modeling method for accelerating DLM inference. It reveals that suffix tokens in different regions serve distinct roles (contextual, structural, boundary), offering a new perspective for efficiency optimization in non-autoregressive/parallel decoding.
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes the SSM (Structured Suffix Modeling) framework: 1) Region-aware suffix retention: divides the suffix into local (retains all neighboring tokens for fine-grained context), middle (retains only the start token of each block as a lightweight structural anchor), and tail (additionally retains the final token for boundary cues) regions. 2) Soft Suffix Embedding: incorporates the decoding results from the previous step into the current step's suffix token representations, enabling them to carry evolving denoising information across generation steps.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluated on mathematical reasoning and code generation benchmarks using LLaDA-Instruct, LLaDA-1.5, and Dream-Base. SSM consistently reduces inference latency while maintaining competitive accuracy. In long-sequence inference, it achieves up to a 72.81x speedup when combined with other acceleration techniques.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on the Method section's analysis of the suffix attention distribution (Figure 1, which motivates the region-aware strategy) and the implementation of the soft suffix embedding mechanism. The orthogonality of this training-free method to existing techniques like KV cache is particularly noteworthy.

recommendation.zh: DLM 是否能实用很大程度卡在解码成本；先读方法和速度-质量曲线，重点看非均匀 suffix 是否真能稳定省算。
recommendation.en: DLM practicality is still constrained by decoding cost; read the method and speed-quality curves, especially whether nonuniform suffix retention saves compute robustly.

paper.title: GRAFT: Adaptive DLM-Based Draft Tree Construction with Target-Distilled Edge Scoring
paper.abstract: Tree-based speculative decoding raises the mean accepted tokens of standard speculative decoding by verifying multiple draft paths, and existing tree builders typically construct these paths through parent-conditioned expansion, where each child token is generated conditioned on its parent path. This construction is incompatible with diffusion language model (DLM) drafters such as DFlash, which produces all future-position distributions in a single forward pass. DDTree bridges this gap by treati

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作处理的是 DLM drafter 下的树式 speculative decoding 怎么真正把“一次前向得到的多位置分布”变成高质量 draft tree。问题不在于能不能拼出树，而在于现有 DDTree 这类做法把每个 future position 的高概率 token 当作独立候选，再按边际概率组装路径，缺少父子兼容性建模。结果是 target 真正会接受的 token 可能已经在树里，但挂在了错误父节点下，导致验证时走不到那条路径。另一个问题是固定 node budget：不同 decoding round 的难度不同，额外节点带来的 accepted length 增益和 verification cost 的权衡也不同，固定预算会在容易轮次浪费验证算力，在困难轮次又给得不够。
summary.importance: 对预训练本身的直接贡献不大，它更偏 serving / inference optimization；但对“非 AR drafter 如何接入现有解码基础设施”这个问题给出了比较完整的答案。更具体地说，它把 DLM drafter 的优势——一次前向给出多位置分布——转化成了可操作的 tree construction 问题，并指出仅靠 token marginal probability 不够，必须显式建模 parent-child compatibility。这一点对 diffusion LM、masked/parallel LM 一类非标准自回归建模范式很关键：这些模型若要进入实际系统，不能只看单步 perplexity 或 acceptance，要看它们如何与 verification protocol 对接。SABA 也提供了一个有用视角：speculative decoding 的最优策略不是静态 recipe，而是 state-dependent control 问题。
summary.technical_approach:
方法分成两部分：TDES 和 SABA。

TDES（Target-Distilled Edge Scoring）解决父子错配。现有 DDTree 的边选择近似是 parent-agnostic 的：child token 在不同 parent 下贡献相同，只由该位置的 token probability 决定。GRAFT 改成显式给 edge 打分。做法是从 target model 的验证轨迹里蒸馏一个轻量 edge scorer，输入是相邻位置候选节点及其上下文特征，输出该 parent-child transition 被 target 接受的兼容性分数。然后树构建时不再只按各位置 token 概率乘积选路径，而是结合 edge score 进行 parent-conditional 组装。这样保留了 DLM 一次前向产出候选节点的优点，又补上了“节点之间是否能连成 target 偏好的路径”这一层信息。

从机制上看，这一步很像把 target 的局部条件分布偏好压缩成一个便宜的结构预测器。它不是重新跑 target，也不是让 drafter 变成 AR，而是在 assembly 阶段补一个 learned compatibility model。相比直接增大候选集，这种做法更有效，因为问题不是候选 token 不在，而是树结构把它们接错了。

SABA（State-Aware Budget Allocation）解决固定预算失配。作者把每轮 throughput 看成 accepted gain 与 verification overhead 的函数，学习一个按当前 decoding state 选择 tree budget 的策略。直觉上，easy round 本来 acceptance 就长，再加节点收益很快饱和；hard round 适度扩树更值钱，但也不是越大越好。SABA 用当前轮的状态特征预测不同 budget 下的收益，选 throughput 最优预算。这里的关键不是复杂控制器，而是把“树大小”从静态超参变成在线决策变量。

整体上，GRAFT 没有改 DLM 本身，也没有改 target verification 机制，而是专门优化 DLM-based tree assembly 这一层。这种切分是合理的，因为瓶颈正出在 one-pass future distributions 到 executable tree 的映射。
summary.experiments:
文中实验覆盖多种模型和数据集，主结论是端到端吞吐提升稳定，且额外开销很小。作者报告 GRAFT 相对基线可带来 2.13× 到 6.36× 的 end-to-end inference throughput 提升，每轮新增开销低于 0.5 ms。这个量级说明方法不是靠重型 reranking 换来的。

更关键的是消融结论。TDES 单独带来更高的 MAT，说明父子兼容性确实是 DLM tree construction 的主要误差源，而不是简单的候选覆盖不足。文中用案例和统计都展示了 parent-child mismatch 在不同任务上普遍存在：target-compatible token 往往已被候选集捕获，但因边连接错误而无法形成可接受路径。SABA 的消融则表明固定 budget 并不稳健，不同 round 的最优预算差异明显；动态分配后，verification cost 增长被控制，而 accepted length 的收益保留得更好。

如果从系统角度看，最值得注意的不是单个 benchmark 的绝对数值，而是两点：一是收益在多任务上比较一致，说明问题定义抓得准；二是 overhead 足够低，说明 edge scorer 和 budget policy 没有破坏 speculative decoding 的成本结构。文中还强调 throughput 最优 budget 会随 round 难度变化，这一点比“某个固定大树最好”更可信。
summary.reading_guide:
这篇适合泛读，但建议把引言、方法和消融图表看仔细。

优先看三处。第一是引言里对两个失败模式的定义：parent-child mismatch 和 budget misallocation。这里决定了整篇工作的价值，如果认同这两个问题，后面的设计就顺了。第二是 TDES 的训练信号和特征设计，重点看它如何从 target traces 构造监督、edge scorer 到底学的是什么，以及它与简单概率乘积的区别。第三是 SABA 的目标函数与状态特征，确认它是不是在直接优化 throughput，而不是只优化 acceptance。

图表上，建议重点看展示错误案例的图、MAT/throughput 对比表、以及 budget 变化与收益饱和关系的曲线。阅读时间大约 25–35 分钟。若只想抓住要点，看问题定义 + 两个模块 + 消融即可。若想深挖，可以进一步想两个问题：一，edge scorer 是否会过拟合某个 target，迁移到相邻 target 时还能否成立；二，SABA 能否扩展到更一般的 adaptive verification policy，而不只是 budget 选择。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies how to build a useful draft tree for speculative decoding when the drafter is a diffusion language model that predicts distributions for multiple future positions in one pass. Existing DLM tree builders such as DDTree assemble trees from per-position high-probability tokens using marginal token probabilities only. That misses parent-child compatibility: a token that the target would accept may already be present in the tree, but attached to the wrong parent path. The second issue is fixed node budget. Different decoding rounds have different difficulty, so the trade-off between extra accepted tokens and verification cost is round-dependent. A static budget wastes verification on easy rounds and under-explores hard ones.
summary_en.importance: This is not a pretraining paper in the narrow sense; it is mainly an inference/serving paper. Still, it matters for pretraining researchers interested in non-AR language modeling because it addresses a practical bottleneck: how to plug DLM-style drafters into speculative decoding infrastructure. The key lesson is that one-pass future-position distributions are not enough by themselves. Once a non-AR model is used as a drafter, the quality of the induced tree structure becomes a first-order issue. The paper also frames speculative decoding as a state-dependent control problem rather than a fixed recipe, which is a useful systems perspective for any alternative LM paradigm that needs target-side verification.
summary_en.technical_approach:
GRAFT has two components: TDES and SABA.

TDES, or Target-Distilled Edge Scoring, addresses parent-child mismatch. DDTree is effectively parent-agnostic: a child token contributes the same score regardless of which parent path it extends, because scoring is driven by per-position token probabilities. GRAFT instead learns an explicit edge scorer distilled from target-model traces. The scorer takes candidate parent-child pairs from adjacent positions, together with contextual features, and predicts how compatible that transition is with the target model. Tree assembly then uses these edge scores, rather than only the product of marginal token probabilities, to select target-compatible paths under a node budget.

Mechanistically, this is a lightweight structural predictor that compresses local target preferences into a cheap model. It does not rerun the target and does not force the DLM drafter into autoregressive expansion. It patches the missing conditional dependency at the tree-assembly stage. That is the right intervention point, because the failure mode is not merely missing candidate tokens; it is incorrect attachment among already available candidates.

SABA, or State-Aware Budget Allocation, addresses budget misallocation. The paper models per-round throughput as a trade-off between draft gain and verification cost, then chooses the budget conditioned on the current decoding state. Easy rounds already have long accepted prefixes, so larger trees mostly add cost. Hard rounds benefit more from extra nodes, but only up to a saturation point. SABA predicts the utility of different budgets from state features and selects the throughput-optimal one online.

Overall, GRAFT leaves the DLM and the target verification mechanism unchanged. It focuses specifically on the mapping from one-pass future distributions to an executable draft tree. That decomposition is sensible and technically clean.
summary_en.experiments:
The main empirical claim is consistent end-to-end throughput improvement with very small overhead. The paper reports 2.13x to 6.36x throughput gains over baselines across models and datasets, while adding less than 0.5 ms overhead per decoding round. That matters because it suggests the method is not trading away the cost structure of speculative decoding.

The ablations are more informative than the headline numbers. TDES improves MAT, indicating that parent-child compatibility is a real bottleneck for DLM-based tree construction. The paper shows both examples and aggregate evidence that target-compatible tokens are often already present among candidates, but become unusable because they are connected to the wrong parent. SABA shows that a fixed budget is not robust: the throughput-optimal tree size varies substantially across rounds. Dynamic allocation preserves most of the acceptance gain while avoiding unnecessary verification cost.

From a systems perspective, the strongest result is not a single benchmark number but the combination of stable gains across tasks and low added latency. That makes the method more credible as a practical layer on top of DLM drafters.
summary_en.reading_guide:
This is a skim paper, but the introduction, method section, and ablations are worth reading carefully.

Focus on three things. First, the two failure modes defined in the introduction: parent-child mismatch and budget misallocation. If those are convincing, the rest of the paper follows naturally. Second, inspect how TDES gets supervision from target traces and what features the edge scorer actually uses. The important question is what information is added beyond marginal token probabilities. Third, check whether SABA is optimizing throughput directly or only a proxy such as acceptance length.

For figures and tables, prioritize the mismatch examples, the MAT/throughput comparisons, and the curves showing diminishing returns with larger budgets. Expected reading time is about 25 to 35 minutes. If reading selectively, the problem setup, the two modules, and the ablations are enough. If reading more deeply, two follow-up questions are worth keeping in mind: how target-specific the distilled edge scorer is, and whether the budget policy can generalize to broader adaptive verification strategies.

recommendation.zh: 如果你在看DLM当draft的推测解码，这篇只需盯住“edge scoring如何蒸馏自target”和预算自适应；没给关键数字前先当工程信号。
recommendation.en: If you care about DLM-as-drafter speculation, focus on the target-distilled edge scoring and adaptive budget; treat it as an engineering signal until numbers are clear.

institutions: Huazhong University of Science and Technology

paper.title: CForce: Boosting Parallel Decoding for dLLMs via Consistency Forcing
paper.abstract: Diffusion large language models (dLLMs) accelerate language generation by predicting multiple masks in a single forward pass. However, existing dLLMs can suffer from unreliable predictions in early denoising stages under aggressive parallelism strategies, leading to errors that can propagate to later stages. To tackle this issue, we present Consistency Forcing (CForce) for dLLMs, a distillation method to force the mask predictions of early stages to align with those of later stages. CForce train

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作解决的是 diffusion LLM 在高并行解码下的一个核心瓶颈：早期去噪阶段的预测不可靠，尤其在 aggressive threshold decoding 时，模型会一次性提交很多 token，但这些 token 当时可用上下文还很弱，错误一旦提交就会向后传播，导致速度上去了、质量却明显掉。作者认为，dLLM 的加速问题不能只理解为“减少 denoising step 数”，更关键的是“让早期阶段在高并行承诺下也更可靠”。这个问题在 edit-capable dLLM 上更突出，因为后期 token-to-token refinement 阶段拥有更丰富上下文，也可能修正早期草稿；如果训练时没有显式利用这种后期信息去约束早期预测，推理时就会出现训练-推理错位：模型被要求在最难、信息最少的阶段做高置信提交，但训练目标并没有专门优化这一点。
summary.importance: 对新型语言建模范式研究，这篇论文的价值很明确。第一，它把 dLLM 的解码效率问题重新表述为 early-stage reliability 问题，而不是单纯的采样步数问题。这是一个更贴近实际系统瓶颈的视角，因为高 TPF（tokens per forward）只有在早期预测足够稳时才真正有意义。第二，它提出的训练方式不是依赖外部 teacher 或构造的 privileged trajectory，而是沿着模型自己的 self-rollout threshold-decoding 轨迹做相邻阶段一致性蒸馏，这直接改善了 training-inference alignment。对于 diffusion LM，这一点比单纯做离线蒸馏更关键。第三，它把 consistency model 的思想移植到离散 masked diffusion LM，并针对 still-masked positions 设计了 confidence-adaptive KL，再配合 reveal-boundary 的 CE anchor 和 curriculum。这个组合不是概念性嫁接，而是紧扣 dLLM 的具体误差来源。第四，结果显示在 edit-capable LLaDA2.1-mini 上，速度和质量可以同时提升；在 non-edit LLaDA2.0-mini 上，则呈现清晰的 speed-quality trade-off。也就是说，这个方法既揭示了 edit-capable dLLM 的额外可蒸馏结构，也说明其收益边界与模型是否支持后期修正密切相关。
summary.technical_approach:
方法核心是 Consistency Forcing（CForce）。训练起点是一个预训练好的 dLLM。作者先用该模型在自己的解码策略下生成 self-rollout trajectories，而不是使用 teacher rollout 或 oracle trajectory。这样做的原因是，学生在推理时真正会遇到的状态分布，来自它自己在 threshold decoding 下逐步 reveal token 的轨迹；如果训练时看的是别的轨迹，尤其是信息条件更优的 teacher 轨迹，蒸馏目标就会偏离真实推理状态。

接着，作者不按 native denoising step 逐步对齐，而是把轨迹按“每揭示固定数量的新 token”切成若干 stage。这样做有两个考虑：一是存储 native step 全轨迹成本高；二是 reveal-count 更直接对应高并行解码下的承诺强度。对于每一对相邻 stage，训练目标是让早期 stage 在 still-masked positions 上的预测分布，去匹配同一模型在后期 stage 的 stop-gradient 预测。这里没有冻结 teacher，teacher 就是同一个模型在更后状态下的输出。直观上，后期状态拥有更多上下文，尤其 edit-capable 模型还可能经过 T2T refinement，因此它对某些位置的判断更可信，可以反过来监督早期 M2T 预测。

关键损失设计有两部分。第一部分是 Confidence Adaptive KL Divergence（CAD），用于 still-masked positions 的分布对齐。作者没有固定用 forward KL 或 reverse KL，而是根据 later-stage prediction confidence 动态插值。原因在于两者偏好不同：forward KL 更覆盖 teacher 支持集，reverse KL 更偏 mode-seeking。后期预测若置信度高，更适合强调 mode-seeking；若置信度低，则需要更保守地保留分布质量。CAD 试图把这两种偏好按置信度自适应结合。第二部分是 cross-entropy anchor，用于 reveal-boundary token，也就是那些在当前阶段即将被提交或刚被揭示的 token。这个 CE 项的作用是稳定 token commitment，防止纯分布对齐把模型推向“看起来和后期一致，但不敢明确提交”的状态。

此外，作者加入了 reveal difficulty curriculum。因为越早期、越高并行的阶段越难，直接在最激进的 reveal 设置上做相邻阶段蒸馏容易不稳定。课程学习让模型先在较容易的 reveal 条件下学会一致性，再逐步过渡到更难的高并行情形。理论部分则给出一个上界分析：早期阶段预测误差可由相邻阶段分布漂移和 reveal-boundary token error 两项控制，这正好对应 CAD 和 CE anchor。这个理论不是完整收敛证明，但它把损失设计和误差来源一一对应起来，解释了为什么不是只用 KL，也不是只用 CE。
summary.experiments:
实验最关键的结果出现在两个模型上。对 edit-capable 的 LLaDA2.1-mini，CForce 把平均 TPF 从 6.94 提升到 9.08，同时平均准确率从 85.57 提升到 86.41。这个结果很重要，因为它不是常见的“更快但略差”，而是在作者的设置下实现了速度和质量同时改善，说明后期 T2T refinement 确实为早期阶段提供了有价值的蒸馏信号。对 non-edit 的 LLaDA2.0-mini，CForce 把平均 TPF 从 3.60 提升到 6.42，但这里更像显式的 speed-quality trade-off：在激进解码下 few-step accuracy 更好，在固定 TPF 预算下也优于基线，但不像 edit-capable 模型那样自然获得双升。这和方法动机一致，因为 non-edit 模型后期状态没有 T2T 修正带来的额外信息增益。

从全文叙述看，实验还包含几类关键分析。第一类是不同解码预算或不同 threshold aggressiveness 下的质量曲线，验证 CForce 的收益主要集中在高并行、少步数区域，而不是所有设置都平均提升。第二类是损失项消融，比较 CAD、纯 forward KL、纯 reverse KL、以及是否加 CE anchor。这里最值得关注的是 CAD 是否在高置信和低置信区域都更稳，以及 CE anchor 对 token commitment 的帮助有多大。第三类是 curriculum 的作用，通常会体现在训练稳定性或最终 few-step accuracy 上。第四类是 edit-capable 与 non-edit 模型的对比，这部分实际上回答了一个更深的问题：一致性蒸馏到底是在利用“更多上下文”，还是在利用“后期可修正的更优轨迹状态”。从主结果看，两者都有，但后者在 LLaDA2.1 上更明显。

如果精读实验，建议特别留意作者如何定义 accuracy、TPF 的统计方式、block diffusion 设置、以及 self-rollout trajectory 的采样与缓存成本。因为这类方法在论文里看起来只是多一个蒸馏目标，落到系统实现时，trajectory collection 和 stage partition 的开销会直接决定它是否适合大规模训练。
summary.reading_guide:
建议先读 Introduction 和 Preliminaries，把 block diffusion、M2T、T2T refinement、threshold decoding 这些对象关系理顺。若不先搞清楚 edit-capable dLLM 与普通 masked diffusion 的区别，很容易低估这篇方法为什么对 LLaDA2.1 更有效。

然后重点读方法章节里关于 self-rollout trajectory、stage partition、CAD、CE anchor 的定义。这里有三个关键问题要带着看：为什么必须用 self-rollout 而不是 teacher rollout；为什么按 reveal-count 切 stage 而不是 native step；为什么 KL 需要按 later-stage confidence 自适应，而不是固定一种方向。理论分析部分建议一起看，因为它把 CAD 和 CE 的必要性讲得比较清楚。

实验部分优先看两张主图和主表：LLaDA2.1-mini 上 TPF/accuracy 同时提升，LLaDA2.0-mini 上 speed-quality trade-off。接着看消融，尤其是 CAD 对比 forward/reverse KL、是否加 CE anchor、以及 curriculum 的影响。如果你做 diffusion LM 或 any-order LM，这篇最值得深挖的点不是单个数字，而是它提出的训练-推理对齐思路：让模型在自己真实会走到的早期状态上，向自己更后期、更有信息的状态学习。泛读大约 40 分钟可抓住主线；若要复现或迁移到别的 dLLM，至少需要 1.5 到 2 小时把 trajectory 构造、损失定义和解码设置读细。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses a central bottleneck in diffusion LLM decoding: under aggressive parallel decoding, early denoising stages make unreliable predictions, and once many tokens are committed too early, those errors propagate through the rest of the trajectory. The authors argue that dLLM acceleration should not be framed only as reducing the number of denoising steps. The harder and more relevant problem is improving early-stage reliability when the model is forced to reveal many tokens with limited context. This is especially acute for edit-capable dLLMs, where later token-to-token refinement stages have richer context and can revise earlier drafts, yet standard training does not explicitly teach early predictions to align with those stronger later states.
summary_en.importance: This is a meaningful contribution to alternative language modeling paradigms. First, it reframes dLLM efficiency around early-stage reliability rather than step count alone, which is closer to the actual failure mode in high-TPF decoding. Second, it improves training-inference alignment by distilling along the model’s own self-rollout threshold-decoding trajectories instead of relying on external teachers or privileged trajectories. That design choice is particularly important for diffusion LMs, where the state distribution seen at inference can differ sharply from teacher-generated trajectories. Third, it adapts consistency-style training to discrete masked diffusion language models with a confidence-adaptive KL objective and a token-commitment anchor, both tailored to the actual sources of decoding error. Fourth, the empirical pattern is informative: edit-capable models can gain both speed and quality, while non-edit models show a clearer speed-quality trade-off. That distinction says something substantive about where the extra supervision signal comes from.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The method, Consistency Forcing (CForce), starts from a pretrained dLLM and collects self-rollout trajectories under the model’s own decoding policy. This is a deliberate choice. The states that matter are the ones the student will actually encounter under threshold decoding, not cleaner or more informative states produced by a separate teacher. Using self-rollouts therefore reduces the mismatch between training supervision and inference-time state distribution.

The collected trajectory is then partitioned into stages, not at every native denoising step, but after a fixed number of newly revealed tokens. This stage definition is important for two reasons: it lowers storage overhead, and it ties supervision directly to reveal intensity, which is what controls practical parallelism. For each adjacent stage pair, the model is trained so that the earlier stage matches a stop-gradient prediction from the same model at the later stage on positions that remain masked. There is no frozen teacher. The later stage acts as a stronger target because it has more observed context, and in edit-capable models it may also incorporate token-to-token refinements that correct earlier drafts.

The loss has two main components. The first is Confidence Adaptive KL Divergence (CAD), used to align distributions on still-masked positions. Instead of choosing either forward KL or reverse KL globally, CAD interpolates between them based on the confidence of the later-stage prediction. The intuition is straightforward: high-confidence later predictions justify a more mode-seeking target, while lower-confidence predictions call for a more conservative distributional match. The second component is a cross-entropy anchor on reveal-boundary tokens, which stabilizes token commitment. Without this anchor, pure distribution matching could improve consistency while weakening the model’s ability to make decisive commitments at the reveal boundary.

The paper also introduces a curriculum over reveal difficulty. Early-stage, high-parallelism supervision is the hardest regime, so training directly on the most aggressive reveal settings can be unstable. The curriculum gradually increases difficulty. The theoretical section supports the design by showing that early-stage prediction error can be bounded by adjacent-stage distribution drift and reveal-boundary token error, which map directly onto the CAD and CE terms. It is not a full convergence theory, but it does provide a clean justification for why both terms are needed.
summary_en.experiments:
The headline results are on two LLaDA variants. On the edit-capable LLaDA2.1-mini, CForce increases average Tokens Per Forward from 6.94 to 9.08 while also improving average accuracy from 85.57 to 86.41. That is the strongest result in the paper because it shows simultaneous gains in speed and quality, consistent with the claim that later T2T-refined states provide useful supervision for earlier M2T predictions. On the non-edit LLaDA2.0-mini, CForce raises average TPF from 3.60 to 6.42, but the effect is better described as an explicit speed-quality trade-off. The model performs better under aggressive few-step decoding and at fixed TPF budgets, yet the gains are not as cleanly dual-improving as in the edit-capable case.

The full paper also appears to include several important analyses. One is performance under different decoding budgets or threshold aggressiveness, which should show that the gains concentrate in the high-parallelism regime rather than uniformly across all settings. Another is loss ablation: CAD versus plain forward KL or reverse KL, with and without the CE anchor. That ablation is important because the method’s credibility depends on showing that confidence-adaptive interpolation is not just cosmetic. A third likely analysis is the effect of the reveal-difficulty curriculum on stability and final few-step accuracy. Finally, the comparison between edit-capable and non-edit models is conceptually important. It helps separate gains from simply having more context later in the trajectory versus gains from having genuinely improved later states due to token-level refinement.

When reading the experiments closely, pay attention to how accuracy is defined, how TPF is measured, what block-diffusion setup is used, and what the storage and compute overhead of self-rollout trajectory collection looks like. Those details determine whether the method is practical beyond the paper’s scale.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Start with the introduction and preliminaries. You need a clear picture of block diffusion, mask-to-token decoding, token-to-token refinement, and threshold decoding before the method will make sense. In particular, the distinction between edit-capable and non-edit dLLMs is central to understanding why the gains differ across models.

Then read the method section carefully, focusing on self-rollout trajectory construction, stage partitioning, CAD, and the CE anchor. Three questions are worth keeping in mind: why self-rollouts are preferable to teacher trajectories, why stages are defined by reveal count rather than native denoising steps, and why KL direction should depend on later-stage confidence. The theory section is worth reading alongside the method because it ties the loss design to a concrete error decomposition.

In the experiments, first inspect the main figures and tables showing the LLaDA2.1-mini speed-and-quality improvement and the LLaDA2.0-mini trade-off. Then move to the ablations, especially CAD versus forward/reverse KL, the effect of the CE anchor, and the curriculum. The deepest idea in the paper is not a single metric gain. It is the training-inference alignment principle: train early states to learn from the model’s own later, more informative states along the actual decoding trajectory it will follow at inference. A quick read takes about 40 minutes. A serious read for reproduction or adaptation to another dLLM will likely take 1.5 to 2 hours.

recommendation.zh: 应优先看；dLLM 的瓶颈不是并行步数本身，而是早期轨迹错配，值得在内部 LLaDA/MDLM ablation 复现。
recommendation.en: Prioritize this: the dLLM bottleneck is early-trajectory mismatch, not just step count, and it is worth reproducing in internal LLaDA/MDLM ablations.

paper.title: LoRA-Diffusion: Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning via Low-Rank Trajectory Decomposition
paper.abstract: Parameter-efficient fine-tuning methods such as LoRA have transformed the adaptation of large autoregressive language models, enabling task-specific customization with substantially fewer trainable parameters. However, these methods have not been successfully extended to diffusion-based language models, which generate text through iterative denoising rather than sequential token prediction. We propose LoRA-Diffusion, a parameter-efficient fine-tuning approach that applies low-rank decomposition

summary.core_problem: 解决扩散语言模型难以沿用 LoRA 这类参数高效微调方法的问题，尤其是其生成过程不是自回归 next-token，而是多步去噪轨迹。
summary.importance: 贡献属于参数高效适配方法向 diffusion LM 的迁移与改造，不是预训练范式突破，但对非 AR 文本建模的后续生态有参考价值，尤其是如果你关心 diffusion LM 的可训练性与多任务部署。
summary.technical_approach: 方法不是对权重矩阵做标准低秩增量，而是对整条去噪 trajectory 做低秩分解与扰动学习。核心包括三点：一是 trajectory-level adapter，在每个去噪步上施加低秩修正；二是 step-adaptive rank allocation，在不同扩散阶段分配不同 rank；三是 compositional multi-task learning，允许在推理时合并任务模块而不重新训练。这个设计的关键判断是：对 diffusion LM 来说，任务差异更多体现在去噪路径而非单层权重更新。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖 SST-2、QNLI、MRPC 等较小 NLP 分类任务，摘要声称在保持参数效率的同时达到有竞争力表现，并支持多任务模块组合。问题在于任务规模偏小、离真正的生成式 diffusion LM 还有距离，缺少大模型、大语料、开放生成任务上的 clean evidence，因此更像概念验证而非可直接迁移到基座训练的结论。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 Bowling Green State University、Angelo State University、University of Extremadura。未见该方向上公认的一线 diffusion LM 团队作者。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper tackles parameter-efficient fine-tuning for diffusion language models, where standard LoRA does not transfer cleanly because generation follows iterative denoising rather than autoregressive next-token prediction.
summary_en.importance: This is a PEFT adaptation for diffusion LM rather than a pretraining breakthrough, but it is still relevant if you care about the tooling and adaptation stack around non-AR text modeling.
summary_en.technical_approach: Instead of applying low-rank updates to weight matrices, the method learns low-rank perturbations over the denoising trajectory itself. The main components are: trajectory-level adapters applied across denoising steps, step-adaptive rank allocation over diffusion phases, and compositional multi-task modules that can be merged at inference without retraining. The underlying bet is that task variation in diffusion LM is better captured at the trajectory level than at individual parameter matrices.
summary_en.experiments: Experiments are on small NLP classification benchmarks such as SST-2, QNLI, and MRPC. The abstract claims competitive performance with strong parameter efficiency and compositional multi-task behavior. Still, the setup is far from large-scale generative diffusion LM, so the evidence is more proof-of-concept than a result that should update pretraining practice directly.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are from Bowling Green State University, Angelo State University, and the University of Extremadura. No clearly identifiable frontline diffusion-LM lab is apparent from the metadata.

recommendation.zh: 可以当作 diffusion LM 生态补件看，但实验太小，先看方法图和多任务组合设定；别据此推断 trajectory-level PEFT 已经站稳。
recommendation.en: Treat it as tooling for diffusion LM rather than a strong result; read the method sketch and compositional setup, but do not update your prior on trajectory-level PEFT from these small-task experiments.

institutions: models and points toward scalable multi-task deployment

paper.title: Ripple-Pivot Search: Active Parallel Decoding for Diffusion Large Language Models
paper.abstract: Diffusion Large Language Models (dLLMs) have emerged as a competitive alternative to autoregressive language models, offering the potential for substantially faster inference through parallel decoding. Existing parallel decoding schedulers typically commit positions only after they meet a per-position criterion, overlooking how early commitments may benefit subsequent decoding. We identify a ripple effect in dLLM decoding: proactively committing a mid-entropy pivot position can induce a pronounc

summary.core_problem: 提升 diffusion LLM 的并行解码效率，避免现有调度器只按单位置置信度保守提交 token。
summary.importance: 这是 diffusion LM 推理机制与高效解码工作。它提出的关键观察是 ripple effect：主动提交一个中等熵位置，可能降低其他 masked positions 的不确定性，从而让后续步骤一次解码更多 token。对关注非 AR 语言建模的人来说，这直接关系到 diffusion LM 相对 AR 的速度优势能否兑现。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 Ripple-Pivot Search，一个 training-free decoding 方法。方法不只选择最低熵位置，而是寻找中等熵 pivot，并通过 lookahead evaluation 评估不同 token assignment 对后续整体不确定性的影响。它把“当前位置是否足够确定”改成“当前位置提交后是否能让剩余位置更容易解码”。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出具体模型参数量、数据集、baseline 名称或速度提升数字。实验应围绕 diffusion LLM 的并行解码调度，与现有按位置置信度提交的 parallel decoding scheduler 对比，评估总解码步数、并行 unmask 数量和生成质量保持情况。
summary.authors_note: Hong Kong Baptist University、A*STAR CFAR、Nanyang Technological University。作者列表包含 Bo Han、Ivor Tsang、Yanfeng Wang、Bo Zheng 等机器学习研究者。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper aims to accelerate diffusion LLM decoding by avoiding conservative per-position commitment rules in existing parallel schedulers.
summary_en.importance: This is an efficient decoding and diffusion-LM inference paper. Its key observation is a ripple effect: proactively committing a mid-entropy position can reduce uncertainty over the remaining masked positions, enabling more tokens to be unmasked in later steps. For researchers following non-autoregressive language modeling, this matters because inference speed is a central part of the diffusion-LM value proposition.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors propose Ripple-Pivot Search, a training-free decoding method. Instead of only committing low-entropy positions, it searches for mid-entropy pivots and uses lookahead evaluation to choose token assignments that create the largest downstream uncertainty reduction. The decision rule shifts from local confidence to global decoding benefit.
summary_en.experiments: The provided abstract does not report model sizes, datasets, baseline names, or exact speedups. The experiments are expected to compare against existing parallel decoding schedulers for diffusion LLMs, measuring decoding steps, parallel unmasking rate, and quality preservation.
summary_en.authors_note: Hong Kong Baptist University, A*STAR CFAR, and Nanyang Technological University. The author list includes Bo Han, Ivor Tsang, Yanfeng Wang, and Bo Zheng.

recommendation.zh: dLLM 推理值得看这篇的 pivot/ripple 设定；若实验数字扎实，应在内部 masked decoding baseline 里复现。
recommendation.en: For dLLM inference, the pivot/ripple setup is worth reading; if the numbers hold, it should be reproduced in internal masked-decoding baselines.

paper.title: Scaling Inherently Interpretable Language Models
paper.abstract: Interpretability is often treated as a tax on capability: language models are trained as opaque systems, then explained after the fact, with methods whose reliability is difficult to establish. In this work, we challenge this premise. Rather than reverse-engineering a model, we make interpretability a constraint of the training pipeline, optimized alongside the language modeling objective. Across three orders of magnitude of compute, on both autoregressive and diffusion language models, interpre

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文要回答的不是“如何解释一个已经训练好的黑盒模型”，而是更前置的问题：能不能把可解释性直接做成训练约束，让模型在预训练阶段就学出一个可干预、可分解、语义对齐的内部接口，同时不随着规模增大而付出越来越高的能力代价。作者把这个问题落到 language modeling 上，覆盖 AR 和 diffusion 两类 backbone，核心检验是两个：一是 capability–interpretability 是否真有硬冲突；二是如果把解释接口写进训练流程，随 scale 增长，模型会更难理解还是更容易理解。
summary.importance: 这篇对基座研究的意义很直接，而且量级不小。第一，它把 interpretability 从 post-hoc 分析工具，推进成 pretraining recipe 的一部分，涉及数据、架构、目标函数和 scaling law，属于训练范式层面的工作。第二，它给出了一个明确的经验结论：在作者定义的 inherent interpretability 设定下，可解释性更像是一个小而固定的 scaling offset，而不是随规模扩大的能力税。这一点如果成立，会改变很多人对“先把模型做强，再想办法解释”的默认假设。第三，论文不只讲理念，还做了大规模数据管线、概念瓶颈架构、diffusion LM 实例化、IsoFLOP scaling 拟合和 8B 级训练，完整度很高。对预训练研究员来说，最值得看的不是某个解释 demo，而是它如何把‘概念监督 + 结构约束 + 训练目标’拼成一个可扩展 recipe。
summary.technical_approach:
技术方案可以拆成四层：概念数据、可解释架构、训练目标、以及 scaling 分析。

第一层是概念数据 Atlas。作者认为 post-hoc 方法的问题，不只是解释器弱，而是训练时根本没有一个与预测计算耦合的语义接口。所以他们先构建大规模概念库和标注流水线：从数百万文档中抽取数亿 free-form tags，做 canonicalization 后得到 3.3 万多个概念，再训练 annotator 对任意文本做 chunk-level 概念标注。Atlas 最终覆盖 web text、code、math、academic prose，总标注规模超过 1T tokens。这里的关键不是“有标签”这么简单，而是把概念监督提升到预训练同量级，否则 concept bottleneck 很容易只停留在小数据实验。

第二层是架构。Steerling-8B 采用 diffusion language model，并使用 block-causal attention：块内保留 diffusion 式并行，块间保留类似 AR 的因果结构和 KV cache 能力。这一点很重要，因为它不是纯粹为了可解释性牺牲生成接口，而是在并行训练与可部署推理之间做折中。真正的解释接口插在 backbone 和 LM head 之间，是一个 additive concept bottleneck。作者强调它让 logit decomposition 变成 algebraically exact，也就是说输出可以精确分解为概念通道与 residual 通道的贡献，而不是事后近似投影。与此同时，masking objective 让模型学到“该位置无信息”的 in-distribution absence baseline，这使 feature removal / token attribution 不再依赖离分布的删词基线。论文把 faithful explanation 需要的几个条件——变量、干预、语义标签与预测计算耦合——都尽量写进了结构里。

第三层是训练目标与解释轴。模型对任意输出都沿三条轴给出归因：对输入 token 的影响、对人类可理解概念的贡献、以及对 residual 未解释部分的贡献。概念在模型中不是只供 probe 读取的标签，而是 forward pass 里真实参与计算的方向，因此可以直接做 intervention，比如放大或抑制某个概念方向，观察输出变化。这个设计和传统 probe / SAE 的差别在于：后者证明“信息可解码”，这里追求的是“概念变量就是计算接口的一部分”。

第四层是 scaling。作者做了四个 family 的 IsoFLOP 扫描：AR、causal diffusion、AR+concepts、causal diffusion+concepts。然后用 joint Chinchilla form 去拟合 loss 与 compute 的关系，并同时拟合多项 interpretability metrics。论文的核心判断来自这里：加入 concept module 后，compute-optimal scaling exponent 只发生小而固定的 per-backbone offset；解释约束没有随着规模放大而越来越贵。更有意思的是，多个解释性指标随 compute 一起改善，包括概念预测更准、known/unknown 表征分离更清楚、更多预测质量通过概念通道而非 residual 路由、概念 embedding 与人类标签更对齐。这不是“能力没掉太多”这么简单，而是“规模增长同时改善能力和可解释接口质量”。

和现有方法相比，区别主要有三点。第一，不是 post-hoc 解释，而是 training-time interpretability。第二，不是把 concept bottleneck 用在小模型分类任务，而是放进大规模 LM 预训练，并覆盖 diffusion LM。第三，不只给案例分析，而是给 scaling law 和大模型实例，试图说明这件事在现代训练规模下仍成立。
summary.experiments:
实验部分信息量很大，最关键的是 scaling 与 8B 实例化两块。

在 scaling 方面，作者做了跨三个数量级 compute 的 IsoFLOP sweep，比较四类模型：AR、causal diffusion、AR with concepts、causal diffusion with concepts。结论是，加入概念模块后，loss–compute 曲线出现的是小而固定的偏移，而不是随规模扩大的惩罚。Steerling-8B 的验证集 loss 可以被小模型拟合的 joint Chinchilla form 预测到 0.11 nats 以内，四个解释性指标里有三个也能被较紧地预测。这说明作者不是只在单一规模上讲故事，而是把“可解释性是否可扩展”当成 scaling 问题来处理。

在解释性指标上，论文报告了几类趋势：概念预测准确率随 compute 提升；known/unknown representation separation 变好；更多 logit 贡献通过 concept path 而不是 residual path；concept embedding 与人类可读标签的对齐增强。这里最值得注意的是“residual routing 比例下降”这一类结果，因为它直接对应一个核心担忧：概念瓶颈会不会只是挂名存在，真正计算仍绕过它。作者的结果表明，至少在他们的训练设定里，随着规模上升，模型更愿意把预测质量放到概念通道里。

在大模型实例化上，Steerling-8B 是一个带 causal attention mask 的 diffusion LM。训练数据是 1.2T token 预训练，再加 150B token 的 code/math augmented midtraining。概念模块在 8B 时只占 4% 参数；按同样参数化外推到更大规模，会降到 1% 以下。和同尺度开源 peer 相比，这个模型在 benchmark 平均表现上落在大约 10% 以内，而对手使用的训练计算量约为它的 2 到 16 倍。这个结果不能简单解读成“同算力最优”，但足以说明解释约束没有把模型能力拉到不可用的程度。

论文还强调它同时在 AR 和 diffusion backbone 上验证了趋势，这一点很重要。因为如果结论只在单一架构上成立，很难判断是 interpretability recipe 有效，还是某个 backbone 的偶然性。这里至少给出了更强的外推信号。
summary.reading_guide:
这篇建议精读。最值得花时间的是五个部分。

第一，先看 Introduction 和作者对 post-hoc interpretability 局限的界定。重点不是那些常见批评，而是他们提出的标准：一个解释接口要想可信，变量、干预、语义标签和预测计算必须耦合。理解这个标准后，后面的数据、架构、loss 设计就会顺很多。

第二，精读数据部分，尤其是 Atlas 的构建流程。要看清楚概念是怎么从 free-form tags 变成可训练标签体系的，chunk-level 标注如何做，覆盖哪些语料域。这里决定了 concept bottleneck 能否在预训练规模上站住。

第三，精读 architecture。重点看 block-causal attention 为什么适合 diffusion LM；additive concept bottleneck 如何做到 exact logit decomposition；masking objective 为什么能提供 in-distribution absence baseline。这里是全文最有新意、也最容易被摘要掩盖的部分。

第四，认真看 scaling laws。优先看四个 family 的 IsoFLOP 曲线、joint Chinchilla 拟合、以及 interpretability metrics 的 scaling 图。要关注的不是“有没有一点损失”，而是 offset 是否固定、斜率是否变化、不同 backbone 是否一致。这部分决定论文最核心的经验结论是否站得住。

第五，再看 Steerling-8B 的训练与评测。这里要把它当成 recipe 的完整实例，而不是单独一个模型发布。重点看 1.2T pretrain + 150B midtrain 的数据配比、概念模块参数占比、与开源 peer 的 compute 对比方式，以及 residual/concept 路由分析。

如果时间有限，至少要看：概念数据管线图、架构总图、scaling law 主图、interpretability metrics 主图、8B 训练配置表。若要深挖，建议顺着一个问题读：模型到底有没有把概念当成真实计算通道，而不是旁路监督。相关证据主要在 exact decomposition、routing 指标和 intervention 结果里。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks a training-time question rather than a post-hoc one: can interpretability be built into language-model pretraining as a structural constraint, so that the model learns a manipulable, semantically aligned internal interface without paying an ever-growing capability cost as scale increases? The authors test this on both autoregressive and diffusion language models. The central issue is whether capability and interpretability are fundamentally in tension, and whether larger models become harder or easier to understand when the explanatory interface is part of the training recipe itself.
summary_en.importance: This is directly relevant to foundation-model pretraining, and the contribution is substantial. First, it moves interpretability from an after-the-fact analysis tool into the pretraining recipe, touching data construction, architecture, objectives, and scaling laws.
