Second, it offers a concrete empirical claim: under their notion of inherent interpretability, the cost behaves like a small fixed scaling offset rather than a growing tax. If that holds more broadly, it weakens the default assumption that one must first train an opaque model and only then attempt to explain it. Third, the paper is unusually complete: a trillion-token concept annotation pipeline, a concept-native architecture, diffusion-LM instantiation, IsoFLOP scaling sweeps, and an 8B model. For pretraining researchers, the main value is not a demo of explanations, but a full recipe that tries to make semantic structure part of the optimization target.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The method has four layers: concept data, interpretable architecture, training objective, and scaling analysis.

The first layer is Atlas, a large-scale concept annotation pipeline. The paper argues that post-hoc interpretability fails not only because the explainer is weak, but because standard training never creates a semantic interface coupled to prediction. Atlas addresses that by extracting hundreds of millions of free-form tags from millions of documents, canonicalizing them into more than 33,000 concepts, and training an annotator that labels arbitrary text at the chunk level. The final annotation coverage exceeds 1 trillion tokens across web text, code, mathematics, and academic prose. The important point is scale: concept supervision is elevated to something comparable to pretraining scale, rather than remaining a small auxiliary dataset.

The second layer is architecture. Steerling-8B is a diffusion language model with block-causal attention. Within a block it preserves diffusion-style parallelism; across blocks it retains an autoregressive-style causal structure and KV-cache compatibility. This is a practical compromise between parallel training and deployable generation. The interpretability interface sits between the transformer backbone and the LM head as an additive concept bottleneck. The paper emphasizes that this makes the logit decomposition algebraically exact, so output contributions from concept channels and residual channels are not merely approximate post-hoc projections. In parallel, the masking objective teaches the model an in-distribution notion of “no information at this position,” which gives token-removal and feature-removal attributions a trained absence baseline rather than an out-of-distribution deletion heuristic.

The third layer is the objective and explanatory interface. For any output, the model attributes prediction along three axes: influential input tokens, human-understandable concepts, and residual unexplained contribution. Concepts are not passive labels decoded by a probe; they are directions used in the forward pass. That means interventions are native: amplifying or suppressing a concept direction directly changes computation. This is the main departure from probes or sparse autoencoders, which often establish decodability rather than computational use.

The fourth layer is scaling. The paper runs IsoFLOP sweeps over four model families: AR, causal diffusion, AR plus concepts, and causal diffusion plus concepts. It fits loss with a joint Chinchilla-style form and also tracks several interpretability metrics as functions of compute. The central empirical claim comes from this section: adding the concept module changes the compute-optimal scaling behavior by a small fixed per-backbone offset, not by a worsening penalty with scale. At the same time, interpretability metrics improve with compute: concept prediction gets better, known-versus-unknown representations separate more cleanly, more predictive mass is routed through concept channels rather than residual channels, and concept embeddings align better with human labels.

Relative to prior work, the differences are clear. This is training-time interpretability rather than post-hoc explanation; it brings concept bottlenecks into large-scale language-model pretraining rather than small supervised tasks; and it supports the claim with scaling laws and an 8B model rather than isolated case studies.
summary_en.experiments:
The experimental section is dense, but two parts matter most: scaling and the 8B instantiation.

On scaling, the authors run IsoFLOP sweeps across three orders of magnitude of compute for four families: AR, causal diffusion, AR with concepts, and causal diffusion with concepts. Their main result is that adding the concept module produces a small fixed shift in the loss-compute tradeoff rather than a penalty that grows with scale. The validation loss of Steerling-8B is predicted within 0.11 nats by a joint Chinchilla-style fit from smaller runs, and three of four interpretability metrics are also predicted within tight bounds. This matters because the paper treats interpretability as a scaling question, not as a one-off model anecdote.

For interpretability, the paper reports several monotonic trends with compute: concept prediction accuracy improves; separation between known and unknown representations becomes cleaner; a larger fraction of the model’s predictive contribution flows through the concept path rather than the residual path; and concept embeddings align more closely with human-readable labels. The routing result is especially important because it addresses a central concern: a concept bottleneck could exist only nominally while the real computation bypasses it. Their evidence suggests that, under this recipe, larger models rely more rather than less on the concept channel.

For the large model, Steerling-8B is a diffusion LM with a causal attention mask. It is trained on 1.2T pretraining tokens followed by 150B midtraining tokens with a code-and-math-augmented mixture. The concept module accounts for 4% of parameters at 8B and would fall below 1% at larger scales under the same parameterization. Compared with open peers at similar parameter count, Steerling-8B lands within roughly 10% of their average benchmark performance, despite those peers using about 2x to 16x more training compute. This does not prove compute-optimality, but it does show that the interpretability constraints do not collapse model usefulness.

The fact that the paper validates the trend on both AR and diffusion backbones is also important. If the result held only for one architecture, it would be hard to tell whether the gain came from the interpretability recipe or from a backbone-specific artifact.
summary_en.reading_guide:
This one deserves a close read. Five parts are worth real attention.

First, read the introduction and the formal discussion of why post-hoc interpretability is structurally limited. The key standard is not a generic complaint about probes; it is the requirement that variables, interventions, semantic labels, and prediction computation be coupled. Once that standard is clear, the rest of the recipe makes sense.

Second, read the data section carefully, especially Atlas. You want to understand how free-form tags are turned into a trainable concept system, how chunk-level annotation is produced, and how the pipeline reaches pretraining scale. Whether the whole approach is credible depends heavily on this layer.

Third, read the architecture in detail. Focus on why block-causal attention is a good fit for diffusion LM, how the additive concept bottleneck yields exact logit decomposition, and why the masking objective creates an in-distribution absence baseline. This is where much of the real novelty sits.

Fourth, spend time on the scaling-law section. Prioritize the IsoFLOP plots for the four families, the joint Chinchilla fits, and the scaling plots for interpretability metrics. The main question is not whether there is some loss penalty, but whether the offset is fixed, whether the slope changes, and whether the pattern is consistent across backbones.

Fifth, read the Steerling-8B training and evaluation sections as a full recipe instantiation rather than a model release. Pay attention to the 1.2T pretrain plus 150B midtrain mixture, the parameter share of the concept module, the compute comparison to peers, and the concept-versus-residual routing analysis.

If time is limited, at minimum read the concept-data pipeline figure, the architecture overview, the main scaling-law plots, the main interpretability-metric plots, and the 8B training table. If you want one deep question to track while reading, use this: does the model actually compute through concepts, or are concepts only an auxiliary supervision layer? The strongest evidence is in the exact decomposition, routing metrics, and intervention results.

recommendation.zh: 必须看 scaling 曲线和干预指标；若指标没被 reward hack，这会改变“可解释性只能后验补丁”的 prior。
recommendation.en: Read the scaling curves and intervention metrics; if the metrics are not reward-hacked, this changes the prior that interpretability is only a post-hoc patch.

paper.title: Lost in Interpolation: Why Predictive Feedback Fails in Diffusion Language Models
paper.abstract: Soft-masking accelerates the convergence of Masked Diffusion Language Models (MDLMs). Existing formulations build this blend with linear interpolation (LERP) in the raw embedding space, which implicitly treats that space as Euclidean. We analyze the embedding space of MDLMs and find that the mask and predicted-token embeddings maintain a near-constant angle of (\approx 73^\circ) throughout training, while embedding norms remain essentially flat across vocabulary-frequency rank. These indicate a

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作讨论 MDLM 中 soft-masking 的反馈表示问题：已有方法用 embedding 空间里的线性插值，把 [MASK] embedding 和 top-k 预测 token embedding 混合，但训练后的 token embedding 更接近等范数球面结构，线性插值会把反馈点推离主要表示流形，导致预测反馈没有被充分利用，甚至带来生成困惑度退化。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的启发在于，它把 diffusion LM 的一个看似工程化的反馈细节，重新放到表示几何里分析。贡献不是新的扩散目标，而是指出 MDLM 的 denoising feedback 需要尊重 embedding manifold。这个问题在 masked diffusion / any-order LM 中较重要，因为非 AR 模型会反复把中间预测送回 backbone，反馈表示质量直接影响训练动态和采样效率。它也提醒预训练研究者：token embedding 的范数、角度结构不是诊断指标而已，可能决定中间态构造是否合理。
summary.technical_approach: 方法是 Spherical Soft-Masking。原始 soft-masking 先取 top-k token embedding 的概率加权欧氏均值，再用 LERP 和 mask embedding 做 convex blend。S-SM 做两处替换。第一，先把 top-k 候选 embedding 投到单位球面，在球面上求 Fréchet/Karcher mean，避免欧氏均值落到球内。第二，用 SLERP 沿测地线在 mask 方向和预测均值方向之间插值，而不是用直线插值。最后把结果缩放回 mask token 的原始范数，再输入 backbone。训练目标、mask corruption schedule、unmasking rule、confidence weight 的定义都保持不变，因此它是 soft-masking 的几何替换件，而不是一套新的 MDLM 训练框架。
summary.experiments: 论文先在已发布的 MDLM checkpoint 上做几何诊断：归一化后的 mask embedding 与 top-k 预测均值方向之间的测地角在训练中基本稳定在约 73°；token embedding 的 L2 norm 沿 GPT-2 frequency rank 基本平坦。这两个结果支持 hyperspherical geometry 的假设。生成实验中，S-SM 在较大 NFE 预算 256 和 512 下，相比 vanilla MDLM 的 MAUVE 接近翻倍；相比 TopK/LERP，在相同预算下 MAUVE 提升超过 50%。同时，LERP 会带来 generative perplexity 退化，S-SM 能避免这一点。在使用等价 learned confidence 训练方案时，SLERP 在多个 seed 和所有采样预算下取得更高 MAUVE 和更低生成困惑度，而训练困惑度几乎相同。learned confidence weight 也支持这个解释：step 7k 时 SLERP 的 λ 收敛到约 0.056，LERP 约 0.030，前者约为后者 1.9 倍，说明优化器更愿意使用几何上合理的反馈。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读 25 分钟。先看 Introduction 中对 MDLM soft-masking 信息丢失的定义，再看几何诊断部分，重点是 mask-to-prediction angle 和 embedding norm across frequency rank 两个图。方法部分只需确认 Fréchet mean、SLERP、rescale 三步如何替换原 LERP。实验部分优先看 MAUVE、generative perplexity、NFE budget 的对比，以及 learned confidence λ 的消融。值得深挖的是：这个球面假设是否依赖特定 tokenizer、embedding tying、模型规模和训练阶段；如果 diffusion LM 使用 continuous latent 或 adaptive embedding norm，S-SM 的优势可能会变化。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies a feedback representation issue in masked diffusion language models. Existing soft-masking methods linearly interpolate between the [MASK] embedding and a weighted average of top-k predicted token embeddings. The authors argue that this is mismatched to the learned embedding geometry, which behaves more like a hypersphere than a Euclidean cloud. Linear interpolation then moves the feedback vector off the dominant representation manifold and can weaken or distort predictive feedback.
summary_en.importance: The main value is not a new diffusion objective, but a sharper treatment of the intermediate states used by diffusion LMs. MDLMs repeatedly feed partially denoised predictions back into the backbone, so the geometry of those feedback embeddings affects convergence, sample quality, and NFE efficiency. For pretraining researchers, the paper is a useful reminder that embedding geometry can constrain valid design choices in non-autoregressive language modeling, especially when the model consumes its own soft predictions during training or sampling.
summary_en.technical_approach: The proposed method, Spherical Soft-Masking, replaces the Euclidean operations in standard soft-masking with intrinsic spherical operations. Instead of taking a probability-weighted linear average of top-k token embeddings, it normalizes candidate embeddings and computes a Fréchet/Karcher mean on the unit sphere. Instead of blending this mean with the mask embedding by LERP, it uses SLERP along the geodesic between the mask direction and the predicted-token mean direction. The resulting vector is then rescaled to the native norm of the mask embedding before being passed into the backbone. The corruption schedule, denoising objective, unmasking policy, and confidence-based mixing mechanism are left unchanged.
summary_en.experiments: The empirical motivation comes from geometry probes on a released MDLM checkpoint. The geodesic angle between the normalized mask embedding and the normalized top-k prediction mean stays close to 73 degrees during training, while token embedding norms remain nearly flat across GPT-2 frequency rank. These observations support the hyperspherical view. In generation experiments, S-SM nearly doubles MAUVE over the vanilla MDLM baseline at larger NFE budgets such as 256 and 512, and improves MAUVE by more than 50% over TopK/LERP at the same budgets. It also avoids the generative perplexity degradation observed with LERP. Under an equivalent learned-confidence training setup, SLERP gives higher MAUVE and lower generative perplexity across budgets and seeds, with almost unchanged training perplexity. The learned mixing weight also shifts upward: around step 7k, λ is about 0.056 for SLERP versus 0.030 for LERP, suggesting that the model can rely more on geometrically consistent feedback.
summary_en.reading_guide: A focused skim should take about 25 minutes. Read the introduction for the failure mode of binary masking and Euclidean soft-masking. Then inspect the embedding-geometry diagnostics, especially the mask-to-prediction angle and embedding-norm plots. In the method section, check the three operations: spherical top-k aggregation, SLERP with the mask direction, and norm rescaling. In the results, prioritize MAUVE, generative perplexity, NFE-budget trends, and the learned-confidence ablation. The most useful follow-up question is whether the spherical assumption remains stable across model sizes, tokenizers, tied versus untied embeddings, and later-stage continued pretraining.

recommendation.zh: 这篇值得看的是它对 MDLM embedding 几何的诊断，不是分数本身；若你在做 diffusion LM，先复现那个“恒定夹角”现象，再决定是否换掉 LERP。
recommendation.en: What matters here is the geometry diagnosis, not the headline gain; if you work on diffusion LMs, first reproduce the near-constant-angle result, then decide whether LERP should be retired.

institutions: Indian Institute of Technology Roorkee, Roorkee, Uttarakhand

paper.title: Stoicheia: Character-Level Masked Diffusion for Ancient Greek Textual Restoration, Parsing, and Metrical Scansion
paper.abstract: We introduce Stoicheia, a 405M-parameter character-level masked-diffusion encoder for Ancient Greek whose input factors into five aligned, independently maskable planes: letters, word and sentence boundaries, diacritics, capitalization, and punctuation. A single backbone can therefore restore lacunae, re-segment, accentuate, and punctuate unspaced text without task-specific retokenization. We pretrain it on an open, revision-pinned corpus of 380M words and release eleven checkpoints: ten rotated

summary.core_problem: 解决古希腊文本在缺字修复、断词断句、重音恢复、标点恢复等多个字符级任务上需要分别建模和重分词的问题。
summary.importance: 这篇工作的价值不在古典语言应用本身，而在于它把 masked diffusion LM 做成了多平面对齐的字符级统一建模器，并用严格去污染的折叠发布方式，较干净地测量了预训练对下游字符任务的贡献。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 Stoicheia：一个 405M 参数的字符级 masked-diffusion encoder。输入被拆成五个对齐且可独立 mask 的平面：字母、词/句边界、变音符号、大小写、标点。这样同一骨干网络可在不改 tokenizer 的情况下统一处理文本修复、重分段、accentuation 和 punctuation。预训练使用 3.8 亿词开放语料，并发布 10 个轮转去污染 fold checkpoint，加上 1 个不含文书文本的 checkpoint，用于控制训练暴露。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖三类任务：受损铭文与纸草文献重建、形态句法标注与依存分析、长短音恢复与格律扫描。每项实验都配随机初始化对照，以隔离 diffusion 预训练收益。摘要中给出铭文重建提升 5.6 个 CER 点，其余任务也报告稳定增益。模型规模为 405M，训练语料为 380M words。由于任务和语种都较特殊，外推到通用 LLM 需谨慎。

summary_en.core_problem: It tackles the need to separately model restoration, segmentation, accentuation, and punctuation for Ancient Greek text, where character-level corruption and missing spans make tokenization brittle.
summary_en.importance: The main value is not the classical-language application itself, but the use of a masked diffusion LM as a unified character-level model with aligned factorized inputs, plus a relatively clean decontaminated release setup to isolate what pretraining actually buys.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper introduces Stoicheia, a 405M-parameter character-level masked-diffusion encoder. Inputs are factorized into five aligned and independently maskable planes: letters, word/sentence boundaries, diacritics, capitalization, and punctuation. A single backbone can therefore solve restoration and reformatting tasks without task-specific retokenization. Pretraining uses an open 380M-word corpus, and the release includes ten rotated decontaminated folds plus one checkpoint with no documentary-text exposure.
summary_en.experiments: Experiments cover damaged inscription and papyri reconstruction, morphosyntactic tagging and dependency parsing, and macronization with metrical scansion. Each task includes a matched random-initialization control to isolate the contribution of diffusion pretraining. The abstract reports a 5.6-point CER gain on inscription reconstruction, with additional gains on the other tasks. The model is 405M parameters and trained on 380M words, but the domain is narrow, so transfer to general-purpose LMs is limited.

recommendation.zh: 不是通用 LLM 论文，但若你关心离散 diffusion LM 在字符级、无 tokenizer 场景怎么做干净实验，这篇的多平面输入和去污染发布方式值得抄作业；正文不必细读。
recommendation.en: Not a general LLM paper, but if you care about discrete diffusion LM in tokenizer-free character regimes, the factorized input design and decontaminated release protocol are worth stealing; no need to read every section.

paper.title: Answer First, Reason Later: Commitment Order in Diffusion LLMs
paper.abstract: Masked diffusion language models (dLLMs) can commit tokens in any order -- a freedom marketed as their core advantage over autoregressive decoding. We show that on reasoning tasks this freedom is instead the axis of failure. Logging every commitment during decoding of LLaDA-8B on GSM8K, we find that unconstrained (pure) decoding commits the final answer at 15-24% of the trajectory while half the reasoning region is still masked, and collapses to answer-only outputs on up to 90% of problems as th

summary.core_problem: 这项工作研究 masked diffusion LLM 在推理任务上的解码顺序问题。dLLM 可以任意顺序提交 token，这通常被视为相对自回归模型的优势；但在 GSM8K、MATH-500 这类需要 chain-of-thought 的任务上，无约束 confidence-ordered decoding 会过早提交答案位置，甚至直接提交 EOS 和 padding，导致模型在推理区域仍大面积 masked 时已经固定最终答案。
summary.importance: 这是一篇对 diffusion LLM 训练和推理都有启发的工作。它把 dLLM 推理失败从“模型想不想推理”拆成“采样器允许它先提交哪里”。结论很具体：问题不主要来自 EOS belief，而来自 reachability，即 sampler 能否在很远的位置立即提交 EOS 或最终答案。这个区分重要，因为它说明部分失败可以通过解码约束修复，不一定需要重新训练；也说明任意顺序生成并不天然适合推理，commitment order 是 dLLM scaling、RL 训练和 CoT 数据设计里需要显式控制的变量。
summary.technical_approach: 论文没有提出新模型，而是对 LLaDA-8B-Instruct 的 denoising 过程做细粒度记录：每个位置何时从 mask 变成确定 token，每一步该位置的 top prediction 是什么。基于这些日志，作者区分了两类失败。第一类是 answer-only collapse：模型跳过推理，输出短答案后接 padding；canvas 越长，远处 EOS 越容易被提前提交。第二类是 answer-first backfill：即便最后有推理文本，答案也在轨迹前 1/4 左右被冻结，推理 token 的中位提交时间接近轨迹中点，后续推导只能围绕已经固定的答案补写。论文进一步比较 pure decoding 与 semi-AR/block-wise decoding，发现二者的 EOS pressure 几乎相同，但 EOS commitment 差异超过 2 倍。因此，差异不在模型对 EOS 的预测倾向，而在无约束 sampler 是否能对远处位置采取行动。干预方法是 window-restricted decoding：只允许提交 left-most masked position 之后 w 个位置内的 token。w=∞ 对应 pure decoding，w=1 接近左到右生成；这个单一参数直接限制远距离提交能力，不改 logits，也不重新训练。
summary.experiments: 主要实验使用 LLaDA-8B-Instruct。GSM8K 上，无约束 pure decoding 在 256-token canvas 时超过三分之一问题出现 answer-only collapse；canvas 扩到 512 时，collapse 最高达到约 90%，说明更大的生成空间反而让模型更容易跳过推理。答案提交时间也显著早于推理文本：最终答案通常在 denoising 轨迹前 1/4 固定，而推理区 token 的中位提交时间接近一半。论文用 2×2 设计交叉 prompt 类型和 decoder 类型：prompt 分为要求 CoT 与只要答案，decoder 分为 pure 与 semi-AR。在 250 个成对问题上，prompt–decoder interaction 约 35 个百分点，permutation p<1e-4。answer-only 条件下两种 decoder 统计上接近；要求 CoT 时，semi-AR 获得约 31 个百分点收益，而 pure decoding 几乎不能把 CoT 转化为同等性能。这个结果说明 semi-AR 的优势主要来自推理文本真正发挥作用，而不是答案格式或任务先验。论文还在 Dream-7B 和 MATH-500 上复现了模式；MATH-500 中短答案难以猜测，collapse 减少，但 answer-first 的 order channel 仍存在。窗口约束的效果很直接：在 LLaDA-8B GSM8K 上，所有 w≤64 都能把 pure decoding 从 0.528 提升到 0.82–0.85，接近 semi-AR；滑动窗口 w=32 与 block size 32 的结果相差约 1 个点，说明有效因素是 reachability 限制，而不一定是固定 block 结构。代价也被测量了：在完整 refinement 下，w=1 最优，任意顺序没有带来精度收益；当每步提交约 8 个 token 时，约束反而有害。有效区间内，gated decoder 仍可保持接近 AR 的准确率，并报告约 4× wall-clock speedup。
summary.reading_guide: 建议精读。先看 Introduction 中对 answer-only collapse、answer-first backfill、EOS pressure 与 reachability 的区分，这是论文的主线。随后重点读日志分析章节，尤其是 token commitment time 的分布、答案位置与推理区域的提交顺序，以及 EOS pressure/commitment 的对照图。2×2 prompt–decoder 实验需要仔细看，因为它回答了 CoT 在 dLLM 中是否只是表面文本的问题；这里的 interaction 和 answer-only near-tie 是关键证据。窗口约束实验也值得细读，尤其是 w 的 sweep、sliding window 与 block-wise decoding 的对照、以及 compute budget 下的精度—速度权衡。对做 diffusion LM 或 masked LM 预训练的人，最值得深挖的是：训练目标是否应该显式学习可用的 commitment order，RL 是否会被 confidence-ordered sampler 限制探索，以及长 canvas 数据中的 EOS/padding 结构如何与采样 reachability 共同作用。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies commitment order in masked diffusion LLMs on reasoning tasks. These models can unmask tokens in any order, but unconstrained confidence-ordered decoding often commits the final answer before most reasoning tokens are available, or commits EOS and padding so early that the model produces answer-only outputs.
summary_en.importance: This is a useful paper for diffusion-LM research because it separates model beliefs from sampler reachability. The failure is not mainly that the model has stronger EOS beliefs under pure decoding; EOS pressure is nearly decoder-invariant. The failure arises because the sampler is allowed to act on those beliefs at distant positions. This matters for decoding, RL exploration, CoT supervision, and pretraining data design for masked diffusion LMs. Any-order generation is not automatically compatible with multi-step reasoning; commitment order needs to be treated as a controlled variable.
summary_en.technical_approach: The work instruments the denoising loop of LLaDA-8B-Instruct. For each position, it logs when the position is committed and what the model predicts at each step. This reveals two distinct pathologies. The first is answer-only collapse: the model emits a bare answer followed by padding, skipping the reasoning region. The second is answer-first backfill: the final answer is fixed early, and the derivation is filled in later around an already committed conclusion. The paper then compares pure decoding with semi-autoregressive or block-wise decoding and shows that EOS pressure is almost the same across decoders, while EOS commitment differs by more than a factor of two. The intervention is window-restricted decoding: only positions within a window of size w after the left-most masked position are eligible for commitment. w=∞ recovers pure decoding, and w=1 approximates left-to-right generation. The method changes only eligibility, not logits or model weights.
summary_en.experiments: The main experiments use LLaDA-8B-Instruct. On GSM8K, pure decoding produces answer-only collapse on more than one third of problems with a 256-token canvas, and up to about 90% with a 512-token canvas. The final answer is typically committed in the first quarter of the denoising trajectory, while the median reasoning token is committed near the halfway point. A fixed 2×2 design crosses prompt type, reasoning requested versus answer-only, with decoder type, pure versus semi-AR. On 250 paired problems, the prompt–decoder interaction is about 35 percentage points with permutation p<1e-4. In the answer-only condition, the two decoders are statistically close. When CoT is requested, semi-AR gains about 31 points, while pure decoding gains only a small amount. The same pattern is replicated on Dream-7B and MATH-500; on MATH-500, collapse is smaller, but the order channel remains. Window restriction recovers most of the gap: all w≤64 improve pure decoding from 0.528 to roughly 0.82–0.85, close to semi-AR. A sliding window of 32 matches a block size of 32 within about one point, indicating that restricted reachability, rather than block structure itself, is the active mechanism. The paper also measures the cost: with full refinement, w=1 is best; at around eight committed tokens per step, the constraint can become harmful. In the useful regime, the gated decoder keeps near-AR accuracy with a reported 4× wall-clock speedup.
summary_en.reading_guide: This is worth a careful read. Start with the Introduction for the distinction between answer-only collapse, answer-first backfill, EOS pressure, and reachability. Then read the logging analysis: the most important evidence is the distribution of commitment times for answer tokens versus reasoning tokens, and the comparison between EOS pressure and EOS commitment. The 2×2 prompt–decoder experiment is central because it tests whether CoT text functionally matters under different commitment orders. The window-restricted decoding section should also be read closely, especially the sweep over w, the comparison with block-wise decoding, and the compute-budget tradeoff. For diffusion-LM pretraining researchers, the main follow-up questions are whether commitment order should be learned or constrained during training, how confidence-ordered sampling affects RL exploration, and how EOS or padding structure in long canvases interacts with sampler reachability.

recommendation.zh: 这篇会直接改你对 dLLM reasoning 失败原因的 prior：先别急着怪训练目标，先复现它的 commitment trace 和 2x2 decoder ablation。
recommendation.en: This should change your prior on why dLLMs fail at reasoning: before blaming the training objective, reproduce the commitment traces and the 2x2 decoder ablation.

institutions: Graduate School of Data Science, Seoul National University

paper.title: Speculative Correction: Draft-then-Refine Decoding for Diffusion Language Models
paper.abstract: Diffusion language models (DLMs) can revise tokens bidirectionally, but standard decoding procedures often adapt them to left-to-right generation by producing text block by block. We study a simple plug-and-play inference pattern: first generate a complete draft, then refine the full response using bidirectional diffusion. Using LLaDA2.1-Flash and LLaDA2.1-Mini, we evaluate two configurations. In Flash-Flash, the same Flash model serves as both drafter and refiner, testing whether an existing mo

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文研究 diffusion language model 的解码方式：现有 DLM 常用 block autoregressive decoding，把序列分块从左到右生成，虽然方便接入常规语言任务，但削弱了 DLM 可以双向修改整段文本的能力。作者提出先生成完整草稿、再用全序列 diffusion refinement 修正的推理模式。
summary.importance: 这篇工作对新型语言建模范式有直接启发。它不改训练目标，也不改模型结构，而是证明现有 DLM checkpoint 中已经存在一定的全局修正能力。这个结论重要在于：DLM 的优势不一定体现在完全替代 AR 解码，而可能体现在“完整候选答案 + 双向编辑”的计算分配方式上。对预训练研究而言，它提示 DLM 训练分布和推理初始化之间仍有错配：refiner 训练时见到的是前向加噪样本，推理时却要修正另一个模型或 block-AR 产生的自然语言草稿。
summary.technical_approach: 方法是 plug-and-play 的 draft-then-refine decoding。第一阶段用 DLM 快速生成完整回答草稿；第二阶段把草稿作为可编辑初始化，由更强或相同的 DLM 在全序列上做双向 denoising。论文测试两种配置。flash–flash 使用 LLaDA2.1-flash 同时作为 drafter 和 refiner，用来验证同一个 checkpoint 是否能改进自身 block-AR 输出。mini–flash 使用 LLaDA2.1-mini 生成草稿，再用 LLaDA2.1-flash 修正，作者称为 speculative correction。它和自回归 speculative decoding 不同：后者是小模型逐 token 提案、大模型验证接受；这里大模型不做 token-level accept/reject，而是能在任意位置重写文本，利用左右上下文一起纠错。
summary.experiments: 实验使用 LLaDA2.1-flash 和 LLaDA2.1-mini，在 GSM8K、MATH、MBPP 等任务上比较质量与延迟。flash–flash 在 GSM8K-384 上从 0.848 提升到 0.899，同时快 1.20×；在 MBPP-384 上 pass rate 从 0.545 提升到 0.693。作者还设置了 latency-window-matched 的 flash-only 控制实验，用来排除收益只是来自 block-AR schedule 没调好的解释。mini–flash 的结果更像质量-延迟折中：MATH-384 上得分 0.294，接近 flash baseline 0.300，同时快 2.17×，约恢复 mini 到 flash 质量差距的 79%；MBPP-384 上从 mini-only 的 0.401 提升到 0.568，高于文中选定 flash baseline 0.545，同时快 1.11×。在 GSM8K 和 MATH-512 上，mini–flash 仍更快，但不能完全恢复 flash 的质量。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读 30–40 分钟。重点看 introduction 中对 block-AR diffusion 局限的定义、draft-then-refine 的具体推理流程、flash–flash 与 mini–flash 的实验设置，以及 latency-matched control。最值得深挖的是 refiner 输入分布错配问题：训练时 refiner 学的是从噪声恢复文本，推理时面对的是一个模型生成的有结构但带错误的草稿。如果后续训练能显式加入 draft corruption 或 model-generated draft，可能会比纯推理技巧更稳。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies decoding for diffusion language models. Current DLM generation often uses block autoregressive decoding: generate one block at a time from left to right, while allowing bidirectional attention only inside each block. This makes DLMs usable for standard language tasks, but it underuses their ability to revise an entire sequence bidirectionally. The proposed inference pattern first drafts a full response, then refines the full sequence with diffusion.
summary_en.importance: The paper is directly relevant to alternative language-modeling paradigms. It shows that existing DLM checkpoints may already contain useful global correction behavior, even without retraining or architectural changes. The more general lesson is that DLMs may not need to compete with AR models only through left-to-right generation. Their useful operating point may be full-candidate generation followed by bidirectional editing. The work also exposes an important training-inference mismatch: the refiner is trained on samples from a forward noising process, but at inference time it must repair a structured draft produced by block-AR decoding or by another model.
summary_en.technical_approach: The method is a plug-and-play draft-then-refine decoder. The first stage produces a complete response draft. The second stage treats that draft as an editable initialization and applies full-sequence bidirectional denoising. Two configurations are evaluated. In flash–flash, LLaDA2.1-flash is both drafter and refiner, isolating whether the same checkpoint can improve its own block-AR output. In mini–flash, LLaDA2.1-mini drafts and LLaDA2.1-flash refines; the authors call this speculative correction. Unlike autoregressive speculative decoding, the larger model does not accept or reject tokens one by one. It can rewrite any position using global context, closer in spirit to cascaded diffusion systems in vision.
summary_en.experiments: Experiments use LLaDA2.1-flash and LLaDA2.1-mini on GSM8K, MATH, and MBPP, reporting both quality and latency. In the flash–flash setting, GSM8K-384 accuracy improves from 0.848 to 0.899 while running 1.20× faster. MBPP-384 pass rate improves from 0.545 to 0.693. A latency-window-matched flash-only control is used to check that the gain is not merely due to an undertuned block-AR schedule. In the mini–flash setting, the method defines a quality-latency tradeoff rather than uniformly dominating flash decoding. On MATH-384, it scores 0.294 versus a flash baseline of 0.300 while running 2.17× faster, recovering about 79% of the mini-to-flash quality gap. On MBPP-384, it improves mini-only decoding from 0.401 to 0.568, slightly above the selected flash baseline of 0.545, while running 1.11× faster. On GSM8K and MATH-512, it remains faster but does not fully recover flash quality.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in 30–40 minutes. Focus on the introduction’s framing of block-AR diffusion, the exact draft-then-refine inference procedure, the distinction between flash–flash and mini–flash, and the latency-matched controls. The most useful point to inspect is the input-distribution mismatch for the refiner: during training it denoises corrupted text, while at inference it edits a model-generated draft with semantic and reasoning errors. Future training recipes that include draft-style corruptions or model-generated drafts may make this decoding pattern more reliable.

recommendation.zh: 这篇值得看，因为它把 DLM 的优势从“训练目标”落到“解码机制”上；先读 latency-matched 对照，若成立，说明很多 DLM 负结果可能只是 decode 用错了。
recommendation.en: Worth reading because it moves the DLM story from training objective to decoding mechanics; start with the latency-matched controls—if they hold, many negative takes on DLMs may just be using the wrong decoder.

paper.title: AURORA-LM: Autoencoding Unified Representation for Continuous-Latent Diffusion Language Modeling
paper.abstract: Language remains an outlier in generative modeling: while images, video, and audio are increasingly modeled in continuous latent spaces, text generation still relies predominantly on discrete tokens. Existing continuous language models either inherit embedding spaces not designed for joint generation and decoding, or compress autoencoded latents to ease diffusion, sacrificing token-level fidelity. Instead of simplifying the representation to suit the generative model, we preserve a high-capacity

summary.core_problem: 连续隐空间扩散模型已经成为图像、视频、音频生成的主流范式，但语言生成仍以离散token自回归建模为主。现有连续扩散语言模型始终受限于一个核心设计矛盾：如果对文本隐空间做压缩、平滑以降低扩散模型的学习难度，会丢失精确恢复原文字词、句法、局部顺序所需的细粒度信息，导致重构精度不足；如果保留足够的重构信息，隐空间分布会过于复杂，传统扩散设计难以有效建模，最终生成质量始终落后于离散token模型。
summary.importance: 这篇跳出了“改造表征以适配生成模型”的固有思路，转而设计能够直接学习高容量、高保真文本隐空间分布的扩散框架，为连续扩散语言模型提供了一条不需要在重构精度上妥协的技术路径。该方向的进展对跨模态统一预训练有直接参考意义：如果文本可以在连续隐空间中被高质量生成，就不需要将图像、音频、视频等天然连续的模态强行离散化为token以适配自回归LM主干，为跨模态共享连续生成接口提供了可能。
summary.technical_approach: AURORA-LM将隐空间构建和生成建模两个环节完全解耦，消除两者的目标冲突。第一阶段单独训练高容量文本自编码器，生成与原token序列等长的全宽连续隐序列（不做序列下采样压缩），训练目标仅聚焦精确重构原文本，不添加任何让隐空间更平滑、更易生成的正则约束，保证隐变量承载全部文本信息。第二阶段针对高维全宽隐空间的特点设计扩散模型，采用块因果注意力结构：将隐序列拆分为连续块，块之间严格遵守因果依赖（前序块完全生成后才开始生成后续块），块内部通过扩散过程并行生成所有位置的隐变量，既保留扩散模型并行生成的效率优势，又通过块间因果约束保证长文本的连贯性，避免全序列非因果扩散常见的长程逻辑混乱。生成阶段，扩散模型输出的连续隐变量直接通过预训练好的自编码器解码器映射为离散文本，无需额外的重排、校正步骤。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖无条件生成、条件生成、系统级效率-质量对比、规模伸缩性验证四个部分。关键消融包括：隐空间容量对重构精度和生成质量的影响，结果显示对隐序列做下采样压缩会带来显著的重构误差和生成质量下降，全宽隐空间是高保真生成的必要条件；块大小对生成速度和质量的权衡，块过小会退化为逐token串行生成、速度优势消失，块过大会破坏因果结构、长文本连贯性下降；规模伸缩性测试验证了模型性能随参数量、训练token数增长呈平滑提升趋势，未出现早期连续扩散LM常见的规模收益饱和现象。系统级对比显示，该方法的生成质量显著超过此前的压缩隐空间连续扩散LM，块因果设计在匹配自回归模型生成质量的同时，通过块内并行获得更高的生成吞吐量。
summary.reading_guide: 属于连续扩散语言模型方向的实质进展工作，建议精读。重点关注几个核心设计选择的逻辑：一是引言和相关工作中对既往连续LM核心设计矛盾的诊断，理解为什么之前的方法无法同时兼顾保真度和生成质量；二是全宽高容量隐空间的自编码器训练方案，明确解耦表征学习和生成建模的具体做法；三是块因果扩散的结构设计，理解其如何平衡并行效率和长程因果性；四是隐容量、块大小权衡与scaling趋势的消融结果。基础扩散模型的通用公式推导可快速浏览，无需逐行推导。预计精读时间1小时。

summary_en.core_problem: Continuous-latent diffusion models have become the dominant paradigm for image, video, and audio generation, but text generation still relies primarily on discrete token autoregressive modeling. Existing continuous diffusion language models are stuck in a core tradeoff: compressing or smoothing text latents to make distributions easier for diffusion models to learn destroys fine-grained information needed for exact reconstruction of words, syntax, and local order, while preserving enough information for perfect reconstruction produces latent distributions too complex for conventional diffusion designs to model effectively, leaving continuous LMs consistently behind discrete token models in generation quality.
summary_en.importance: This work moves past the prevailing design pattern of modifying representations to fit the limitations of generative models, instead building a diffusion framework designed to learn distributions directly over high-capacity, high-fidelity text latents. It provides a technical path for continuous diffusion language modeling that does not require trading off reconstruction accuracy. Progress in this direction has direct implications for cross-modal unified pretraining: high-quality continuous text generation removes the need to quantize inherently continuous modalities such as image, audio, and video into discrete tokens to fit autoregressive LM backbones, enabling a shared continuous generative interface across modalities.
summary_en.technical_approach: AURORA-LM fully decouples latent space construction and generative modeling to eliminate conflicting objectives between the two stages. First, a high-capacity text autoencoder is trained independently to produce full-width continuous latent sequences of the same length as the original token sequence, with no sequence downsampling. The autoencoder training objective focuses exclusively on exact text reconstruction, with no added regularization to smooth latents or make them easier to generate, ensuring latents carry all information present in the original text. Second, a diffusion model is tailored to model the distribution of these high-dimensional full-width latents, using a block-causal attention structure: sequences are split into contiguous chunks, with strict causal dependence across chunks (later chunks are generated only after previous chunks are fully determined), while diffusion-based parallel generation operates within each chunk. This design preserves the parallel throughput of diffusion models while maintaining the causal structure required for long-form text coherence, avoiding the long-range logical inconsistencies common to non-causal full-sequence diffusion. At generation time, continuous latents produced by the diffusion model are mapped directly to discrete text via the pretrained autoencoder decoder, with no external reranking or correction required.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluations cover unconditional generation, conditional generation, system-level efficiency-quality tradeoffs, and scaling behavior. Key ablation studies examine three core design choices: Latent capacity tests show that sequence downsampling introduces non-trivial reconstruction error and measurable generation quality degradation, confirming full-width uncompressed latents are necessary for high-fidelity text generation. Block size ablations map the tradeoff between speed and coherence: very small blocks regress to token-by-token serial generation with no throughput benefit, while very large blocks break causal structure and degrade long-form coherence. Scaling tests confirm smooth, predictable performance gains as model parameter count and training data volume increase, with no saturation of returns at evaluated scales—a common failure mode of earlier continuous LM designs. System-level comparisons show substantial quality gains over prior compressed-latent continuous diffusion LMs; the block-causal design matches the generation quality of autoregressive baselines while delivering higher throughput via within-block parallel generation.
summary_en.reading_guide: This work represents a material design advance for continuous diffusion language models and warrants a close read. Prioritize the logic of core design choices: the problem diagnosis in the introduction and related work explaining why prior continuous LMs failed to balance fidelity and generative tractability; the autoencoder training scheme for full-width high-capacity latents, which decouples representation learning and generative modeling; the block-causal diffusion design that balances parallel throughput and long-range causal consistency; and ablation results for latent capacity, block size tradeoffs, and scaling behavior. Standard, generic diffusion formula derivations can be skimmed without line-by-line derivation. Estimated reading time: 1 hour.

recommendation.zh: 连续 latent + block-causal flow matching 是文本扩散的新设计点，建议读 encoder-decoder 与 block causal 那两节，并在内部对比 MDLM/LLaDA。
recommendation.en: Continuous latents plus block-causal flow matching is a fresh design point for diffusion LMs; read the encoder-decoder and block-causal sections and compare internally against MDLM/LLaDA.

paper.title: REFLEX: Rethinking MoE Inference as Refinement-Aware Compute Allocation in Diffusion Language Models
paper.abstract: Mixture-of-experts (MoE) models increase parameter capacity by activating only a small subset of experts for each token. This conditional-computation paradigm has enabled autoregressive language models to scale model capacity without a proportional increase in per-token computation. In diffusion language models (DLMs), however, each denoising forward jointly revisits all token positions despite their sharply different refinement demands, while the default fixed token-choice routing assigns them

summary.core_problem: 扩散语言模型（DLM）的 MoE 推理默认对所有 token 使用固定 top-k 专家选择，但在同一次 denoising forward 中，不同 token 所处的 refinement 状态差异很大——有的还在结构探索阶段，有的已接近确定。固定专家预算造成计算与 refinement 需求错配：低需求 token 浪费专家，高需求 token 预算不足。
summary.importance: 对 diffusion LM 这一非 AR 建模范式的推理效率有实际意义，也触及 MoE 与 DLM 结合时的一个新问题：AR MoE 的可变专家策略以 router score 或全局预算为依据，而 DLM 中 token 是联合迭代精炼的，分配单元应是 token 的 refinement state。论文把这一问题形式化为受约束的 state-wise 分配问题，对后续 DLM-MoE 架构和训练-推理协同设计有参考价值。属于推理优化方向，对 pretrain 本身启发间接。
summary.technical_approach: REFLEX 是 training-free 方法，保留默认 router 学到的专家排序，只改变每个 token 分配到的专家数量。它用两个维度刻画 refinement state：(1) Refinement-Role Budgeting，根据 token 在 block-wise 扩散中的结构角色给出先验分配；(2) Frontier-Guided Expert Reallocation，用 Frontier-Progress Score 衡量 token 向确定状态推进的动态进度，在保持每个 block 总专家预算不变的前提下做粗到细的再分配。与 dMoE（限制每 block 唯一专家数以降加载开销）和 EC-DLM（按 timestep 全局调度专家容量）不同，REFLEX 以 token refinement state 为分配单位，且不改动 router。
summary.experiments: 在 LLaDA-MoE 和 LLaDA2.0-mini 上，针对数学推理和代码 benchmark 评测。相比默认 Fixed TC top-8 routing，REFLEX 平均减少 15% 的 selected expert-token pairs，在多数 benchmark 上保持甚至提升生成质量；与 AR 风格的可变专家路由方法相比，quality-computation 权衡更稳定。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读。建议重点看引言中对 DLM-MoE 与 AR-MoE 推理差异的问题刻画，以及方法部分两个维度（structural role + frontier progress）的定义。实验部分关注 15% 专家削减下的质量保持情况即可。预计 20 分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: MoE inference in diffusion language models defaults to fixed top-k expert selection for every token, yet within a single denoising forward different tokens occupy very different refinement states — some are still under structural exploration while others are near commitment. A uniform expert budget mismatches compute with refinement demand, wasting experts on low-demand tokens and under-provisioning tokens that still benefit from refinement.
summary_en.importance: Practical for inference efficiency of non-AR diffusion LMs, and it surfaces a genuine new problem at the MoE–DLM intersection: variable-expert strategies for AR MoEs rely on router scores or global budgets, but in DLMs tokens are refined jointly and iteratively, so the natural unit of allocation is the token refinement state. The paper formalizes this as a constrained state-wise allocation problem, which is useful for future DLM-MoE architecture and training–inference co-design. The relevance to pretraining itself is indirect, sitting mainly in inference optimization.
summary_en.technical_approach: REFLEX is training-free and keeps the default router's learned expert ranking; it only changes how many experts each token receives. Refinement state is characterized along two axes: (1) Refinement-Role Budgeting produces a structural prior based on a token's role within block-wise diffusion; (2) Frontier-Guided Expert Reallocation uses a Frontier-Progress Score as dynamic evidence of progress toward commitment and reallocates experts coarse-to-fine while preserving each block's total expert budget. Unlike dMoE (which limits unique experts per block to reduce loading overhead) and EC-DLM (which adapts expert capacity across timesteps via a global schedule and expert-choice routing), REFLEX allocates at the token-refinement-state granularity without modifying the router.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluated on LLaDA-MoE and LLaDA2.0-mini over mathematical reasoning and coding benchmarks. Relative to default Fixed TC top-8 routing, REFLEX reduces selected expert-token pairs by 15% on average while preserving or improving generation quality on most benchmarks, and yields a more consistent quality–compute trade-off than autoregressive-style variable-expert routing.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim. Focus on the introduction's framing of how DLM-MoE inference differs from AR-MoE, and on the two refinement-state dimensions (structural role and frontier progress) in the method. In experiments, the key takeaway is quality retention at a 15% expert reduction. Estimated 20 minutes.

recommendation.zh: DLM+MoE 的推理预算不该照搬 AR；只看方法和预算曲线，值得在内部 DLM ablation 里复现。
recommendation.en: Do not inherit AR-style MoE budgeting for DLMs blindly; the compute-allocation curves are worth reproducing in an internal DLM ablation.

paper.title: xPress: Parallel Refinement for Diffusion Drafters in Speculative Decoding
paper.abstract: Block-diffusion drafters like dFlash generate an entire block of draft tokens in a single forward pass, drastically reducing the overhead of multiple-token drafting in speculative decoding. The crucial final step of the single-pass discrete denoising process involves using the logit distribution at each position to sample conditionally independent tokens. The resulting draft is thus a set of per-position marginals, rather than a joint distribution: no draft token is guaranteed to depend on its p

summary.core_problem: 块扩散草稿模型（如dFlash）可单次前向生成整块草稿token，但各位置从边缘分布独立采样，缺乏因果依赖，导致草稿局部token合理但联合概率低，会被左到右的目标模型提前拒绝，直接限制推测解码的接受长度与端到端吞吐。
summary.importance: 为扩散式推测解码的核心缺陷提供了低开销解决方案，在保留并行草稿生成优势的前提下稳定提升接受率，对大模型推理效率优化有直接工程参考价值，也为离散扩散模型的因果性注入提供了通用思路。
summary.technical_approach: 提出xPress轻量因果修正框架，核心设计有两点：一是保留原扩散草稿模型的并行块生成能力，新增低秩因果修正头，将token嵌入和草稿隐藏状态投影到低秩空间，用严格下三角线性混合器聚合前驱位置信息，输出逐位置logit加性偏置完成修正；二是用Jacobi迭代并行求解修正过程的因果依赖，仅需远小于块长B的K次并行迭代即可逼近串行自回归修正的不动点，避免重新引入串行解码开销。
summary.experiments: 以Qwen3-8B为目标模型、dFlash为基础草稿模型，在7个数学、代码、对话基准上测试：贪心解码下接受长度提升18%-56%，T=1采样下提升19%-58%，端到端解码吞吐获得一致增益。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读重点关注第3节的Jacobi并行修正推导逻辑、第4节的实验对比与消融（尤其是块长B和迭代次数K的权衡），预计阅读时间20-30分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Block diffusion drafters (e.g., dFlash) generate an entire block of draft tokens in one forward pass, but sample each position independently from marginal distributions without causal dependencies. This produces drafts with locally plausible tokens but low joint probability under the target model's left-to-right distribution, leading to early rejection, limited acceptance length, and suboptimal end-to-end throughput for speculative decoding.
summary_en.importance: Provides a low-overhead fix for the core limitation of diffusion-based speculative decoding, preserving parallel drafting while improving acceptance rates. It offers direct engineering value for inference efficiency optimization, and a generalizable approach to injecting causality into discrete diffusion models.
summary_en.technical_approach: xPress is a lightweight causal refinement framework with two key designs: 1) It keeps the original diffusion drafter's parallel block proposal intact, and adds a low-rank causal refinement head that projects token embeddings and drafter hidden states into a low-rank space, uses a strictly lower-triangular linear mixer to aggregate predecessor information, and outputs per-position additive biases for the drafter's logits. 2) It resolves the causal dependency in refinement via parallel Jacobi iterations: only K ≪ B (B is block size) parallel passes are needed to approximate the fixed point of sequential autoregressive refinement, avoiding reintroducing serial overhead.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluated with Qwen3-8B as the target model and dFlash as the base drafter across 7 math, coding, and chat benchmarks. Acceptance length improves by 18–56% under greedy decoding and 19–58% under T=1 sampling, with consistent end-to-end throughput gains.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim focus on Section 3 (Jacobi parallel refinement derivation) and Section 4 (experimental results and ablation studies on block size B vs iteration count K). Estimated reading time: 20–30 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 准确指出 block-diffusion draft 的边际独立采样问题，因果 refiner 是直接补丁；做推测解码或 diffusion LM 应看方法节。
recommendation.en: Correctly identifies the marginal-independence flaw in block-diffusion drafts and offers a direct causal-refinement fix; read the method section if you work on speculative decoding or diffusion LMs.

paper.title: Beyond On-Policy Exploration: Integrating External Policy Rollouts for Reinforcement Learning in Diffusion Language Models
paper.abstract: Recent reinforcement learning methods for diffusion large language models (dLLMs) commonly rely on on-policy rollouts generated by the target dLLM itself. When successful on-policy rollouts are scarce, however, on-policy training may receive little positive reward and make only limited progress. To mitigate this problem, we explore incorporating higher-reward rollouts generated by a stronger external policy alongside on-policy rollouts from the target dLLM. However, directly incorporating these

summary.core_problem: 该工作解决 diffusion language model 做 RLVR 时的探索瓶颈：目标 dLLM 依赖 on-policy rollout，但在数学、约束求解等任务上早期很难采到正奖励样本，导致 group-based policy optimization 几乎没有可学习信号。单纯改进 dLLM 的 likelihood estimator 或 surrogate objective，不能解决正奖励 rollout 稀缺的问题。
summary.importance: 这篇对新型语言建模范式的后训练接口有参考价值。dLLM 的 RL 目前主要难点不只是序列 likelihood 不可精确计算，还包括非自回归生成策略下的探索质量。引入强外部策略 rollout 类似用 teacher policy 提供高奖励轨迹，但作者指出不能直接混用：长度分布和 reward normalization 都会影响训练稳定性。这个结论对 diffusion LM、masked LM、any-order LM 的 RL 训练都有迁移意义。
summary.technical_approach: ERILS 将目标 dLLM 的 on-policy rollout 与强外部策略生成的 external rollout 放入同一训练流程，外部策略在实验中由更强的 autoregressive LM 承担。核心有两个处理。第一是 Rollout Length Control：外部模型往往生成更长答案，而 dLLM RL 的生成长度通常固定或受限；如果直接使用长答案，虽然 verifier reward 高，但训练收益有限。长度控制把外部 completion 调到接近目标 dLLM 的生成长度，同时尽量保留可验证质量。第二是 Source-Specific Reward Processing：on-policy 和 external rollout 的 reward 分布不同，如果放在同一组里用一个均值做相对优势，会导致优化不稳定甚至 collapse；因此分别处理两个来源的 reward，再合并用于更新。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖 Sudoku、Countdown 和 MATH500，采用 zero-shot evaluation，并报告 stochastic multi-sample 指标。Sudoku 上，ERILS 的所有 best-of-k completion accuracy 都超过 90%，而复现的最强 on-policy baseline 在 best-of-4 只有 40.3%。Countdown 上，ERILS 的 Pass@4 为 87.5%，SPG 为 76.6%。MATH500 也有提升，但给定内容未提供完整数值。消融信息显示，直接加入外部 rollout 收益有限；不做长度控制会浪费外部样本质量；把两类 rollout 放在一起做统一 reward processing 会造成训练不稳定。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议 30–40 分钟。先看 Introduction 和 Fig. 1，那里把三个现象讲得最清楚：on-policy 正奖励稀缺、外部 rollout 长度不匹配、联合 reward processing 导致 collapse。方法部分重点看 Rollout Length Control 的具体实现，以及 Source-Specific Reward Processing 如何计算 advantage 或 reward-normalized signal。实验部分优先看 Sudoku 和 Countdown 的消融，因为这两个任务最能暴露探索和稳定性问题。MATH500 结果可作为泛化参考，但不要只看最终准确率，应看外部策略质量、长度分布和训练曲线是否匹配。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses an exploration bottleneck in RLVR for diffusion language models. Existing dLLM RL methods usually rely on on-policy rollouts from the target model. When the model rarely solves the task, the verifier returns few positive rewards, and group-based policy optimization receives little useful signal. Better diffusion likelihood estimators alone do not fix this shortage of successful rollouts.
summary_en.importance: The work is relevant to the post-training interface of non-autoregressive language models. For dLLMs, RL is hard not only because exact sequence likelihood is intractable under denoising, but also because the model may not explore successful solutions early in training. Using a stronger external policy as a source of high-reward trajectories is a natural idea, but the paper shows that naive mixing is fragile. Length mismatch and reward processing are training signals, not implementation details. The same issue is likely to appear in masked, any-order, and other non-AR language-modeling regimes.
summary_en.technical_approach: ERILS mixes on-policy rollouts from the target dLLM with external rollouts generated by a stronger fixed policy, instantiated as an autoregressive LLM. It adds two mechanisms. Rollout Length Control adjusts external completions so that their lengths are closer to the generation length used by the target dLLM, while trying to preserve verifier-assessed correctness. This matters because external answers are often much longer; directly training on them gives less benefit than their reward would suggest. Source-Specific Reward Processing avoids normalizing on-policy and external rewards with a single group mean. Since the two sources have different reward distributions, joint processing can create unstable advantages and lead to collapse. ERILS processes the sources separately before using them in the policy update.
summary_en.experiments: The evaluation covers Sudoku, Countdown, and MATH500 under zero-shot settings with stochastic multi-sample metrics. On Sudoku, all ERILS best-of-k completion accuracies exceed 90%, while the strongest reproduced on-policy baseline reaches only 40.3% at best-of-4. On Countdown, ERILS reaches 87.5% Pass@4, compared with 76.6% for SPG. The supplied text also reports gains on MATH500, but does not include the full number. The ablations are the important part: uncontrolled external rollouts give limited gains despite high verifier rewards, length control improves their usefulness, and joint reward processing across sources destabilizes optimization.
summary_en.reading_guide: A useful skim takes about 30–40 minutes. Read the introduction and Fig. 1 first; they isolate the three core phenomena: sparse on-policy successes, length mismatch of external rollouts, and collapse from joint reward processing. In the method section, focus on the exact form of Rollout Length Control and how Source-Specific Reward Processing computes the training signal. In the experiments, prioritize the Sudoku and Countdown ablations because they most clearly expose exploration and stability effects. Treat MATH500 as a transfer check, and look beyond final accuracy to rollout length distributions, external-policy quality, and training curves.

recommendation.zh: 读外部rollout混合和reward分流设计即可；结论依赖外部策略强度，适合作为dLLM RL接口的消融种子。
recommendation.en: Read the rollout-mixing and reward-splitting design; the claim depends on external-policy strength but is a good ablation seed for dLLM RL.

paper.title: Faster but Different: Diagnosing and Controlling Content Drift in Accelerated Multimodal Diffusion Language Models
paper.abstract: Training-free acceleration makes diffusion-based multimodal large language models (dMLLMs) more deployable, but it may silently change generated content. We study this serving-time consistency problem on 300 real images, comparing Fast-dLLM outputs with the same model's unaccelerated outputs. Across the mild parallelism induced in our long-form setting (1.05--1.25 committed tokens per step), confidence-threshold tuning changes decoding behavior but not baseline agreement. State-refresh ablations

summary.core_problem: 解决扩散式多模态语言模型在无训练加速推理时出现“内容漂移”的问题，即加速后输出内容与同一模型未加速解码结果不一致。
summary.importance: 这项工作不是在做更高分的生成，而是在诊断 serving-time consistency。对扩散/并行解码范式来说，这比单纯报速度更关键，因为部署侧常见的 cache、并行提交和状态复用会悄悄改写生成内容。
summary.technical_approach: 作者以 Fast-dLLM 为主，比较加速版与未加速版在真实图像长文本生成上的输出一致性；通过 confidence-threshold 调参、state-refresh 消融、image-swap 干预来定位漂移来源，指出陈旧的视觉状态和已生成文本状态是主要因素。进一步提出缩短 KV-cache refresh interval，得到速度与一致性的单调折中曲线；并在 dLLM-Cache、LaViDa 上做了初步外推验证。
summary.experiments: 实验基于 300 张真实图像，关注长文本场景下较轻度并行提交（每步约 1.05–1.25 committed tokens）。结果显示：调 confidence threshold 会改变解码行为，但不能改善与原始解码的一致性；缩短 KV 刷新间隔可稳定提升 agreement，并在实测约 1.3x 加速下接近精确复现未加速输出。对 dLLM-Cache 和 LaViDa 也观察到类似诊断现象，但 dLLM-Cache 只有同时收紧两类 cache 才能恢复一致性，代价是速度优势基本消失。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自北京理工大学和浙江大学。不是头部实验室的大规模系统报告，但问题设定很贴近扩散式 MLLM 的真实部署。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies content drift in accelerated diffusion-based multimodal LMs, where training-free serving-time acceleration changes the generated content relative to the same model's unaccelerated decoding.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is not about chasing higher task scores, but about serving-time consistency. For diffusion and partially parallel decoding, this matters because cache reuse and stale states can silently alter outputs even when speedups look modest.
summary_en.technical_approach: Using Fast-dLLM as the main case, the authors compare accelerated and unaccelerated generations on real-image long-form tasks. They run confidence-threshold tuning, state-refresh ablations, and image-swap interventions to localize the source of drift, identifying stale visual states and stale generated-text states as key contributors. They then shorten the KV-cache refresh interval and obtain a monotonic speed-agreement tradeoff. Similar diagnostics are also checked on dLLM-Cache and LaViDa.
summary_en.experiments: The study uses 300 real images in a long-form setting with mild parallelism, around 1.05-1.25 committed tokens per step. Confidence-threshold tuning changes decoding behavior but does not improve baseline agreement. Shorter KV refresh intervals steadily improve agreement and recover near-exact outputs at a measured 1.3x speedup. Similar drift appears in dLLM-Cache and LaViDa, while dLLM-Cache only regains agreement after tightening both caches, which largely removes its speed benefit.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are from Beijing Institute of Technology and Zhejiang University. This is not a frontier-lab scaling report, but the problem setup is directly relevant to real deployment of diffusion-style multimodal LMs.

recommendation.zh: 做 dLM/dMLLM serving 的人该看：它提醒你速度提升未必是“同一个模型”，先看状态刷新与 cache 失真，读消融和 speed-agreement 曲线就够了。
recommendation.en: Worth reading if you care about diffusion-LM serving: a speedup is not necessarily the same model anymore, and the useful part is the cache/state-refresh diagnosis plus the speed-agreement frontier.

paper.title: Where and When to Commit: Candidate-Aware Decoding for Diffusion Language Models
paper.abstract: Diffusion language models (DLMs) expose a provisional prediction at every denoising step, creating an opportunity for generation-time early exit that stops decoding before the schedule is exhausted. Existing early-exit gates decide termination from fixed-region confidence statistics or schedule-dependent rules, evidence too coarse for a decision that freezes every remaining position at once, so they fire prematurely on long chain-of-thought outputs whose answers stabilize only near the end. Adap

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作处理的是 diffusion language model 推理阶段的一个很具体、但此前被混在一起的问题："局部 token 何时可以提交"和"整条序列何时可以提前停止"其实需要不同证据。已有方法常把位置级置信度、固定监控区域稳定性、或解码进度，当作全局 early exit 的依据；在短答案任务上还能工作，但在长链式推理里，前面中间推理文本会先稳定，真正决定正确性的答案 span 往往到很后面才稳定，于是模型会过早 fill-and-stop，直接把尚未收敛的答案冻结。论文的核心问题不是单纯再做一个更激进的加速器，而是给 DLM 的 early exit 建立更合适的判据：停止决策必须验证“候选答案本身是否稳定”，而不是看某种粗粒度代理信号。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的直接意义不在训练 recipe，而在新型语言建模范式的推理机制。Diffusion LM 相比 AR 的一个潜在优势，是中间步已经有全序列 provisional prediction，因此存在训练外加速空间；但如果 early exit 的证据设计不对，这个优势会在长推理任务上变成明显精度损失。论文把“sampling axis”和“termination axis”明确拆开，给出了一个更像 DLM 原生推理协议的框架。这一点对后续 diffusion / masked / any-order LM 都有启发：非 AR 模型的中间状态不是天然可用，必须区分局部提交和全局收敛。量级上，这篇更像一篇推理机制校正工作，而不是改变范式上限的论文；但如果你关心 DLM 能否在真实长推理场景里站住脚，这类工作是必要拼图。
summary.technical_approach:
方法上有两个部件，合起来叫 LATCH。第一个是 CVC，Confidence-Verified Commit，负责“when to stop”。它不是在固定区域上看平均置信度，也不是按 schedule 进度阈值停，而是在每一步重新抽取并定位当前 candidate answer span，然后同时检查两件事：其一，这个 span 上的置信度是否足够高；其二，这个 span 的 argmax 身份是否在连续若干步内保持稳定。只有答案候选本身被持续验证，才允许做全局 fill-and-stop。这里的关键区别是，验证对象从代理统计量换成了 candidate identity，本质上是在做 answer-aware convergence check。

第二个是 BWEC，Block-Wise Early Commit，负责“where to commit”。作者认为非最终 block 多数承载的是中间推理文本，不值得用 CVC 那套较重的 identity tracking；因此 BWEC 采用更便宜的局部置信度规则，但只允许作用在 non-final blocks。最终 block 以及整个序列的终止，仍然由 CVC 保护。这个设计避免了 SlowFast / KLASS 这类 adaptive sampling 方法把便宜的局部证据直接扩展到答案区域，从而在答案尚未稳定时过早提交。

论文还有一个重要分析前提：candidate stabilization 的时间分布高度任务相关。作者用 s0.9 这类指标刻画“90% 轨迹完成稳定所需的解码进度”，发现不同任务从 0.04 到 0.96 都有。这说明任何只依赖 progress 的统一 early exit 规则都不稳。LATCH 的价值就在于把停止条件从 schedule 位置，改成 candidate-level verification。
summary.experiments:
实验覆盖 11 个任务、两类模型家族，文中明确提到以 LLaDA-8B-Instruct 作为参考解码骨干，并测试向 Dream 的迁移。结果上，LATCH 在不按任务或模型重新调阈值的情况下，短答案任务达到 9.3–17.8× 加速，长推理任务达到 2.0–3.3× 加速，同时在所有任务、两类模型上都控制在相对 full decoding 不超过 2.0 个 accuracy point 的误差带内。

更有信息量的是失败分析。作者指出 Prophet 和 SchED 这类 termination gate，在统一 free-form zero-shot 协议下，对五个长推理任务和两种模型，全部超过 2.0 point 容忍线，最差可差 69 个点。也就是说，问题不是个别 benchmark 上的小退化，而是 termination evidence 选错了层级。SlowFast 作为 sampling-only 方法，在所有长推理设置上也超过精度容忍线；KLASS 只有在其校准 backbone 上还能勉强守住，迁移到 Dream 时会掉 5–52 个点。作者借此说明：局部提交规则可以加速，但不能替代全局终止验证。

论文最值得注意的实验信号不是单个最好数字，而是“固定一组 CVC 阈值 + 固定 BWEC 阈值”即可跨任务、跨模型迁移，而先前方法做不到。这说明 candidate-aware stopping 至少比 schedule-aware stopping 更接近模型真实收敛行为。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读时先抓三部分。第一，看引言和 Section 3，弄清作者为什么坚持把 early exit 分成两个轴：sampling commit 和 sequence termination。这里是整篇最重要的 conceptual move。第二，看 Section 4.1 关于 candidate stabilization 的统计，尤其 s0.9 的任务差异；这是他们否定 progress-only 规则的证据基础。第三，看 CVC 和 BWEC 的定义与伪代码，重点理解“为什么 BWEC 只作用于 non-final blocks，为什么 final block 必须交给 CVC”。

实验部分建议优先看与 Prophet、SchED、SlowFast、KLASS 的对比表，以及 Dream 迁移结果。若时间有限，30–40 分钟足够把主要结论读清。若要深挖，可以继续看 candidate span 的抽取方式、连续稳定性窗口如何设定、以及 block 划分对不同任务长度分布的敏感性。这些细节决定方法是否真能泛化到更开放的 free-form generation，而不只是短答案抽取场景。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses a specific inference-time failure mode in diffusion language models: token-level commitment and sequence-level termination are different decisions, but prior work often uses the same kind of evidence for both. Existing early-exit rules rely on fixed-region confidence, schedule progress, or coarse aggregate stability. That can work for short-answer tasks, but it breaks on long reasoning outputs where intermediate rationale tokens stabilize early while the actual answer span stabilizes only near the end. The result is premature fill-and-stop: the model freezes the remaining masked positions, including the answer, before true convergence. The core problem is therefore not just faster decoding, but defining the right evidence for stopping in DLMs.
summary_en.importance: Its value is mainly in inference mechanics for non-AR language modeling, not in pretraining recipe. Diffusion LMs expose provisional full-sequence predictions at every denoising step, which creates a genuine training-free acceleration opportunity. But this opportunity is only useful if the stopping criterion matches how convergence actually happens. The paper makes a clean distinction between the sampling axis and the termination axis, and that distinction is likely relevant beyond DLMs, including masked and any-order generation. The contribution is not a new modeling paradigm or a scaling result; it is a correction to how one should operationalize convergence in diffusion-style decoding, especially for long-form reasoning.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The method, LATCH, has two components. The first is CVC, Confidence-Verified Commit, which decides when the whole sequence may stop. Instead of monitoring a fixed region or using schedule-dependent heuristics, CVC re-extracts and relocates the current candidate answer span at every denoising step. It then requires both high confidence on that span and sustained argmax identity stability across multiple steps. Only when the candidate answer itself has remained stable does the decoder allow a global fill-and-stop. The key change is that the stopping rule verifies the object of interest, the answer candidate, rather than a proxy statistic.

The second component is BWEC, Block-Wise Early Commit, which decides where local commitments may happen during decoding. The authors argue that non-final blocks usually contain intermediate reasoning text, so they can be handled with a cheaper local confidence rule. BWEC therefore applies only to non-final blocks. The final block, and any global termination decision, remains under CVC. This separation is meant to preserve the speed benefits of adaptive sampling while preventing local confidence signals from prematurely freezing the answer region.

A central analytical premise is that candidate stabilization is highly task-dependent. The paper measures stabilization timing with metrics such as s0.9, the decoding progress by which 90% of trajectories have stabilized, and finds a very wide range across tasks. That observation motivates abandoning progress-only early exit in favor of candidate-aware verification.
summary_en.experiments:
The evaluation covers 11 tasks and two model families, with LLaDA-8B-Instruct used as the reference decoding backbone and transfer tested to Dream. With one frozen CVC threshold tuple and one fixed BWEC threshold, without per-task or per-model retuning, LATCH achieves 9.3–17.8× speedup on short-answer tasks and 2.0–3.3× on long-reasoning tasks, while staying within a 2.0-point accuracy tolerance relative to full decoding on every task and both model families.

The failure analysis is more informative than the headline speedups. Under a matched free-form zero-shot protocol, Prophet and SchED exceed the 2-point tolerance on all five long-reasoning tasks and both models, with errors as large as 69 points. That strongly suggests the issue is not implementation detail but the level of evidence used for termination. SlowFast, which only adjusts commitment pace, also violates the tolerance on every long-reasoning setting. KLASS remains acceptable only on its calibration backbone and drops by 5–52 points on Dream. The paper uses these results to argue that local commitment heuristics cannot substitute for explicit sequence-level convergence verification.

One notable empirical claim is transferability: the same thresholds work across tasks and model families for LATCH, whereas prior methods do not. That is a meaningful sign that candidate-aware stopping is better aligned with actual convergence behavior than schedule-aware stopping.
summary_en.reading_guide:
For a quick read, focus on three parts. First, read the introduction and the formalization section that separates sampling commits from sequence termination. That conceptual split is the backbone of the paper. Second, read the stabilization analysis, especially the statistics around s0.9, because that is the empirical basis for rejecting progress-only stopping rules. Third, read the definitions of CVC and BWEC carefully, with attention to why BWEC is restricted to non-final blocks and why the final block is protected by CVC.

In the experiments, prioritize the comparisons against Prophet, SchED, SlowFast, and KLASS, plus the Dream transfer results. Around 30–40 minutes should be enough for a solid skim. If you want to go deeper, inspect how candidate spans are extracted, how many consecutive stable steps are required, and how sensitive the method is to block partitioning. Those details matter if you care about extending the approach to more open-ended generation rather than answer-span style tasks.

recommendation.zh: 做 DLM 的人该看：它把“局部 commit”和“全局 stop”拆开，修正了很多早退工作证据粒度不匹配的问题；先看方法图和长 CoT 实验。
recommendation.en: Worth reading if you care about DLMs: it cleanly separates local commitment from global stopping, fixing the evidence-granularity mismatch in many early-exit schemes; start with the method figure and long-CoT results.

paper.title: Neuromorphic Diffusion Language Models: Addressing Compute and Memory Bottlenecks via Sparsity and Block Denoising
paper.abstract: Autoregressive (AR) large language models (LLMs) are inherently inefficient at inference time because each generated token requires accessing the full set of model parameters, leading to low operational intensity and high energy consumption. Masked diffusion language models (MDLMs) partially address this limitation for memory-bound settings by allowing multiple tokens to be generated per parameter access. In order to further enhance inference efficiency on modern platforms with extensive in-chip

summary.core_problem: 这项工作处理的是 diffusion LM 推理效率问题：MDLM 可以用 block denoising 一次生成多个 token，降低每次参数访问只产出一个 token 的低效，但每个去噪步仍然依赖 Transformer 计算，能耗和片上存储条件下的吞吐收益并不稳定。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的启发主要在建模范式与硬件效率的接口。它不是单纯做推理系统优化，而是把 masked diffusion language modeling 的并行生成特性，与 spiking / neuromorphic computation 的事件驱动稀疏性放在同一个效率模型里分析。对关注 diffusion LM 是否能替代或补充 AR 解码的人，价值在于指出：block diffusion 的收益依赖硬件瓶颈位置；如果现代加速器有较大片上存储，单靠 block 生成未必足够，需要进一步降低激活计算和参数访问。
summary.technical_approach: 方法称为 N-MDLM。基础模型采用 encoder-decoder 形式的 masked diffusion LM：encoder 编码已生成上下文，decoder 在当前 block 内做迭代去噪，一次预测多个 token。核心改动是把常规 MDLM 转成 neuromorphic 版本，使用量化和 integrate-and-fire neuron。IF neuron 通过膜电位累积输入，超过阈值才发放 spike；没有 spike 时，对应神经元不触发乘加和权重访问。这样产生动态稀疏，既减少计算，也减少参数流量。论文还给出 token-level roofline 风格分析，把 block size、activation sparsity、计算带宽和内存访问放到统一框架里，解释 diffusion 的 block parallelism 与 spiking sparsity 为什么可能互补：前者提高每次参数访问的 token 产出，后者降低每个去噪步的有效计算与访存。
summary.experiments: 实验在翻译任务上验证 N-MDLM 相对 AR-LLM 和常规 MDLM 的吞吐与能效优势，同时保持接近的任务性能。可见正文没有给出完整的模型规模、数据规模和具体提升数字，因此不宜推断精确幅度。可确认的实验设计重点是比较三类解码方式：AR 单 token 顺序生成、MDLM block 并行去噪、N-MDLM 在 block 去噪上叠加 spike-induced sparsity。消融关注 block size 与激活稀疏率对 token throughput 和 energy efficiency 的影响。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读即可，预计 20–30 分钟。重点看 Introduction 中对 AR、MDLM、N-MDLM 的效率瓶颈拆分，以及 Preliminaries 里 AR factorization、block-level factorization 和 IF neuron 的定义。最值得看的部分是 roofline-inspired analytical framework：它决定这项工作是否只是把两个已有想法拼在一起，还是能清楚说明在什么硬件条件下 diffusion 与 spiking 有协同收益。实验部分建议只看 block size、sparsity、throughput、energy 的曲线和消融，不必过度关注翻译任务本身。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets an efficiency gap in diffusion language models. Masked diffusion LMs can amortize parameter access by generating a block of tokens through iterative denoising, but each denoising step still relies on Transformer-style computation. The throughput gain also depends on whether inference is memory-bound, which may not hold on accelerators with substantial on-chip memory.
summary_en.importance: The main relevance for pretraining researchers is the link between a non-AR language modeling objective and hardware-level efficiency. The paper argues that block diffusion alone is not a complete answer to AR decoding inefficiency. Its benefit depends on the hardware bottleneck. By adding event-driven sparsity through neuromorphic computation, the model can reduce both arithmetic work and parameter traffic, making block-parallel generation more attractive under a wider range of deployment regimes.
summary_en.technical_approach: The proposed model, N-MDLM, starts from an encoder-decoder masked diffusion LM. The encoder processes previously generated context, while the decoder denoises the current token block over multiple steps. The conversion to a neuromorphic model uses quantization and integrate-and-fire neurons. An IF neuron emits a spike only when its internal state crosses a threshold; without spikes, event-driven hardware can skip synaptic operations and weight access. The technical contribution is therefore twofold: a spiking version of a block diffusion LM, and a token-level roofline-style analysis that models decoding efficiency as a function of block size and activation sparsity.
summary_en.experiments: The experiments are described as translation-task evaluations comparing AR LMs, standard MDLMs, and N-MDLMs. The reported conclusion is that N-MDLM improves token throughput and energy efficiency while retaining competitive task quality. The visible text does not provide exact model sizes, data sizes, or numerical gains, so precise effect sizes should not be inferred. The key experimental axis is the interaction between block size and spike-induced activation sparsity.
summary_en.reading_guide: A skim is sufficient, around 20–30 minutes. Read the introduction for the bottleneck analysis, then the preliminaries for the AR factorization, block diffusion factorization, and integrate-and-fire neuron definition. The most useful part is the roofline-inspired analysis, since it states when block diffusion and event-driven sparsity should help. In the experiments, focus on curves or ablations over block size, sparsity, throughput, and energy rather than the translation task itself.

recommendation.zh: 只看 roofline 模型和硬件假设；若成立，它会改变 diffusion LM 推理效率评估的度量口径。
recommendation.en: Read the roofline model and hardware assumptions; if they hold, this changes how diffusion-LM inference efficiency should be measured.

institutions: This work was supported by the European Research Council (ERC)

paper.title: TRE: Training-Free Hallucination Detection for Diffusion Language Models
paper.abstract: Diffusion large language models (D-LLMs) have recently gained increasing attention, yet their reliability is significantly hindered by the hallucination problem. Existing hallucination detection approaches for D-LLMs mainly follow a training-based paradigm, relying on data-driven training to optimize the detector. Such reliance not only limits their generalizability across domains models but also incurs additional training cost and deployment overhead. To address these limitations, we propose TR

summary.core_problem: D-LLM 的幻觉检测不能直接照搬自回归 LLM 的不确定性指标，因为扩散式生成同时有空间维度的多位置更新和时间维度的多步去噪。TRE 解决的是：不训练额外检测器、不做多次采样，只用单次生成过程里的熵信号判断幻觉风险。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的直接价值不在幻觉检测本身，而在于提供了一种观察 diffusion LM 解码动态的简单诊断信号。AR 模型的 token entropy 只有一个 next-token 前沿，D-LLM 的 entropy 是 token position × denoising step 的二维结构。TRE 的设计说明，D-LLM 的可靠性信号应优先看“正在被揭示的 token”和“后期去噪步骤”，这对分析 diffusion LM 的训练—推理不匹配、置信度校准、解码策略都有参考意义。
summary.technical_approach: 方法是参数-free、single-run 的 Temporal-weighted Revealing Entropy。核心分两步。第一步按每个去噪 step 中 token 的 revelation state 对 token 分组，经验分析发现最有用的不是已经稳定的 token，也不是尚未被模型实质决定的位置，而是当前 step 正在 reveal 的 token；这些 token 对应模型正在提交的内容决定，其 entropy 更接近事实性风险。第二步沿时间聚合 entropy evidence。作者观察到后期 denoising step 对幻觉检测更有判别力，因此给后期步骤更高权重，形成 temporal-weighted 的熵分数。它和训练式 D-LLM 检测器的区别在于不拟合 action trace、deviation model 或动态图网络，也不需要标注数据和额外 detector forward。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖多个数据集和多个 D-LLM backbone，用 TRE 与已有训练式检测方法以及面向 AR LLM 的 uncertainty baseline 比较。给出的结论是 TRE 在检测效果、计算开销和跨设置鲁棒性上表现稳定。片段中没有提供完整表格数字，因此不应把具体提升幅度外推。已给出的关键信息是：TRE 不需要 detector training，不需要 repeated sampling，只依赖一次生成中的 entropy trace。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读即可，预计 15–25 分钟。重点看三处：第一，Introduction 中对 D-LLM 幻觉检测为什么不同于 AR LLM 的问题拆解；第二，token revelation state 的分组定义和 revealing-token entropy 的经验分析；第三，temporal weighting 的设计依据。若关注 diffusion LM 的训练动态，可以进一步看 entropy 随 denoising step 变化的图，因为这类曲线比最终检测指标更有研究价值。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets hallucination detection for diffusion language models without training an auxiliary detector. The key issue is that D-LLMs expose uncertainty over both token positions and denoising steps, so AR-style next-token uncertainty metrics are not directly aligned with the generation process.
summary_en.importance: Its main relevance to pretraining research is diagnostic rather than the hallucination task itself. TRE offers a lightweight way to inspect D-LLM decoding dynamics. The useful signal is not generic token entropy, but entropy on tokens being revealed at a given step, with later denoising steps carrying more detection value. This is useful for studying confidence calibration, decoding behavior, and possible train–inference mismatch in diffusion LMs.
summary_en.technical_approach: TRE, Temporal-weighted Revealing Entropy, is parameter-free and uses a single generation run. It first categorizes tokens by their revelation state at each denoising step and keeps entropy from revealing tokens, since those positions correspond to active content decisions. It then aggregates these step-level entropy signals with a temporal weighting scheme that emphasizes later denoising steps. This differs from prior D-LLM hallucination detectors based on action-trace modeling, deviation learning, or dynamic graph modeling, all of which require labeled data and an additional trained detector.
summary_en.experiments: The experiments evaluate TRE on multiple hallucination datasets and multiple D-LLM backbones, comparing against training-based D-LLM detectors and uncertainty-style baselines adapted from AR LLMs. The reported finding is that TRE is competitive while being cheaper and more portable, since it avoids detector training and repeated sampling. The provided text does not include exact benchmark tables, so precise deltas should not be inferred.
summary_en.reading_guide: A skim is enough, around 15–25 minutes. Focus on the motivation for why D-LLM hallucination detection is structurally different from AR detection, the token-state analysis that selects revealing-token entropy, and the temporal weighting design. For diffusion LM researchers, the entropy-over-denoising-step plots are likely more informative than the final detection scores.

recommendation.zh: 扩散 LM 可靠性方向的小而实的工作，核心思路（用去噪过程熵信号做无训练检测）值得做 D-LLM 的人参考，重点看方法节。
recommendation.en: A compact but solid work on D-LLM reliability. The core idea—using denoising-process entropy signals for training-free detection—is worth examining for anyone working on diffusion LMs; focus on the method section.

paper.title: Beyond Block Boundaries: Multi-Block Editing for Diffusion Large Language Models
paper.abstract: Block diffusion has emerged as the dominant paradigm for scaling discrete diffusion language models (dLLMs), because decoding text in fixed-size blocks preserves parallel generation within each block while keeping the quadratic attention cost tractable. However, this efficiency comes with a structural limitation: tokens near the end of a block are generated without access to future cross-block context, and once a block is finalized, its uncertain predictions become irreversible context for all s

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作处理 block diffusion language model 的边界退化问题。block diffusion 为了控制注意力成本，会按固定 block 从左到右生成，并在 block 内并行去噪。问题是 block 尾部 token 缺少未来 block 的右侧上下文，一旦当前 block 被提交，错误会成为后续 block 的固定条件，后面即使出现了可纠错的上下文也无法回改。
summary.importance: 对 diffusion LM 的预训练和推理范式有直接参考价值。它指出 blockwise decoding 的质量损失不是单纯的采样噪声，而是由固定提交边界带来的结构性错误传播。这个观察对 LLaDA、Dream、Seed Diffusion 一类离散扩散语言模型尤其重要，因为大模型扩展时 block diffusion 往往是吞吐和注意力成本之间的折中方案。MBE 的意义在于给出了一种低侵入的修正路径：不推翻 block diffusion 的并行生成优势，而是在已生成 block 上增加有限的跨 block 编辑能力。
summary.technical_approach: 方法分为推理、训练和系统三层。推理侧，Multi-Block Editing 在生成新 block 后，重新打开一个由多个连续已解码 block 构成的滑动窗口，做联合 forward，让早先提交的 token 能利用后续 block 的上下文重新修订。与逐 token 回退或复杂控制策略不同，MBE 直接做 token-to-token revision，保持实现简单，并把额外计算控制在有限窗口内。当编辑窗口超过相邻 block 时，方法引入 entropy-based historical surprisal watermark，用历史不确定性来选择最可能出错的旧 block，而不是盲目重算所有历史内容。训练侧，作者提出 Multi-Block Edit SFT，引入双向注意力 mask，并用 curriculum 从 2 个 block 逐步扩展到 4 个 block，缓解预训练模型只见过单 block 去噪、推理时却要求跨 block 编辑的分布不匹配。系统侧，作者扩展 SGLang，加入 multi-shape CUDA Graph pool 和细粒度 KV cache 控制，使单 block 解码和多 block 编辑这两类不同 shape、不同 attention pattern 的 forward 可以在同一请求中高效交错执行。
summary.experiments: 实验模型是 LLaDA2.1-Mini，覆盖 13 个 benchmark。训练-free MBE 在 K=2 编辑窗口下已经超过已有 decoding baseline，同时保持相近吞吐。文中给出的吞吐指标显示，MBE 的 Tokens Per Forward 为 8.42，而对比设置为 8.63，说明额外编辑没有明显破坏 block diffusion 的并行效率。加入 Multi-Block Edit SFT 后，整体性能最多提升 2.7 分，推理和逻辑类任务收益更明显，例如 AIME 2025 提升 13.3 分，ZebraLogic 提升 5.9 分。这些结果支持一个判断：跨 block 上下文主要修正的是边界附近的不确定 token，而这些 token 对长链推理和结构化约束任务更敏感。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读 30 到 40 分钟。重点看 Introduction 中对 block boundary problem 的定义，以及 Figure 2 中按位置上升的 perplexity 证据；这部分是问题成立的关键。方法部分重点看 training-free MBE 的 sliding-window editing 和 entropy watermark，理解它为什么比简单扩大 block 或全历史重算更便宜。Multi-Block Edit SFT 部分值得看 attention mask 和 curriculum 设计，因为这里连接了 inference-time editing 与训练分布对齐。系统部分可快速看 SGLang 改动，重点关注 multi-shape CUDA Graph 和 KV cache 控制是否会成为实际部署瓶颈。实验部分优先看 K 值、编辑频率、吞吐和任务收益之间的 trade-off。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses a structural failure mode in block diffusion language models. Block diffusion decodes fixed-size blocks from left to right while denoising tokens in parallel inside each block. Tokens near the end of a block lack future cross-block context, and once a block is committed, its uncertain predictions become irreversible context for all later blocks.
summary_en.importance: The work is relevant to diffusion LM scaling because blockwise decoding is a practical compromise between parallel generation and attention cost.
