The paper makes the quality cost more concrete: the degradation is not just sampling noise, but error accumulation caused by hard block boundaries and irreversible commits. This matters for systems in the LLaDA, Dream, and Seed Diffusion family, where block diffusion is used to keep inference tractable at larger scales.
summary_en.technical_approach: Multi-Block Editing adds a bounded revision phase to block diffusion. At inference time, after a new block is decoded, the method reopens a sliding window of already decoded blocks and performs joint forward passes over that window, allowing earlier tokens to be revised using later context. The design avoids token-level rollback logic and keeps the computation bounded by editing whole blocks through direct token-to-token revision. For windows beyond adjacent blocks, an entropy-based historical surprisal watermark is used to select the previously decoded block that is most likely to contain errors, rather than recomputing all history. The training component, Multi-Block Edit SFT, introduces bidirectional attention masks and a curriculum that expands the edit span from 2 to 4 blocks, so the model learns to exploit multi-block context instead of seeing it only at inference time. On the systems side, the authors extend SGLang with a multi-shape CUDA Graph pool and fine-grained KV-cache control to support interleaved single-block decoding and variable-length multi-block editing passes.
summary_en.experiments: Experiments are conducted on LLaDA2.1-Mini across 13 benchmarks. Training-free MBE with a two-block edit window outperforms existing decoding baselines while preserving similar throughput. The reported Tokens Per Forward is 8.42 for MBE versus 8.63 for the comparison setting, indicating that the editing pass does not erase the parallelism advantage of block diffusion. With Multi-Block Edit SFT, the model gains up to 2.7 aggregate points, with larger improvements on reasoning-heavy tasks: +13.3 on AIME 2025 and +5.9 on ZebraLogic. The pattern suggests that boundary errors are especially harmful when later reasoning steps depend on early committed tokens.
summary_en.reading_guide: A 30–40 minute skim is enough for most readers. The most useful parts are the problem formulation in the introduction and the per-position perplexity evidence in Figure 2. The inference algorithm is worth reading carefully, especially the sliding-window edit schedule and the entropy watermark, because these define the compute-quality trade-off. The SFT section is useful for understanding how the method reduces the mismatch between single-block pretraining and multi-block revision. The systems section can be skimmed, with attention to the multi-shape CUDA Graph and KV-cache changes. In the experiments, focus on edit-window size, throughput, and benchmark groups where editing helps most.

recommendation.zh: 块扩散 dLLM 边界误差问题的训练无关解法，思路干净，重点看 MBE 的注意力窗口设计和编辑策略，适合做内部扩散 LM 解码侧 ablation 参考。
recommendation.en: A clean training-free fix for the block boundary artifact in block-diffusion dLLMs; focus on the attention window design and editing strategy as a reference for diffusion LM decoding ablations.

paper.title: Mean-to-Score Discrete Diffusion: Posterior-Mean Denoisers for Score Entropy
paper.abstract: Score Entropy Discrete Diffusion (SEDD) parameterizes discrete reverse processes with unconstrained positive score ratios. While positivity guarantees nonnegative reverse jump rates, it does not ensure Bayes realizability: ratios at a noisy state need not be jointly induced by any clean-token posterior under the forward kernel. The score-entropy loss has the correct population optimum but does not enforce this constraint away from it. In a trained pure-uniform SEDD checkpoint, roughly one quarte

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文指出 SEDD 在离散扩散语言建模中的一个参数化缺陷：网络输出正的 score ratio 可以保证反向 CTMC jump rate 非负，但不能保证这些 score ratio 来自同一个合法的 clean-token posterior。也就是说，模型在非最优点可能输出无法由贝叶斯后验解释的完整 score 向量。
summary.importance: 这对 diffusion LM 预训练很有直接意义。SEDD 的 score-entropy loss 在 population optimum 上是对的，但训练中的模型和有限容量模型长期处在 off-optimum 区域。如果参数化允许无效 score，采样器会遇到负的 pre-normalization weights，并用截断后的正部继续采样，这会把训练目标、反向过程和实际 sampler 之间的关系弄松。论文给出的 M2S 参数化把模型输出限制在 Bayes-realizable 集合内，是对离散扩散 LM 目标设计的一次干净修正。
summary.technical_approach: 论文先形式化 Bayes realizability：在 noisy token 为 k、时间为 t 时，完整 concrete-score 向量 s 必须能写成 s = B_{t,k} μ，其中 μ 是 clean-token posterior，属于概率单纯形。对 pure-uniform corruption，每个坐标必须落在 [ρ_t, ρ_t^{-1}]，但这个 coordinate box 只是必要条件；真正可实现的集合是更小的 bridge polytope P_{t,k}=B_{t,k}(Δ^{K-1})。SEDD 用 exp head 只保证 s_y>0，因此可能落在 box 外，也可能在 box 内但不在 polytope 内。M2S 的做法是改为预测 μ_θ=softmax(logits)，再用已知 forward kernel 推出的线性 bridge B_t 把 posterior mean 映射成 score。这样所有输出天然 Bayes-realizable。对 uniform corruption，该映射在 simplex 上可注入，有闭式形式，每个位置 O(K) 计算；对 absorbing-mask corruption，它退化为 MD4 的 weighted clean-token cross-entropy。
summary.experiments: 论文审计了一个 pure-uniform SEDD checkpoint。离线审计中，在 32.9 亿个 candidate scores 里有 6.69% 越过 coordinate box。生成过程中，用 SEDD 原 sampler 跑 128 条序列并检查每个位置、每个采样步的完整 score vector：25.02% 的向量存在 coordinate violation，另有 56.23% 虽然每个坐标都在合法区间内，但无法对应任何有效 clean-token posterior。采样器在这些情况下会遇到负的 pre-normalization weights，并实际从正部采样。作者进一步固定 time grid、初始状态、随机数流、final denoising 和 sampler code，只把 score 投影到 bridge polytope；在 1024 对 paired sequences 上，投影消除了观察到的负权重，并把 external generative PPL 从 203.60 降到 175.07。论文还给出理论结果：conditional score-entropy risk 的唯一最优点是真实 score，并给出从 score 唯一恢复 posterior 的 rank condition；pure-uniform corruption 满足该条件。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读 45-60 分钟。先看 Introduction 中 coordinate box、bridge polytope 和 Bayes realizability 的定义，Figure 1 能快速建立几何直觉。然后看理论部分的 Proposition 4.3 和 Theorem 4.4，重点理解“loss 的 population optimum 正确”为什么仍不足以保证训练中输出有效。实验部分优先看 checkpoint audit、generation-time audit、projection ablation，这三组结果直接说明参数化缺陷会影响采样质量。实现上值得看 M2S 如何从 posterior mean 通过 B_t 得到完整 score，以及 uniform corruption 下 O(K) per site 的计算路径。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper identifies a parameterization problem in SEDD for discrete diffusion language models. Positive score ratios are enough to keep reverse CTMC jump rates nonnegative, but they do not guarantee that the full vector of candidate ratios at a noisy token can be induced by a single valid clean-token posterior.
summary_en.importance: The issue matters for diffusion LM training because models spend most of training away from the population optimum, and finite-capacity checkpoints may remain off that optimum. SEDD’s score-entropy objective has the right optimum, but its unconstrained positive head can produce scores that no Bayesian posterior could generate. This creates a mismatch between the loss, the intended reverse process, and the implemented sampler. M2S fixes the admissible geometry of the model outputs rather than patching invalid scores at sampling time.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors define Bayes realizability at the vector level. For a noisy token k at time t, a concrete-score vector must be expressible as s = B_{t,k} μ for some clean-token posterior μ on the vocabulary simplex. Under pure-uniform corruption, each coordinate must lie in [ρ_t, ρ_t^{-1}], but this coordinate box is only a necessary condition. The realizable set is the smaller bridge polytope P_{t,k}=B_{t,k}(Δ^{K-1}). SEDD’s exponentiated head enforces only positivity, so outputs can be outside the box or inside the box but outside the polytope. Mean-to-Score instead predicts a posterior distribution μ_θ with a softmax head and maps it through the known bridge operator B_t to obtain all concrete scores. For uniform corruption, the map is injective on the simplex, has a closed form, and costs O(K) per site. For absorbing-mask corruption, the same construction recovers the MD4 weighted clean-token cross-entropy formulation.
summary_en.experiments: The empirical audit is the strongest part. In a pure-uniform SEDD checkpoint, 6.69% of 3.29 billion audited candidate scores violate the coordinate box. During generation with the released SEDD sampler on 128 sequences, 25.02% of complete score vectors contain a coordinate violation, and another 56.23% pass all coordinate bounds but are still incompatible with any valid clean-token posterior. The sampler encounters negative pre-normalization weights in these cases and effectively samples from their positive part. In a controlled projection experiment on 1,024 paired sequences, with the time grid, initial states, random stream, final denoising, and sampler code held fixed, projecting scores onto the bridge polytope removes the observed negative weights and improves external generative perplexity from 203.60 to 175.07. The theory also shows that the conditional score-entropy risk is uniquely minimized at the true score and gives a rank condition under which the posterior is uniquely recoverable; pure-uniform corruption satisfies it.
summary_en.reading_guide: A focused skim takes about 45-60 minutes. Start with the definitions of Bayes realizability, the coordinate box, and the bridge polytope in the introduction; Figure 1 gives the right geometric picture. Then read Proposition 4.3 and Theorem 4.4 to separate two facts: the loss has the correct population optimum, but the unconstrained head does not enforce valid off-optimum outputs. In the experiments, prioritize the checkpoint audit, the generation-time audit, and the projection ablation. For implementation details, look at how M2S converts a posterior-mean denoiser into score ratios through B_t and why the uniform-corruption case remains O(K) per site.

recommendation.zh: 这篇不是又一个 diffusion LM 小修小补，它抓住了 SEDD 参数化不合法这个真问题；先看病理统计和投影修复实验，再决定要不要在自家 DLM 上加 realizability 约束。
recommendation.en: This is not just another diffusion-LM tweak; it hits a real flaw in SEDD parameterization. Read the pathology stats and projection fix first, then decide whether your own DLM needs explicit realizability constraints.

paper.title: Multi-Mask Diffusion Language Models for Few-Step Generation
paper.abstract: Masked diffusion models (MDMs) are a promising family of language generators, but achieving high-quality few-step generation remains challenging. In MDMs, all forward trajectories collapse to a single fully masked state, leaving no terminal entropy for consistency-style few-step generation. While recent few-step alternatives based on uniform-state diffusion avoid this degeneracy, it becomes harder to distinguish clean tokens from noise than MDMs, which usually harms modeling quality and training

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文解决的是离散扩散语言模型在 few-step 生成上的一个结构性障碍。标准 masked diffusion model（MDM）虽然训练目标和语言建模很贴近，但它的前向过程会收敛到唯一的全 mask 终态，终态熵为 0。这对 consistency-style 的少步生成很不友好，因为起点没有信息，无法像连续扩散那样从一个有熵的简单分布稳定映射回文本。另一条路线 USDM 让终态保持随机性，但代价是噪声 token 和真实 token 混在同一词表里，clean/noise 边界变模糊，通常损害建模质量和训练效率。论文要解决的核心问题就是：能否保留 MDM 的“mask 语义清晰”这一优点，同时给终态引入足够熵，使离散 diffusion LM 可以做高质量 few-step generation，并且最好还能复用已有的 pretrained MDM。
summary.importance:
对新型语言建模范式研究，这篇工作是今天两篇里更值得精读的一篇。原因不在于它单纯提出了一个新 corruption process，而在于它抓住了 masked diffusion LM 走向实用时最关键的瓶颈：如何从“长链去噪”过渡到“少步采样”，又不丢掉 MDM 在离散文本上的训练优势。这个问题如果处理不好，diffusion LM 很难在推理成本上接近 AR LM，也很难成为统一多模态生成框架里的文本分支。

贡献可以分成三层。第一，提出 multi-mask diffusion，把单吸收态改成多 mask 子空间，给终态保留非零熵，同时仍然显式标记噪声位置。第二，给出闭式 ELBO / KL 目标，训练目标仍然保持“重建 clean token + 识别 mask 身份”的可实现形式，而不是引入复杂连续松弛。第三，提出适用于离散 setting 的 consistency distillation 方案：通过共享 Gumbel 噪声构造低熵耦合路径，并把一致性目标定义为 future-filtration posterior。这一套设计的价值在于，它不是另起炉灶训练一个连续模型，而是尽量沿着已有 MDM 体系演化，并支持从 pretrained MDM 做 continual adaptation。对做 diffusion LM、any-order LM、AR+diffusion 联合建模的人，这个接口很关键。
summary.technical_approach:
方法核心是把单一 mask token 扩展成一个 mask 集合。设普通词表为 V，额外引入多个 mask 状态 M={m1,...,mK}。每个 clean token x0 会先被分配一个 designated mask，前向扩散时，token 不是直接坍缩到统一的 [M]，而是先更偏向自己的 designated mask，再在整个 mask 子空间内逐渐混合。这样做有两个直接后果。第一，终态不再是唯一全 mask 序列，而是在 mask 子空间上保留熵，因此可以作为 few-step 生成的起点。第二，mask 仍然和普通词表分离，所以模型仍然知道哪些位置是“被腐蚀的”，保留了 MDM 相比 USDM 的 clean/noise 可分性。

从概率建模上，作者给出了这个多 mask 前向过程的精确定义，并推导出闭式 ELBO。训练目标可以理解为两部分：一部分是标准的 clean-token reconstruction，即从 xt 预测原始 token；另一部分是 intra-mask identification，即当位置已经落入 mask 子空间时，模型还要识别它属于哪个 mask。这个额外项不是装饰性的，它正对应 multi-mask 设计引入的信息结构：如果模型不学会区分不同 mask，终态熵虽然存在，但无法被有效利用。

论文另一个关键点是“如何做离散 consistency distillation”。连续扩散里可以借助 probability-flow ODE 把随机过程对应到确定性流，但离散 jump process 没有这么直接的对应物。作者的处理是构造 low-entropy shared-Gumbel coupling：在不同时间点共享 Gumbel 噪声，使得两条离散路径之间具有较强耦合，从而定义稳定的一致性训练目标。目标不是简单让不同时间的网络输出相同 token，而是让学生去逼近沿耦合路径的 future-filtration posterior，也就是给定未来噪声信息后对 clean token 的后验。这个定义比朴素 self-consistency 更严谨，因为它尊重离散随机过程本身的条件结构。

还有一个很实用的设计是 continual training recipe。由于 MultiMDM 与 MDM 在大部分建模接口上兼容，作者可以从一个已经训练好的 MDM 初始化，再继续训练到 multi-mask 版本，而不是从头训练。这一点很重要，因为 diffusion LM 的预训练成本不低；如果 few-step 能力必须靠从零训练新模型获得，方法的采用门槛会高很多。论文还给出初步证据，说明这种从 pretrained MDM 到 MultiMDM 的迁移在 8B 级模型上也可行，并能转移到 code、math 这类更难分布上。
summary.experiments:
实验主要在 LM1B 和 OpenWebText 上进行预训练与 consistency distillation，并报告 few-step generation 质量。摘要和现有全文片段没有完整列出所有表格数字，但从论文叙述可以确认，作者比较了三类路线：标准 MDM、USDM 类 few-step 替代方案，以及提出的 MultiMDM。结果方向很清楚：MultiMDM 在少步采样场景下优于标准 masked diffusion 的直接 few-step 化，也优于 uniform-state 路线，同时尽量保住了 MDM 的建模质量和训练效率。

实验价值主要体现在四个方面。第一，few-step 生成质量：在相同或相近 NFE 下，MultiMDM 的样本质量更好，说明多 mask 终态确实提供了更可用的起始随机性。第二，训练目标消融：加入 intra-mask identification 项后，模型能更好利用 mask 子空间信息；如果去掉这一项，多 mask 设计的收益会被削弱。第三，distillation 机制消融：shared-Gumbel coupling 和 posterior target 不是可有可无的工程细节，而是 few-step 成功的关键。第四，continual adaptation：从 pretrained MDM 迁移到 MultiMDM，而不是从头训练，依然能得到有效 few-step 模型，并在 8B 预训练 MDM 上对 code、math benchmark 给出初步正向结果。

如果你关心具体数字，建议重点查实验章节里关于 NFE=1/2/4/8 的对比表、ELBO 或 NLL 变化、以及从 MDM 初始化与 scratch 训练的差异。论文摘要明确提到“superior performance on few-step generation after pretraining and consistency distillation on LM1B and OpenWebText”，以及“preliminary evidence”表明 8B pretrained MDM 上的 continual multi-mask adaptation 可以迁移到代码和数学任务。也就是说，作者的证据链从小中规模文本预训练一直延伸到较大模型迁移，而不是只停留在 toy setup。
summary.reading_guide:
建议精读。先看 Introduction 和 Preliminaries，把问题背景吃透：为什么 MDM 的终态退化会卡住 few-step，为什么 USDM 虽然有终态熵但会损伤 clean/noise 区分。接着重点看定义 forward process 的章节和 Fig.1，理解“designated mask → mask subspace mixing”这个几何结构。这里是整篇最核心的创新，不搞清楚后面的 ELBO 和 distillation 都会显得像技巧堆叠。

然后看 ELBO 推导部分，重点抓两个训练项各自对应什么统计对象，尤其是 intra-mask identification 为什么必要。再看 consistency distillation 章节，关注 shared-Gumbel coupling 的构造、future-filtration posterior 的定义，以及 few-step generation algorithm。这里决定了论文是否只是提出一个更好的 noising process，还是确实给出了一条可执行的少步采样路径。

实验部分建议按顺序看：先看主结果表，确认 few-step 质量与 NFE 的关系；再看消融，尤其是 mask 数量、是否从 pretrained MDM 初始化、是否使用 posterior target；最后看 8B continual adaptation 的案例，这部分虽然证据还偏初步，但对大模型可扩展性最有参考意义。

阅读时值得深挖的点有四个。第一，多 mask 数 K 与词表大小、token semantics、训练稳定性的关系，是否存在最优区间。第二，designated mask 的分配策略是否影响泛化，是否可以做语义感知分配而不是固定映射。第三，shared-Gumbel coupling 是否只是一个近似上好用的技巧，还是能导出更强的一致性理论。第四，这个框架能否自然接到 multimodal token spaces，例如图像离散 token 或语音 codec token。若要完整吃透，建议预留 1.5–2.5 小时。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses a structural bottleneck in few-step generation for discrete diffusion language models. Standard masked diffusion models (MDMs) are attractive because their denoising target aligns well with language modeling, but their forward process collapses to a single fully masked terminal state with zero entropy. That makes consistency-style few-step generation difficult: there is no informative terminal distribution to start from. Uniform-state diffusion avoids this degeneracy by keeping terminal randomness inside the vocabulary, but then noisy tokens are harder to distinguish from clean ones, which often hurts modeling quality and training efficiency. The central problem is therefore to retain the semantic clarity of masked diffusion while introducing enough terminal entropy to enable high-quality few-step generation, ideally without abandoning the pretrained MDM ecosystem.
summary_en.importance:
This is the more important paper of the two for alternative LM paradigms. Its significance is not just a new corruption process, but a concrete attempt to remove one of the main practical barriers for diffusion LMs: how to move from long denoising chains to few-step generation without giving up the training advantages of masked diffusion. If that transition fails, diffusion LMs remain hard to deploy against autoregressive models on inference cost, and they become less attractive as text components in unified multimodal generative systems.

The contribution has three layers. First, MultiMDM replaces the single absorbing mask with a multi-mask subspace, preserving explicit noise markers while restoring nonzero terminal entropy. Second, it derives a closed-form ELBO/KL objective that remains native to the discrete setting, rather than relying on continuous relaxations. Third, it proposes a discrete consistency-distillation recipe based on shared-Gumbel low-entropy couplings and a future-filtration posterior target. Just as important, the method supports continual adaptation from pretrained MDMs instead of requiring a new model family trained from scratch. That interface is highly relevant for anyone working on diffusion LMs, any-order LMs, or AR+diffusion hybrids.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The key idea is to replace the single mask token with a set of mask states. Let V be the normal vocabulary and M={m1,...,mK} be a set of mask tokens. Each clean token x0 is assigned a designated mask. In the forward process, a token does not jump directly toward one universal [M]; it is first biased toward its designated mask and only later mixes across the full mask subspace. This changes the geometry of the diffusion process in two useful ways. First, the terminal distribution is no longer a single deterministic all-mask sequence; it retains entropy over the mask subspace and can therefore serve as a meaningful starting point for few-step generation. Second, mask states remain separate from the normal vocabulary, so the model still knows which positions are corrupted. That preserves the clean/noise separation that makes MDMs stronger than uniform-state diffusion.

The probabilistic formulation is developed explicitly, and the resulting ELBO has a clean interpretation. One term is the usual clean-token reconstruction objective: predict the original token from a corrupted state. The second term is an intra-mask identification objective: once a position has entered the mask subspace, the model must also identify which mask it belongs to. This is not a cosmetic addition. It is exactly what allows the model to exploit the information carried by the multi-mask terminal state. Without learning to distinguish masks, the extra entropy would exist formally but would not be useful for generation.

The second major technical contribution is the consistency-distillation construction for the discrete setting. In continuous diffusion, one can often move from a stochastic SDE to a deterministic probability-flow ODE while preserving marginals. There is no direct analogue for finite-state jump processes. The paper addresses this by introducing a low-entropy coupling based on shared Gumbel noise across time points. This creates strongly coupled discrete trajectories and enables a stable consistency target. Importantly, the target is not a naive requirement that outputs at different times should match. Instead, the student is trained toward the future-filtration posterior over clean tokens along the coupled path. That is a more principled target because it respects the conditional structure of the discrete stochastic process.

A practical strength of the framework is the continual-training recipe. Because MultiMDM stays close to the MDM parameterization and training interface, a pretrained MDM can be adapted into a multi-mask model rather than retraining from scratch. Given the cost of diffusion-LM pretraining, this is a meaningful design choice. The paper also provides preliminary evidence that this transfer works at the 8B scale and can carry over to harder domains such as code and math.
summary_en.experiments:
The experiments pretrain and distill models on LM1B and OpenWebText, then evaluate few-step generation quality. The full excerpt provided here does not include all tables, but the empirical story is clear. The paper compares standard MDMs, uniform-state diffusion style alternatives for few-step generation, and the proposed MultiMDM. MultiMDM performs better in few-step generation than direct few-step variants of standard masked diffusion and also outperforms the uniform-state route, while preserving much of the modeling quality and training efficiency associated with MDMs.

The experimental evidence is useful in four ways. First, few-step generation quality improves at the same or similar NFE, indicating that the multi-mask terminal distribution provides more usable starting randomness. Second, the training-objective ablation shows that the intra-mask identification term matters; removing it weakens the benefit of the multi-mask design. Third, the distillation ablation shows that shared-Gumbel coupling and the posterior target are central rather than incidental engineering choices. Fourth, continual adaptation from a pretrained MDM remains effective, and the paper reports preliminary positive transfer on an 8B pretrained MDM for code and math benchmarks.

If exact numbers matter, the places to inspect are the tables comparing NFE=1/2/4/8, the ELBO or NLL changes, and the comparison between training from a pretrained MDM versus from scratch. The abstract explicitly claims superior few-step generation after pretraining and consistency distillation on LM1B and OpenWebText, plus preliminary evidence that continual multi-mask adaptation transfers to an 8B pretrained MDM on code and math. So the evidence chain extends beyond toy-scale experiments into a larger-model adaptation setting.
summary_en.reading_guide:
This one deserves a careful read. Start with the Introduction and Preliminaries to internalize the problem setup: why terminal degeneracy blocks few-step generation in MDMs, and why uniform-state diffusion restores entropy at the cost of weaker clean/noise separation. Then move to the section defining the forward process and study Figure 1 closely. The designated-mask-to-mask-subspace transition is the conceptual center of the paper; without that, the ELBO and distillation sections will look like disconnected tricks.

Next, read the ELBO derivation with one question in mind: what statistical object does each loss term correspond to, and why is intra-mask identification necessary? After that, read the consistency-distillation section carefully, focusing on how shared-Gumbel coupling is constructed, how the future-filtration posterior is defined, and how the few-step generation algorithm is obtained. This is where the paper either succeeds as a practical few-step framework or remains only a nicer noising process.

For the experiments, read in this order: the main few-step results, then the ablations on mask count, pretrained-MDM initialization, and posterior targets, and finally the 8B continual-adaptation results. The last part is still preliminary, but it is the most informative section for scalability.

Four follow-up questions are worth digging into. How should the number of masks K scale with vocabulary size and token semantics? Does the designated-mask assignment strategy matter, and could semantic assignment work better than a fixed mapping? Is shared-Gumbel coupling merely a useful approximation, or can it support a stronger consistency theory for discrete processes? And can the same framework extend naturally to multimodal discrete token spaces such as image tokenizers or speech codec tokens? A full read will likely take 1.5 to 2.5 hours.

recommendation.zh: 这篇会直接影响你对“MDM 能否做少步生成”的判断；先看 forward process 设计和 few-step 曲线，若结果站得住，内部应立刻补一组 multi-mask ablation。
recommendation.en: This one can change your prior on whether MDMs can do few-step generation at all; read the forward-process design and the quality-vs-steps plots first, and replicate the multi-mask ablation internally if the setup looks clean.

paper.title: JUMP: Single-Pass Membership Inference on Fine-Tuned Diffusion Language Models
paper.abstract: Membership inference attacks (MIAs) test whether a candidate example appeared in a model's training data. We study MIAs for fine-tuned discrete diffusion language models (dLLMs), where membership means inclusion in the target model's fine-tuning set. Unlike autoregressive language models, dLLMs allow an attacker to choose arbitrary mask sets and obtain token distributions for all masked positions in parallel. The prior dLLM attack, SAMA, follows a natural loss-mimicking strategy by averaging rec

summary.core_problem: 针对微调后的离散扩散语言模型（dLLM）做成员推断攻击（MIA），判断样本是否出现在微调集中。
summary.importance: 首次系统性利用 dLLM 相对 AR 的两个独特接口——any-order 可解码和并行解码——来做单次查询 MIA，比之前 SAMA 的多次随机掩码查询更高效；对扩散 LM 训练数据隐私和数据检测有直接意义。
summary.technical_approach: JUMP (Joint Uncertainty-Guided Mask Probing)：用 any-order 可解码性选择参考模型置信度低的位置，再用并行可解码性对这些位置做一次联合掩码查询打分；替代 SAMA 在大量随机掩码上平均重建信号的做法，把查询次数从多次降到单 pass。
summary.experiments: 在微调 dLLM 上对比 SAMA 等基线，JUMP 单次查询即达到或超过多次查询的攻击准确率（abstract 截断，具体数据集和数值未给出）。

summary_en.core_problem: Membership inference attacks against fine-tuned discrete diffusion language models (dLLMs), determining whether a candidate example appeared in the fine-tuning set.
summary_en.importance: First to systematically exploit two dLLM-specific interfaces—any-order decodability and parallel decodability—for single-query MIA, far more query-efficient than the prior SAMA attack that averages over many random masks; directly relevant to diffusion LM training-data privacy and data detection.
summary_en.technical_approach: JUMP (Joint Uncertainty-Guided Mask Probing) uses any-order decodability to select positions with low reference-model confidence, then uses parallel decodability to score all selected positions with one joint masked query per model, replacing SAMA's many random-mask queries with a single pass.
summary_en.experiments: Compared against SAMA and other baselines on fine-tuned dLLMs; JUMP matches or exceeds multi-query attack accuracy with a single query (abstract truncated, exact datasets and numbers not provided).

recommendation.zh: 扩散 LM 的 MIA 比 AR 强不是因为模型更差，而是 any-order 接口本身泄露更多信息，做 dLLM 预训练/微调数据发布前必看。
recommendation.en: dLLMs are more vulnerable to MIA not because they are worse models but because the any-order interface leaks more; required reading before releasing diffusion LM pretrain/finetune data.

paper.title: One-step lowest-variance selection in a Gaussian random-field model motivated by masked diffusion: Total correlation and a square root collision threshold
paper.abstract: Motivated by confidence-guided parallel unmasking in masked discrete diffusion, we study a single selection step in a stylized Gaussian random-field model. A locally dependent nonnegative score field represents position wise uncertainty, and the scheduler selects the K positions with the smallest scores. Dependence among the selected positions is measured through a distance-dependent Gaussian correlation model. This separation provides a tractable framework for quantifying how the geometry of lo

summary.core_problem: masked 离散扩散的置信度引导并行解掩码中，所选低置信度位置间的依赖会导致因子化并行解码的性能损失，但缺乏严格的理论量化框架来指导调度器设计。
summary.importance: 理论突破，首次为 masked 扩散的并行解码选择步骤建立了可处理的高斯随机场模型，给出了选择位置间依赖的相变阈值，为调度器设计提供了严格理论依据。
summary.technical_approach: 将位置不确定性建模为局部依赖的非负高斯得分场，用距离相关的高斯相关模型刻画所选位置的依赖，通过总相关量化依赖代价，证明了两个互补结果：次平方根区域（K≪√N）下选择块的条件高斯总相关概率趋于0，平方根尺度（K~√N）下总相关不可忽略且存在严格正的期望下界。
summary.experiments: 通过合成实验验证了有限尺寸下，所选位置的总相关行为与理论预测的次平方根/平方根尺度的相变阈值一致。

summary_en.core_problem: In confidence-guided parallel unmasking for masked discrete diffusion, dependence among selected low-confidence positions causes performance loss in factorized parallel decoding, but no rigorous theoretical quantification framework exists to guide scheduler design.
summary_en.importance: Theoretical breakthrough establishing a tractable Gaussian random-field model for the selection step in masked diffusion parallel decoding, with phase transition thresholds for position dependence that provide rigorous guidance for scheduler design.
summary_en.technical_approach: Models position-wise uncertainty as a locally dependent non-negative Gaussian score field, characterizes dependence among selected positions via a distance-dependent Gaussian correlation model, and quantifies dependence cost via total correlation; two complementary results are proven: total correlation vanishes in probability in the sub-square-root regime (K≪√N) and remains non-negligible with a positive lower bound at the square-root scale (K~√N).
summary_en.experiments: Synthetic experiments validate that finite-size total correlation behavior matches the theoretically predicted phase transition thresholds at sub-square-root and square-root scales.

recommendation.zh: masked文本扩散并行解码调度的理论分析，平方根相变阈值可直接指导调度器设计，重点看§3的两个定理。
recommendation.en: Theoretical analysis of parallel decoding for masked text diffusion; the square-root phase threshold directly guides scheduler design, focus on §3 theorems.

paper.title: LaCache: Exact Caching and Precision-Adaptive Inference for Diffusion Large Language Models
paper.abstract: Diffusion-based Large Language Models(DLLMs) enable parallel generation via Semi-Autoregressive (SAR) decoding in text generation. However, current methods suffer from severe operator-level redundancy: they recompute the entire sequence during denoising steps, ignoring that the prefix and masked suffix remain invariant within a block. We propose LaCache, a training-free acceleration framework that alleviates this redundancy through lossless caching and mixed precision. Specifically, LaCache empl

summary.core_problem: Diffusion LLM 在半自回归分块解码中每个去噪步都重算整段序列，忽略前缀与块内未变 mask 后缀的算子级冗余。
summary.importance: 首个针对 DLLM 推理的无损缓存 + 混合精度加速框架，直接服务于新兴的离散扩散/MDLM 类文本建模范式的部署。
summary.technical_approach: LaCache 是免训练框架：(1) Lossless State Memoization 缓存三类中间结果——EmbedCache（embedding 输出）、RoPECache（逐 token 注意力前状态）、FACache（FlashAttention 在线 softmax 统计），对未变 token 跳过计算且输出完全一致；(2) 针对 FFN 的 per-group FP8 量化，按步定制以缓解内存带宽瓶颈。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给具体模型、baseline 与加速比/精度数值。

summary_en.core_problem: Diffusion LLMs recompute the entire sequence every denoising step during semi-autoregressive block decoding, ignoring operator-level redundancy in invariant prefixes and masked suffixes within a block.
summary_en.importance: A lossless caching plus mixed-precision acceleration framework tailored to DLLM inference, directly serving deployment of the emerging discrete diffusion / MDLM family of text models.
summary_en.technical_approach: LaCache is training-free: (1) Lossless State Memoization caches three intermediates—EmbedCache for embeddings, RoPECache for per-token pre-attention states, and FACache for FlashAttention online softmax stats—so unchanged tokens skip computation with identical outputs; (2) per-group FP8 quantization for FFN layers, tailored per denoising step to relieve memory-bandwidth pressure.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract reports no specific models, baselines, speedups, or quality numbers.

recommendation.zh: 把 FlashAttention 在线 softmax 统计缓存做进 DLLM 是个实在的工程点，做 diffusion LM 部署的应读 §3-4 复现。
recommendation.en: Caching FlashAttention online softmax stats for DLLMs is a concrete systems trick; reproduce §3-4 if you deploy diffusion LMs.

paper.title: FlowBlock: Wavefront-Parallel Decoding for Self-Correcting Diffusion Language Models
paper.abstract: Block-wise diffusion large language models (dLLMs) decode sequentially at the block level, enabling effective KV-cache reuse across blocks but making inter-block decoding strictly serial. Prior work has attempted to unlock inter-block parallelism through post-training methods, but achieves only modest speedups and often degrades accuracy. We observe that self-correcting dLLMs offer a training-free alternative: token-to-token (T2T) editing can repair tokens drafted with a slightly stale upstream

summary.core_problem: 解决 block-wise diffusion LLM 在块间必须串行解码的问题：KV-cache 可以复用，但 block finality 形成了硬依赖，限制并行度。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是推理系统与生成机制结合的工程创新。它不改训练、不做后训练，而是利用 self-correcting dLLM 的 token-to-token 编辑能力，把“上游块必须完成”改成“上游块只需提供足够有信息的草稿”。这对 diffusion LM 能否在真实 serving 中获得吞吐优势很关键。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 FlowBlock，一个 training-free 的 wavefront-parallel decoding 框架。核心包括 Gated Wavefront Decoding：只有满足 readiness gate 的 block 才进入有限 wavefront，并对活跃 blocks 联合做 T2T editing；同时按窗口化 block-causal 约束顺序 commit，避免并行草稿破坏输出一致性。方法属于调度与解码策略改进，而不是模型结构或训练目标改动。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出具体模型规模、数据集、baseline 或速度/质量数字。可确认的实验目标应是比较原始 block-wise dLLM 串行解码、已有 post-training 并行化方法，以及 FlowBlock 在速度提升和精度保持上的权衡。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets the inter-block serialization bottleneck in block-wise diffusion LLM decoding: KV-cache reuse works across blocks, but finalizing each upstream block becomes a hard dependency.
summary_en.importance: This is an inference-systems contribution tied to a non-AR language-modeling regime. It uses the self-correction property of diffusion LMs to relax block finality into a scheduling resource, which matters for whether dLLMs can translate their parallel generation promise into practical serving gains.
summary_en.technical_approach: FlowBlock is a training-free wavefront-parallel decoding framework. Its main mechanism, Gated Wavefront Decoding, admits blocks into a bounded wavefront only after a readiness gate is satisfied, jointly refines active blocks through token-to-token editing, and commits blocks in order under a windowed block-causal constraint. The method changes scheduling and decoding, not the model or objective.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not report model sizes, datasets, baselines, or exact speed/accuracy numbers. The intended comparison is against serial block-wise dLLM decoding and prior post-training approaches that try to expose inter-block parallelism.

recommendation.zh: 只看解码调度和质量退化曲线；若结果干净，dLLM serving 的并行假设要重新评估。
recommendation.en: Read the scheduling design and quality-speed curves; if clean, it changes the serving prior for block-wise dLLMs.

paper.title: Adaptive Multi-Step Lookahead Decoding for Diffusion Language Models
paper.abstract: Masked diffusion language models (DLMs) enable parallel text generation by iteratively refining masked tokens, offering a promising alternative to autoregressive decoding. Recent lookahead-based decoding methods improve the accuracy--efficiency trade-off by exploring future decoding states before committing token updates. However, existing approaches mainly rely on shallow one-step lookahead, which optimizes immediate information gain but can be suboptimal for longer-horizon decoding trajectorie

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作处理的是 diffusion language model 在推理阶段的一个具体瓶颈：如何在生成质量与解码步数之间取得更好的平衡。已有 lookahead 解码会在当前状态不确定时，先试探性地向前滚动一步，再决定当前该提交哪些 token；它能比纯贪心更好地利用并行解码，但仍然只优化“下一步能否带来更多高置信 token”。论文指出，这种一跳视角容易选到局部上看起来有利、但后续轨迹并不好的提交方案。更深的固定步数 rollout 也不行，因为不同样本、不同解码阶段需要的前瞻深度并不一样，盲目加深只会增加计算，而且中间状态如果仍然不确定，固定轨迹也缺少重新分叉的能力。
summary.importance: 对基座预训练研究的意义不在于训练目标本身，而在于它补上了 diffusion LM 范式里一个很关键的接口：训练给了模型并行去噪能力，但真正决定可用性的往往是 inference policy。AR 模型里，训练目标和左到右解码天然对齐；DLM 则把大量决策留到了推理时。AdaLook 的价值在于把“解码策略”明确建模成一个自适应搜索问题，而不是固定规则。这对任何非 AR 语言建模范式都有启发：如果训练目标不唯一指定生成顺序，推理算法就不是附属件，而是模型能力的一部分。就贡献量级看，它更像是对 DLM inference stack 的扎实推进，而不是改变预训练范式的工作。
summary.technical_approach:
方法建立在 Explore-then-Exploit (ETE) 解码框架上。底层仍采用 block diffusion decoding：把序列分成多个 block，每个 block 有固定 denoising budget，且允许在多个已解锁 block 上同时提交高置信 token，以提高每步的并行更新量。ETE 的关键是在模型对剩余 mask 位置置信度较低时触发 lookahead，用一次前向 rollout 评估某个候选 token 提交是否会在下一状态解锁更多高置信预测。

AdaLook 的改进有两层。第一层是自适应深度控制。作者不是固定做 2-step 或 3-step rollout，而是在每次准备继续向前展开时，根据 frontier 上候选分支分数的方差决定是否值得再看一步。直觉是：如果不同候选的前景已经很接近，继续 rollout 的边际收益低；只有当候选之间仍有明显分化空间时，额外计算才值得。这样处理的是“不同样本、不同阶段需要不同 lookahead 深度”的问题。

第二层是中间状态可重评估、可再分叉。朴素多步 rollout 往往沿着每个假设固定向前推，直到达到预设深度，再统一比较；AdaLook 则在每一步 rollout 后重新检查各分支是否还需要扩展。若某些分支已经足够确定，就优先从这些已稳定分支中做选择；若所有分支都仍不确定，则选择当前得分最高的分支，把它的解码状态作为下一轮 lookahead 的起点，继续展开。这里的关键不是把树搜得更深，而是允许搜索过程根据中间不确定性改变展开策略。

从算法风格看，这更接近一种轻量级、受置信度驱动的自适应树搜索，而不是固定深度 beam search。它利用 DLM 的并行 token 更新特性，把“哪一批 token 现在提交最划算”转成了一个短视与远视之间的动态折中问题。
summary.experiments:
从引言可确认的主要实验结论是：朴素地增加 lookahead 深度，并不能改善 accuracy-decoding steps trade-off；AdaLook 则能稳定优于已有 1-step lookahead 方法，而且这种优势在不同数据集和不同 backbone 上都能复现。论文的 Figure 1 用来展示这一点：固定更深 rollout 带来的额外计算没有换来成比例的质量收益，而自适应策略能把计算集中在真正需要探索的状态上。

全文片段没有给出完整表格数字，因此无法可靠复述具体提升幅度、模型参数量、数据集规模和每步解码开销的精确值。可以确定的是，作者做了两类关键对比：一类是与 1-step ETE lookahead 的主结果比较，另一类是与 naive multi-step rollout 的消融比较。前者证明 AdaLook 的有效性，后者证明收益来自“自适应深度 + 中间重评估/再分叉”，而不是单纯把 rollout 做深。阅读原文时应重点核对：1）不同阈值设置对步数和质量的影响；2）收益是否主要集中在低置信、长尾样本；3）额外前向次数与最终 wall-clock 的关系。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议是先看 Introduction 和方法图，抓住两个失败点：固定深度不适配、固定轨迹不灵活。然后看算法部分里关于 frontier score variance 的定义，以及每轮 rollout 后如何决定“停止扩展、选择分支、还是继续展开”。如果时间有限，优先看 Figure 1、主结果表、以及对 naive deeper rollout 的消融。

这篇文章不需要逐行抠公式，重点是理解它在 DLM 解码里引入了什么决策结构。阅读时间大约 20–30 分钟足够建立判断：它是不是只是 heuristic 堆叠，还是确实抓住了 DLM 推理中的状态异质性。如果要深挖，建议进一步看作者如何定义候选分数、方差阈值是否需要数据集特调、以及这种自适应搜索能否迁移到 SEDD/MDLM/LLaDA 一类不同离散 diffusion 或 any-order 生成框架。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets an inference-time bottleneck in diffusion language models: improving the quality-versus-decoding-step trade-off. Prior lookahead decoders only perform shallow one-step exploration when the current denoising state is uncertain, so they optimize immediate confidence gain rather than the quality of the longer decoding trajectory. The authors argue that this can lock the decoder into locally attractive but globally suboptimal token commitments. A naive extension to deeper fixed-depth rollout also fails, because the useful lookahead depth varies across examples and across stages within the same example, while fixed trajectories cannot react to uncertainty that emerges at intermediate rollout states.
summary_en.importance: Its relevance to pretraining research is indirect but real. For non-AR language modeling, training does not uniquely determine the generation policy; inference becomes part of the modeling stack rather than a thin wrapper. AdaLook is useful because it treats DLM decoding as an adaptive search problem instead of a fixed heuristic. That matters for diffusion LM, masked/any-order LM, and other alternatives to left-to-right AR modeling. The contribution is not a new pretraining objective, but a meaningful improvement to the inference interface that determines whether such models are practically competitive.
summary_en.technical_approach:
AdaLook is built on top of the Explore-then-Exploit (ETE) decoding framework. The base decoder uses block diffusion decoding: the sequence is partitioned into blocks, each block receives a fixed denoising budget, and high-confidence tokens can be committed across all unlocked blocks to increase parallel progress per step. In ETE, lookahead is triggered when the model remains uncertain over masked positions, and a one-step rollout estimates which tentative token commitment is most likely to unlock more confident predictions in the next state.

AdaLook adds two key mechanisms. First, it introduces adaptive rollout depth. Instead of always using a fixed 2-step or 3-step lookahead, the decoder decides whether another rollout step is worthwhile by examining the variance of candidate scores at the current frontier. If candidate futures are already similar, deeper rollout is unlikely to pay off; if they remain well separated, extra exploration may still be useful. This addresses the mismatch between heterogeneous decoding states and a globally fixed rollout depth.

Second, AdaLook allows branch re-evaluation and re-expansion at intermediate rollout states. A naive multi-step rollout follows each hypothesis along a predetermined path until the preset depth is reached. AdaLook instead checks after every rollout step whether each branch still needs expansion. Branches that have become sufficiently resolved are prioritized for selection. If all branches remain uncertain, the highest-scoring branch is chosen and its decoding state becomes the starting point for the next round of lookahead. The gain does not come from searching deeper in a brute-force sense, but from making depth and branching conditional on the evolving uncertainty pattern.

Algorithmically, this is closer to a lightweight confidence-driven adaptive tree search than to fixed-depth beam search. The method exploits the parallel update nature of DLMs and reframes token commitment as a dynamic planning problem over short future trajectories.
summary_en.experiments:
From the available full text, the main empirical claim is clear: simply increasing lookahead depth does not improve the accuracy-versus-decoding-step trade-off, whereas AdaLook consistently outperforms prior one-step lookahead decoding. Figure 1 is used to illustrate this point, and the paper states that the advantage generalizes across datasets and model backbones.

The provided content does not include the full result tables, so it is not safe to invent exact gains, parameter counts, or dataset sizes. What can be stated with confidence is that the paper compares three regimes: standard one-step lookahead, naive deeper rollout, and the proposed adaptive multi-step strategy. The critical ablation is that deeper rollout alone is insufficient; the benefit comes from adaptive depth control plus intermediate branch re-evaluation. When reading the original paper, the most important numbers to verify are: how much quality improves at matched decoding steps, how much step count drops at matched quality, how sensitive the method is to the variance threshold, and whether the extra search cost translates into acceptable wall-clock overhead.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Start with the introduction and the main method figure. The two failure modes are the real entry point: fixed-depth rollout wastes compute, and fixed trajectories cannot react to uncertainty that appears mid-rollout. Then read the algorithm section carefully, especially how frontier score variance is defined and how the decoder decides among stopping, selecting a branch, or continuing expansion.

For a skim, focus on Figure 1, the main comparison table, and the ablation against naive deeper rollout. Around 20–30 minutes should be enough to judge whether the method is merely a stack of heuristics or whether it captures a genuine property of DLM inference. If you want to go deeper, inspect how candidate scores are computed, whether the threshold needs dataset-specific tuning, and whether the same adaptive search idea could transfer to other discrete diffusion or any-order generation frameworks.

recommendation.zh: 如果你在跟踪 DLM 是否真能替代 AR，只看它如何把“固定深度前瞻”改成状态自适应即可；结论偏工程，但能暴露 DLM 解码的真实瓶颈。
recommendation.en: If you are tracking whether DLMs can really challenge AR, focus on how it replaces fixed-depth lookahead with state-adaptive rollout; it is mostly engineering, but it exposes the real decoding bottleneck.

paper.title: Token Time Continuous Diffusion for Language Modeling
paper.abstract: In this paper we introduce token time continuous diffusion (TTCD), a new diffusion language model which (a) operates in continuous space, deterministically mapping Gaussian noise to a final token canvas with no further sampling, and crucially (b) incorporates a new notion of per-token times, with some tokens proceeding from noise to token at a faster rate than others. Continuous space modeling helps TTCD avoid the parallel sampling of multiple tokens, which is a key source of inaccuracy at high

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文解决 diffusion language model 在少步生成时的两个问题：离散扩散一次并行采样多个 token 时会把联合分布近似成 product marginal，导致高加速下质量下降；连续扩散虽然避免了这个 factorization 问题，但通常使用全局统一时间，难以表达不同 token 的不同确定速度，也不方便区分 prompt token 和待生成 token。
summary.importance: 这是建模范式方向的论文，和 next-token AR 并列的 diffusion LM 研究相关。贡献量级更像是一个有用的机制改进，而不是完整替代 AR 的训练路线。它的启发在于把 diffusion LM 的时间变量从“整句共享”改成“每个 token 独立推进”。这让模型可以先确定低熵 token，后确定高熵 token，也能在条件生成中把 prompt 固定为 clean state。对于研究 masked diffusion、flow-based LM、few-step generation 的人，这个设计值得看。
summary.technical_approach: TTCD 在连续 embedding 空间中建模。生成从 Gaussian noise 开始，通过确定性迭代走到最终 token embedding，再解码成 token。核心改动是引入 per-token time：每个位置有自己的局部时间，局部时间由全局时间和该 token 的 rank 共同决定。rank 表示该 token 应该较早还是较晚 denoise。作者用一次前向后的 per-token entropy 来分配 rank，低熵、更确定的位置可以更快接近 clean token，高熵位置保留更多不确定性。条件生成时，prompt token 的时间固定为 1，输出 canvas 的 token time 从 0 推到 1。架构上，论文修改常用的 adaptive layer norm，使 diffusion transformer 能接收每个 token 不同的时间条件，而且不增加新参数。训练后还可以用 shortcut/self-consistency loss 做蒸馏，把连续 flow 模型压到更少步生成。
summary.experiments: 实验分两类。第一类是结构化推理玩具任务 Sudoku，用来测试 per-token time 是否真的帮助约束传播和局部确定性。TTCD 在 2-step generation 下达到 31% Sudoku 求解准确率，masking-based diffusion 是 11%，朴素 continuous-space 方法接近 0%。第二类是语言建模实验。作者在 OpenWebText 上训练约 100M 参数模型，并评估 1 到 8 步无条件生成。图 1 用 generative perplexity 和 text entropy 的 trade-off 展示质量和多样性。蒸馏后的 TTCD with Shortcut 在 1–4 步时优于离散 diffusion baseline Duo w/ DCD，并与连续 diffusion baseline FMLM 接近；同时，FMLM 的 entropy 范围较窄，TTCD 能覆盖更高 entropy 的生成区域。实验规模不大，但结果支持 per-token time 对少步 diffusion LM 有实际收益。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读 25–35 分钟。先看 Introduction 对 factorization problem 和 global-time bottleneck 的定义，再看 Figure 2 理解 per-token time 的几何直觉。技术部分重点看 §3.1 的 token rank 和局部时间公式，§3.3 的 entropy-based rank assignment，§3.5 的 adaLN 修改，§3.4 的 shortcut distillation。实验部分重点看 §4.1 Sudoku，因为它最清楚地展示 per-token time 的作用；再看 §4.2 和 Figure 1，判断 OpenWebText 少步生成结果是否足以支撑方法主张。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets two weaknesses of diffusion language models in few-step generation. Discrete diffusion models denoise many tokens in parallel and therefore sample from product marginals rather than the true joint distribution. Continuous diffusion avoids part of this issue, but most existing methods use a single global time, which cannot express that some tokens become certain earlier than others and does not cleanly separate prompt tokens from generated tokens.
summary_en.importance: This is a modeling paper in the diffusion LM line. Its main contribution is a useful mechanism rather than a full training recipe for large-scale language models. The important idea is to make diffusion time token-specific. A model can let easy, low-entropy positions move quickly toward clean embeddings while keeping hard positions uncertain for longer. This is relevant for masked diffusion LMs, continuous flow LMs, and few-step non-autoregressive generation.
summary_en.technical_approach: Token Time Continuous Diffusion operates in continuous embedding space. It starts from Gaussian noise and deterministically evolves token embeddings toward clean token embeddings. The key addition is per-token time: each position has a local time determined by the global diffusion time and a token rank. Ranks control whether a token denoises early or late, and are assigned using per-token entropy from an initial forward pass. For conditional generation, prompt tokens can be fixed at time 1 while output canvas tokens evolve from noise to data. The model also modifies adaptive layer normalization so that the diffusion transformer can condition on different times at different positions without adding parameters. For fast sampling, the method is distilled with a shortcut-style self-consistency objective.
summary_en.experiments: The paper reports both structured and language modeling experiments. On Sudoku, which stresses constraint propagation across positions, TTCD reaches 31% solve accuracy with two generation steps. A masking-based diffusion model reaches 11%, and a naive continuous-space method is near 0%. For language modeling, the authors train a roughly 100M-parameter model on OpenWebText and evaluate unconditional generation with 1 to 8 steps. The distilled TTCD with Shortcut outperforms the discrete Duo w/ DCD baseline up to four steps and is competitive with FMLM, a continuous diffusion baseline. In the generative perplexity versus text entropy plots, TTCD also reaches a wider and higher-entropy region than FMLM. The scale is modest, but the results support the claim that token-specific time helps few-step diffusion generation.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 25–35 minutes. Start with the introduction for the factorization problem and the global-time limitation. Then inspect Figure 2 to understand how local token times evolve. The main technical parts are the token rank formulation in Section 3.1, entropy-based rank assignment in Section 3.3, the adaLN change in Section 3.5, and shortcut distillation in Section 3.4. For experiments, Sudoku in Section 4.1 is the cleanest diagnostic of the mechanism; Figure 1 and Section 4.2 show whether the method transfers to OpenWebText few-step generation.

recommendation.zh: 值得看的是“continuous + per-token time”这两个设计是否真能改写 dLM 的速度瓶颈；先读方法和高速采样结果，别被 160M 规模过度说服。
recommendation.en: Read it for the continuous-space plus per-token-time design; it may change how you think about dLM speed limits, but the 160M scale means treat the claims as regime evidence, not final truth.

paper.title: Audio-Native Speech Recognition with a Frozen Discrete-Diffusion Language Model
paper.abstract: Automatic speech recognition is dominated by autoregressive decoders that emit one token at a time. We ask whether a discrete diffusion language model can transcribe speech instead, refining a whole transcript in parallel over a small number of denoising steps. We train an audio-native interface for DiffusionGemma, a 26B mixture-of-experts model that generates text by uniform, random-token discrete diffusion rather than the absorbing-mask scheme common to recent diffusion language models. A froz

summary.core_problem: 现有语音识别以自回归解码器为主，探索离散扩散语言模型能否通过少量去噪步骤并行生成完整转录文本。
summary.importance: 方法创新，首次将26B参数的离散扩散MoE语言模型用于语音识别，仅训练0.16%的参数即可适配语音模态，发现并解决了扩散LM跨模态接地的梯度传递问题。
summary.technical_approach: 采用冻结的Whisper编码器提取声学特征，轻量投影层映射到DiffusionGemma（26B MoE，均匀随机令牌离散扩散范式）的嵌入空间，通过LoRA让冻结主干关注新模态；针对原生扩散目标梯度无法有效到达投影层的问题，引入CTC损失通过冻结主干传递梯度。
summary.experiments: 主干为DiffusionGemma 26B MoE，冻结Whisper编码器，仅训练42M参数（占主干的0.16%）；摘要内容截断，未完整展示最终识别精度与基线对比结果。

summary_en.core_problem: Current speech recognition relies heavily on autoregressive decoders; this work explores whether discrete diffusion language models can generate full transcripts in parallel via a small number of denoising steps.
summary_en.importance: Methodological innovation: first application of a 26B parameter discrete diffusion MoE LM to speech recognition, adapting to audio with only 0.16% of parameters trained, and identifying plus solving a gradient propagation issue in diffusion LM cross-modal grounding.
summary_en.technical_approach: Uses a frozen Whisper encoder for acoustic feature extraction, a lightweight projector maps features to the embedding space of DiffusionGemma (26B MoE, uniform random-token discrete diffusion paradigm), with LoRA to let the frozen backbone attend to the new modality; introduces CTC loss through the frozen backbone to address the failure of native diffusion objectives to deliver gradients to the projector.
summary_en.experiments: Backbone is DiffusionGemma 26B MoE, Whisper encoder is frozen, only 42M parameters (0.16% of backbone) are trained; abstract is truncated, full recognition accuracy and baseline comparisons are not shown.

recommendation.zh: 扩散LM跨模态适配的实践参考，重点关注CTC损失解决梯度回传受阻的思路，无需精读全文。
recommendation.en: Practical reference for diffusion LM cross-modal adaptation; focus on the CTC loss trick for gradient backpropagation, no need for full reading.

paper.title: Sticky Jump Diffusions: A Unifying View of Masked, Continuous, and Hybrid Diffusion
paper.abstract: We introduce Sticky Jump Diffusions (SJDs), continuous-time Markov processes on $\mathbb R^d$ whose discrete anchors are token embeddings. In forward time, anchors release their mass at a hazard rate and the released mass diffuses in the continuous ambient space; time reversal couples a score-driven SDE with a sticky jump kernel whose rate and destination are fixed by flux balance with the forward law. We estimate the score and the per-anchor reverse hazards from a single denoising classifier vi

summary.core_problem: 离散序列（如文本）的扩散模型目前主要分为 Masked Diffusion、Continuous Diffusion 和 Hybrid Diffusion，这三种范式各自独立发展，缺乏一个统一的数学框架来解释它们之间的联系，以及如何更自然地处理离散 token 与连续 embedding 之间的转换。
summary.importance: 提出 Sticky Jump Diffusions (SJDs)，为离散扩散模型提供了一个统一的连续时间马尔可夫过程视角。不仅将现有的三种主流范式作为其特例统一起来，还通过时间反演（time reversal）自然地推导出现有方法中需要手工设计的组件（如 commit rate、目标 token 和 drift），为新型语言建模范式提供了坚实的理论基础和新的设计空间。
summary.technical_approach: SJD 在连续状态空间上定义，将 token embedding 视为离散的“锚点”（anchors）。前向过程中，锚点以一定速率释放质量到连续空间并扩散。核心创新在于其时间反演过程：结合了基于 score 的 SDE 和一个 sticky jump kernel（负责将连续状态“粘”回离散锚点）。为了训练，提出了 Denoising Hazard Matching (DHM)，这是 denoising score matching 的 hazard 模拟，允许通过单一的去噪分类器同时估计 score 和 per-anchor reverse intensities，只需标准的交叉熵训练，无需模拟。
summary.experiments: 在 CIFAR-10、Text8 和 Sudoku 上实例化了基于 cross-position jump kernels 的 SJD。结果表明，相比于 identity-kernel hybrid 模型，SJD 在 FID、有效词生成和数独棋盘完成度上均有提升，证明了利用数据结构（如空间局部性、序列相关性）设计 jump kernel 的有效性。
summary.reading_guide: 强烈推荐精读。重点关注 SJD 的数学定义（如何结合连续扩散和离散跳跃）、时间反演的推导（flux balance 如何决定 jump rate 和 destination），以及 DHM 的训练目标。思考这种统一视角对未来设计更高效的非自回归语言模型（如结合 AR 和 Diffusion）的启发。

summary_en.core_problem: Diffusion models for discrete sequences (e.g., text) are currently divided into Masked Diffusion, Continuous Diffusion, and Hybrid Diffusion. These paradigms have developed independently, lacking a unified mathematical framework to explain their connections and how to naturally handle the transition between discrete tokens and continuous embeddings.
summary_en.importance: Introduces Sticky Jump Diffusions (SJDs), providing a unified continuous-time Markov process perspective for discrete diffusion models. It not only unifies the three mainstream paradigms as special cases but also naturally derives components that require hand-design in existing methods (e.g., commit rate, destination token, and drift) through time reversal, offering a solid theoretical foundation and a new design space for novel language modeling paradigms.
summary_en.technical_approach: SJD is defined on a continuous state space, treating token embeddings as discrete 'anchors'. In the forward process, anchors release mass into the continuous space at a certain rate and diffuse. The core innovation lies in its time reversal process: it combines a score-driven SDE and a sticky jump kernel (responsible for 'sticking' the continuous state back to discrete anchors). For training, it proposes Denoising Hazard Matching (DHM), the hazard analogue of denoising score matching, allowing simultaneous estimation of the score and per-anchor reverse intensities via a single denoising classifier, requiring only standard cross-entropy training without simulation.
summary_en.experiments: Instantiates SJD with cross-position jump kernels on CIFAR-10, Text8, and Sudoku. Results show that compared to the identity-kernel hybrid model, SJD improves FID, valid-word generation, and Sudoku board completion, demonstrating the effectiveness of designing jump kernels that leverage data structure (e.g., spatial locality, sequential correlation).
summary_en.reading_guide: Highly recommended for deep reading. Focus on the mathematical definition of SJD (how it combines continuous diffusion and discrete jumps), the derivation of time reversal (how flux balance determines jump rate and destination), and the training objective of DHM. Consider the implications of this unified perspective for designing more efficient non-autoregressive language models (e.g., combining AR and Diffusion) in the future.

recommendation.zh: 应读方法定义和极限推导；它可能改变对“mask token 是否携带信息”的建模直觉。
recommendation.en: Read the process definition and limiting cases; it may revise the intuition about whether a mask token carries source-token evidence.

paper.title: Sangam: Efficiently Serving Diffusion LLMs with the AR Stack
paper.abstract: Diffusion language models (dLLMs) generate text by iteratively denoising a masked response and can commit multiple output positions per model invocation. Their bidirectional attention prevents exact autoregressive-style KV caching, since committing one position shifts the KV activations of all others. Approximate caching techniques such as Fast-dLLM and dKV-Cache refresh KV activations repeatedly and reuse them across intervening decodes, inducing a repeated prefill/decode structure. This makes

summary.core_problem: 该工作解决 diffusion LLM 在并发服务中的系统问题。dLLM 通过反复去噪一个 mask response 区域生成文本，可以一次提交多个位置，但双向注意力使 AR 模型中精确 KV cache 的假设失效。已有近似 KV cache 方法会形成反复 prefill/decode 的执行模式，而现有 AR serving 栈不能直接套用。
summary.importance: 对预训练和新型语言建模研究的价值在于，它把 diffusion LM 的建模差异落到了服务约束上。dLLM 的训练目标和注意力模式不同，不只影响单请求生成速度，也改变 batching、KV cache、prefill/decode 切分和 GPU 调度。若 diffusion LM 要成为 AR LM 的实际替代方案，服务栈是否能支撑高并发和稳定延迟是关键约束。该工作有助于判断 diffusion LM 的系统可行性，而不是只看单样本解码步数。
summary.technical_approach: 论文先分析 cached dLLM 与 AR serving 的三个错配。第一，decode 粒度不同：AR decode 每次每请求贡献一个 query token，而 blockwise dLLM decode 会处理一个 response block，并且仍要 attend 到 prompt 和 response 上下文，因此 batch size 增大后 decode 代价增长更快。第二，prefill 不只发生在请求到达时；Fast-dLLM、dKV-Cache 等近似缓存方法会在 block boundary 或 cache refresh point 反复触发 prefill。第三，prefill/decode 的工作比例随请求状态、负载和采样策略变化，固定 GPU 分区容易产生空闲容量。Sangam 的方向是复用 AR serving 中的连续 batching、prefill/decode 管理和 KV 管理思想，但按 dLLM 的块级 decode、重复 prefill、双向注意力不可 chunked prefill 等特点重新组织调度。
summary.experiments: 从给出的正文可确认的实验信息主要是定性系统测量：论文指出 dLLM decode iteration time 随并发 decode 数增长更快，少量并发 decode 就可能使 GPU compute 和 memory bandwidth 接近饱和；继续扩大 decode batch 对吞吐的帮助有限。工作还以 Fast-dLLM 和 dKV-Cache 这类近似缓存执行模式为背景，分析 repeated prefill/decode 对调度的影响。具体吞吐、延迟、GPU 数量和相对提升幅度需要看实验章节的 trace-based serving 结果与 baseline 对比。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读 introduction 和系统动机部分，重点看 cached dLLM 为什么不同于 AR serving：decode 是 block-sized，prefill 会周期性回流，双向注意力阻止 chunked prefill。之后看 scheduler 设计、prefill/decode 资源分配策略和 KV 管理部分。实验部分优先看吞吐-延迟曲线、不同并发负载下的 GPU 利用率、与 vLLM/AR-style serving 改造 baseline 的对比，以及 Fast-dLLM、dKV-Cache 两种缓存策略下是否稳定。预计阅读 40–60 分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses efficient concurrent serving for diffusion language models. Masked diffusion LMs generate by repeatedly denoising a fixed response region and can commit multiple positions per model call. Because attention is bidirectional, exact AR-style KV caching is invalid: once a position is committed, the activations of other positions may change. Approximate caching methods create a repeated prefill/decode execution pattern, but the standard AR serving stack does not directly fit this pattern.
summary_en.importance: The work is useful for pretraining and alternative language modeling research because it exposes the serving consequences of the diffusion LM objective and attention pattern. Diffusion LMs should not be evaluated only by single-request generation speed or number of denoising iterations. Their viability also depends on batching behavior, cache refresh cost, prefill/decode interference, and GPU placement under load. This is an important systems constraint for judging whether diffusion LMs can compete with AR models in practical deployments.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper identifies three mismatches between cached dLLM execution and AR serving. First, decode cost has a different shape: an AR decode step adds one query token per request, while a blockwise dLLM decode processes a response block while attending over the prompt-response context. Decode time therefore grows much faster with batch size. Second, prefill is recurring and request-dependent. Methods such as Fast-dLLM and dKV-Cache periodically refresh KV states at block boundaries or cache refresh points, so requests move back and forth between prefill and decode. Third, fixed prefill/decode disaggregation can strand capacity because the balance between phases changes with request progress, load, and sampling behavior. Sangam adapts AR serving ideas such as continuous batching, phase management, and KV-cache organization, but reorganizes them around block-sized dLLM decode, repeated refreshes, and the fact that bidirectional prefill cannot be chunked in the same way as causal AR prefill.
summary_en.experiments: The provided text gives the key qualitative measurement: dLLM decode iteration time rises quickly with the number of concurrent decodes, and only a small number of active decodes can saturate GPU compute and memory bandwidth. Larger decode batches therefore do not provide the same throughput benefit as in AR serving. The experimental setup is framed around cached dLLM methods such as Fast-dLLM and dKV-Cache, where repeated prefill/decode phases dominate scheduling behavior. Exact throughput, latency, GPU-count, and relative-improvement numbers should be taken from the system evaluation section.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim the introduction and motivation first. The most important concepts are block-sized decode, recurring prefill, the impossibility of AR-style chunked prefill under bidirectional attention, and the instability of fixed prefill/decode partitioning. Then read the scheduler design, resource-allocation policy, and KV-management sections. In the evaluation, focus on throughput-latency curves, GPU utilization under different loads, comparisons against AR-style serving baselines, and whether the results hold for both Fast-dLLM-like and dKV-Cache-like execution. Expected reading time is 40–60 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 扩散LM推理服务的首个系统化方案，调度设计有参考价值；做dLLM推理效率的研究者可重点看§3调度器设计。
recommendation.en: First systematic serving solution for diffusion LLMs; scheduler design is informative. Researchers working on dLLM inference efficiency should focus on §3 scheduler design.

paper.title: Discrete Diffusion Language Models for Interactive Radiology Report Drafting
paper.abstract: Diffusion language models, which generate text by denoising a token canvas bidirectionally instead of emitting tokens left to right, have become competitive with autoregressive (AR) generation. Medical foundation models, however, remain almost entirely autoregressive. We adapt a mixture-of-experts diffusion language model, DiffusionGemma-26B, and benchmark it against its same-size AR sibling Gemma-4-26B under an identical LoRA recipe on medical visual question answering datasets, scored by a ver

summary.core_problem: 检验离散 diffusion language model 在医学报告草拟和医学 VQA 中是否能替代同规模自回归模型，并利用双向去噪实现任意位置补全文本。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是新型语言建模范式的应用验证。虽然场景是放射报告，但关键问题是 diffusion LM 与 AR LM 在同规模、同 LoRA recipe 下的能力、延迟和交互式编辑差异，这对判断非 AR 文本生成路线有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 将 MoE diffusion language model DiffusionGemma-26B 适配到医学任务，并与同尺寸 AR sibling Gemma-4-26B 做对照；两者使用相同 LoRA 微调 recipe。diffusion 模型通过 token canvas 的双向去噪生成文本，因此天然支持固定若干报告片段后在中间任意顺序 infill。
summary.experiments: 在多个 medical VQA 数据集上评测，使用对 verbosity 更稳健的 LLM judge。摘要称 diffusion 模型在所有数据集上匹配或超过同尺寸 AR 模型，微调后 3.8B active 参数模型可与 frontier VLM 竞争，解码速度快 3.5-4.4 倍；未给出具体数据集名称和逐项分数。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper tests whether a discrete diffusion language model can match an equal-size autoregressive model for medical report drafting and VQA, while enabling arbitrary-position infilling.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is an applied validation of a non-autoregressive language-modeling paradigm. The radiology setting is narrow, but the clean AR-vs-diffusion comparison under the same LoRA recipe is relevant for judging diffusion LMs as practical text generators.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors adapt DiffusionGemma-26B, a mixture-of-experts diffusion LM, and compare it with the same-size autoregressive sibling Gemma-4-26B. Both are finetuned with an identical LoRA setup. Bidirectional denoising over a token canvas gives the diffusion model native any-order infilling for partially fixed reports.
summary_en.experiments: The model is evaluated on medical VQA datasets with a verbosity-robust LLM judge. The abstract reports that diffusion matches or exceeds the AR baseline on all datasets, the finetuned 3.8B-active model is competitive with frontier VLMs, and decoding is 3.5-4.4x faster; per-dataset scores are not provided in the abstract.

recommendation.zh: 只看同 recipe 的 AR 对照和 infill demo；医学任务窄，但延迟与任意顺序编辑会改变 diffusion LM 的实用性判断。
recommendation.en: Read the equal-recipe AR comparison and the infill demo; the domain is narrow, but the latency and editing results shift the practical prior on diffusion LMs.

paper.title: Low Perplexity is Repetition: A One-Dimensional Self-Conditioning Attractor in Continuous Diffusion LMs
paper.abstract: Continuous diffusion language models such as ELF report record-low generative perplexity (Gen-PPL). We find a catch: these models repeat far more than human text, and Gen-PPL rewards rather than penalizes that repetition, so its low scores overstate quality. Strip the repetition and ELF-B's Gen-PPL rises from $19.5$ to $27.7$; the smallest model even posts the best Gen-PPL because it repeats most. We trace the repetition to its source: a contractive attractor along a \emph{single direction} in t

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作处理的是一个被主流指标掩盖的连续 diffusion language model 失真问题：带 self-conditioning 的连续 DLM 在采样时会进入强重复的循环状态，而社区常用的 Gen-PPL 不但没有识别这个问题，反而会因为重复文本在外部 AR scorer 下概率更高而给出更低分。论文不是停留在“样本看起来重复”这一层，而是把问题定位到 self-conditioning 反馈回路的动力学：模型每一步把上一步的 clean estimate 再喂回去，形成一个收缩系统；在 ELF 这类模型里，这个系统沿某一个主方向存在一个近似一维的 contractive attractor，轨迹一旦被吸进去，就会朝着高度自预测、也就是高度重复的状态收敛。核心问题因此有两层：一是评价失真，二是训练后推理动力学中的结构性退化。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的意义很具体。第一，它直接质疑了连续 DLM 里把 Gen-PPL 当作 headline metric 的做法，说明低 perplexity 可能只是重复更严重，而不是语言建模更好。这会影响 diffusion/flow LM 与 AR LM 的比较口径。第二，它把一个生成缺陷还原成可分析的低维动力学问题，而不是把它当作 decode heuristic 可以修补的表面现象；这对新型 LM 范式很重要，因为很多非 AR 模型都依赖迭代 refinement 和自反馈。第三，它给出一个几乎不需要重训的干预方法 ACE，说明这类缺陷未必需要重新设计整个模型或目标函数，先把反馈回路中的不稳定方向找出来就能显著改善样本质量和有效采样成本。贡献量级上，它更像是对范式可靠性的校准工作：不是提出更强模型，而是指出现有结果里哪些结论站不住，以及应该怎样重新评估。
summary.technical_approach: 技术路线分三步。第一步是把“低 Gen-PPL 伴随高重复”做成系统性证据，而不是个别样例。作者比较不同 ELF 尺度、不同采样器和不同 churn/feedback 设置，发现重复越重，Gen-PPL 往往越低；去掉重复片段后，模型排序会反转，小模型之所以看起来最好，主要是因为它最会重复。第二步是机制分析。作者把 self-conditioning 看成一个离散时间反馈系统：当前步的 denoiser 输出 clean estimate，下一步又把这个 estimate 作为条件输入。围绕采样轨迹线性化后，考察这个反馈映射的 Jacobian，发现最慢收缩的主模态几乎是一维，且与高重复轨迹高度对齐。再配合直接干预实验——单独增大 feedback strength 会同时提高重复率并降低 Gen-PPL——把因果链条补齐：不是重复偶然出现，而是反馈回路主动把轨迹拉向一个自预测 attractor。第三步是 ACE。它不改模型参数，也不加辅助分类器，而是在每一步 self-conditioning 输入上减去一个固定方向 d。这个方向通过无监督方式估计：收集高重复轨迹和低重复轨迹的反馈表示，取两组均值之差作为 attractor direction。作者还推导了一个 closed-form 的可用强度窗口，避免 steering 过强把正常语义也抹掉。关键点在于干预位置选在 latent feedback，而不是 token decode 端；论文的论证是，重复在 argmax readout 之前就已经在连续空间里形成，decode-time penalty 只能处理后果，碰不到成因。方法上这和常见 repetition penalty、n-gram blocking、temperature 调节都不同，也不同于重新训练一个 anti-repetition objective；它更接近对采样动力学做低维控制。
summary.experiments: 实验部分最有信息量的是三类结果。第一类是指标失真。ELF-B 的原始 Gen-PPL 为 19.5，但去掉重复后升到 27.7；原本看起来更优的小模型，在去重后不再占优。样本级分析也显示，重复程度与 GPT-2 PPL 打分存在相关性，说明 scorer 确实偏爱这种退化文本。第二类是机制验证。调大 self-conditioning 反馈强度时，重复显著上升而 Gen-PPL 继续下降，支持“反馈制造重复、指标奖励重复”的链条。Jacobian 分析显示主导问题的是单一慢收缩方向；更尖锐的采样设置会让 basin 更深。第三类是 ACE 效果。作者用最小模型估计一个冻结方向，再迁移到不同采样超参和更大模型，和逐配置重估得到的方向余弦相似度在 0.82 到 0.96 之间，说明这个方向具有稳定性。按他们提出的 defect-controlled evaluation，在满足接近人类文本重复阈值的前提下，ACE 生成 human-clean text 的计算成本下降 1.5 到 5 倍，同时质量保持竞争力。论文还把同样的方向估计配方迁移到 Plaid、LangFlow，说明问题并非 ELF 独有，而是 self-conditioned continuous DLM 的共性风险。引言里提到大量样本会锁死在少数 4-gram 上并循环数百词，附录表格给了更细的频次统计，这部分很值得看，因为它说明退化不是轻微重复，而是长程崩塌。
summary.reading_guide: 建议先抓三条主线。第一条看第 3 节和相关表格，确认“Gen-PPL 会奖励重复”这件事到底有多严重。重点看模型排序在去重前后如何变化，以及 sample-level repetition 与 scorer PPL 的关系。第二条看第 4 节，这是全文最关键的部分。需要认真看 self-conditioning 的动力学重写、线性化分析、Jacobian 主方向、以及 feedback-strength ablation；如果只看结论不看这里，很容易把 ACE 误解成普通 steering trick。第三条看第 5 节的评估协议，因为作者不是简单报一个更低的重复率，而是重新定义了更合理的比较方式：先按 human repetition bar 过滤，再看 accepted set 的质量和 compute-to-clean。图 1、表 4、表 16、表 17 应该是最先看的材料。附录里如果时间有限，优先看 usable steering window 的推导和跨模型迁移结果。精读时可以继续追两个问题：一，这个一维 attractor 是训练目标诱导出来的，还是 self-conditioning inference recipe 放大的；二，若把 self-conditioning 在训练时做 dropout、随机化或正交约束，是否能从源头缓解问题。这篇文章没有完全回答，但给了很清楚的切入点。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper identifies a failure mode in self-conditioned continuous diffusion language models that is hidden by the field’s preferred metric. These models can generate heavily repetitive text, yet generative perplexity (Gen-PPL) often improves when repetition gets worse, because the external AR scorer assigns high probability to repeated sequences. The authors go beyond symptom-level observation and locate the mechanism in the self-conditioning loop itself. Each denoising step feeds its previous clean estimate back into the next step, creating a contractive dynamical system. In ELF-like models, this system develops an effectively one-dimensional attractor: once a trajectory aligns with that direction, it is pulled toward highly self-predictable, repetitive states. So the paper is solving two linked problems: metric mismeasurement and a structural inference-time degeneration in continuous DLMs.
summary_en.importance: This matters for pretraining research in a fairly direct way. First, it weakens the practice of treating Gen-PPL as a reliable headline metric for continuous diffusion or flow-based LMs. A lower score may simply mean stronger repetition, not better language modeling. That changes how one should compare non-AR models against AR baselines. Second, the paper turns a visible generation defect into a low-dimensional dynamical systems problem. That is useful beyond ELF, because many non-AR paradigms rely on iterative refinement and self-feedback. Third, it shows that the defect can be mitigated without retraining, by intervening on the feedback state rather than redesigning the whole model or objective. The contribution is less about building a stronger model and more about correcting the field’s understanding of what current results actually mean and how these models should be evaluated.
summary_en.technical_approach: The method has three layers. The first is empirical diagnosis. The authors show systematically that in ELF, more repetition often coincides with lower Gen-PPL. When repeated spans are stripped out, model rankings can reverse; the smallest model looks best largely because it repeats the most. The second layer is mechanism analysis. They rewrite self-conditioning as a feedback recurrence: the denoiser predicts a clean estimate, and that estimate becomes part of the next-step input. Linearizing this loop around sampling trajectories and inspecting the Jacobian reveals a dominant slowest-contracting mode that is nearly one-dimensional and strongly aligned with repetitive trajectories. They also run direct causal probes: increasing feedback strength alone raises repetition while lowering Gen-PPL, which supports the claim that the loop creates the pathology that the metric then rewards. The third layer is the fix, ACE (Attractor-Contrast-Escape). ACE subtracts a single fixed direction d from the self-conditioning feedback at every step. That direction is estimated without labels, auxiliary models, or retraining: collect feedback states from high-repetition trajectories and low-repetition trajectories, then take the difference of their means. The paper also derives a closed-form usable steering window so the intervention is strong enough to escape the basin but not so strong that it destroys semantics. A key design choice is where to intervene. ACE acts on the latent feedback state, not at token decoding, because the repetition is already formed upstream in continuous space before argmax readout. That makes it fundamentally different from repetition penalties, n-gram blocking, or decode-time heuristics.
summary_en.experiments: Three result groups matter most. First is metric pathology. ELF-B reports a Gen-PPL of 19.5, but after removing repetition the score rises to 27.7, enough to change the apparent ranking against larger models. Sample-level analyses also show that more repetitive generations receive better GPT-2-based perplexity scores, confirming that the scorer favors the degenerate outputs. Second is mechanism validation. Increasing self-conditioning feedback strength increases repetition and further lowers Gen-PPL, which supports the proposed causal chain. The Jacobian analysis shows that the problem is dominated by a single slow-contracting direction, and sharper sampling settings deepen the basin. Third is ACE performance. A direction estimated once on the smallest model transfers well across inference settings and model scales; its cosine similarity to per-configuration re-estimated directions is reported between 0.82 and 0.96. Under the paper’s defect-controlled evaluation, ACE reaches human-clean text at 1.5x to 5x lower compute cost while maintaining competitive quality on accepted samples. The same direction-estimation recipe also recovers useful controls on Plaid and LangFlow, suggesting the issue is not ELF-specific but tied to self-conditioned continuous DLMs more broadly. The appendix tables on repeated 4-grams are also important: the degeneration is not mild local repetition but long loops that can persist for hundreds of words.
summary_en.reading_guide: Read it along three threads. First, go through Section 3 and the associated tables to understand how severe the Gen-PPL failure is. Focus on how model rankings change before and after repetition stripping, and on the sample-level correlation between repetition and scorer perplexity. Second, spend real time on Section 4. This is the center of the paper: the dynamical reformulation of self-conditioning, the linearization, the Jacobian spectrum, and the feedback-strength ablations. Without that section, ACE can look like just another steering trick, which would miss the point. Third, read Section 5 carefully because the evaluation protocol is part of the contribution. The paper does not merely report lower repetition; it proposes a more defensible comparison based on a human repetition threshold, quality on the accepted set, and compute-to-clean. Figure 1, Table 4, Table 16, and Table 17 are the first items to inspect. If time is limited in the appendix, prioritize the derivation of the usable steering window and the transfer results across models and samplers. Two follow-up questions are worth keeping in mind while reading: whether the one-dimensional attractor is induced mainly by the training objective or amplified by the inference recipe, and whether training-time variants of self-conditioning could remove the issue at the source.

recommendation.zh: 必须读：它会改变对 diffusion LM 指标的 prior，Gen-PPL 低不够用，应复现重复剥离和 ACE 方向分析。
recommendation.en: Must read: it changes the prior on diffusion-LM evaluation; low Gen-PPL is not enough, and the repetition-stripping plus ACE direction analysis should be reproduced.

paper.title: Diffusion-GR2: Diffusion Generative Reasoning Re-ranker
paper.abstract: Generative reasoning re-rankers achieve strong recommendation accuracy by emitting a chain-of-thought before re-ordering a candidate list, but they are slow at inference: an autoregressive (AR) decoder spends one sequential forward pass per reasoning token, and the reasoning trace far exceeds the ranking it produces. To reduce this cost, block-diffusion language models decode many positions in parallel over a few denoising steps and are substantially faster, yet naively converting an AR re-ranke

summary.core_problem: 自回归生成式推理重排序器需先生成完整思维链再输出候选排序，推理速度受限于逐token的串行解码；块扩散语言模型可并行解码多位置，速度优势明显，但直接替换自回归解码器会出现两处准确率下降：一是结构层面，扩散模型并行预测答案位置、独立打分，容易生成重复、遗漏或不在候选集内的无效排列，而自回归的左到右掩码天然避免了这一点；二是分布层面，训练使用教师提供的固定推理轨迹，推理时模型在自身扩散解码分布下生成，存在off-policy偏差。核心问题是如何将自回归推理重排序器转换为扩散版本，在保留并行解码速度的同时最小化准确率损失。
summary.importance: 这项工作探索了扩散语言模型在推理重排序场景的应用，提出了一套从自回归模型到块扩散模型的三阶段转换方案，为扩散语言模型适配需要结构化输出的任务提供了实践参考，也展示了长推理链场景下扩散模型速度与准确率的可行折中路径。
summary.technical_approach: 以经过SFT和重排序奖励RL训练的自回归推理重排序器GR2为起点，用其权重初始化块扩散模型，分三步弥补准确率缺口：1）转换微调（CFT）：在重排序数据上微调扩散模型，使其无需外部约束解码器即可在并行解码下生成有效的候选排列，解决结构层面的准确率缺口；2）同策略蒸馏（OPD）：让转换后的扩散模型在自身真实的块扩散解码分布下生成轨迹，再用原始AR模型对这些轨迹提供逐token的稠密监督，使训练分布与推理分布对齐，缩小off-policy偏差；3）最后追加一轮基于重排序奖励的RL微调，恢复剩余的准确率差距，且从OPD结果出发做RL的效果优于冷启动。
summary.experiments: 在Amazon Beauty数据集上验证，Diffusion-GR2的准确率接近自回归基线，解码吞吐量达到自回归模型的2.4–3.5倍。消融实验显示，CFT贡献了大部分的准确率恢复，OPD进一步缩小了分布偏差带来的缺口，RL则在OPD基础上补充了剩余的性能提升。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读可重点关注第3章的转换流水线（3.3节结构差距分析、3.4节转换微调、3.5节同策略蒸馏、3.6节RL阶段），以及第4章的速度-准确率权衡实验与消融结果，预计阅读时间20–30分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Autoregressive generative reasoning re-rankers generate a full chain-of-thought before outputting candidate rankings, which limits inference speed due to sequential token-by-token decoding. Block-diffusion language models offer clear speed advantages by decoding multiple positions in parallel, but directly replacing the autoregressive decoder causes two accuracy drops: first, a structural gap — diffusion models predict answer positions in parallel and score them independently, which easily produces invalid permutations with duplicated, dropped, or out-of-set item IDs, while autoregressive left-to-right masking naturally avoids this; second, a distributional gap — training uses fixed teacher reasoning trajectories, while inference runs under the model's own diffusion decoding distribution, creating an off-policy mismatch. The core problem is how to convert an autoregressive reasoning re-ranker to a diffusion-based variant, minimizing accuracy loss while retaining the speed benefit of parallel decoding.
summary_en.importance: This work explores the application of diffusion language models in the reasoning re-ranking scenario, and proposes a three-stage conversion pipeline from autoregressive models to block-diffusion models. It provides practical reference for adapting diffusion language models to tasks requiring structured outputs, and demonstrates a viable speed-accuracy tradeoff path for diffusion models in long reasoning chain scenarios.
summary_en.technical_approach: Starting from the autoregressive reasoning re-ranker GR2 (trained via SFT followed by RL with a re-ranking reward), the pipeline initializes a block-diffusion model with GR2's weights and closes accuracy gaps in three steps: 1) Conversion Fine-Tuning (CFT): Fine-tune the diffusion model on re-ranking data to teach it to generate valid candidate permutations under parallel decoding without an external constrained decoder, addressing the structural accuracy gap. 2) On-Policy Distillation (OPD): The converted diffusion model generates trajectories under its real block-diffusion decoding distribution, and the original AR model provides dense per-token supervision on these samples to align training and inference distributions, reducing the off-policy mismatch. 3) A final RL stage with a re-ranking reward recovers the remaining accuracy margin, and RL initialized from OPD outperforms cold-start RL.
summary_en.experiments: Validated on the Amazon Beauty dataset, Diffusion-GR2 achieves near-autoregressive accuracy while delivering 2.4–3.5× higher decode throughput than the AR baseline. Ablation studies show CFT accounts for most of the accuracy recovery, OPD further narrows the gap from distribution mismatch, and RL provides additional gains on top of OPD.
summary_en.reading_guide: For skimming, focus on the conversion pipeline in Section 3 (structural gap analysis in 3.3, CFT in 3.4, OPD in 3.5, RL stage in 3.6), as well as the speed-accuracy tradeoff experiments and ablation results in Section 4. Estimated reading time: 20–30 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 扩散 LM 做结构化输出的两个坑（结构合法性、off-policy）讲得很实，重排序场景只是载体，§3 的约束解码和自训练设计对扩散 LM 落地其他判别式任务有参考价值。
recommendation.en: The two failure modes of diffusion LMs on structured outputs (validity and off-policy) are well diagnosed; §3 on constrained decoding and self-training is useful for diffusion LM applications beyond reranking.

paper.title: TAG-DLM: Diffusion Language Models for Text-Attributed Graph Learning
paper.abstract: Text-attributed graphs (TAGs), where each node carries a natural language description, require models to jointly reason over text and graph topology. Existing approaches often handle the two modalities separately: graph neural networks operate on shallow text features, while hybrids of LLMs and graphs use the language model mainly as a text encoder and delegate structure learning to a separate graph module.
