We propose method that unifies textual reasoning and graph message passing within a maske

summary.core_problem: 将文本属性图中的节点文本理解与图结构推理统一到一个生成式语言模型里，而不是把 LLM 编码器和 GNN 结构模块分开训练。
summary.importance: 贡献偏方法迁移：把 masked diffusion language model 用到图学习场景，并用注意力掩码模拟图上的消息传递。对预训练研究员的价值在于观察 DLM 的双向注意力和迭代生成是否能承载非序列结构归纳偏置。
summary.technical_approach: 方法将每个图实例的采样局部邻域线性化为 token 序列，再通过 topology attention mask 限制 token 间可见性，使注意力模式对应图拓扑上的消息传递。由于底座是 masked diffusion LM，模型既能读文本也能生成文本，任务适配主要通过 prompt 完成，覆盖节点分类、链接预测等图任务。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出模型规模、训练数据量、具体基线和提升幅度。可确认的实验范围包括文本属性图上的节点分类和链接预测等任务，并与传统 GNN 或 LLM+图模块混合方法形成对比。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper tries to unify textual reasoning and graph-structure reasoning for text-attributed graphs inside one generative language model, instead of coupling an LM text encoder with a separate graph module.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is mainly a method transfer: masked diffusion language modeling is adapted to graph learning, with attention masks used as a structural inductive bias. For pretraining researchers, the useful question is whether bidirectional diffusion LMs can naturally host non-sequential structure.
summary_en.technical_approach: Each graph instance is converted into a token sequence by linearizing a sampled local neighborhood. A topology-aware attention mask injects graph connectivity, so attention implements a form of message passing. Because the backbone is a masked diffusion LM, the same model can interpret and generate text, and different graph tasks are handled through prompts.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not report model size, training data scale, baselines, or numerical gains. The stated evaluation covers text-attributed graph tasks such as node classification and link prediction, compared against graph or LM-graph hybrid approaches.

recommendation.zh: 作为 DLM 扩展到非序列结构的案例可扫一眼；若实验只停在图任务榜单，对预训练 recipe 没多少增量。
recommendation.en: Worth a quick look as a DLM-on-graphs case; if the evidence is only task leaderboard gains, it adds little to pretraining practice.

paper.title: Masked Diffusion Decoding as $x$-Prediction Flow
paper.abstract: Masked diffusion language models (MDLMs) generate text by iteratively unmasking tokens, but their standard decoder reduces each step to a binary action: a position is either committed to a single token or left fully masked, with no representation of partial belief in between. This all-or-nothing regime discards rich predictive information and forces premature, irrevocable commitments, leading to poor performance under a limited decoding budget. In this paper, we reinterpret mask prediction as cl

summary.core_problem: 解决 masked diffusion language model 在解码时“要么提交一个 token、要么保持全 mask”的离散决策过于粗糙，导致有限步数下性能差的问题。
summary.importance: 这是文本扩散/MDLM 解码范式上的方法改造，不是简单采样技巧。它试图把离散 mask-prediction 重新解释为连续的 x-prediction flow，对非 AR 语言建模的生成机制有直接参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 作者将 MDLM 的 mask prediction 重写为 clean-state prediction，并据此在输入 embedding 空间中诱导连续流。核心做法是：每一步不再做不可逆的 hard commit，而是让各位置积累部分进度、保留可修正性；同时用基于置信度的异步更新替代图像 diffusion 常见的全局同步日程，使不同 token 位置按上下文约束强弱推进不同的 diffusion progress。
summary.experiments: 从摘要看，重点比较的是有限 decoding budget 下的生成质量，主张连续解码优于标准 MDLM 的二元提交机制。摘要未给出具体模型规模、训练 token 数和基线列表，但可预期基线包括标准 masked diffusion decoding 与同步式更新策略；需要正文确认提升幅度、步数-质量曲线以及是否与 AR/其他 DLM 解码公平对比。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses the coarse all-or-nothing decoding rule in masked diffusion language models, where each position is either committed to a token or kept fully masked, hurting quality under limited decoding steps.
summary_en.importance: This is a generation-mechanism paper for diffusion-style language modeling rather than a minor sampling tweak. It is relevant to anyone tracking alternatives to autoregressive decoding.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors reinterpret mask prediction as clean-state prediction and use that view to induce a continuous flow in embedding space. Instead of irreversible hard commits, each token position accumulates partial progress and remains revisable across steps. They also replace globally synchronous schedules with confidence-based asynchronous updates so positions advance at different rates depending on contextual certainty.
summary_en.experiments: From the abstract, the main claim is better generation under a limited decoding budget compared with standard MDLM decoding. The abstract does not expose model sizes, training data, or exact baselines, so the key things to verify in the paper are step-quality tradeoffs, fairness against standard MDLM decoders, and whether gains survive stronger baselines.

recommendation.zh: 做 diffusion LM 的人该看：它不是再调一个采样超参，而是在动“离散提交”这个核心假设；先看方法图和步数-质量曲线，若增益只在小 budget 才成立，外推要保守。
recommendation.en: Worth reading if you care about diffusion LM: it attacks the hard-commit assumption itself, not just sampler tuning; check the step-vs-quality plots before buying the story.

paper.title: Masked Language Flow Models
paper.abstract: Masked Diffusion Models (MDMs) promise fast, parallel language generation, but their reverse transition factorises across token positions -- an approximation that breaks down in the few-step sampling regime where parallel generation ought to provide the greatest efficiency gains. Flow Language Models (FLMs) sidestep this limitation by learning a continuous flow that transports noise toward clean sequences represented in Euclidean space, inducing a flow map that can be distilled for single-step g

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作要解决的是非 AR 语言建模里一个很核心的张力。Masked diffusion model 适合 any-position 并行生成，但在 few-step 采样时通常把多个 masked 位置的反向转移做位置独立分解，这个近似恰好在最想要速度的区域最不可靠。Flow language model 则把离散 token 序列搬到连续空间里做联合流动，能避免这种位置独立假设，也有机会蒸馏成少步甚至一步生成；但标准 FLM 在生成时往往需要对所有位置持续解码，不擅长“部分已确定、部分待推理”的迭代式语言生成。论文的核心问题就是：能否把 MDM 的 any-position 条件结构和 FLM 的连续耦合建模合在一起，既保留并行生成能力，又让模型在多步推理任务里逐步确定 token，而不是每一步都重解整句。
summary.importance: 这对预训练研究是 must-read 级别的，因为它不是在 AR 框架里做局部改良，而是在认真推进一种与 next-token LM 并列的建模范式。贡献有三层。第一，提出了 MLFM 这一类 masked flow 模型，把离散 masked generation 与连续 flow matching 统一起来，补上了 MDM few-step 质量差和 FLM 缺少显式 masking 结构之间的空档。第二，给出从预训练 MDM warm-start 到 MLFM 的训练路径，降低了新范式的训练门槛，这一点对大规模实验尤其关键。第三，提出 early token promotion 与适配的 classifier-free guidance，使模型在采样过程中把高置信 token 尽早转成干净上下文，形成一种更接近“迭代推理”的生成动态。若这条路线继续扩展，影响的不只是采样速度，还包括如何定义语言模型的中间状态、如何做 reasoning-friendly 的非 AR 预训练，以及如何把 flow map distillation 和 masked refinement 结合起来。
summary.technical_approach: 方法的关键是把“部分 mask 的离散序列”嵌入连续空间，再在这个空间上定义从部分 mask 状态到干净序列的随机插值与速度场学习。具体地，MLFM 使用 Brownian bridge 作为 stochastic interpolant，连接 embedded partially masked sequence 与 embedded clean sequence。这样做有两个好处。其一，连续状态在所有位置上联合演化，不需要像传统 MDM 那样在反向过程里对 masked positions 做条件独立分解，因此 few-step 时能更自然地表达位置间依赖。其二，在 Brownian bridge 的边界，插值退化回嵌入后的 partially masked sequence，这与预训练 MDM 的输入形式对齐，于是可以直接用已有 MDM 权重做 warm start，而不是从头训练一个 flow LM。训练上，模型学习的是条件速度场，目标与 flow matching / stochastic interpolant 系列方法一致，但 conditioning 结构保留了 any-position generation：未 mask 的 token 作为已知上下文，mask 的位置由连续流逐步推向干净 token embedding。推断上，论文提出两项关键机制。第一是新的 classifier-free guidance 形式。与常见 CFG 直接在条件/无条件预测间线性外推不同，这里为了隔离 clean tokens 对速度场的贡献，会在 reference velocity 中对 clean tokens 再加噪，从而更稳定地估计“条件信息带来的修正量”。第二是 online token promotion：如果某个位置的 posterior mode 概率达到 1-ε，就立即把该位置提交为 clean token，并用其干净 embedding 替换连续状态。这样一来，已解决 token 不必等到最后一步才固定，而是能在后续步骤中立刻作为上下文参与其它位置的生成。这个设计与 MDM 的逐步 unmasking 有相似之处，但不同点在于：MDM 的反向转移通常仍在离散空间逐步采样，MLFM 则是在连续耦合动力学中做“提前离散化”的局部提交。论文真正新颖的地方不只是把 mask 加进 flow，而是把 masking 变成 flow 过程中的结构性边界条件和采样控制机制。
summary.experiments: 实验基于 Nie et al. (2025a) 的一个 1028M 预训练 MDM，并将其适配为 MLFM，再在 GSM8K 和 MT-Bench 上评估。作者强调这是 flow-based language model 首次被扩展到 instruction-following 与 reasoning 类下游生成任务。结果层面，MLFM 在 MT-Bench 上优于 SMDM 和同量级 AR baseline，在 GSM8K 上也给出“有竞争力但仍偏早期”的结果，说明这种范式至少没有因为改成连续 flow 而失去处理复杂语言任务的能力。全文更值得看的不是单个 benchmark 分数，而是采样策略消融：加入新 CFG 与 token promotion 后，模型在两类任务上都有显著提升，说明 few-step 非 AR 生成的瓶颈不只在训练目标，也在于采样时是否能把高置信 token 尽早转化为有效上下文。论文还讨论了 warm-start 的必要性：直接从大规模 MDM 迁移到 MLFM，能明显降低训练成本，否则 flow 模型在语言空间中从头学到稳定的连续动力学会很贵。摘要里没有给出完整数字表，正文主结果和附录消融需要结合阅读，重点看不同步数、是否启用 promotion、不同 guidance 强度下的性能变化。
summary.reading_guide: 精读建议按四步走。先看引言和背景，确认作者要修补的是哪两个范式的缺口：MDM 的 factorised reverse transition 与 FLM 的全位置持续解码。然后重点读方法部分里 Brownian bridge stochastic interpolant 的定义，弄清楚为什么它既保留 partially masked boundary condition，又允许连续联合演化；这是整篇最核心的建模点。接着看 warm-start 训练部分，理解它如何复用预训练 MDM，以及哪些参数或表示是直接继承的。最后精读采样算法，尤其是 classifier-free guidance 的构造和 token promotion 触发条件，这部分决定了模型是否真的具备“逐步推理、逐步固化上下文”的行为。实验上优先看主结果表、few-step 设置、采样消融和案例分析。若只想抓住论文价值，至少要回答三个问题：为什么 MDM 在 few-step 下会坏；为什么 FLM 需要 masking 才更适合 reasoning；为什么 early promotion 能改变后续 token 的生成轨迹。整篇值得深挖的点是它对“语言生成中间态”给出的新定义：中间态不再只是离散 mask 模式，也不是纯连续噪声，而是两者混合且可逐步提交的状态。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses a central tension in non-autoregressive language modeling. Masked diffusion models support any-position parallel generation, but in the few-step regime they usually rely on a reverse process that factorizes across masked positions, and that approximation becomes weakest exactly where parallel decoding should be most useful. Flow language models avoid this by moving generation into a continuous space where token positions evolve jointly, but standard FLMs are less natural for iterative language generation in which some tokens should become fixed early while others remain unresolved. The paper asks whether one can combine the any-position conditional structure of masked models with the coupled dynamics of flow models, so that generation remains parallel yet can still proceed through partially resolved intermediate states.
summary_en.importance: This is a must-read for pretraining researchers because it pushes on an alternative language-modeling paradigm rather than making a local improvement inside the autoregressive setup. The contribution matters at three levels. First, it introduces Masked Language Flow Models, a hybrid that fills the gap between masked diffusion models with poor few-step behavior and flow language models without explicit masking structure. Second, it provides a practical training path by warm-starting from pretrained MDMs, which is important if this family is ever to scale beyond small proof-of-concept experiments. Third, it proposes an inference mechanism with classifier-free guidance and early token promotion, giving the model a more reasoning-like iterative generation dynamic. If this line develops further, it could affect not only sampling efficiency but also how intermediate states are represented in language modeling and how non-AR pretraining objectives are designed for reasoning-heavy tasks.
summary_en.technical_approach: The core idea is to embed partially masked discrete sequences into a continuous space and learn a conditional flow from those partially observed states to clean token sequences. MLFM uses a Brownian bridge as the stochastic interpolant between an embedded partially masked sequence and the embedded clean sequence. This choice is important for two reasons. First, the latent state evolves jointly across positions, so the model is not forced into the position-wise independence approximation used by standard masked diffusion models. That makes few-step generation better aligned with the true dependency structure of language. Second, at the boundary of the Brownian bridge, the interpolant reduces to the embedded partially masked sequence, which matches the input structure of pretrained MDMs. This enables warm-start adaptation from a large masked diffusion model instead of training a flow LM from scratch. Training follows the stochastic-interpolant / flow-matching view: the network learns a conditional velocity field that transports the continuous latent state toward clean token embeddings while conditioning on observed, unmasked tokens. Inference adds two mechanisms. The first is a new form of classifier-free guidance. Rather than only contrasting conditional and unconditional predictions, the method noises clean tokens inside the reference velocity so that the contribution of clean context can be isolated more cleanly. The second is online token promotion: once the posterior mode at a position exceeds a confidence threshold of 1-ε, that token is immediately committed and its clean embedding is inserted into the state. This means resolved tokens become usable context for later denoising steps instead of remaining noisy until the end. That is the main behavioral difference from standard FLMs, which keep decoding all positions throughout generation, and from standard MDMs, which iteratively unmask in discrete space but still rely on factorized reverse transitions.
summary_en.experiments: The experiments adapt a pretrained 1028M-parameter MDM from Nie et al. (2025a) into an MLFM and evaluate it on GSM8K and MT-Bench. The paper positions this as the first scaling of flow-based language models to instruction-following and reasoning-style downstream generation. Empirically, MLFM improves over SMDM and similarly sized autoregressive baselines on MT-Bench, and shows encouraging, though still early-stage, performance on GSM8K. The most informative results are the sampling ablations rather than any single benchmark number: the proposed guidance method and token-promotion mechanism both contribute meaningful gains, suggesting that the bottleneck in few-step non-AR generation is not only the training objective but also whether high-confidence tokens can be turned into useful context early enough. The paper also argues that warm-starting from a pretrained MDM materially reduces training cost; learning stable continuous dynamics for language from scratch would be substantially more expensive. The abstract does not expose the full numeric table, so the main results and appendix ablations should be read together, especially the comparisons across sampling step counts, promotion on/off, and guidance strength.
summary_en.reading_guide: Read it in four passes. First, use the introduction and background to pin down the two limitations being combined: factorized reverse transitions in masked diffusion models and all-position decoding in standard flow language models. Second, study the definition of the Brownian-bridge stochastic interpolant; this is the conceptual center of the paper because it preserves the partially masked boundary condition while enabling coupled continuous evolution. Third, read the warm-start training section carefully to understand how pretrained MDMs are reused and what exactly is inherited. Fourth, spend time on the sampling algorithm, especially the modified classifier-free guidance and the token-promotion rule, because these determine whether the model actually behaves like an iterative reasoning generator rather than a generic continuous denoiser. On the experimental side, prioritize the main results, the few-step setting, the sampling ablations, and any qualitative examples. The three questions worth keeping in mind are: why masked diffusion breaks in the few-step regime, why flow models benefit from explicit masking structure for reasoning tasks, and why early promotion changes the downstream generation trajectory.

recommendation.zh: 这篇会直接影响你对“flow LM 是否注定不适合复杂文本生成”的 prior；先看它如何把 masking 嵌进 continuous flow，再检查 few-step 结果是否真比 MDM 干净，值得尽快复现小规模版。
recommendation.en: This one can change your prior on whether flow LMs are inherently awkward for complex text generation; first inspect how masking is inserted into the continuous flow, then verify whether the few-step results are actually cleaner than MDMs—worth a small-scale reproduction.

paper.title: VGB for Masked Diffusion Model: Efficient Test-time Scaling for Reward Satisfaction and Sample Editing
paper.abstract: Inference-time scaling is a promising paradigm to improve generative models, especially when outputs must satisfy structural constraints or optimize downstream rewards. We consider Masked Diffusion Model (MDM) and introduce MDM-VGB, a discrete diffusion sampler that augments unmasking generation with theoretically principled reward-guided remasking. Inspired by the recent success of the classical Jerrum-Sinclair backtracking Markov chain in reward-tilted generation, MDM-VGB extends the backtrack

summary.core_problem: Masked Diffusion Model 在测试时如何利用 reward 或 verifier 信号，在不靠大量 best-of-N 采样的情况下生成满足约束的离散样本。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是文本/离散 diffusion 生成范式中的采样与 test-time scaling 方法创新。它把 reward-guided backtracking 从前缀树推广到 masked-state graph，对 MDLM、LLaDA 类任意位置生成模型有直接参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 MDM-VGB，在普通 unmasking 过程中加入 reward-guided remasking。方法允许任意位置 token 被揭示或重新 mask，使用 partial configuration 的价值信号决定前进和回退方向。它借鉴 Jerrum-Sinclair backtracking Markov chain，但不局限于固定前缀树，而是在 mask 状态图上做随机游走和修复。
summary.experiments: 摘要强调该 sampler 可用于高 reward 生成和低 reward 样本修复，并给出理论性质：对 process verifier noise 鲁棒，复杂度为 quadratic；同时指出 best-of-N 等常见 test-time heuristic 在某些 reward-tilted generation 设置下可能出现 exponential cost。摘要未列出具体模型规模、数据集或数值提升。

summary_en.core_problem: How can masked diffusion models use reward or verifier signals at test time to satisfy constraints without relying on large best-of-N sampling?
summary_en.importance: This is a sampling and test-time scaling contribution for discrete diffusion generation. By moving reward-guided backtracking from prefix trees to masked-state graphs, it is directly relevant to MDLM- and LLaDA-style non-autoregressive language modeling.
summary_en.technical_approach: MDM-VGB augments standard unmasking with reward-guided remasking. Tokens can be unmasked or remasked at arbitrary positions, and moves are biased by the estimated value of partial configurations. The method adapts the Jerrum-Sinclair backtracking Markov chain from fixed prefix trees to the graph of masked states.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract claims effectiveness for high-reward generation and repair of low-reward samples. It proves robustness to noisy process verifiers and quadratic complexity, while showing that common heuristics such as best-of-N may incur exponential cost in some reward-tilted settings. The abstract does not specify model sizes, datasets, or numeric empirical gains.

recommendation.zh: 应立刻在内部 MDLM 小模型上复现；若二次复杂度结论站得住，best-of-N prior 要下调。
recommendation.en: Worth reproducing on an internal small MDLM; if the quadratic-cost claim holds, the default best-of-N prior should be weakened.

paper.title: Speculative Refinement: A Hybrid Autoregressive Diffusion Decoding Strategy and Its Behavior Across Benchmarks
paper.abstract: How should we evaluate generation systems that combine autoregressive (AR) and diffusion decoding? We study this question through Speculative Refinement (SpecRef), a training-free hybrid method that warm-starts a masked diffusion language model from an AR draft using entropy-guided selective masking. Evaluating SpecRef across six benchmarks (HumanEval, MBPP, GSM8K, BBH, ARC-Challenge, HellaSwag) with three distinct evaluation protocols (execution-based pass@1, exact-match, log-likelihood scoring

summary.core_problem: 探索自回归（AR）与掩码扩散语言模型的混合解码策略，并解决这类混合生成系统的评测标准缺失问题。
summary.importance: 方法创新（训练无关的混合AR-扩散解码范式）+ 原理分析（揭示现有主流基准的三大系统性偏差），为非AR语言建模与评测设计提供反常识参考。
summary.technical_approach: 提出Speculative Refinement（SpecRef）方法，无需额外训练：用AR模型生成初始草稿，基于熵引导的选择性掩码保留高置信token，将低置信区域输入掩码扩散LM做局部精修。
summary.experiments: 跨HumanEval、MBPP、GSM8K、BBH等6个主流基准，采用执行准确率、精确匹配、对数似然三种评测协议；发现语法支架可将代码基准准确率从近0提升至20%+，多阶段精修存在1.5%-3%的正确token退化率，对数似然与实际生成质量相关系数低于0.3。

summary_en.core_problem: Explore hybrid decoding strategies for autoregressive (AR) and masked diffusion language models, and address the lack of evaluation standards for such hybrid generation systems.
summary_en.importance: Method innovation (training-free hybrid AR-diffusion decoding paradigm) + principle analysis (revealing three systematic biases in mainstream benchmarks), providing counterintuitive references for non-autoregressive LM and evaluation design.
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes Speculative Refinement (SpecRef), a training-free method: generating an initial draft with an AR model, retaining high-confidence tokens via entropy-guided selective masking, and sending low-confidence regions to a masked diffusion LM for local refinement.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluated across 6 mainstream benchmarks including HumanEval, MBPP, GSM8K and BBH with three protocols (execution accuracy, exact match, log-likelihood scoring); finds syntactic scaffolds lift code benchmark accuracy from ~0 to 20%+, multi-stage refinement corrupts 1.5-3% correct tokens, and log-likelihood has <0.3 correlation with actual generation quality.

recommendation.zh: 做非AR文本建模或LLM评测的优先看§4的三个发现，SpecRef方法本身是训练无关的弱创新，可跳过实现细节。
recommendation.en: Researchers working on non-autoregressive LMs or LLM evaluation should prioritize Section 4’s three findings; the SpecRef method itself is a minor training-free innovation, implementation details can be skipped.

paper.title: Nemotron-TwoTower: Diffusion Language Modeling with Pretrained Autoregressive Context
paper.abstract: Diffusion language models offer a promising alternative to autoregressive models due to their potential for parallel and iterative generation. However, existing approaches use a single network for both context representation and iterative denoising, forcing one model to serve both roles and limiting its capacity for either role. We propose TwoTower, a block-wise autoregressive diffusion model that decouples these roles into two towers: a frozen AR context tower that causally processes clean toke

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作处理的是离散 diffusion LM 在大模型尺度上的一个结构性矛盾：同一套参数既要承担“干净上下文的表示器”，又要承担“带噪 token 的迭代去噪器”。这两个角色的注意力结构、信息流方向、训练信号都不同。前者更像标准 AR LM，需要稳定地压缩和传递历史语义；后者则要在每个 diffusion step 上对局部噪声块做条件重建，还希望块内能双向看见彼此。把两者绑在一个 decoder 里，会让模型在表示 clean context 和 denoise noisy block 之间相互牵制。论文的核心问题不是再做一个小型 diffusion decoder，而是验证：在 30B 级、混合 Mamba/Attention/MoE 骨干上，能否把这两个角色彻底拆开，并借助一个已经很强的预训练 AR 模型作为 frozen context tower，让 diffusion tower 只学去噪，从而在质量接近 AR 基线的前提下换取更高吞吐。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的意义有两层。第一，它给 diffusion LM 提供了一条比“从头训练单塔去噪模型”更现实的路线：直接复用成熟 AR 预训练骨干，把 AR 预训练能力当作条件表示器，再追加一个专门的 denoiser。这样做把 AR 预训练资产转成了 diffusion 生成资产，降低了新范式落地门槛。第二，它说明在大规模混合架构上，context modeling 与 denoising 的解耦不是只在 1B 级别成立，而是可以扩展到 30B MoE，并且只用约 2.1T token 的额外训练，就能保住大部分 AR 质量。这对“AR 是否会被并行生成范式部分替代”给出了更工程化的答案：短期内更可行的路径不是完全抛弃 AR，而是把 AR 变成条件塔、把 diffusion 变成生成塔。贡献类型偏架构与训练范式，量级属于值得精读的范式性工程工作。
summary.technical_approach:
方法上最关键的是 two-tower 设计。作者从同一个预训练 Nemotron-3-Nano-30B-A3B checkpoint 复制出两份网络。context tower 保持原始 AR 结构并冻结，负责对 prompt 和已提交 token 做因果建模，持续维护每层的 KV cache 以及 Mamba state。denoiser tower 则是可训练的 diffusion 模块，针对当前待生成 block 的 [MASK] 初始化序列做 T 步迭代去噪。

生成过程是 block-wise autoregressive。序列被按块生成：过去块一旦“提交”，就进入 context tower 的干净历史；当前块在 denoiser 中反复细化，直到 token 变干净后再提交。这样既保留了跨块的 AR 因果结构，又允许块内并行生成。

架构创新主要有四点。第一，layer-aligned cross-attention。denoiser 的第 i 层直接访问 context tower 第 i 层的表示，而不是只读最后一层 hidden state。作者的理由很直接：两塔从同一 checkpoint 初始化，同层表示处在相近抽象层级，逐层对齐比“末层广播”更自然，也让 denoiser 在不同深度都能拿到条件信息。第二，块内 bidirectional attention。当前 noisy block 内部取消因果 mask，使 token 彼此双向可见；但对过去 clean blocks 仍保持因果约束。这让 denoiser 更像条件填空器，而不是被迫按 AR 方式在块内单向传播。第三，time conditioning。作者把图像 diffusion transformer 常用的 adaLN-single 引入语言去噪器，用 timestep 生成 scale/shift/gate，对每层做调制。额外参数只有约 1.5M，在 30B 骨干上几乎可以忽略，但能显著改善采样质量。第四，Mamba 层的条件接入。attention 层通过 cross-attention 读 context KV；Mamba-2 层则用对应 context tower 的 Mamba state 作为初始状态。也就是说，两塔的耦合不只发生在 attention 子层，而是覆盖了混合骨干里的两类主要计算单元。

论文还讨论了几个设计取舍。作者测试了 parameter-free 的 bidirectional Mamba：同一组预训练 Mamba 权重分别做左右两个方向扫描，再平均输出。这个设计几乎不增参数，但会把 SSM FLOPs 近似翻倍。实验显示收益很小，所以最终保留 causal Mamba，只在 attention 上做双向块内建模。MoE routing 基本沿用骨干已有机制，噪声感知主要通过 adaLN 调制进入专家路由前的表示，而不是重写路由器。推理时只有 context tower 维护跨块 cache，因此序列长度相关内存与 AR 基线同阶；额外成本主要是固定的第二塔权重和当前块去噪计算。
summary.experiments:
论文最重要的实验结论有三个。第一，规模与训练预算上，这不是小模型验证。底座是 Nemotron-3-Nano-30B-A3B，52 层，由 23 个 Mamba-2 层、6 个 self-attention 层和 23 个 MoE 层组成。TwoTower 在这个 30B 混合 MoE 骨干上训练，额外训练 token 约 2.1T，而原始骨干预训练总量约 25T。也就是说，作者不是从头重训一个 diffusion LM，而是在强 AR 基座上做相对节制的追加训练。

第二，质量-速度权衡是这篇工作的主结果。作者报告 TwoTower 在保留大部分 AR 基线质量的同时，获得了明显更高的解码吞吐。机制上，默认采样点会在早期 refinement step 一次性提交多个 token，而不是像 AR 那样每步只前进 1 个 token，这解释了 wall-clock speedup 的来源。论文摘要截断处已明确写到“preserves most of the autoregressive baseline’s quality while delivering substantially higher throughput”；正文也强调速度收益来自 block-wise parallel commit，而不是单步 FLOPs 更低。

第三，消融实验支持其关键设计。作者在 3.2 节对若干改动做了对比：time conditioning 明显提升采样质量；layer-wise 对齐访问 context 表示优于只用末层条件；bidirectional Mamba 只带来边际收益，不值得额外 FLOPs；因此最终版本只保留 bidirectional attention。还有一个重要工程观察是，context tower 冻结后仍能提供足够强的条件表示，说明额外训练主要集中在“如何利用已有 AR 表示做去噪”，而不是重新学习语言知识。

受限于给出的全文片段，具体 benchmark 数字、吞吐倍数、不同 block size / denoising step 的最优点没有完整展开；但从方法描述和实验总结可以确定，这篇工作的说服力主要来自 30B 级真实训练、2.1T token 追加预算、以及质量接近 AR 基线同时换来更高吞吐这组三元结果。
summary.reading_guide:
建议先看 Introduction 和 Figure 1，把问题设定吃透：作者不是在做“更强的 masked LM”，而是在做“AR context + diffusion denoiser”的职责拆分。随后重点看 Method 2.1 和算法描述，理解 block-wise autoregressive generation 的状态流：哪些状态由 context tower 持久化，哪些状态只在当前 block 内存在。

精读时最值得盯的点有四个。第一，layer-aligned cross-attention 的实现细节和动机。这是整篇最有信息量的设计，因为它把预训练 AR 表示当成多尺度条件，而不是单一语义摘要。第二，Mamba state 如何从 context tower 注入 denoiser。对混合架构研究者，这部分比普通 Transformer 版 diffusion 更有参考价值。第三，3.2 节消融。重点看 time conditioning、bidirectional attention、bidirectional Mamba、末层条件 vs 逐层条件的对比，这些实验决定了哪些设计是真有效，哪些只是看起来合理。第四，推理部分关于 throughput、block size、denoising steps、提交策略的分析。真正决定这类模型是否有部署价值的，不是 perplexity，而是 wall-clock 与质量曲线。

如果时间有限，优先顺序可以是：Figure 1 + Algorithm 1，Method 2.1/2.2，Ablation 3.2，主结果表和速度图。预计 45-60 分钟能抓住主干；若要深挖，建议进一步思考两个问题：为什么冻结 context tower 仍然够用；以及这种 two-tower 设计能否迁移到更纯粹的 any-order LM 或多模态 token 生成。
summary.authors_note: NVIDIA 工作。文中明确基于 Nemotron 系列开放权重模型展开，属于 NVIDIA 在 Nemotron 预训练体系上的延伸。给出的片段未完整列出作者名单。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets a structural limitation in discrete diffusion language modeling at scale: a single network is usually asked to do two different jobs at once. It must represent clean causal context, and it must iteratively denoise corrupted tokens. Those roles prefer different information flow patterns and different inductive biases. Clean-context modeling looks like standard AR language modeling; denoising benefits from bidirectional access within the noisy region and from timestep-conditioned reconstruction. The paper asks whether these roles can be fully separated on top of a large modern backbone, using a frozen pretrained AR model as the context encoder and a trainable diffusion tower as the denoiser, while keeping most of the AR model’s quality and gaining decoding throughput.
summary_en.importance: This matters for pretraining research because it offers a practical migration path from AR pretraining to diffusion-style generation. Instead of training a large diffusion LM from scratch, the work reuses a strong pretrained AR backbone as a conditional representation engine and only trains the denoising side for the new objective. That lowers the adoption barrier for non-AR generation paradigms. It also shows that the context/denoiser split is not just a small-scale architectural curiosity: it can be instantiated on a 30B-class hybrid Mamba-Transformer-MoE model and trained with about 2.1T additional tokens, far less than the 25T-token budget used for the original backbone. The contribution is mainly architectural and recipe-level, but the scale makes it relevant to anyone thinking about post-AR pretraining paradigms.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The central idea is a two-tower architecture built from two copies of the same pretrained Nemotron-3-Nano-30B-A3B checkpoint. The context tower is frozen and remains a causal AR model over the prompt and previously committed tokens. It maintains per-layer KV caches and final Mamba states. The denoiser tower is trainable and performs masked diffusion over the current block, starting from a block of [MASK] tokens and refining it over T denoising steps.

Generation is block-wise autoregressive. Past blocks are committed and become clean causal context. The current block is refined in parallel inside the denoiser. Once the block is sufficiently clean, it is committed, the context tower consumes it causally, and generation moves to the next block. This preserves AR structure across blocks while enabling parallel generation within a block.

There are four notable design choices. First, layer-aligned conditioning: denoiser layer i attends to context-tower layer i, rather than conditioning only on the final hidden state. Since both towers start from the same pretrained checkpoint, same-depth layers are expected to live at similar representational levels, making aligned cross-attention a sensible pairing. Second, bidirectional attention inside the noisy block: tokens under refinement can attend to one another without a causal mask, while still attending causally to past clean blocks. This turns the denoiser into a conditional infilling module rather than a left-to-right decoder. Third, timestep conditioning via adaLN-single: the denoiser is modulated by the diffusion timestep using scale/shift/gate parameters generated from t. The added parameter cost is tiny, about 1.5M on top of the 30B backbone, but it improves sampling quality. Fourth, Mamba-state conditioning: attention layers consume context KV caches, while Mamba-2 layers are initialized from the corresponding context-tower Mamba states. So the coupling spans both attention and state-space components of the hybrid backbone.

The paper also studies design trade-offs. A parameter-free bidirectional Mamba variant is tested by running the same pretrained Mamba weights left-to-right and right-to-left and averaging outputs. It nearly doubles SSM FLOPs and yields only marginal gains, so the final model keeps Mamba causal and uses bidirectionality only in attention. MoE routing is inherited from the backbone, with noise awareness entering through timestep-conditioned activations rather than a redesigned router. At inference time, only the context tower keeps sequence-length-dependent cache state across blocks, so cache scaling remains comparable to the AR baseline; the extra cost is mainly the fixed second tower and the iterative denoising compute for the current block.
summary_en.experiments:
The experimental story has three main parts. First, this is a large-scale validation rather than a toy setup. The backbone is Nemotron-3-Nano-30B-A3B, a 52-layer hybrid model with 23 Mamba-2 layers, 6 self-attention layers, and 23 MoE layers. TwoTower is trained on top of this 30B-class model with about 2.1T additional tokens, compared with roughly 25T tokens used to pretrain the original backbone. So the work is not retraining a diffusion LM from scratch; it is converting a strong AR asset into a diffusion-capable generator with a moderate extra budget.

Second, the key result is the quality-throughput trade-off. The model retains most of the AR baseline’s quality while delivering substantially higher decoding throughput. The mechanism is important: at the default operating point, the model commits multiple tokens per refinement step early in decoding, rather than advancing by exactly one token as in AR decoding. The wall-clock gain therefore comes from block-wise parallel progress, not from lower per-step complexity alone.

Third, the ablations support the final recipe. Timestep conditioning improves sampling quality. Layer-wise aligned conditioning is better motivated than using only the last hidden state, and the paper presents it as a meaningful architectural choice rather than a cosmetic one. Bidirectional Mamba brings only small gains relative to its extra FLOPs, which justifies the final decision to keep Mamba causal. Another useful engineering takeaway is that a frozen context tower is already strong enough to provide the conditional signal; most of the extra training is spent on learning how to denoise given AR representations, not on relearning language knowledge.

The provided full-text excerpt does not include all benchmark tables or exact throughput multipliers, so some numeric details are missing here. Still, the evidence that matters is clear from the paper’s setup and reported conclusions: 30B scale, 2.1T-token additional training, near-AR quality retention, and materially better throughput.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Start with the introduction and Figure 1. The paper is easier to read once the role split is clear: this is not just a stronger masked LM, but an AR-context-plus-diffusion-denoiser system. Then read the method section carefully, especially the block-wise generation algorithm and the state flow between towers. You want to understand which states persist across blocks and which exist only during denoising.

Four parts deserve close attention. First, the layer-aligned cross-attention design and its motivation. This is one of the most informative ideas in the paper because it treats pretrained AR representations as multi-scale conditioning signals rather than a single summary vector. Second, the way Mamba states are injected from the context tower into the denoiser. That part is especially relevant for researchers working on hybrid backbones. Third, the ablations in Section 3.2: focus on timestep conditioning, bidirectional attention, bidirectional Mamba, and layer-wise versus last-layer conditioning. Those experiments tell you which choices are actually carrying the result. Fourth, the inference analysis around throughput, block size, denoising steps, and token commitment behavior. For deployment relevance, those curves matter more than perplexity.

If time is limited, the best reading order is Figure 1 plus Algorithm 1, then Method 2.1/2.2, then the ablations, then the main quality/speed tables. Around an hour should be enough to capture the main ideas. For deeper study, two follow-up questions are worth keeping in mind: why a frozen context tower is sufficient, and whether the same two-tower pattern could extend to any-order LM or multimodal token generation.
summary_en.authors_note: NVIDIA work built on the Nemotron model family. The excerpt clearly places it within the Nemotron open-weight pretraining line, but the full author list is not visible in the provided text.

recommendation.zh: 应立刻看方法和消融：它把 diffusion LM 的弱上下文问题改成“复用 AR prior”，比从零训练 DLM 更像可落地路线。
recommendation.en: Read the method and ablations now: it reframes diffusion LM as reuse of a strong AR prior, a much more deployable path than training a DLM from scratch.

paper.title: Retrieval-Warmed Energy-Based Reasoning: A Five-Arm Ablation Methodology for Diffusion-as-Inference on Structured Reasoning Tasks
paper.abstract: Warm-started diffusion samplers accelerate iterative inference, but it is rarely clear which part of the pipeline carries the gain. We study \textbf{retrieval-warmed energy-based reasoning (RW-EBR)} -- an IRED energy-based diffusion model \cite{du2024ired} augmented with a Modern Hopfield trajectory memory -- and contribute a \textbf{five-arm ablation methodology} (oracle, best-constant, per-query-random, shuffled, aligned) that separates three confounded effects: class-prior bias shift, stochas

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文解决的是检索 warm-start 在迭代式推理模型中到底为何有效的问题。作者不把准确率提升直接归因于“检索到了有用样本”，而是把收益拆成三类：初始化分布的类别先验偏移、每个 query 的随机扰动、以及与当前图结构对齐的历史解复用。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的直接价值不在模型规模或训练 recipe，而在诊断方法。它提供了一套可迁移的消融设计，用来分析 retrieval-augmented diffusion / energy-based inference 中的收益来源。对 diffusion LM、masked iterative refinement、latent reasoning 这类非自回归推理框架有启发：warm-start 的收益需要区分“分布更好”“扰动打破坏平衡”和“内容真的对齐”，否则很容易把检索记忆的作用估计过高。论文的贡献量级偏方法学诊断，不是新的基座建模范式。
summary.technical_approach:
作者在 IRED energy-based diffusion reasoning 模型外接 Modern Hopfield trajectory memory。基础任务是 connectivity-2：给定 Erdős–Rényi 图 G(N=12, p=0.2)，预测 all-pairs reachability matrix。基础模型使用 IRED 的 32-channel GraphEBM，训练 30k steps，10 个 diffusion timesteps，目标是对 ±1 缩放后的 reachability target 做 MSE denoising，并保留 IRED 的 energy-landscape supervision 和 inner-loop optimization。检索 key 由 3-layer GIN 产生，使用 label-ordered readout 而不是 sum-pool，因为 reachability matrix 需要与节点标签顺序对齐；还加入 per-position id embedding，避免度数对称结构坍缩。key encoder 用 supervised contrastive loss 训练 3000 steps，正样本来自 target-nearest neighbours，pair similarity 用 reachability 的 per-edge Hamming agreement。

核心是五臂消融：oracle、best-constant、per-query-random、shuffled、aligned。oracle 用金标准 memory 检验上限；best-constant 衡量固定初始化带来的类别先验偏移；per-query-random 衡量每个 query 随机 warm-start 是否单独有用；shuffled 保持 value 分布和检索机制，但打乱 key-value 配对；aligned 保持正确配对。aligned 与 shuffled 的差值用于隔离“内容是否与当前 query 对齐”。这个设计比只比较 cold-start 与 warm-start 更干净，因为它把 value 分布、检索噪声、配对关系分开控制。
summary.experiments:
connectivity-2 上，作者在固定 1000 图验证集、seed 20260420 上运行 warm-start 诊断。oracle memory 条件下，aligned 相比 shuffled 的 balanced accuracy 提升达到 +35 个百分点，说明主要收益来自图级别对齐的 value reuse。best-constant sweep 给出的 bias-shift 上界不超过 +8 个百分点；per-query-random 初始化为负收益，约 -1.5 到 -3.1 个百分点，说明随机扰动不是主要原因。可部署的 cold-prediction pipeline 未通过 -2 pp acceptance gate，实际 Δ balanced accuracy 为 -4.09 pp；同一套分解把失败定位到 stored-value quality，而不是 key encoder。

作者还在 Sudoku 上做了异质失败案例。使用任务特定 encoder、contrastive key training 和 quality-ratio gate，但在 key-quality screen 就失败：在当前 mask-aware solved-board target 与 500-candidate pool 设置下，key encoder 本身未达到质量门槛。这个结果与 connectivity-2 形成对照：connectivity 的瓶颈是 stored-value quality，Sudoku 的瓶颈是 key quality。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读即可，预计 25–35 分钟。重点看 Introduction 中的三类混杂因素定义，以及 Methods 里五臂消融如何构造。connectivity-2 的 aligned、shuffled、best-constant、per-query-random 对比是核心结果；它比最终 end-to-end accuracy 更有信息量。若关心 diffusion-as-inference 或 retrieval-augmented iterative reasoning，可细看 key encoder 设计，尤其是为什么不能用 permutation-invariant readout。Sudoku 部分适合看作 failure attribution 示例，不必按新方法读。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies why retrieval warm-starting helps iterative reasoning models. It separates three effects that are usually conflated: a better class-prior initialization, query-specific stochastic perturbation, and reuse of a retrieved value that is actually aligned with the input structure.
summary_en.importance: Its relevance to foundation-model pretraining is methodological rather than scale-oriented. The five-arm diagnostic is useful for retrieval-augmented diffusion inference, energy-based reasoning, masked iterative refinement, and other non-AR inference schemes. The main lesson is that a warm-start gain should not be interpreted as evidence of useful retrieval unless value distribution, stochasticity, and key-value alignment are separately controlled.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The system wraps an IRED energy-based diffusion reasoning model with a Modern Hopfield trajectory memory. The main task is connectivity-2: given an Erdős–Rényi graph G(N=12, p=0.2), predict its all-pairs reachability matrix. The base model is IRED’s 32-channel GraphEBM, trained for 30k steps with 10 diffusion timesteps and an MSE denoising objective on ±1-scaled targets, with energy-landscape supervision and inner-loop optimization enabled.

Retrieval keys are produced by a 3-layer GIN. The encoder uses a label-ordered readout instead of sum pooling, because the retrieved reachability matrix must preserve the node-label alignment of the query graph. A learned per-position ID embedding is added to avoid collapses in degree-symmetric cases. The key encoder is trained with supervised contrastive learning for 3000 steps; target-nearest neighbors are defined by Hamming agreement over reachability entries.

The main contribution is the five-arm ablation: oracle, best-constant, per-query-random, shuffled, and aligned. The best-constant arm estimates how much can be gained by a favorable fixed initialization. The per-query-random arm tests whether stochastic perturbation alone helps. The shuffled arm keeps the value distribution and retrieval mechanics but permutes key-value pairings. The aligned arm keeps the correct pairing. The aligned-minus-shuffled gap isolates graph-aligned value reuse.
summary_en.experiments:
On connectivity-2, the warm-start diagnostic is run on a fixed validation set of 1,000 graphs with seed 20260420. Under oracle memory, aligned initialization outperforms shuffled initialization by +35 percentage points in balanced accuracy. The constant-initialization sweep bounds the class-prior bias effect at no more than +8 points. Per-query random initialization is negative, around -1.5 to -3.1 points. These results indicate that graph-aligned value reuse is the dominant source of the warm-start gain.

The deployable cold-prediction pipeline does not pass the -2 pp acceptance gate; its balanced-accuracy delta is -4.09 points. The decomposition localizes this failure to stored-value quality rather than key quality. A Sudoku case study shows a different bottleneck: with the current mask-aware solved-board target and a 500-candidate pool, the key encoder fails its quality gate. The diagnostic therefore identifies different first blocking components on the two tasks.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 25–35 minutes. The most useful parts are the definition of the three confounders and the construction of the five ablation arms. The aligned-versus-shuffled oracle comparison is the central result. Readers working on diffusion-as-inference or retrieval-augmented iterative refinement should also inspect the key encoder design, especially the choice of label-ordered readout. The Sudoku section is best read as a failure-attribution example rather than as a new solver.

recommendation.zh: 对离散扩散模型做推理的机制拆解很干净，五臂消融法值得借鉴，关注 Diffusion LM 推理机制的必看。
recommendation.en: Clean mechanism disentanglement for discrete diffusion inference; the five-arm ablation is worth adopting for those studying Diffusion LM reasoning.

paper.title: Beyond the Autoregressive Horizon: A Comprehensive Survey of Diffusion Models, World Modelling, and State Space Models for Code
paper.abstract: Autoregressive (AR) language models have driven significant progress in automated software engineering, enabling powerful code generation and assistance systems. However, the next-token prediction paradigm introduces structural limitations for code reasoning, including restricted global planning, challenges in maintaining long-range dependencies, and limited grounding in program execution semantics. Noting the heavy skewness of existing literature towards AR models, we discuss emerging paradigms

summary.core_problem: 在代码智能场景下，next-token 自回归范式的结构性限制（全局规划、长程依赖、执行语义落地）是否有替代建模路线可走。
summary.importance: 综述型工作：把“非AR代码建模”相关的三条线（Diffusion code generation / Code world models / State space models）放到同一框架下讨论，帮助预训练研究员快速定位可能挑战 AR 的范式与关键瓶颈。
summary.technical_approach: 以问题驱动方式梳理：1) 扩散模型用整体去噪生成以更好满足全局语法/结构约束；2) 代码世界模型通过显式/隐式执行状态模拟来增强语义与可验证性；3) SSM 以线性时间序列建模缓解长上下文成本。主要是概念归纳与文献组织，不提出新训练目标或新架构实现细节。
summary.experiments: 无原创实验（survey）。

summary_en.core_problem: Whether alternatives to next-token autoregressive modeling can better address structural limitations in code intelligence (global planning, long-range dependencies, and grounding in execution semantics).
summary_en.importance: A survey that consolidates three non-AR directions for code modeling—diffusion models, code world models, and state space models—useful for quickly mapping the design space that could challenge AR pretraining.
summary_en.technical_approach: Problem-driven literature organization: (1) diffusion-style holistic denoising for global syntactic/structural constraints, (2) code world models that simulate execution states for semantic grounding and verification, and (3) SSMs for linear-time long-context modeling. No new objective/architecture is introduced.
summary_en.experiments: No original experiments (survey).

recommendation.zh: 当作“非AR代码建模路线图”备查即可；别指望有可复现的 recipe，主要价值是帮你快速列出 diffusion/CWM/SSM 三条线的关键问题清单。
recommendation.en: Use it as a map of non-AR code modeling threads; don’t expect reproducible recipes—its value is a curated problem checklist across diffusion/CWMs/SSMs.

paper.title: When to Plan, When to Polish: Noise Level as a Granularity Axis for Diffusion Language Models
paper.abstract: Standard tokenwise diffusion LMs keep training corruption and inference commitment at token granularity throughout denoising. At high noise, this leaves scattered local fragments rather than coherent evidence, making it hard to form early coarse structure, exactly what planning-sensitive generation requires. Hierarchical planning methods add coarse stages to separate planning from wording, but they need extra planners, block latents, or two stage designs. We propose Noise Dependent Granularity C

summary.core_problem: 标准token级扩散语言模型在高噪声步仅能生成零散局部token片段，难以形成规划所需的早期粗语义结构，而现有分层规划方法需引入额外规划器、隐变量块或两阶段设计，复杂度高。
summary.importance: 方法创新，在单级扩散LM框架内实现了规划式粗到细去噪，无需显式规划器或分层架构，拓展了扩散语言建模范式的设计空间。
summary.technical_approach: 提出噪声依赖粒度控制（NDGC）方法，将噪声水平作为粒度调节线索：高噪声步采用连贯token组进行早期语义承诺，低噪声步回到token级精修，对齐训练时的暴露策略与推理时的生成粒度。
summary.experiments: 跨控制测试、消融实验、WritingPrompts数据集的初步结果显示，NDGC可更早形成生成的语义骨架，生成质量优于标准token级扩散LM。

summary_en.core_problem: Standard token-level diffusion LMs only produce scattered local token fragments at high noise steps, failing to form early coarse semantic structures required for planning, while existing hierarchical planning methods require additional planners, latent blocks, or two-stage designs with high complexity.
summary_en.importance: Methodological innovation that enables planning-style coarse-to-fine denoising within a single-level diffusion LM framework, eliminating the need for explicit planners or hierarchical architectures and expanding the design space of diffusion language modeling paradigms.
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes Noise Dependent Granularity Control (NDGC), which uses noise level as a granularity cue: coherent token groups are used for early semantic commitment at high noise steps, and generation returns to token-level refinement at low noise steps, aligning training exposure with inference granularity.
summary_en.experiments: Preliminary results across controlled tests, ablations, and the WritingPrompts dataset show that NDGC forms semantic skeletons earlier and outperforms standard token-level diffusion LMs in generation quality.

recommendation.zh: 扩散LM无需分层架构即可实现粗到细规划的新思路，重点看§3的训练-推理粒度对齐设计，做非AR预训练的团队可做小范围复现
recommendation.en: A novel approach to coarse-to-fine planning in diffusion LMs without hierarchical architectures; focus on §3 for training-inference granularity alignment design, suitable for small-scale reproduction by non-AR pretraining teams.

paper.title: Where to Place the Query? Unveiling and Mitigating Positional Bias in In-Context Learning for Diffusion LLMs via Decoding Dynamics
paper.abstract: While In-Context Learning (ICL) is extensively studied in Autoregressive (AR) LLMs, its mechanism within Diffusion Large Language Models (dLLMs) remains largely unexplored. Unlike AR models restricted by unidirectional causal masking, dLLMs intrinsically utilize bidirectional attention, offering extensive spatial flexibility for query placement. Unfortunately, current practices conventionally inherit AR-style trailing-query templates, often overlooking the structural paradigm shift. This paper p

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文研究 diffusion LLM 做 ICL 时一个此前几乎被忽略的问题：query 应该插在 demonstrations 的什么位置。AR 模型里 query 基本只能放在末尾，但 dLLM 具备双向注意力，query 的空间位置变成了可配置变量；作者要回答的是，这个变量到底有多重要、为什么重要、以及能否在无标签条件下自动选择位置。
summary.importance: 对预训练与新型语言建模范式的启发在于，它揭示了 diffusion LM 的 ICL 机制并不只是把 AR prompt 模板平移过来。双向建模带来的不是单纯“更灵活”，而是新的位置偏置和新的解码动力学。这个观察对 dLLM 的 prompt 设计、评测协议、甚至训练目标都有影响：如果 query placement 会显著改变性能，那么很多现有 dLLM ICL 结果可能混入了模板偏差，而不是纯模型能力差异。
summary.technical_approach: 方法上分三步。第一，做严格控制实验，把 demonstrations 的内容和顺序固定，只枚举 query 插入位置 p∈{0,…,N}，从而把性能变化归因到空间位置本身。第二，做机制分析。空间上用 Attention Rollout 观察 query 是否更依赖邻近 examples，作者据此提出 dLLM 中存在明显 recency effect；时间上分析 decoding trajectory，发现 trailing query 更接近 AR 式左到右生成，而 prefix query 会诱发 boundary-first、更加不规则的迭代解码。第三，提出 Auto-ICL。作者认为 AR 常用的单步置信度不适合 dLLM，因为 diffusion 解码是多步演化过程，于是改用 trajectory-level 的 Average Confidence，对所有 decoding steps 的激活概率做聚合，用它在无监督条件下选择 query placement。论文还把 Vanilla、Prefix、Random 三种空间配置明确形式化，作为 dLLM ICL 的基础设定。
summary.experiments: 实验使用 LLaDA-8B-Base 和 Dream-7B-Base，在 GSM8K、MATH、MBPP、Sudoku、Countdown 上做 4-shot 为主的评测。最关键的结果有两点。第一，位置带来的性能波动很大，作者用方差影响比 r=1.236 说明：仅仅改变 query 位置，带来的影响量级可以和替换 demonstrations 语义内容相当。第二，最优位置强烈依赖任务类型：GSM8K 这类 sequential reasoning 更偏好传统 trailing placement，而 Sudoku 这类 global-perception 任务在 prefix boundary 达到最好表现。Auto-ICL 方面，论文声称 Average Confidence 与生成稳定性高度相关，能在无标签条件下接近 oracle placement。对 skim 阅读者，最该记住的是：dLLM 的 ICL 里，query position 不是模板细节，而是一级超参数。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议是先看 Introduction、Problem Setup、External Sensitivity Experiments，再看机制分析和 Auto-ICL。预计 20–30 分钟能抓住主结论。若只看图表，优先看不同位置下的准确率矩阵、Attention Rollout 可视化、以及 Average Confidence 与真实效果相关性的结果。方法不复杂，价值主要在问题定义和现象拆解。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies a neglected variable in in-context learning for diffusion LLMs: where the query should be inserted among the demonstrations. In autoregressive models the query is effectively forced to the end, but bidirectional diffusion LLMs allow flexible placement. The paper asks how important this choice is, why it matters, and whether the model can choose the placement automatically without labels.
summary_en.importance: The main relevance is conceptual. It shows that ICL in diffusion LLMs should not inherit AR prompting conventions by default. Bidirectional modeling introduces a new positional degree of freedom, and that degree of freedom materially affects performance. This has implications for prompt design, evaluation protocol, and possibly training objectives for diffusion-based language models, because part of the observed performance variance may come from template topology rather than model quality alone.
summary_en.technical_approach: The study proceeds in three stages. First, it uses a controlled setup where the demonstration set and its ordering are fixed while only the query insertion position is varied over all possible slots. This isolates spatial position as the causal variable. Second, it analyzes the mechanism behind the effect. Spatially, Attention Rollout is used to show a strong recency effect: the query tends to anchor on nearby examples. Temporally, the paper examines decoding trajectories and finds that a trailing query induces a more AR-like left-to-right generation pattern, whereas a prefix query leads to boundary-first and more irregular iterative decoding. Third, it proposes Auto-ICL, an unsupervised routing method. Instead of using single-step confidence, which is natural in AR decoding but mismatched to iterative diffusion decoding, the method uses Average Confidence aggregated across all decoding steps as a trajectory-level proxy for generation stability.
summary_en.experiments: Experiments are run on LLaDA-8B-Base and Dream-7B-Base across GSM8K, MATH, MBPP, Sudoku, and Countdown, mainly in a 4-shot setting. Two findings stand out. First, query position has a large effect: the variance induced purely by moving the query is reported to be on par with changing the semantic content of the demonstrations, with a variance impact ratio of r = 1.236. Second, the best placement is task-dependent. Sequential reasoning tasks such as GSM8K prefer the standard trailing query, while global-perception tasks such as Sudoku perform best with prefix placement. The proposed Auto-ICL uses Average Confidence to select placements without labels and is reported to approach oracle routing across tasks.
summary_en.reading_guide: For a quick read, focus on the introduction, the problem setup, the external sensitivity experiments, and then the Auto-ICL section. Around 20 to 30 minutes should be enough to extract the main message. If you only inspect figures, prioritize the accuracy-by-position matrices, the Attention Rollout visualizations, and the plots showing the correlation between Average Confidence and actual performance. The method itself is lightweight; the main value is in the problem framing and the mechanistic diagnosis.

recommendation.zh: 做 diffusion LM 的可以读；它在提醒一个常被忽略的 prior：AR prompt 模板不能直接搬过去，先看位置消融和解码轨迹分析，再决定是否纳入内部 eval。
recommendation.en: Worth reading if you care about diffusion LMs: it challenges the lazy prior that AR prompt templates transfer unchanged; read the position ablations and decoding-trajectory analysis first.

paper.title: DreamReasoner-8B: Block-Size Curriculum Learning for Diffusion Reasoning Models
paper.abstract: Block diffusion language models accelerate decoding through parallel block-wise denoising, yet whether they can be reliably scaled for long chain-of-thought (CoT) reasoning remains unresolved. To this end, we develop DreamReasoner-8B, an open-source block diffusion reasoning model, and conduct a systematic study of how training and inference block sizes affect long-CoT reasoning. Our analysis reveals a stark performance disparity: training with large block sizes yields remarkably poor reasoning,

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文解决的是 block diffusion language model 在长 CoT 推理中能否使用大 block 的问题。block diffusion 希望把跨 block 依赖做成自回归，把 block 内 token 用扩散去噪并行生成，以换取推理并行度。但大 block 会削弱逐步生成的细粒度约束，直接训练大 block 时推理能力明显下降。论文把 block size 从一个固定超参提升为训练和推理共同作用的尺度变量，研究训练 block size、推理 block size、解码策略三者如何影响长推理。
summary.importance: 这篇工作对预训练研究的价值在于，它给 diffusion LM 做长推理提供了一个较清晰的训练动态结论：并行生成的粒度不能只在推理阶段调大，训练阶段必须让模型逐步适应从细粒度到粗粒度的去噪条件。它不是单纯提出一个 diffusion 解码技巧，而是在 8B 规模上验证了 block size curriculum 可以缓解大 block 训练的脆弱性。对 AR 之外的语言建模范式来说，这是一个重要信号：推理能力不只来自模型规模和数据，也来自生成因子分解与训练课程之间的匹配。论文还指出，当前 block diffusion 的效率收益受 token-level confidence threshold 限制，说明推理并行度的瓶颈已经部分转移到 commit 策略，而不只是模型结构。
summary.technical_approach: 模型采用 block diffusion factorization：序列被切成连续 block，block 之间按自回归顺序建模，前面 block 保持 clean context；当前 block 从全 mask 状态开始，通过吸收态离散扩散过程迭代预测被 mask 的 token。训练目标可化为对 masked positions 的加权交叉熵，权重由噪声日程决定。这个设计保留了 AR 的长程顺序依赖，又允许 block 内 token 并行去噪。核心创新是 block-size curriculum learning。直接用大 block 训练时，模型需要在一个更宽的局部双向空间里同时恢复很多 token，局部约束变弱，长 CoT 中容易破坏中间推理步骤。课程学习先使用小 block，让模型在接近 AR 的细粒度条件下学会推理轨迹，再逐步过渡到大 block，使模型适应更粗粒度的并行去噪。与固定小 block 相比，它保留了大 block 推理的效率空间；与直接大 block 训练相比，它降低了训练不稳定和推理退化。论文还提出 RelaxedConfidence 作为分析性解码 probe：常规解码只在 token 置信度足够高时 commit，策略偏保守；RelaxedConfidence 检查高置信 token 的连续 span，允许被可靠邻域包围的 token 在较宽松阈值下更早 commit，用来估计 block diffusion 还能释放多少并行度。
summary.experiments: 论文训练并开源 DreamReasoner-8B，一个 8B 参数的 block diffusion reasoning model。主要实验围绕数学和代码推理 benchmark，比较不同训练 block size、推理 block size 和解码策略。关键发现是：直接使用大 block 训练会导致推理性能显著下降；小 block 训练能保持较好的长 CoT 推理；从小 block 到大 block 的 curriculum 可以恢复大 block 训练下丢失的推理能力，并让大 block 推理获得效率收益。论文称 DreamReasoner-8B 在数学和代码推理上达到与 Qwen3-8B-Thinking 接近的表现，并明显超过同规模既有 block diffusion 模型。效率分析中，RelaxedConfidence 在 thinking phase 和 answering phase 分别带来平均 TPF，即 tokens per forward pass，22.5% 和 54.5% 的提升，而且没有破坏推理正确性。这个结果说明，模型本身已经能在局部区域给出更宽的可靠并行生成信号，但默认 confidence threshold 没有充分利用。
summary.reading_guide: 建议精读三处。第一是 block diffusion preliminaries 和训练目标部分，重点看它如何把 clean prefix、masked current block、absorbing corruption 和 weighted cross-entropy 组合起来；这决定了它与 full-sequence diffusion LM、纯 AR LM 的差异。第二是 block size 相关实验，尤其是训练 block size 与 inference block size 的交叉表或曲线；这里能看到大 block 失败不是单一解码问题，而是训练条件和推理条件不匹配。第三是 block-size curriculum 和 RelaxedConfidence。前者是主要训练贡献，值得关注 curriculum 的阶段设计、block size 迁移节奏、是否需要额外 compute；后者是推理瓶颈分析，建议看 TPF、正确率和不同推理阶段的拆分结果。需要留意的是，RelaxedConfidence 更像诊断工具，不一定等价于最终可部署解码算法；它的意义在于暴露保守 commit 阈值带来的并行度损失。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies whether block diffusion language models can use large blocks for long chain-of-thought reasoning without losing reasoning quality. Block diffusion keeps autoregressive dependencies across blocks and denoises tokens inside each block in parallel. This gives a path toward faster decoding, but large blocks weaken the fine-grained sequential constraints that long reasoning often relies on. The central question is how training block size, inference block size, and decoding policy interact at an 8B reasoning-model scale.
summary_en.importance: The main contribution is a training-dynamics result for diffusion-based language modeling: coarse parallel generation cannot be treated as an inference-only knob. A model trained directly with large blocks can lose reasoning ability, while a curriculum that moves from fine-grained to coarse-grained blocks can make large-block inference usable. This matters for pretraining research because it identifies block size as a scaling axis for non-AR language models, not merely a decoding hyperparameter. The paper also shows that the efficiency bottleneck is partly in token commitment rules. Conservative confidence thresholds leave parallelism unused even when the model assigns reliable local predictions.
summary_en.technical_approach: The model uses a block diffusion factorization. A sequence is split into contiguous blocks. Previous blocks are kept clean and used as prefix context, while the current block is corrupted with an absorbing [MASK] process and denoised in parallel. The conditional distribution for each block is trained with a weighted cross-entropy over masked positions, with weights induced by the diffusion noise schedule. This design interpolates between AR generation and fully parallel diffusion. The main method is block-size curriculum learning. Training starts with small blocks, where the model sees a generation problem closer to AR and can learn coherent reasoning trajectories. It then gradually increases the block size so the model adapts to coarser parallel denoising. This differs from fixed small-block training, which limits inference parallelism, and from direct large-block training, which is brittle for reasoning. The paper also introduces RelaxedConfidence, an analytical decoding probe that commits contiguous spans of high-confidence tokens earlier under relaxed thresholds when neighboring tokens provide reliable support.
summary_en.experiments: The authors train DreamReasoner-8B, an open 8B-parameter block diffusion reasoning model. The experiments vary training block size, inference block size, and decoding strategy on math and code reasoning benchmarks. The key result is that naive large-block training substantially hurts reasoning, while small-block training preserves reasoning ability. A fine-to-coarse block-size curriculum recovers strong reasoning under larger blocks and enables efficiency gains during inference. The paper reports that DreamReasoner-8B is competitive with Qwen3-8B-Thinking on math and code reasoning and clearly improves over prior block diffusion models at comparable scale. RelaxedConfidence gives average tokens-per-forward-pass gains of 22.5% in the thinking phase and 54.5% in the answering phase without degrading reasoning fidelity, indicating that conservative token-level commitment is a real bottleneck.
summary_en.reading_guide: Read the block diffusion formulation first, especially how clean prefixes, masked target blocks, absorbing corruption, and weighted cross-entropy are combined. Then focus on the experiments that cross training block size with inference block size; these are the most important evidence that large-block failure is a training mismatch, not just a decoding issue. The curriculum section is the main technical contribution and is worth checking for schedule design, compute cost, and sensitivity to block-size transitions. The RelaxedConfidence analysis is useful for understanding the remaining inference bottleneck. It should be read as a diagnostic for unused parallelism rather than as a fully settled serving algorithm.

recommendation.zh: 这篇会直接影响你对 diffusion LM 做 reasoning 的 prior：先别盯采样步数，先复现 block-size curriculum；若结论稳，训练粒度就是比解码并行度更关键的控制杆。
recommendation.en: This should update your prior on diffusion reasoning: before obsessing over sampling steps, reproduce the block-size curriculum result—if it holds, training granularity is a more important lever than decoding parallelism.

paper.title: Diffusion-Proof: Recipe for Formal Theorem Proving Beyond Auto-Regressive Generation
paper.abstract: Enhancing the formal math reasoning capabilities of Large Language Models (LLMs) has become a key focus in both mathematical and computer science communities in recent years. While significant progress has been made in using state-of-the-art Auto-Regressive (AR) LLMs for formal theorem proving, these models suffer from inherent limitations. Their next-token prediction generation methods may yield suboptimal performance due to the challenges of long-range coherence and the compounding of errors o

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作关注 formal theorem proving 中一个很具体的建模问题：自回归语言模型按 token 左到右生成证明，容易在长证明里累积错误，也不擅长局部修补；而形式化证明恰恰要求长程一致性和可验证性。作者想验证 diffusion LLM 能否在这个场景里替代或补充 AR 生成，并给出一套可训练、可推理的 formal proof recipe。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的价值不在数学任务本身，而在它把 diffusion LM 放进了一个对长程一致性要求很高、且有严格 verifier 的场景。很多非AR建模范式都缺少足够硬的测试床，formal proving 正好提供了可验证反馈。文章的贡献量级属于“方向性探索 + 初步 recipe 建立”：它不是通用预训练范式的定论，但对研究 diffusion LM 在代码、形式语言、结构化生成中的适用边界有参考意义。尤其是 large-block correction 这个训练/推理接口，体现了 diffusion 模型相对 AR 的一个真实优势：可以做双向条件下的局部修复，而不是整段重写。
summary.technical_approach:
框架名为 Diffusion-Proof，由两个 7B 模型组成：dLLM-Prover-7B 负责整段证明生成，dLLM-Corrector-7B 负责局部修补。底座是 Fast-dLLM-V2-7B。整体思路不是用一个 diffusion 模型包打天下，而是把“写初稿”和“修局部错误”拆成两个子任务，这个拆分很合理，因为 formal proof 中很多失败并不是全局思路错，而是局部 tactic、变量、类型或中间步骤不一致。

训练数据方面，作者从既有 theorem proving 数据中收集了 5.5M records，再清洗筛选出 300k SFT 数据用于 whole-proof fine-tuning。这里能看出作者没有直接把全部数据灌进去，而是做了质量筛选；对 formal domain 来说，这通常比盲目扩量更重要，因为错误证明、低质量中间轨迹和格式噪声会直接污染 verifier-sensitive 学习。

方法创新主要在 large block correction。作者不是做 token-level 或很小span的 infilling，而是训练 dLLM-Corrector 在较大 diffusion block 上进行局部修正。这样做的理由有两个。第一，形式化证明中的错误常常跨越多个 token，甚至一整段 tactic 组合，小span修补不够。第二，diffusion 模型天然能利用左右双向上下文，因此适合在“前后都已知，中间有错”的条件下重写局部片段。与 AR 模型相比，这种修补不需要从错误点之后整段续写，理论上更稳，也更符合 proof debugging 的工作流。

推理流程是：先由 dLLM-Prover-7B 根据 theorem statement 生成完整证明；如果 verifier 判错，但判断为 proof skeleton 大体正确，则调用 dLLM-Corrector 对局部块进行修复。这里的关键不是单次生成，而是“生成 + 验证 + 局部修补”的闭环。这个闭环和代码生成里的 generate-then-repair 很像，但在 formal proof 中更自然，因为 verifier 给出的成功/失败信号更干净。

从建模范式上看，这篇文章真正想说明的是：diffusion LM 的优势不只是并行生成，而是双向条件建模和 block-level rewriting。formal proving 只是一个高约束测试场景。
summary.experiments:
实验结论集中在与同数据训练的 AR 基线比较。作者报告在 pass@32 下，Diffusion-Proof 相比 AR LLM 在 ProofNet-Test 上提升 1.61%，在 MiniF2F-Test 上提升 6.14%。这两个数字不算夸张，但在 formal proving 这种高噪声、低通过率任务里是有意义的，尤其 MiniF2F 的提升更明显，说明局部修补和长程一致性可能在更难的小规模基准上更有帮助。

另一个有辨识度的结果是：Diffusion-Proof 解出了一道 DeepSeek-Prover-V2-7B 没解出的 IMO 题。单题结果不能当总体结论，但它说明 diffusion 路线至少不是只在平均指标上小幅波动，而是可能在某些需要全局结构保持、局部修补的题目上表现出不同错误分布。

从全文可见的实验设置里，模型规模是两个 7B，训练数据原始池 5.5M，SFT 选取 300k。摘要没有给出更细的消融数字，但值得重点看几类实验：一是只用 dLLM-Prover 与加上 dLLM-Corrector 的差异，判断 correction 模块到底贡献多少；二是 large-block correction 相比小span修补或AR repair 的收益；三是 verifier-guided correction 的触发条件是否严格，是否会引入额外搜索成本。

如果论文正文提供了 proof length、error type、correction success rate 等分析，这些会比单纯 pass@k 更重要，因为它们能说明 diffusion 模型到底改善了哪类失败：是前期偏航少了，还是后期局部错误更容易补救。
summary.reading_guide:
这篇适合带着“非AR语言建模在高约束生成里到底有什么真实优势”这个问题去读。

先看 Introduction，确认作者对 AR 局限的论证是否具体，而不是泛泛而谈。然后直接看 Methodology 里的两部分：数据筛选流程，以及 large block correction 的训练目标和推理流程。这是全文最关键的创新点。接着看主实验表，重点比较同数据、同规模下 dLLM 与 AR 的差异，而不是和更大模型横向比。最后看 case study 或 error analysis，尤其是 verifier 失败后哪些样例能被 corrector 救回来。

如果只想快速判断是否值得跟进，40 分钟足够看完方法和主结果；如果你在做 diffusion LM 或 any-order LM，建议再花时间细看 correction 训练细节、block 设计和推理成本。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies a concrete modeling issue in formal theorem proving: autoregressive proof generation is brittle over long sequences, accumulates errors, and is poor at local repair, while formal proofs require strong long-range coherence and exact verifiability. The goal is to test whether diffusion LMs can serve as a practical alternative, or at least a better repair mechanism, in this setting.
summary_en.importance: The value for pretraining research is not the math domain itself but the testbed. Formal proving is one of the few language-generation settings with strict external verification, so it is a useful place to probe the strengths and limits of non-AR language modeling. The contribution is best viewed as an early recipe paper for diffusion-based structured generation: not a definitive replacement for AR, but a meaningful step in understanding where bidirectional block generation and local rewriting actually help.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The framework, Diffusion-Proof, uses two 7B diffusion models built from Fast-dLLM-V2-7B: dLLM-Prover-7B for full-proof generation and dLLM-Corrector-7B for local proof repair. This split is sensible. In formal proving, many failures are not due to a completely wrong global plan; they often come from local inconsistencies, invalid tactics, typing issues, or broken intermediate steps. A dedicated correction model matches that error structure better than a single monolithic generator.

On the data side, the authors collect 5.5M theorem-proving records from prior work and clean/select 300k examples for SFT. That choice matters. In verifier-sensitive domains, low-quality trajectories and formatting noise can be more harmful than raw scale, so the paper implicitly treats data curation as part of the recipe.

The main technical idea is large-block correction. Instead of token-level or very small-span infilling, the correction model is trained to rewrite larger proof blocks using both left and right context. This is where diffusion modeling has a natural advantage over AR generation: it can condition bidirectionally and rewrite a local region without forcing a full left-to-right continuation from the first error onward. For formal proofs, where an error often spans a whole tactic chunk rather than a single token, large-block repair is a more realistic operation.

Inference follows a generate-then-verify-then-repair loop. The prover first generates a complete proof from the theorem statement. If the proof fails verification but appears structurally close, the corrector is invoked to repair local blocks. The important point is not just using diffusion for generation, but using it as a bidirectional rewriting engine under verifier feedback.

At the paradigm level, the paper is really arguing that the practical advantage of diffusion LMs is not merely parallel generation. It is block-level conditional rewriting with access to both past and future context.
summary_en.experiments:
The headline results are reported against AR baselines trained on the same data. Under pass@32, Diffusion-Proof improves by 1.61% on ProofNet-Test and 6.14% on MiniF2F-Test. These are not huge numbers, but they are meaningful in formal proving, where success rates are low and exact verification makes gains hard to obtain. The larger gain on MiniF2F suggests that local repair and coherence may matter more on harder or more brittle benchmarks.

The paper also reports solving one IMO problem that DeepSeek-Prover-V2-7B could not solve. This should not be overinterpreted as a broad ranking claim, but it does suggest that the diffusion-based error profile may differ in useful ways from AR provers.

From the visible setup, the model scale is two 7B models, with 5.5M raw records and 300k selected SFT examples. The most important ablations to inspect in the full paper are: prover-only versus prover-plus-corrector, large-block correction versus smaller-span repair, and the cost/benefit trade-off of verifier-guided correction. If the paper includes analyses by proof length, error type, or correction success rate, those are more informative than pass@k alone because they reveal what kind of failures diffusion actually fixes.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Read this paper with one question in mind: what real advantage does non-AR language modeling provide in a highly constrained generation task? Start with the introduction and check whether the critique of AR is tied to concrete proof-generation failure modes rather than generic claims. Then go straight to the methodology, especially the data filtering pipeline and the large-block correction objective. That is the key contribution. After that, inspect the main tables, focusing on same-scale and same-data comparisons with AR baselines. Finish with case studies or error analysis, especially examples where the corrector rescues a failed proof.

If you only want a quick signal, 40 minutes is enough for the method and main results. If you work on diffusion LMs, masked/any-order LMs, or structured generation, spend extra time on the correction training details, block design, and inference cost.

recommendation.zh: 方向有意义——形式化证明是 dLLM 长程一致性的硬测试，但摘要没给数，先看实验表再决定是否跟进复现。
recommendation.en: Interesting direction—formal proving is a hard long-coherence test for dLLMs—but the abstract gives no numbers; check the result tables before deciding whether to reproduce.

paper.title: Learning from the Self-future: On-policy Self-distillation for dLLMs
paper.abstract: On-policy self-distillation (OPSD) has proven effective for post-training large language models (LLMs), yet its application to diffusion LLMs (dLLMs) remains unexplored. Existing OPSD methods are inherently autoregressive-centric. They inject privileged information via left-to-right prefix conditioning with token-level divergence supervision, a design that fundamentally conflicts with the arbitraryorder generation of dLLMs. We introduce d-OPSD, the first OPSD framework tailored for dLLMs. Our ap

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文解决 diffusion LLM 的 on-policy self-distillation 如何定义的问题。AR 模型里的 OPSD 通常把 privileged information 放在 prefix 中，并做 token-level divergence；但 dLLM 是迭代去噪、任意顺序生成，这种左到右前缀条件和 token 级监督并不匹配。d-OPSD 的目标是在不引入更强外部 teacher 的情况下，让 dLLM 从自己的生成轨迹中获得更密集的自蒸馏信号。
summary.importance: 它对新型语言建模范式的 post-train 接口有参考意义。dLLM 近期已经能用 RLVR 做 reasoning post-training，但 RLVR 的 outcome reward 稀疏，SFT 又有 off-policy 和 exposure bias 问题。d-OPSD 提供了一种更贴合去噪生成过程的训练信号：用模型自己生成的答案作为 suffix privileged information，再用 step-level divergence 监督整个去噪转移。这把 AR post-training 中的 OPSD 思路迁移到 diffusion LM，但没有照搬 token-level objective。对研究 diffusion LM 的训练目标、推理过程和 reasoning 能力提升有启发。
summary.technical_approach: 核心有两处改动。第一，self-teacher 的构造不再把参考解或 privileged information 拼到 prompt 后面作为 prefix 条件，而是利用 dLLM 可做非自回归条件建模的特点，把模型自己生成的答案作为 suffix condition。这样 teacher 学到的是在已知“未来答案”时，对前面推理轨迹或中间内容的条件分布，可理解为从 self future-experience 中提供训练信号。第二，监督粒度从 token-level divergence 改为 step-level divergence。dLLM 每一步会对多个 masked tokens 同时预测，然后保留一部分、重新 mask 一部分；单个 token 的 next-token KL 并不能自然对应这个 Markov denoising transition。d-OPSD 因此在每个去噪 step 上比较 student transition 与 self-teacher transition，使蒸馏目标和 dLLM 的推理机制对齐。它和 RLVR 的区别是提供密集分布监督，而不是只依赖最终答案奖励；和 SFT 的区别是训练轨迹来自 student 自身，on-policy 程度更高。
summary.experiments: 论文在四个 reasoning 任务上比较 d-OPSD、RLVR 和 SFT。给定内容显示，d-OPSD 在 reasoning performance 和 sample efficiency 上稳定优于这些 baseline。实验还分析了不同设置对效果的影响，用来支持两个设计选择：suffix privileged conditioning 比把 privileged information 作为前缀更适合 dLLM；step-level divergence 比 token-level 监督更符合迭代去噪。给定内容未包含任务名称、模型规模、训练样本量、步数和具体分数，因此需要在实验表中重点核对提升幅度，以及是否在不同 denoising steps、不同采样策略、不同自生成答案质量下保持稳定。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议 25–35 分钟。先看 Introduction 中对 AR-OPSD 与 dLLM 不匹配的两点分析：prefix conditioning 和 token-level divergence。然后看 Preliminaries，确认作者如何定义 dLLM 的 forward corruption、reverse denoising、masked token 保留与 remasking。方法部分重点看 self-teacher 的 suffix conditioning 形式，以及 step-level divergence 的具体计算对象。实验部分建议优先看四类结果：与 RLVR/SFT 的主结果，样本效率曲线，privileged information 放置方式的消融，token-level 与 step-level supervision 的消融。若要进一步判断价值，需要看它是否依赖高质量自生成答案筛选，以及额外推理成本是否会影响训练吞吐。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks how on-policy self-distillation should be formulated for diffusion LLMs. OPSD methods for autoregressive models usually inject privileged information through left-to-right prefix conditioning and apply token-level divergence. That design does not fit dLLMs, which generate by iterative denoising and can condition on arbitrary parts of the sequence. d-OPSD aims to give a dLLM dense self-distillation signals without requiring a stronger external teacher.
summary_en.importance: The work is relevant to the interface between alternative language modeling objectives and post-training. Recent dLLMs can benefit from RLVR, but outcome rewards are sparse, while SFT uses off-policy trajectories and can suffer from exposure bias. d-OPSD proposes a training signal that matches the denoising process more closely: use the model’s own generated answer as suffix privileged information, then distill at the denoising-step level. This is a useful direction for studying how reasoning training should differ between autoregressive LMs and diffusion LMs.
summary_en.technical_approach: The method makes two main changes to AR-style OPSD. First, the self-teacher is built with suffix conditioning rather than prefix conditioning. Instead of appending a reference solution to the prompt in a left-to-right format, d-OPSD uses the model’s own generated answer as a future suffix condition. This exploits the bidirectional or arbitrary-order conditioning ability of dLLMs and keeps the data on-policy. Second, the divergence objective is moved from token level to step level. In a dLLM, each denoising step predicts many masked positions, commits to a subset, and may remask others. A next-token KL objective is therefore not the natural unit of supervision. d-OPSD compares the student and self-teacher denoising transitions at each step, aligning the distillation target with the Markov denoising process. Compared with RLVR, it provides dense distributional feedback. Compared with SFT, it trains on trajectories sampled from the student itself.
summary_en.experiments: The paper reports experiments on four reasoning tasks, comparing d-OPSD with RLVR and SFT baselines. The provided content states that d-OPSD improves both reasoning performance and sample efficiency. The ablations are designed to test the two central choices: suffix-based privileged conditioning versus prefix-style conditioning, and step-level divergence versus token-level supervision. Exact task names, model sizes, training budgets, and score deltas are not available in the supplied text, so the experimental tables should be checked for the actual margins and for robustness across denoising step counts, sampling strategies, and different qualities of self-generated answers.
summary_en.reading_guide: A 25–35 minute skim should cover the main contribution. Start with the Introduction, especially the two failure modes of directly applying AR-OPSD to dLLMs: prefix conditioning and token-level divergence. Then read the preliminaries to verify the paper’s notation for forward corruption, reverse denoising, token commitment, and remasking. In the method section, focus on the suffix-conditioned self-teacher and the exact definition of step-level divergence. In the experiments, prioritize the main comparison with RLVR and SFT, the sample-efficiency curves, and the ablations on privileged-information placement and supervision granularity. For a deeper assessment, check whether the method depends on filtering high-quality self-generated answers and how much extra computation the self-teacher pass adds.

recommendation.zh: 只看方法和 ablation 即可；它提醒 dLLM 后训练不能照搬 AR 的 prefix 教师信号。
recommendation.en: Skim the method and ablations; the useful point is that dLLM post-training cannot simply inherit AR prefix-based teacher signals.

paper.title: LESS Is More: Mutual-Stability Sampling for Diffusion Language Models
paper.abstract: Diffusion large language models (dLLMs) offer a promising alternative to autoregressive decoding by iteratively refining masked sequences, enabling parallel token updates and bidirectional conditioning. Their practical efficiency, however, is limited by sampling procedures that execute a fixed number of reverse denoising steps selected before decoding, spending computation on already-stable positions and sometimes committing unstable ones too early. We present \textsc{LESS}, a training-free, mod

summary.core_problem: 扩散语言模型的采样通常用固定反向步数，既浪费计算在已稳定位置上，也会过早提交尚不稳定的 token，导致效率和质量都受限。
summary.importance: 这是 diffusion LM 方向里少见的、直接碰到实际可用性的工作。贡献不在训练目标，而在推断时提出一个训练无关的自适应提交规则，试图把 dLLM 从“能跑”往“值得部署”推进一步。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 LESS（Mutual-Stability Sampling），把 token commitment 视为在线停止问题。一个位置只有同时满足三类稳定性条件才会被解 mask：高 top-1 置信度、最近若干反向步 top-1 预测保持一致、以及预测分布在 top-K 上的跨步 Jensen-Shannon divergence 足够稳定。方法训练无关、模型无关，可直接套在已有 dLLM 采样流程上。
summary.experiments: 在 Dream-7B、LLaDA-8B、LLaDA-1.5-8B 上评估，覆盖不同扩散 LM。摘要表明 LESS 能在减少不必要反向步的同时保持或改善生成质量，核心比较对象应是固定步数采样和已有启发式提交策略。虽然摘要未给出具体增益数字，但从问题设定看，重点是 step-quality tradeoff 是否更优，以及不同模型上是否稳定复现。

summary_en.core_problem: Diffusion language models typically use a fixed number of reverse denoising steps, which wastes compute on already stable positions and may commit unstable tokens too early, limiting both efficiency and quality.
summary_en.importance: This is one of the more practically relevant papers in diffusion LM research. The contribution is not a new training objective but a training-free adaptive commitment rule at inference time, pushing dLLMs a bit closer to usable decoding.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper proposes LESS, a mutual-stability sampler that treats token commitment as an online stopping problem. A masked position becomes eligible for unmasking only when three stability conditions are jointly satisfied: high top-1 confidence, persistence of the top-1 token across recent reverse steps, and stability of the predictive distribution measured by top-K inter-step Jensen-Shannon divergence. The method is training-free and model-agnostic.
summary_en.experiments: The method is evaluated on Dream-7B, LLaDA-8B, and LLaDA-1.5-8B, covering multiple diffusion LMs. The abstract indicates that LESS reduces unnecessary reverse steps while maintaining or improving generation quality, with the key comparison likely against fixed-step sampling and prior heuristic commitment rules. The main question is whether the step-quality tradeoff improves consistently across models.

recommendation.zh: 如果你在跟踪 diffusion LM，这篇该读：它不改训练却直击采样瓶颈，先看稳定性判据和 step-quality 曲线；若增益稳，内部实现应立刻复现。
recommendation.en: If you track diffusion LMs, read this one: it attacks the real bottleneck without retraining; start with the stability criteria and the step-quality tradeoff curves.

paper.title: Mean-Field Parallel Decoding for Discrete Diffusion Language Models
paper.abstract: Discrete diffusion language models enable parallel token generation, offering a pathway to low-latency decoding. However, selecting tokens independently by marginal confidence limits effective parallelism: tokens that appear reliable in isolation can form incompatible configurations when several positions are updated at once. We introduce a training-free decoding framework that coordinates these parallel updates. At each forward pass, the method assigns a commit score to each masked position and

summary.core_problem: 离散 diffusion LM 虽然能并行生成 token，但独立按边际置信度提交多个位置时容易产生彼此冲突的配置，限制了有效并行度。
summary.importance: 这是对非 AR 文本生成范式的解码层改进，贡献不在训练而在生成机制：它指出 diffusion LM 的并行瓶颈并给出无需重训的协调式并行提交方法。对关注 D3PM/MDLM/LLaDA 一类建模的人有直接参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 方法是 training-free 的 mean-field parallel decoding。每次前向先给每个 mask 位置一个 commit score，再利用模型预测分布导出的成对相互作用对这些分数做变分松弛下的 fixed-point 更新，从而抑制同一步内互相不兼容的 token 提交。核心思想是把“独立高置信”改成“联合一致性更高”的并行决策。
summary.experiments: 摘要表明该方法可直接插入现有 diffusion decoding pipeline，无需辅助模型或再训练，在保持有竞争力生成质量的同时提高每步可并行提交的 token 数。摘要未给出具体模型规模、数据集和提升幅度，因此结论强度仍需看正文中的解码步数、质量退化和 wall-clock 对比。
summary.authors_note: 作者包括 Lior Wolf。该团队长期做生成模型与离散建模，论文风格偏方法导向。

summary_en.core_problem: Discrete diffusion LMs can generate tokens in parallel, but committing positions independently by marginal confidence often creates incompatible joint configurations and limits effective parallelism.
summary_en.importance: This is a decoding-side contribution for non-autoregressive text generation rather than a training recipe. It matters because it targets a real bottleneck in diffusion LMs and offers a drop-in way to improve coordinated parallel updates.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper proposes a training-free mean-field parallel decoding method. It assigns commit scores to masked positions, then refines them using pairwise interactions derived from the model's predictive distributions.
