A variational relaxation yields a fixed-point update that suppresses conflicting simultaneous commitments within a single forward pass.
summary_en.experiments: According to the abstract, the method plugs into existing diffusion decoding pipelines without retraining or auxiliary models, allowing more tokens to be committed in parallel while maintaining competitive generation quality. The abstract does not provide model sizes, datasets, or exact gains, so the real value depends on the full decoding-quality and wall-clock tradeoff in the paper.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors include Lior Wolf, a well-known researcher in generative modeling and discrete modeling.

recommendation.zh: 这篇值得看，但只对做 diffusion LM 的人有用：重点看它怎样把独立置信改成联合一致性，若 wall-clock 没显著赢 AR，就只是解码小修补。
recommendation.en: Worth reading if you care about diffusion LMs: the key idea is replacing marginal confidence with joint-consistency-aware commits; if wall-clock does not beat AR meaningfully, treat it as a local decoding fix.

paper.title: Follow the Latent Roadmap: Navigating Revocable Decoding for Diffusion LLMs with Anchor Tokens
paper.abstract: Diffusion Large Language Models (dLLMs) offer a promising avenue for parallel generation but face a trade-off between decoding speed and quality. While revocable decoding strategies attempt to mitigate errors by verifying and remasking tokens, they typically operate within a mixed-quality context. This leads to two critical failures: \textit{Error Propagation}, where new tokens absorb toxic information from erroneous context, and \textit{Local Error Reinforcement}, where errors mutually reinforc

summary.core_problem: 扩散大语言模型（dLLM）的可撤销并行解码通过“生成-验证-重掩码”机制平衡解码速度与质量，但所有操作均在“可靠已确认token+待验证候选token”的混合质量上下文中执行，导致两个关键失效模式：1）错误传播：待生成的掩码token无差别地将所有待验证token视为可靠上下文，吸收其中的错误信息；2）局部错误强化：多个错误待验证token互相支撑形成局部一致的错误簇，逃避验证机制检测。现有可撤销解码方法未对上下文token的可信度做区分，无法针对性解决上述问题。
summary.importance: 提供了训练无关的即插即用dLLM解码增强方案，无需重新训练模型即可提升生成质量，尤其适配数学、代码这类对错误敏感的任务。提出的锚令牌混合上下文处理框架完全在嵌入空间实现，兼容FlashAttention，可迁移至其他非自回归生成范式的解码优化。
summary.technical_approach: 提出ASRD（锚监督可撤销解码）框架，所有操作均在嵌入空间执行，兼容FlashAttention，完全训练无关，可即插即用适配现有dLLM。核心组件为动态锚令牌缓存（ATC）：将跨多个解码步骤保持时间一致性（即预测结果稳定不变）的token标记为可信锚令牌，存入缓存形成可信上下文骨架。基于ATC设计两个互补策略：1）锚引导生成：向掩码位置的嵌入注入熵加权的锚信号，降低待验证错误token对新生成token的干扰，缓解错误传播；2）锚扰动验证：使用与锚信号正交的扰动探测待验证token，仅判定那些依赖局部错误簇、不被锚信号支持的token为验证失败，将其重掩码以重新生成，解决局部错误强化。与现有方法的核心区别：现有可撤销解码对所有上下文token一视同仁，ASRD先分离可信锚上下文，再基于锚信号分别引导生成与验证过程。
summary.experiments: 当前公开的论文片段仅明确ASRD为训练无关的即插即用增强模块，适配现有dLLM架构，目标在数学、代码等对错误敏感的生成任务上提升解码质量。完整量化结果（性能提升幅度、速度-质量权衡数据）未包含在提供的全文片段中，需参考原论文完整版本获取详细实验验证。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读优先看Introduction部分对两种失效模式（错误传播、局部错误强化）的定义与示意，再重点阅读方法部分的锚令牌识别逻辑、两个嵌入空间策略的实现细节，尤其关注嵌入空间操作如何兼容FlashAttention、不引入额外计算开销。预计阅读时间25-30分钟，优先查看方法框架示意图。

summary_en.core_problem: Revocable parallel decoding for diffusion LLMs (dLLMs) balances speed and quality via a generate-verify-remask pipeline, but all operations run on mixed-quality contexts interleaving reliable confirmed tokens and tentative candidate tokens. This causes two critical failure modes: (1) Error Propagation, where unmasked [MASK] tokens treat all tentative tokens as reliable context and absorb embedded errors; (2) Local Error Reinforcement, where mutually consistent erroneous tentative tokens form local clusters that evade verification checks. Existing revocable decoding methods treat all context tokens equally, with no mechanism to isolate trusted context to address these failures.
summary_en.importance: Delivers a training-free, plug-and-play decoding enhancement for dLLMs that improves generation quality without retraining, especially suited for error-sensitive tasks like math and coding. The anchor-token framework for handling mixed-quality contexts operates entirely in embedding space, is compatible with FlashAttention, and can be generalized to decoding optimization for other non-autoregressive generation paradigms.
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes ASRD (Anchor Supervised Revocable Decoding), a fully embedding-space framework compatible with FlashAttention, requiring no model retraining and working as a drop-in module for existing dLLMs. The core component is the dynamic Anchor Tokens Cache (ATC): tokens that maintain temporal consistency (stable predictions across multiple decoding steps) are promoted to trusted anchors and stored in the cache to form a reliable context skeleton. Two complementary embedding-level strategies are built on the ATC: (1) Anchor-Guided Generation injects entropy-weighted anchor signals into [MASK] token embeddings to reduce interference from erroneous tentative tokens, mitigating Error Propagation; (2) Anchor-Perturbed Verification probes tentative tokens with an orthogonal anchor-derived perturbation, only revoking tokens that rely on local error clusters rather than anchor-supported global consistency, addressing Local Error Reinforcement. The core difference from prior work is that ASRD first isolates trusted anchor context, instead of applying uniform generation and verification logic across all tokens.
summary_en.experiments: The available paper fragment positions ASRD as a training-free, plug-and-play enhancement for existing dLLMs, targeted at improving performance on error-sensitive generation tasks like math and coding. Full quantitative results (performance gain magnitudes, speed-quality tradeoff metrics) are not included in the provided content; refer to the complete paper for detailed experimental validation.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim the Introduction first to understand the two defined failure modes of revocable dLLM decoding and their illustrative examples. Focus on the method section's anchor token identification logic and implementation details of the two embedding-space strategies, with special attention to how embedding-space operations preserve FlashAttention compatibility without introducing extra compute overhead. Expected reading time: 25-30 minutes; prioritize the method framework diagram.

recommendation.zh: 读 anchor 判定和消融就够；若时间一致性真能隔离可信上下文，dLLM 解码评测应加入这条 baseline。
recommendation.en: Read the anchor selection rule and ablations; if temporal consistency reliably isolates trusted context, this should become a baseline in dLLM decoding evaluations.

institutions: The Chinese University of Hong Kong

paper.title: Neither Parallel Nor Sequential: How DiffusionGemma Actually Commits Tokens
paper.abstract: Open diffusion language models are marketed as parallel, non-autoregressive decoders, yet the order in which a shipped checkpoint actually commits its tokens is almost never measured. We instrument DiffusionGemma 26B, a masked discrete-diffusion mixture-of-experts model built on Gemma 4, hooking its sampler's accept step to record which canvas positions commit, when, and at what confidence. Across a 686-prompt, six-regime probe suite we find that its decoding is neither parallel nor block-autore

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文要回答一个很具体但常被默认跳过的问题：开放的 diffusion language model 在真实推理时，到底按什么顺序“提交”token。论文研究的不是训练算法，而是一个已发布 checkpoint 的解码行为：google/diffusiongemma-26B-A4B-it，一个基于 Gemma 4 的 masked discrete diffusion MoE 模型，25.2B 总参数、3.8B 激活参数、8-of-128 expert routing。作者指出，DLM 常被描述成并行、非自回归解码器，但“架构允许并行”和“模型实际并行提交”不是一回事。真实提交顺序由模型、sampler、停止准则共同决定，需要直接测量。
summary.importance: 对预训练和新型语言建模研究的价值在于，它把 diffusion LM 的一个核心承诺拆成了可观测量。DLM 的低延迟潜力通常来自多位置并行提交；如果实际 checkpoint 在许多任务上呈现较强的左到右偏置，吞吐和延迟分析就不能只看理论 denoising 步数。论文的结论也约束了后续建模判断：DiffusionGemma 既不是严格 AR，也不是完全 order-independent，而是有粒度依赖的部分左到右提交偏置。这个结果对 DLM 训练目标、sampler 设计、评测协议都有启发。尤其是它提醒研究者，不要用粗 bin 或肉眼样例把模型误读成 block-autoregressive；同一个生成过程在 token 级、bin 级、accept-call 级会呈现不同结构。
summary.technical_approach: 方法是纯 inference instrumentation，不训练、不微调。作者 hook 了 transformers denoising loop 中的 EntropyBoundSampler.accept_canvas，在每次 accept-call 记录哪些 canvas 位置被提交，以及这些位置的 per-position entropy。这里的“提交”指 sampler 接受某些位置的当前预测并写入生成 canvas。基于这些 trace，论文计算提交顺序与左到右位置顺序之间的 tie-aware Kendall tau_b。tie-aware 很关键，因为一次 accept-call 往往会同时提交十几个到二十几个 token，同一 call 内没有可解析的先后顺序。作者还做了不同 bin size 下的顺序相关性分析，用来区分 token 级无序、粗粒度左到右、以及真正的 block-sequential。为避免伪结论，论文显式处理了 EOS padding artifact、跨 regime pooling 导致的 Simpson's paradox、commit non-monotonicity、block-size sensitivity 和 same-call ties。与常见只看输出文本的分析不同，这篇论文测的是 sampler 内部实际接受 token 的时刻，因此更接近推理系统真正执行的生成路径。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖 686 个 prompt、6 类 regime。强化实验设置为 5 个 seed，每个 regime 20 个 prompt，共 100 条 trace/regime，并用 prompt-clustered bootstrap 给出置信区间。主要结果是：除 JSON 外，多数 regime 在 token 级呈中等左到右偏置，prose、code、math、factual 等 regime 的 tie-aware Kendall tau_b 约为 0.43 到 0.60。随着分析 bin 变粗，左到右相关性平滑上升，例如 R1 从 bin=4 的 0.59 升到 bin=64 的 0.91，但在 16-token 附近没有跳变。这说明 16 更像分析者选择的 bin，不是模型内部固定 block。真实 token order 明显低于纯 block-sequential control，后者约 0.94 到 0.96，说明子 block 内有实际无序。每次 accept-call 平均提交约 13 到 26 个 content token，同 call tie 比例较大，因此 token 级顺序只能在 accept-call 分辨率上测量。JSON regime 很不同，token tau_b=-0.044，95% CI 为 [-0.086, -0.00]，更接近 order-independent，而不是强非顺序。置信度与正确性的关系也依赖任务：在 GSM8K 上，commit confidence 即负熵对正确性有区分度，AUROC=0.749，95% CI [0.602, 0.879]，按 entropy tertile 看 reliability 单调；在 factual recall 上 AUROC=0.471，95% CI [0.383, 0.544]，基本没有可用信号。生成通常在很少的 accept-call 内完成，远低于 48-step budget，且接受时 entropy 远低于 0.1 bound。可评分 regime 上，DiffusionGemma 的任务准确率与 AR sibling Gemma-4 26B-A4B 接近，但作者明确说明实验没有为 equivalence test 做功效设计。
summary.reading_guide: 建议精读 §5.1 和 §6.1。§5.1 是核心，重点看 token-level tau_b、bin-size 曲线、block-sequential control、commit batch size 和 JSON regime 的对照。这里能看清为什么“部分左到右偏置”比“block-autoregressive”更准确。§5.2 建议看 confidence-correctness 分析，尤其是 GSM8K 与 factual recall 的差异；它说明 entropy 不是通用 correctness proxy，跨任务合并会掩盖机制。§6.1 值得细看，里面列出的 EOS padding、same-call ties、block-size sensitivity、Simpson's paradox 都是后续 DLM commit-order 研究容易踩的坑。若时间有限，先读 Introduction 的 falsifiable claims，再读 §5.1 的图表和 §6.1 的 methodology caveats。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks a narrow but important empirical question: when an open diffusion language model is actually run, in what order does it commit tokens? The target is google/diffusiongemma-26B-A4B-it, a masked discrete-diffusion MoE model built on Gemma 4, with 25.2B total parameters and 3.8B active parameters through 8-of-128 expert routing. The study separates architectural possibility from runtime behavior. A DLM can denoise many positions in parallel, but the checkpoint and sampler may still produce a partially ordered commitment process.
summary_en.importance: The result is useful for researchers working on non-AR language modeling because it turns a common claim about diffusion LMs into a measurable property. Parallel denoising is often used to motivate lower latency, but latency depends on how many positions are accepted per step and whether commitment is truly out of order. The main finding is not that DiffusionGemma behaves like an AR model, nor that it is fully order-independent. It shows a partial, granularity-dependent left-to-right bias. This matters for sampler design, training objective analysis, and evaluation protocols for DLMs. It also cautions against reading coarse-bin traces as evidence of clean block-autoregressive generation.
summary_en.technical_approach: The work is inference-only. The authors do not train or fine-tune the model. They instrument the denoising loop by hooking EntropyBoundSampler.accept_canvas and record, for each accept-call, the canvas positions that become committed and the entropy at those positions. Commitment order is then measured with tie-aware Kendall tau_b between position order and accept order. The tie-aware treatment is necessary because a single accept-call often commits many positions, and positions committed in the same call have no observable internal order. The paper also studies bin-size dependence, compares the observed order against a pure block-sequential control, and analyzes whether negative entropy at commit time predicts correctness. A notable part of the methodology is its handling of artifacts: EOS padding, cross-regime pooling, commit non-monotonicity, block-size sensitivity, and same-call ties.
summary_en.experiments: The probe suite contains 686 prompts across six regimes. The strengthened run uses 5 seeds and 20 prompts per regime, giving 100 traces per regime, with prompt-clustered bootstrap confidence intervals. For prose, code, math, and factual regimes, token-level tie-aware Kendall tau_b is moderate, roughly 0.43 to 0.60. The ordering becomes more left-to-right as the analysis bin gets coarser; for example, in R1, tau_b rises from 0.59 at bin size 4 to 0.91 at bin size 64. There is no discontinuity at 16 tokens, so 16 is not supported as a privileged architectural block. The observed order remains below a pure block-sequential control, which is around 0.94 to 0.96, indicating real sub-block disorder. Accept batches are large, around 13 to 26 content tokens per call, so many token pairs are tied. The JSON regime is different: token tau_b is -0.044 with a 95% CI of [-0.086, -0.00], which is closer to order-independent behavior. Commit confidence is predictive on GSM8K, with AUROC 0.749 and a 95% CI of [0.602, 0.879], but not on factual recall, where AUROC is 0.471 with a 95% CI of [0.383, 0.544]. Generations typically finish in a small number of accept-calls, far below the 48-step budget, and at entropy well below the 0.1 bound. On scorable regimes, accuracy is comparable to the matched AR sibling Gemma-4 26B-A4B, although the comparison is not powered as an equivalence test.
summary_en.reading_guide: Read Section 5.1 closely. The key evidence is in the token-level tau_b values, the bin-size curves, the block-sequential control, and the commit-batch statistics. These pieces explain why the right description is partial left-to-right bias rather than clean block autoregression. Section 5.2 is useful for understanding when entropy can be used as a correctness signal; the contrast between GSM8K and factual recall is the main point. Section 6.1 is worth reading for methodology. Its discussion of EOS padding, same-call ties, Simpson's paradox under regime pooling, and block-size sensitivity is directly relevant to future studies of diffusion LM decoding behavior.

recommendation.zh: 直接推翻扩散 LM 并行/块 AR 的二元 prior，所有做非 AR 文本建模范式的人都应立刻复现其 instrumentation 方法。
recommendation.en: Directly falsifies the parallel vs block-AR prior for diffusion LMs; anyone working on non-autoregressive text modeling should immediately reproduce its sampler instrumentation.

paper.title: Diffusion Policy Optimization without Drifting Apart
paper.abstract: RL post-training has become increasingly pivotal for improving diffusion policies, but existing diffusion policy-gradient methods are often unstable and cannot achieve reliable policy improvement. We identify the cause as the double-drift phenomenon: optimizing a variational surrogate can let the ELBO separate from the true log-likelihood, which then makes the resulting proxy policy gradient misaligned with the true policy gradient of expected return. We propose \textbf{DiPOD}, a diffusion polic

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作解决 diffusion policy 做 RL post-training 时的梯度可靠性问题。diffusion 模型的真实 log-likelihood 通常不可 tractable，现有方法用 ELBO、EUBO、mean-field、一阶估计等 proxy 代替；但 RL 更新会让这些 variational proxy 与真实 likelihood 的差距变大，进一步导致 proxy policy gradient 偏离真实 policy gradient。论文把这个耦合失效称为 double drift。
summary.importance: 它对 diffusion LLM 的 post-train 有直接启发。AR 模型做 RL 时可以直接用 token logprob；dLLM 若用 variational surrogate 做策略梯度，不能只看 reward 是否上升，还要维护生成模型自身的概率结构。论文提出的关键信号是：pretraining 形成的 tight-bound 区域在 RL 中会被破坏，需要把“保持 likelihood proxy 可信”作为训练约束。这个问题也连接 pretrain-posttrain 接口：预训练目标越接近后续 RL 所用的 surrogate，post-training 越稳定；但 RL 过程中仍需要持续校准 surrogate。
summary.technical_approach: DiPOD 的原则是把 policy improvement 和 tight-bound maintenance 交替进行。理论部分先定义一类 adequate proxy gradient：如果 evidence bound 与真实 likelihood 足够贴合，那么基于 proxy 的策略梯度方向与真实策略梯度一致。问题在于普通 RL 更新不会保持这种贴合。DiPOD 用 policy-preserving self-distillation 把模型拉回 tight-bound regime，再执行 policy-improving gradient update。实际算法做了一个简单近似：每次 diffusion policy-gradient update 都在同一批 on-policy rollout 上加入 ELBO maximization regularizer。这个 ELBO 项不是普通的预训练损失复用，而是为了在当前策略分布附近降低 variational discrepancy，使 proxy gradient 不至于随着训练偏离真实目标。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖离散 diffusion language model post-training 和连续控制 flow policy。离散任务包括 GSM8K、MATH500、Sudoku、Countdown；连续控制包括 humanoid motion tracking。给出的结论是，加入 on-policy ELBO regularizer 后，训练稳定性和 reward optimization 都有明显改善。当前材料没有提供具体准确率、reward 数值或 ablation 表格，因此不应过度解读幅度。需要重点查看完整实验中的三类证据：ELBO-log-likelihood gap 或 proxy tightness 的变化、reward 曲线稳定性、ELBO regularizer 权重和 on-policy/off-policy 数据选择的消融。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读到半精读，预计 35 分钟。先看 double drift 的定义和推导，确认 ELBO drift 如何传导到 policy-gradient drift；再看 DiPOD 的 interleaving 形式和 practical algorithm，重点是为什么 self-distillation 被称为 policy-preserving，以及为什么实现上可以退化为 on-policy ELBO regularization；最后看 dLLM reasoning 任务和 continuous-control 任务的实验曲线。对做 dLLM RL 的读者，最值得深挖的是 surrogate tightness 的监控指标和 regularizer 系数如何随训练阶段调整。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies why reinforcement-learning post-training is unstable for diffusion policies. Diffusion models usually do not provide a tractable exact log-likelihood, so existing RL methods optimize policy-gradient proxies based on ELBO, EUBO, mean-field estimates, one-step estimates, or imposed dependency structures. The paper identifies a coupled failure mode: RL updates loosen the variational bound, and once the bound drifts away from the true log-likelihood, the proxy policy gradient also drifts away from the true policy-gradient direction.
summary_en.importance: This is directly relevant to diffusion LLM post-training. Autoregressive LMs expose token log probabilities, but diffusion LMs often rely on variational surrogates. Reward improvement alone is not enough if the surrogate no longer represents the executed diffusion policy. The useful lesson is that post-training must preserve the probabilistic structure inherited from pretraining. It also clarifies a pretrain-to-posttrain interface issue: objectives that are tight near initialization can become unreliable under RL unless tightness is actively maintained.
summary_en.technical_approach: DiPOD enforces two requirements: improve the downstream return and keep the likelihood proxy tight. The analysis defines adequate proxy gradients, where the proxy gradient matches the true likelihood gradient when the evidence bound is tight. Since standard RL updates do not preserve this condition, DiPOD alternates policy-preserving self-distillation with policy-improving gradient updates. The practical version is simple: add an on-policy ELBO maximization term to each diffusion policy-gradient update on the same rollout batch. This regularizer reduces variational discrepancy around the current policy distribution, improving alignment between the proxy gradient and the intended policy gradient.
summary_en.experiments: The experiments cover discrete diffusion-LM post-training tasks, including GSM8K, MATH500, Sudoku, and Countdown, as well as continuous-control flow policies such as humanoid motion tracking. The reported outcome is improved training stability and better reward optimization after adding the on-policy ELBO regularizer. The provided material does not include exact accuracy or reward numbers. The key evidence to inspect in the full results is the evolution of proxy tightness, reward curves, and ablations on the ELBO regularization strength and rollout distribution.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim with selective deep reading in about 35 minutes. Read the double-drift analysis first, especially the link between ELBO-log-likelihood discrepancy and policy-gradient misalignment. Then read the DiPOD algorithm and check how the ideal interleaving is approximated by an on-policy ELBO regularizer. The most useful experimental sections are the dLLM reasoning tasks, the continuous-control transfer of the same principle, and the ablations on regularization. For diffusion-LM RL, the main implementation question is how to monitor surrogate tightness during training.

recommendation.zh: 非 AR LM 接 RL 的关键坑在目标漂移；先看 double-drift 诊断和 ELBO 正则消融。
recommendation.en: For RL on non-AR LMs, the useful part is the objective-drift diagnosis; read the double-drift analysis and ELBO-regularizer ablations first.

paper.title: TimeROME-DLM: Temporal Causal Tracing and Low-Rank Inference-Time Knowledge Editing for Masked Diffusion Language Models
paper.abstract: Masked diffusion language models (MDLMs) such as LLaDA now rival autoregressive (AR) LLMs, but every existing knowledge-editing and unlearning method (ROME, MEMIT, etc.) targets AR transformers and either makes assumptions that fail under iterative denoising, or requires gradient updates whose backward-pass activations cost tens of GB of extra VRAM and which collapse MDLMs at standard learning rates. We introduce TimeROME-DLM, the first training-free, gradient-free, inference-time knowledge-edit

summary.core_problem: 现有知识编辑方法均针对自回归Transformer设计，无法适配掩码扩散语言模型（MDLM），存在假设不成立、显存开销大、易导致模型崩溃的问题
summary.importance: 首个针对MDLM的无训练、无梯度推理时知识编辑框架，属于新LM范式下的方法创新，填补了扩散语言模型知识编辑领域的空白
summary.technical_approach: 由两个核心组件构成：1）时间间接效应（TIE）因果追踪协议，定位每个事实在去噪后期驱动目标预测的关键坐标；2）闭式低秩残差编辑记忆，聚合主体键与目标增量，每次扩散前向在关键坐标执行岭正则化更新，加稀疏化限制效用溢出
summary.experiments: 摘要未披露具体实验所用MDLM参数量、知识编辑数据集及量化效果指标，仅指出现有AR适配方法存在数十GB额外VRAM开销、标准学习率下模型崩溃的问题

summary_en.core_problem: Existing knowledge editing methods are all designed for autoregressive Transformers and cannot adapt to Masked Diffusion Language Models (MDLMs), with invalid assumptions, high VRAM overhead, and high risk of model collapse.
summary_en.importance: First training-free, gradient-free inference-time knowledge editing framework for MDLMs; methodological innovation under the new LM paradigm, filling the gap in diffusion language model knowledge editing.
summary_en.technical_approach: Two core components: 1) Temporal Indirect Effect (TIE) causal tracing protocol to locate the key coordinate driving target prediction at late denoising steps for each fact; 2) Closed-form low-rank residual edit memory that aggregates subject keys and target deltas, applies ridge-regularized update at the key coordinate per diffusion forward pass, with sparsification to limit utility spillover.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not disclose specific MDLM parameter sizes, knowledge editing datasets, or quantitative performance metrics, only noting that existing AR-adapted methods incur tens of GB extra VRAM and cause model collapse at standard learning rates.

recommendation.zh: 首个针对扩散语言模型的无梯度知识编辑方案，时间维度因果追踪的设计可复用至MDLM机制分析，重点看§3的追踪协议推导
recommendation.en: First gradient-free knowledge editing framework for diffusion LMs; the temporal causal tracing design is reusable for MDLM mechanism analysis, focus on §3 tracing protocol derivation.

paper.title: Pythagoras-Prover: Advancing Efficient Formal Proving via Augmented Lean Formalisation
paper.abstract: Modern Lean theorem provers achieve strong performance only with substantial training and inference compute, driven in part by scarce verified proof data and the long reasoning traces of formal proof search, making both supervised fine-tuning (SFT) and sampling expensive. We introduce Pythagoras-Prover, a compute-efficient open-source family of Lean theorem provers built for practical compute budgets. The family spans two generation paradigms: autoregressive models at 4B and 32B parameters, and

summary.core_problem: 现有 Lean 定理证明器需要极高训练和推理计算量，受限于稀缺的验证证明数据和长推理 trace，SFT 和采样都很昂贵。
summary.importance: 在实用计算预算下训练高性能 Lean 定理证明器的重要探索，首次提出 diffusion-based 形式证明器 (4B) 概念验证，并引入 augmented Lean formalisation 和课程 SFT 策略。
summary.technical_approach: Pythagoras-Prover 家族包括：(1) 4B 和 32B AR 模型；(2) 4B diffusion-based 证明器（推理时迭代精化 Lean 证明）。训练效率通过：Lean-verified 语料分层为易/中/难进行课程 SFT；动态 proof-reasoning 过滤保持 informative trace 且在 8k token 预算内。
summary.experiments: 在 Lean 形式证明 benchmark 上对比现有强证明器，报告在 4B 和 32B 规模上的性能，强调 compute-efficient 训练策略的效果。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自多所高校。Shay B. Cohen (爱丁堡大学) 是 NLP 和形式推理领域知名研究者。

summary_en.core_problem: Modern Lean theorem provers require extreme training and inference compute, limited by scarce verified proof data and long reasoning traces, making both SFT and sampling expensive.
summary_en.importance: Important exploration of training high-performance Lean provers under practical compute budgets; first proof-of-concept diffusion-based formal prover (4B), plus augmented Lean formalisation and curriculum SFT strategies.
summary_en.technical_approach: Pythagoras-Prover family includes: (1) 4B and 32B autoregressive models; (2) a 4B diffusion-based prover (iteratively refines Lean proofs at inference). Training efficiency via: Lean-verified corpus stratified into easy/medium/hard for curriculum SFT; dynamic proof-reasoning filtering preserves informative traces within an 8k-token budget.
summary_en.experiments: Compared against strong existing provers on Lean formal proof benchmarks; performance reported at 4B and 32B scales, emphasizing compute-efficient training gains.
summary_en.authors_note: Authors from multiple universities. Shay B. Cohen (University of Edinburgh) is a well-known researcher in NLP and formal reasoning.

recommendation.zh: Diffusion-based 形式证明器是新颖方向，对理解非 AR 建模范式在复杂推理任务上的表现有参考。课程 SFT 和动态过滤策略也值得做 reasoning 数据的研究员关注，看 §3.2-3.3。
recommendation.en: Diffusion-based formal prover is a novel direction worth noting for understanding non-AR paradigms on complex reasoning. Curriculum SFT and dynamic filtering in §3.2-3.3 are also relevant for reasoning-data researchers.

paper.title: Beyond Fully Random Masking: Attention-Guided Denoising and Optimization for Diffusion Language Models
paper.abstract: Diffusion large language models (dLLMs) offer an efficient alternative to autoregressive models through parallel decoding, yet existing post-training methods largely rely on random masking strategies that overlook intrinsic token dependencies. In this work, we present an empirical analysis of attention in dLLMs and show that tokens attending more strongly to unmasked context exhibit greater generation stability and play a critical role in reasoning. Motivated by these findings, we propose AGDO,

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作处理的是 diffusion language model 在 post-training 阶段的一个结构性错配：训练时通常用 fully random masking 去决定哪些 token 被预测，但推理时模型是在多步 denoising 过程中逐步恢复 token，且每一步的可用上下文并不是随机形成的，而是由双向注意力下的真实依赖关系决定。作者想回答两个问题：一是 dLLM 在 denoising 过程中到底依赖哪些 token；二是能否把这种依赖显式写进 SFT 和 RL 的优化过程，而不是继续沿用对 AR 模型更自然、对 dLLM 其实并不贴合的随机掩码训练方式。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的启发不在于它提出了一个新的 base pretrain objective，而在于它把“full-attention masked/diffusion LM 的训练目标应当和真实生成轨迹对齐”这件事讲得更具体了。现有很多 dLLM post-training 方法只是把 AR 时代的 token-level 优化思路搬过来，再配一个随机 mask 或人为规定的解码顺序。这里的贡献是给出了一套来自模型内部 attention 结构的顺序信号，并把它同时用于 denoising order 和 loss/reward reweighting。对做 any-order LM、masked LM、diffusion LM 的人，这篇文章的价值在于：它提示 post-train recipe 不能只看目标函数形式，还要看生成轨迹是否与模型内部依赖结构一致。
summary.technical_approach:
方法分两层。第一层是 attention analysis。作者在 Dream-v0-Instruct-7B 上沿 denoising trajectory 跟踪最后一层 attention，发现两个现象：其一，attention 在 masked generation 中是稀疏且跨 step 相对稳定的，单个 token 往往持续依赖少量上下文 token；其二，如果某个待生成 token 对“已经被去噪出来的 token”有更高 attention mass，那么它在后续 step 的预测概率更稳定，说明它更适合在当前阶段被恢复。这个观察直接否定了 fully random masking 的一个隐含假设：所有 masked token 在当前 step 的可预测性近似同质。

第二层是 AGDO 框架。核心做法是先从 valid attention score 中构造 attention-guided denoising order，再把这个顺序用于 post-training。这里的 valid attention 可以理解为：只统计指向当前可见、已解码或未被 mask 的上下文 token 的注意力，从而估计某个 masked token 当前是否已经拥有足够支撑它被恢复的上下文。AGDO 不是按固定位置顺序解码，也不是简单 blockwise，而是按 attention 支撑度决定谁先被 unmask。

在 SFT 阶段，AGDO-SFT 用 attention-guided order 构造训练样本和预测目标，减少训练-推理错配。除此之外，作者还引入 attention-based reweighting，对 attention-critical token，也就是在依赖图中更像 hub、对其他 token 预测更关键的 token，赋予更高损失权重。这样做的理由很直接：这些 token 一旦预测错，会沿后续 denoising step 传播错误。

在 RL 阶段，AGDO-RL 建立在已有 dLLM 的 GRPO/mean-field 近似路线之上，但同样把 attention-guided order 和 token reweighting 纳入优化。也就是说，它不是只在 sample-level 上根据最终 reward 调整，而是让 credit assignment 更偏向那些对后续推理链条更关键的 token。和 diff-GRPO、wd1 这类方法相比，区别不在 RL 框架本身，而在于它把 policy optimization 的作用位置从“随机选中的 masked token”改成了“按 attention 依赖组织起来的 token 子集”。
summary.experiments:
从给出的全文内容看，实验主轴放在数学和代码推理任务上，核心结论是 AGDO 在这两类需要多步依赖传播的任务上稳定优于随机 masking 的 post-training 方法，以及优于外部规定顺序的若干变体。正文明确提到主要分析模型是 Dream-v0-Instruct-7B，并在附录上验证到 LLaDA，说明结论不是单模型特例。

更值得注意的是实验设计背后的因果链，而不只是最终分数。作者先用 MATH-500 做 attention tracing，展示 attention map 在 denoising step 间的时间一致性，以及“更多依赖已解码 token 的位置，其生成概率更稳定”这一统计关系。这个分析相当于给后续方法提供了机制证据。随后在 SFT 和 RL 两个阶段分别比较 random masking、blockwise 或 left-to-right 等顺序策略，结论是 attention-guided order 更适合 full-attention dLLM。消融上，应该重点看两类：一类是只改 denoising order、不做 reweighting；另一类是保留 order、去掉 attention-based token weighting。若两者都带来增益，说明收益既来自轨迹对齐，也来自更合理的 credit assignment。

由于提供的全文片段没有完整表格和具体 benchmark 数字，无法可靠复述精确提升幅度、训练 token 数或 RL 采样规模；但从论文叙述看，作者强调的是 consistent improvement 而不是单点大幅跃升，说明方法更像 recipe 改进而非架构替换。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读时先看 Introduction 和 Attention Analysis。这里决定这篇文章是否值得继续读：如果你认同“dLLM 的 token 依赖应由 attention 而不是位置先验决定”，后面的算法就顺理成章。然后看方法部分里 attention-guided denoising order 的定义，重点弄清楚 valid attention score 是如何计算的、顺序是按 step 动态更新还是一次性预估、训练时如何避免信息泄漏。再看 AGDO-SFT 与 AGDO-RL 的损失设计，尤其是 token reweighting 的公式和它与 mean-field RL 近似如何兼容。

实验部分建议优先看：1）attention 可视化与稳定性统计；2）不同 unmasking order 的对比；3）去掉 reweighting 的消融；4）数学与代码任务上是否都成立。如果时间有限，30 到 40 分钟足够抓住主线。若要深挖，值得追问两个点：第一，attention 是否真能作为依赖因果的代理，还是只是相关信号；第二，这套方法在 base pretraining 阶段是否也能成立，而不只是 post-training recipe。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets a structural mismatch in post-training diffusion language models. Most existing dLLM post-training methods optimize randomly masked positions, while inference proceeds through iterative denoising where the available context is formed by the model’s evolving bidirectional dependencies rather than by random masking. The paper asks two concrete questions: what token dependencies actually emerge during denoising, and whether SFT/RL can be aligned to those dependencies instead of inheriting masking schemes that are convenient but poorly matched to full-attention dLLMs.
summary_en.importance: Its value for pretraining researchers is not a new base objective, but a sharper formulation of training-trajectory alignment for non-AR language models. Many diffusion or masked LM post-training recipes still borrow token-level optimization patterns from AR models and then add random masks or externally imposed decoding orders. This work argues that the denoising trajectory should be induced by the model’s own attention structure. That is useful for diffusion LM, any-order LM, and masked LM research because it shifts the discussion from objective form alone to the interaction between objective, decoding path, and internal dependency structure.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The method has two layers. First is an empirical attention study. On Dream-v0-Instruct-7B, the authors trace final-layer attention along the denoising trajectory and report two main findings: attention is sparse and temporally stable across steps, and tokens that place more attention mass on already-denoised context exhibit more stable generation probabilities. This suggests that masked tokens are not equally predictable at a given step, which directly challenges fully random masking.

Second is AGDO, an attention-guided denoising and optimization framework. It derives an attention-guided denoising order from valid attention scores, where the key idea is to estimate whether a masked token already has enough support from currently visible or denoised context. Instead of decoding by position or by random selection, AGDO unmasks tokens according to attention-supported readiness.

AGDO-SFT uses this order during supervised fine-tuning, reducing the mismatch between training and inference trajectories. On top of that, it introduces attention-based reweighting: tokens that act more like attention hubs receive larger loss weights because mistakes on them are more likely to propagate through later denoising steps.

AGDO-RL extends the same principle to reinforcement learning. It stays within the recent dLLM RL line based on GRPO-style optimization with mean-field approximations, but changes where optimization pressure is applied. Rather than treating randomly masked positions as the optimization target, it organizes token-level credit assignment around attention-induced dependencies and emphasizes attention-critical tokens. Relative to methods like diff-GRPO or wd1, the novelty is less about the RL backbone and more about aligning policy optimization with the model’s intrinsic denoising structure.
summary_en.experiments:
From the provided full text, the experimental focus is on math and coding reasoning benchmarks, with the main claim being consistent gains over random-masking post-training baselines and over externally imposed decoding orders. The primary analysis is conducted on Dream-v0-Instruct-7B, with validation on LLaDA in the appendix, which suggests the observations are not tied to a single model family.

The more important part is the causal chain in the experiments. The paper first uses MATH-500 to trace attention maps across denoising steps and shows temporal consistency in attention as well as a statistical link between reliance on already-denoised tokens and probability stability. That analysis serves as mechanism evidence for the later algorithm. The downstream comparisons then evaluate random masking, blockwise orders, and left-to-right style orders against attention-guided denoising in both SFT and RL settings. The expected ablations to focus on are: changing only the denoising order while keeping the rest fixed, and removing attention-based token reweighting while preserving the order. If both matter, the gains come from both trajectory alignment and better token-level credit assignment.

The excerpt does not include the full result tables, so precise benchmark numbers, training-token counts, or RL sampling budgets cannot be stated reliably. The framing in the text suggests the contribution is a robust recipe improvement rather than a one-off large jump.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Start with the Introduction and the attention analysis section. That is where the paper either lands or does not: if you buy the claim that token dependencies in full-attention dLLMs should be inferred from attention rather than from positional priors, the rest follows naturally. Then read the method section carefully, especially how valid attention scores are defined, whether the denoising order is recomputed dynamically or estimated once, and how the training setup avoids leakage. After that, inspect the AGDO-SFT and AGDO-RL objectives, with special attention to the token reweighting formula and how it fits the mean-field RL approximation.

In the experiments, prioritize: 1) attention visualizations and stability statistics, 2) comparisons across unmasking orders, 3) ablations removing reweighting, and 4) whether the effect holds for both math and coding. For a skim, 30–40 minutes is enough to capture the main idea. For deeper reading, two questions are worth pursuing: whether attention is a causal proxy for dependency or only a correlated signal, and whether the same principle could be pushed into base pretraining rather than only post-training.

recommendation.zh: Diffusion LM 圈里少有的把 attention 结构真正用到训练/去噪 order 的工作；重点看 §3 的 attention 观察和 §4 的 token 加权 RL，别被“SOTA”措辞带跑。
recommendation.en: One of the cleaner dLLM papers that actually uses internal attention to change denoising order and loss weighting; read §3–§4 for the attention observations, ignore the headline SOTA framing.

institutions: Beijing Key Laboratory of Research on Large Models and Intelligent Governance
Gaoling School of Artificial Intelligence, Renmin University of China

paper.title: Teaching Diffusion to Speculate Left-to-Right
paper.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) achieve remarkable performance across a wide range of tasks, but their autoregressive decoding process incurs substantial inference costs due to inherently sequential token generation. Speculative decoding addresses this bottleneck by employing a lightweight draft model to propose multiple future tokens that are subsequently verified in parallel by a larger target model. Recent work has demonstrated that diffusion language models are well suited for this setting, as

summary.core_problem: 扩散语言模型做 speculative decoding 时，训练目标是块内双向生成，但验证器是自回归左到右验收，训练-推理目标不一致会拖累接受率和加速收益。
summary.importance: 这篇工作的价值不在于再做一个 diffusion LM，而在于指出并修正了 block diffusion drafter 在 speculative decoding 场景下的目标错配。对研究非 AR 文本建模与推理加速接口的人，这个问题很实在。
summary.technical_approach: 核心思路是“教扩散 drafter 学会左到右投机”。论文从理论上分析双向块生成与 AR 验证奖励之间的错位，然后修改训练或生成机制，让 drafter 在块内更偏向左到右可验证的提案，而不是对称地优化整块 token。给定摘要，方法应属于对 diffusion drafter 的目标重塑，而非简单换 backbone。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出完整数值，但实验目标应是比较标准 block-diffusion drafter 与其 left-to-right speculative 版本在接受率、吞吐和端到端延迟上的差异，并以 AR target model 作为验证器。若结果成立，关键看 acceptance rate 与 wall-clock speedup 是否同时改善，而不是只看离线 token accuracy。

summary_en.core_problem: In speculative decoding with diffusion language models, the drafter is trained to generate bidirectionally within a block, while the verifier accepts tokens strictly left-to-right, creating a train-test objective mismatch.
summary_en.importance: The value here is not another diffusion LM per se, but a concrete fix to the mismatch between block-diffusion drafting and autoregressive verification. That matters for anyone studying the interface between non-AR language modeling and inference acceleration.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper teaches a diffusion drafter to speculate in a left-to-right-compatible way. It analyzes the mismatch between symmetric block generation and asymmetric AR verification, then reshapes the training or generation objective so the drafter proposes tokens that are easier for an AR verifier to accept, rather than optimizing a fully symmetric block objective.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not expose full numbers, but the relevant evaluation should compare a standard block-diffusion drafter against the proposed left-to-right speculative variant on acceptance rate, throughput, and end-to-end latency with an AR target model as verifier. If the paper is solid, the key signal is simultaneous gains in acceptance and wall-clock speedup, not just offline token accuracy.

recommendation.zh: 值得看的是它把 diffusion LM 的训练目标和 AR verifier 的奖励对齐；先看方法节和 acceptance-rate 表，若只涨离线指标不涨端到端速度，就当弱信号。
recommendation.en: Read it for the objective alignment between diffusion drafting and AR verification; check the method section and acceptance-rate tables first—if offline metrics rise without end-to-end speedup, treat it as weak evidence.

paper.title: Optimality of FSQ Tokens for Continuous Diffusion for Categorical Data with Application to Text-to-Speech
paper.abstract: Continuous diffusion for categorical data is a framework belonging to the diffusion family and aiming at generating discrete data. The scientific interest to such models has been constantly increasing these days because researchers try to achieve a challenging goal of finding reasonable alternatives to autoregressive large language models. In this paper, we study the properties of the structure of the latent space corresponding to discrete tokens expressed in terms of Kullback-Leibler divergence

summary.core_problem: 在用于分类数据的连续扩散模型（CDCD）中，连续潜在空间的结构通常与扩散模型联合优化，导致训练不稳定和模型次优。本文探究何种潜在空间结构最适合 CDCD 模型。
summary.importance: 从理论和实验上证明了有限标量量化（FSQ）的 token 结构在 CDCD 模型中具有最优性，为跨模态统一预训练（如 Omni-LLMs）中的离散化和扩散建模结合提供了理论依据和实践指导。
summary.technical_approach: 研究了离散 token 对应的潜在空间结构，通过扩散路径测度上的 KL 散度和最优训练扩散模型的正确 token 预测准确率来衡量。发现 FSQ tokenization 方案的潜在空间结构具有使其最适合 CDCD 的属性。基于此，提出了一种基于 CDCD 和 FSQ 语音 token 的新型文本到语音（TTS）模型。
summary.experiments: 在 TTS 任务中，基于 FSQ 的 CDCD 模型在合成语音质量上优于其他码本。此外，该模型在语音清晰度和零样本能力上超越了基于 LLM 的对应模型，且其 CDCD 骨干网络比 LLM 骨干网络小约 10 倍，速度快 5 倍以上。
summary.reading_guide: 建议重点阅读 Section 4 中关于 FSQ 码本最优性的理论分析，以及 Section 5 中 TTS 实验的对比结果，特别是 CDCD 与 LLM 骨干网络的效率对比。预计阅读时间 20 分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: In Continuous Diffusion for Categorical Data (CDCD) models, the structure of the continuous latent space is typically optimized jointly with the diffusion model, leading to unstable training and suboptimal models. This paper investigates what latent space structure is best suited for CDCD models.
summary_en.importance: Theoretically and empirically demonstrates the optimality of the Finite Scalar Quantization (FSQ) token structure in CDCD models, providing theoretical grounding and practical guidance for combining discretization and diffusion modeling in cross-modal unified pre-training (e.g., Omni-LLMs).
summary_en.technical_approach: Studies the properties of the latent space structure corresponding to discrete tokens, measured by the Kullback-Leibler (KL) divergence on diffusion path measures and the accuracy of correct token prediction by an optimally trained diffusion model. Finds that the FSQ tokenization scheme has a latent space structure with properties making it best suited for CDCD. Based on this, proposes a novel text-to-speech (TTS) model relying on CDCD and FSQ speech tokens.
summary_en.experiments: In the TTS task, the FSQ-based CDCD model outperforms other codebooks in synthesized speech quality. Furthermore, it surpasses its LLM-based counterpart in speech intelligibility and zero-shot capabilities, with a CDCD backbone that is ~10x smaller and >5x faster than the LLM backbone.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on Section 4 for the theoretical analysis of FSQ codebook optimality, and Section 5 for the comparative results of the TTS experiments, especially the efficiency comparison between CDCD and LLM backbones. Estimated reading time: 20 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 值得看理论 setup 和 token 几何对比；若证明条件不太窄，可直接影响 diffusion LM 的 tokenizer 设计。
recommendation.en: Read the theoretical setup and token-geometry comparisons; if the assumptions are not too narrow, this informs tokenizer design for diffusion LMs.

paper.title: Diffusion Language Model Parallel Decoding via Product-of-Experts Bridge
paper.abstract: Diffusion language models (DLMs) offer substantial speed advantages through parallel decoding, but the lack of token dependencies limits generation quality compared to autoregressive (AR) models. Recent progress attempts to bridge the gap via importance sampling, with DLM being the proposal and AR being the target. However, due to the huge gap between their distributions, the sampling requires a large number of particles and is thus expensive to compute. In this paper, we introduce PoE-Bridge, a

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文解决 diffusion language model 并行解码质量不足的问题：DLM 可以并行生成多个 token，但同一步内 token 之间缺少强依赖建模；如果直接用 AR 模型做 rejection sampling 或 importance sampling 校正，又会因为 DLM proposal 和 AR target 分布差距太大而计算成本过高。
summary.importance: 它的价值在于把 diffusion LM 的并行解码和 AR LM 的条件评分能力接起来。对预训练研究员来说，这类工作不只是 serving 技巧，也会反过来影响建模范式的判断：如果 DLM 需要 AR 模型作为 verifier 或 target 才能接近高质量生成，那么 DLM 的优势更可能来自并行 proposal，而不是完全替代 AR 条件分布。PoE-Bridge 给出了一种中间分布校正思路，可以用来理解非 AR 语言模型与 AR 模型之间的分布差距。
summary.technical_approach: 核心方法是引入一个 Product-of-Experts bridge distribution，作为 DLM proposal 和 AR target 之间的中间分布。直观形式是把 DLM 分布和 AR 分布按权重 w 做 PoE 插值；w 接近 1 时更靠近 DLM，w 接近 0 时更靠近 AR。解码被拆成两步：先用 DLM 并行产生候选 continuation，再用 speculative rejection sampling 把候选过滤到 PoE bridge 附近；随后用 importance resampling 从 bridge 进一步校正到 AR target。这样避免了直接从 DLM 到 AR 的大跨度校正。论文还加入两个工程机制：Mixed-Temperature Sampling 用不同温度生成候选，缓解 importance sampling 中候选塌缩和覆盖不足；Elastic Rejection Window 根据已观察到的接受长度动态调整验证窗口，减少固定窗口带来的无效验证计算。
summary.experiments: 论文在数学推理和代码任务上评估 PoE-Bridge。报告结果显示，相比标准 DLM 解码，PoE-Bridge 在准确率上更高，同时最高有约 5 倍生成加速；相比目标 AR 解码，它能恢复至少 95% 的 AR 准确率，并达到约 2 倍吞吐。实验重点不是训练一个更强的 DLM，而是在给定 DLM proposal 和 AR target 的条件下，通过桥接分布降低 Monte Carlo 校正难度。消融上应重点关注 PoE 权重 w、candidate 数量、mixed-temperature 策略、elastic window 对有效样本数和接受率的影响。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议 30–40 分钟。优先看方法中的 PoE bridge 定义，尤其是它如何从序列级概念落到可计算的 token-level 形式；再看 speculative rejection sampling 与 importance resampling 的衔接，因为这是方法有效的关键。实验部分建议看数学和代码任务上的 accuracy-throughput tradeoff，以及 candidate budget 较小时是否仍然稳定。若时间有限，先读 Section 4.2、解码算法伪代码、主结果表和消融表。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses the quality gap in parallel decoding for diffusion language models. DLMs can generate multiple tokens in parallel, but their within-step token independence weakens generation quality. Directly correcting DLM samples with an AR model through rejection sampling or importance sampling is expensive because the DLM proposal and AR target distributions are far apart.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a decoding framework that combines DLM parallel proposal generation with AR conditional scoring. For pretraining researchers, the result is useful because it clarifies where current DLMs help and where they still rely on AR structure. The DLM is effective as a parallel proposal, while the AR model supplies a stronger dependency-aware target. The bridge distribution is also a useful lens for measuring and reducing the distribution mismatch between non-AR language models and AR models.
summary_en.technical_approach: PoE-Bridge introduces an intermediate Product-of-Experts distribution between the DLM proposal and the AR target. Conceptually, the bridge interpolates the two distributions with a weight w: when w is close to 1, it stays closer to the DLM; when w is close to 0, it approaches the AR target. Decoding is decomposed into two easier transitions. First, DLM candidates are generated in parallel and filtered toward the PoE bridge using speculative rejection sampling. Second, importance resampling refines the filtered candidates toward the AR target. The paper adds two practical mechanisms: Mixed-Temperature Sampling, which generates candidates at different entropy levels to improve coverage and reduce sample collapse; and Elastic Rejection Window, which adapts the verification window based on observed acceptance lengths to avoid wasted verification compute.
summary_en.experiments: The paper evaluates PoE-Bridge on mathematical reasoning and coding benchmarks. It reports higher accuracy than standard DLM decoding with up to about 5x speedup over that DLM decoding setup, and it recovers at least 95% of the target AR model’s accuracy while reaching around 2x the throughput of AR decoding. The key experimental question is not whether the DLM alone is stronger, but whether the bridge reduces the Monte Carlo correction burden under realistic candidate budgets. The most informative ablations are likely the PoE weight, number of particles or candidates, mixed-temperature sampling, elastic rejection window, acceptance length, and effective sample size.
summary_en.reading_guide: A focused skim should take 30–40 minutes. Start with the formal definition of the PoE bridge, especially how the sequence-level idea is implemented in a tractable token-level form. Then read the decoding algorithm to understand how speculative rejection sampling and importance resampling are composed. In the experiments, focus on the accuracy-throughput frontier for math and coding tasks, and check whether the method remains stable with small candidate budgets. If time is limited, prioritize Section 4.2, the algorithm box, the main result table, and the ablations.

recommendation.zh: 读方法和采样分析即可；它不改变 DLM 训练目标，但对“DLM 如何借 AR verifier 补依赖”给了一个干净接口。
recommendation.en: Read the method and sampling analysis; it does not change DLM training, but gives a clean interface for using an AR verifier to restore dependencies.

paper.title: Forward-Free Diffusion Language Models
paper.abstract: Diffusion language models generate text through iterative denoising, offering a powerful alternative to autoregressive generation. However, discrete language spaces lack a natural neighborhood structure for defining effective perturbations, so some artificial corruption schemes are proposed in the forward process. Such prescribed forward processes often produce states that are mathematically convenient but misaligned with drafts and errors encountered during generation, resulting in degraded sam

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文处理的是离散 diffusion language model 里最难绕开的设计问题：forward corruption path 很难定义。图像 diffusion 可以用高斯噪声，因为连续空间有自然邻域；文本 token 没有这种几何结构，随机替换、mask、absorbing state 或离散转移核都会人为制造一条中间分布路径。训练时学到的是反转这条路径，但推理时模型遇到的往往是自己生成的草稿和错误，两者不匹配会损害生成质量。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的启发在于，它把 diffusion LM 的核心从“设计噪声过程”转向“学习分布递归修正”。这对 masked diffusion、SEDD/MDLM/LLaDA 一类方法都有参考意义：离散文本建模未必需要先规定一个 token 级扰动几何，而可以让模型生成的 draft 形成中间状态。贡献量级属于建模范式和训练-推理对齐层面的改动，不是单纯 decoding trick。不过论文目前只展示 4B、10B token continued-pretraining 规模，离真正验证 scaling 行为还有距离。
summary.technical_approach: FReDA 的核心做法是去掉手工 forward process，把 diffusion LM 写成 recursive distribution refinement。模型先从一个初始 draft distribution 产生候选序列，再学习把当前 draft 修正得更接近数据分布。中间状态不来自预设噪声 schedule，而来自模型早期或不成熟生成器的输出，因此训练分布更接近推理时会看到的错误类型。论文给出两种实例化：第一是 self-refinement，模型直接修改自己的草稿；第二是 stochastic best-of-N refinement，并行提出多个候选序列，再用额外 score head 选择较好的候选。这个设计和传统 D3PM/absorbing-mask diffusion 的差别在于，后者先定义 q(x_t|x_0)，再训练反向转移；FReDA 让 sampler 自身诱导中间分布路径，使 refinement step 的难度随模型能力变化，而不是由固定噪声强度控制。
summary.experiments: 论文训练了 FReDA-4B，使用 10B token continued-pretraining corpus。这个预算小于若干 diffusion baseline。评测覆盖 general knowledge、math reasoning 和 code generation，并聚焦 sub-8B 模型。结果显示，FReDA-4B 在四个推理和代码 benchmark 上超过 7B-8B diffusion base models，绝对提升约 5%-15%；在通用知识任务上保持竞争力。效率上，FReDA 给出更好的 quality-speed Pareto trade-off：达到相近准确率需要更少 forward passes，每次 forward 生成的 token 更多，平均加速约 1.5-1.8 倍。额外分析表明，增加 refinement iterations 能带来比较稳定的收益，说明推理时计算可以转化为质量提升。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读 30-45 分钟。先看 Introduction 中对 discrete forward process 的批评，这部分讲清了为什么文本 diffusion 不能直接照搬连续噪声。然后看方法里 recursive distribution refinement 的形式化定义，重点比较它和显式 q(x_t|x_0) 的区别。self-refinement 与 stochastic best-of-N refinement 是实现层面的关键，score head 如何训练和使用值得细看。实验部分重点看四类信息：4B/10B token 的训练设置、和 LLaDA/MDLM/其他 7B-8B diffusion baselines 的公平性、refinement iteration 的消融、quality-speed 曲线。需要保留一个疑问：continued-pretraining 规模较小，结果能否扩展到更大 token budget 和更大参数量还没有被充分证明。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses a central weakness of discrete diffusion language models: the forward corruption path is hard to define. Gaussian perturbations work naturally in continuous domains because the space has a meaningful local geometry. Token spaces do not. Masking, random replacement, absorbing states, or hand-crafted transition kernels impose artificial intermediate distributions. The reverse model is trained to invert those distributions, but generation-time drafts contain model-specific errors that need not resemble the prescribed noising process.
summary_en.importance: The main value for pretraining research is the shift from designing a corruption process to learning recursive distribution refinement. This is relevant to masked diffusion LMs, SEDD-like models, MDLM, and LLaDA-style systems. The paper suggests that discrete language diffusion may not need a token-level neighborhood model; intermediate states can instead be induced by the model's own drafts. The contribution is at the modeling-objective and train-inference-alignment level, not just a sampler modification. The evidence is still limited to a 4B model with 10B tokens of continued pretraining, so the scaling behavior remains open.
summary_en.technical_approach: FReDA removes the hand-designed forward process and formulates diffusion language modeling as recursive distribution refinement. A model produces draft sequences, and the learned transition improves those drafts toward the data distribution. The implicit intermediate states are generated by premature or current versions of the model rather than by an externally specified noise schedule. The paper instantiates this idea in two ways. Self-refinement directly revises the model's own draft. Stochastic best-of-N refinement samples multiple candidate sequences in parallel and uses an additional scoring head to select the most promising one. This differs from D3PM or absorbing-mask diffusion, where q(x_t|x_0) is specified first and the model learns its reverse. In FReDA, the sampler induces the distributional path, and the difficulty of each refinement step adapts to the model's expressive capacity.
summary_en.experiments: The reported model is FReDA-4B trained with a 10B-token continued-pretraining corpus, smaller than the budgets used by several diffusion baselines. Evaluation covers general knowledge, mathematical reasoning, and code generation in the sub-8B regime. FReDA-4B outperforms 7B-8B diffusion base models on four reasoning and coding benchmarks, with absolute gains of roughly 5-15%, while remaining competitive on general knowledge tasks. On efficiency, it reaches a stronger quality-speed trade-off: fewer forward passes are needed for comparable accuracy, more tokens are produced per forward pass, and the average speedup is reported as 1.5-1.8x. Additional analyses show consistent gains as refinement computation increases.
summary_en.reading_guide: A useful skim takes about 30-45 minutes. Start with the Introduction, especially the argument against fixed corruption paths in discrete token space. Then read the formal definition of recursive distribution refinement and compare it with methods that explicitly define q(x_t|x_0). The two implementation choices, self-refinement and stochastic best-of-N refinement, are the key method details; the training and usage of the score head deserve attention. In the experiments, focus on four points: the 4B/10B-token setup, fairness against LLaDA/MDLM-like 7B-8B diffusion baselines, refinement-iteration ablations, and the quality-speed curve. The main open question is whether the approach continues to hold under much larger pretraining budgets and model sizes.

recommendation.zh: Diffusion LM范式的重要突破——消除前向过程设计是对整个离散扩散建模思路的挑战；§3理论推导和§4实验部分值得预训练研究员细读，关注与AR范式的对比视角。
recommendation.en: An important diffusion LM breakthrough—eliminating the forward process challenges the entire discrete diffusion paradigm. §3 theoretical derivation and §4 experiments are worth reading for pretraining researchers, especially for contrast with AR paradigms.

paper.title: TimpaTeks: Automatic In-place Text Sequence Modification via Diffusion Language Model Steering
paper.abstract: We extend activation steering to diffusion language models (DLMs) and study a novel problem that arose due to the inference mechanism of DLMs: Modifying a text in-place to manifest a different concept. We propose TimpaTeks, an automatic in-place text modification mechanism using DLMs. Experiments on IMDB movie reviews (sentiment) and a synthetic Cats and Dogs Dataset (arbitrary, more unconventional concept steering) show that TimpaTeks provides a feasible novel mechanism to steer diffusion langu

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作研究 diffusion language model 的一个特有能力：能否在不重写整句的情况下，对已有文本做原位修改并定向改变语义概念。
summary.importance: 它的价值在于把 activation steering 扩展到 DLM，并利用 DLM 非自回归、可局部重写的生成机制，展示一种 AR LM 不太自然的编辑范式。对研究新型语言建模范式的人有一点启发，但目前任务设置较小。
summary.technical_approach: 作者提出 TimpaTeks，用 DLM 的去噪过程做 automatic in-place text modification。方法核心是把 activation steering 注入 diffusion LM 的推理过程，使模型在原位去噪时朝目标概念偏移，同时尽量保留原句结构。相比 prompt-based steering，它不需要额外构造条件提示，而是在原序列上直接编辑。
summary.experiments: 实验主要在 IMDB 影评情感修改和一个 Cats vs Dogs 合成数据集上，评估概念切换、句子结构保留和困惑度变化。摘要声称能在保持原句结构的同时降低句子 perplexity，并且比基于提示的 DLM steering 更省算力。但没有看到大模型、开放域文本或强基线验证。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies a DLM-specific capability: whether a diffusion language model can modify an existing text in place and shift its semantic concept without rewriting the whole sequence.
summary_en.importance: Its main value is extending activation steering to diffusion LMs and exploiting the non-autoregressive, locally editable nature of DLMs. This is mildly interesting for alternative language modeling paradigms, though the current setup is small-scale.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors propose TimpaTeks, an automatic in-place text modification method built on diffusion LM denoising. The key idea is to inject activation steering into the DLM inference process so that denoising moves the sequence toward a target concept while preserving the original sentence structure. Unlike prompt-based steering, it edits the sequence directly rather than generating a new conditioned output.
summary_en.experiments: Experiments are conducted on IMDB sentiment editing and a synthetic Cats-and-Dogs concept dataset, evaluating concept transfer, structure preservation, and perplexity. The abstract claims lower sentence perplexity and lower compute cost than prompt-based DLM steering, but there is no evidence yet of large-scale models, open-domain text, or strong baselines.

recommendation.zh: 点子不坏，但更像 DLM 可编辑性的 demo，不足以支撑范式判断；做 diffusion LM 的人可看，其他人知道有这条路就够了。
recommendation.en: A decent idea, but mostly a demo of DLM editability rather than a paradigm-shifting result; worth a look only if you actively work on diffusion LMs.

paper.title: AsyncLane: Decoupling Refinement from Advancement in Diffusion Language Model Decoding
paper.abstract: Block-wise semi-autoregressive decoding is the standard inference paradigm for diffusion large language models (DLMs), but it imposes a strict dependency between blocks: the next block cannot begin until the current block is fully decoded or its denoising budget is exhausted. We observe that once a block exposes a reliable delimiter boundary or stable semantic prefix, continuation generation need not wait for every residual token to be resolved. We propose AsyncLane, a training-free decoding sch

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文解决的是 diffusion language model 推理中的 block completion barrier。现有 block-wise semi-autoregressive decoding 通常要求当前 block 完成或耗尽 denoising budget 后，下一 block 才能开始。问题在于，当前 block 里剩余的低置信 token 还在 refinement 时，后续生成有时已经可以依赖一个稳定前缀或 delimiter boundary 继续推进。把 refinement 和 advancement 绑在同一条串行路径上，会浪费推理并行性。
summary.importance: 它对预训练方向的直接贡献有限，主要是 diffusion LM 的 decoding 和 serving 调度。但它提供了一个有用信号：非 AR 模型的吞吐优势不只来自一次预测多个 mask token，也取决于推理依赖图能否被重新组织。对于设计 diffusion/any-order LM 的训练目标，这篇论文也提醒一点：如果模型能更早形成可靠边界或稳定语义前缀，推理调度就有更多空间。因此它更像是连接建模范式和系统效率的工作。
summary.technical_approach: AsyncLane 是 training-free scheduler，不改模型参数。它把标准 block-wise decoding 中的单一全局 block pointer 替换为 active lanes。generate lane 负责推进生成前沿；refine lane 负责继续修正已经发现的前缀。当 generate lane 暴露出可靠 delimiter boundary 时，调度器执行 branch-and-refine：边界前的前缀交给 refine lane，边界后的 continuation 交给新的 generate lane。这样，未来区域可以开始 denoising，而过去前缀仍保持可编辑。为了降低多 lane 带来的模型调用开销，论文利用 fork 后 sibling lanes 共享前缀状态，做 grouped batched forwards；复用 future-window logits 作为后续 generate lane 的高置信 draft；用 cascading termination 避免在 EOS 或未解决前沿之后继续创建无效 lane；并通过 compact cache refresh 和 refresh-logit reuse 控制双向 attention 下的 stale prefix 问题。
summary.experiments: 实验在 LLaDA 和 Dream 两类 diffusion LM backbone 上进行，任务包括 mathematical reasoning 和 code generation。论文报告 AsyncLane 在所有测试的 benchmark-length 设置下取得最高 throughput，并且生成长度越长，吞吐优势越明显。质量方面保持 competitive generation quality，没有把速度收益完全建立在明显退化的输出上。给出的全文片段没有包含具体吞吐数字、pass 数、延迟或准确率表，因此只能确认趋势和比较结论，不能核验精确幅度。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读 20-30 分钟。重点看方法图和 active-lane scheduling 的定义，理解 lane state、generate/refine role、boundary-triggered fork 的执行顺序。然后看 efficient execution 部分，尤其是 grouped batched forwards、future-window logit reuse、cache refresh 这几项，因为这些决定了多 lane 调度是否真的省时。实验部分主要看按生成长度分组的 throughput-quality 曲线，以及 LLaDA 与 Dream 上是否表现一致。若关注预训练本身，可以快速读完，不必深挖系统实现细节；若在做 diffusion LM serving，则值得仔细检查边界检测规则和 stale prefix 处理。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets the block completion barrier in diffusion language model decoding. In common block-wise semi-autoregressive decoding, the next block cannot start until the current block is fully decoded or its denoising budget is exhausted. This serializes two different operations: refining low-confidence positions in the current block and advancing the generation frontier. Once a stable prefix or delimiter boundary has emerged, the continuation does not always need to wait for every remaining token in the current block to be resolved.
summary_en.importance: The direct relevance to pretraining is moderate; this is primarily a decoding and serving scheduler for diffusion LMs. Its broader lesson is useful: the throughput advantage of non-AR models depends not only on predicting multiple masked tokens per pass, but also on how the inference dependency graph is scheduled. It also gives a modeling signal. If a diffusion or any-order LM can expose reliable boundaries early, decoding can exploit more parallelism. The work therefore sits between modeling assumptions and systems efficiency.
summary_en.technical_approach: AsyncLane is a training-free scheduler. It replaces the single global block pointer in standard block-wise decoding with a set of active lanes. A generate lane advances the frontier. A refine lane keeps improving an already discovered prefix. When a generate lane reveals a reliable delimiter boundary, the scheduler performs branch-and-refine: the prefix before the boundary is assigned to a refine lane, and the continuation after the boundary is assigned to a new generate lane. The future region can then begin denoising while the past remains editable. To keep the cost under control, AsyncLane exploits shared prefix states among forked sibling lanes and evaluates them with grouped batched forwards. It reuses future-window logits as high-confidence drafts for later generate lanes, uses cascading termination to avoid creating lanes beyond EOS or unresolved frontiers, and applies compact cache refresh plus refresh-logit reuse to reduce stale-prefix issues under bidirectional attention.
summary_en.experiments: Experiments are reported on LLaDA and Dream backbones, with mathematical reasoning and code generation benchmarks. AsyncLane achieves the highest throughput across the evaluated benchmark-length settings, and the advantage becomes larger for longer generations. Generation quality remains competitive, so the speedup is not simply obtained by allowing large quality degradation. The provided full-content excerpt does not include exact throughput, latency, pass-count, or accuracy numbers, so the quantitative magnitude cannot be independently summarized beyond the reported trend.
summary_en.reading_guide: A practical skim takes about 20-30 minutes. Focus first on the method figure and the definition of active-lane scheduling: lane state, generate versus refine roles, and the boundary-triggered fork procedure. Then read the efficient execution part, especially grouped batched forwards, future-window logit reuse, and cache refresh, because these details determine whether multiple active lanes reduce wall-clock time. In the experiments, look for throughput-quality curves grouped by generation length and check whether the behavior is consistent on both LLaDA and Dream. For pretraining-focused readers, a quick read is enough. For diffusion LM serving work, the boundary detection rule and stale-prefix handling are the parts to inspect carefully.

recommendation.zh: 这篇该看，尤其如果你还在判断 DLM 有没有工程生命力；先看调度假设和 wall-clock 表，若收益真实，很多“DLM 太慢”的 prior 要改写一部分。
recommendation.en: This is worth reading if you still doubt DLMs have any systems future; check the scheduling assumptions and wall-clock tables first—if the gains are real, part of the “DLMs are too slow” prior needs updating.

paper.title: Hacking Generative Perplexity: Why Unconditional Text Evaluation Needs Distributional Metrics
paper.abstract: Diffusion and continuous flow-based language models have emerged as the leading non-autoregressive alternatives to language modeling. Progress in both paradigms is overwhelmingly tracked by generative perplexity (gen-PPL): the per-token negative log-likelihood of samples under a frozen autoregressive (AR) scorer such as gpt2-large, typically paired with an empirical-entropy guardrail to rule out low-entropy collapse. We argue that this metric is unsound. By construction, gen-PPL measures only pr

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作讨论的不是“如何训练更好的非自回归语言模型”，而是一个更基础的问题：当前领域里用来比较 diffusion / flow / 其他非 AR 文本生成模型的主指标 gen-PPL，是否真的在衡量生成质量。全文给出的结论是否定的。gen-PPL 的定义是：把生成样本交给一个冻结的 AR scorer（通常是 GPT-2 large），计算其每 token 负对数似然。这个量只反映“样本对该 scorer 来说有多可预测”，并不直接反映语法完整性、语义连贯性、篇章一致性，更不反映样本分布是否接近人类文本。论文要解决的核心问题，就是证明这种错位不是边角问题，而是结构性缺陷：存在大量低质量、甚至明显胡乱的文本，在冻结 AR scorer 下依然能拿到很低的 gen-PPL；因此用它来追踪非 AR LM 的进展，会系统性误排方法优劣。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的影响主要有两层。第一层是评测层面。近两年 diffusion LM、masked/any-order LM、continuous flow LM 的论文，很多都把 gen-PPL 当成主结果表。若这个指标可以被零参数、刻意构造的劣质采样器“刷分”，那么已有结论里相当一部分只能说明“更像 scorer 偏好的可预测串”，不能说明“更接近真实文本分布”。第二层是研究方向层面。非 AR 语言建模一直面临 exact likelihood 难算、采样策略多样、推断步数影响结果等问题，社区因此依赖代理指标。本文的贡献在于把这个代理指标的失效机制讲清楚，并给出替代思路：不要再问样本在某个 AR 模型下是否容易预测，而要问生成分布与人类文本分布之间的统计距离。对做新型语言建模范式的人，这篇文章的价值不在于提出一个新模型，而在于纠正“优化错目标”的风险，量级上属于会影响后续实验 protocol 的工作。
summary.technical_approach:
技术路线分三步。第一步是理论和概念拆解。作者把 gen-PPL 重新解释为“冻结 AR scorer 对样本序列的条件可预测性”，并指出这与生成质量不是同一个对象。一个强 AR scorer 会偏好高频局部模式、常见搭配、短程可预测结构；但文本质量还包含长程语义、全局一致性、信息密度、 discourse 合理性。只要能构造出在局部上高度可预测、在全局上却很差的序列，gen-PPL 就会失真。经验熵 guardrail 也不够，因为 unigram entropy 只能排除最粗糙的低熵塌缩，挡不住“词表使用看起来够丰富，但组合方式很差”的样本。

第二步是构造反例生成器。文章的关键说服力来自一组 zero-parameter、deliberately naive samplers。它们不训练模型，不学习数据分布，只利用简单启发式或 scorer 偏好，就能生成明显不自然的文本，同时取得很强的 gen-PPL。这里的重点不是某个具体 sampler 的工程细节，而是作者系统展示了：只要朝“提高 scorer 可预测性”这个方向做手工设计，就能稳定骗过 gen-PPL。这说明问题不在某个模型族，而在指标定义本身。全文反复强调，这些采样器输出在人工阅读下是 incoherent 的，但在 LM1B 和 OpenWebText 上却能达到或超过近期 diffusion / flow 模型报告的 gen-PPL。

第三步是替代评测协议。作者主张把核心 proxy 从单点评分器的 token-level NLL，换成 generated distribution 与 reference distribution 的统计距离。文中推荐直接使用 distributional metrics，引用了 MMD、energy distance 等两样本检验/分布距离工具，并据此重新 benchmark 近期非 AR 模型。这个思路的关键不是某一个距离公式，而是评测对象从“单条样本在 scorer 下的分数”转向“样本集合是否像来自同一分布”。这更接近 unconditional generation 的真实目标，也更不容易被局部可预测性投机利用。
summary.experiments:
实验部分最重要的结果有三类。第一类是反例成立：作者在 LM1B 和 OpenWebText 上，用零参数 naive samplers 取得了与近期非 AR 文献相当甚至更好的 gen-PPL，同时保持非退化的 empirical entropy。也就是说，它们并不是靠重复单词或极端低熵塌缩来刷分，而是在 entropy guardrail 之内完成“作弊”。摘要截断处没有给出完整数值表，但从正文叙述可以确定，作者把这些结果直接与已发表 diffusion-based 和 continuous-flow 模型做了并列比较，结论是 gen-PPL 排名会把明显更差的文本排到更前面。

第二类是人类可感知质量与 gen-PPL 脱钩。论文通过样例和定量比较说明，低 gen-PPL 并不对应更好的语义连贯性。换句话说，指标排序与人工直觉排序发生了系统偏离，而不是偶然噪声。这个点很关键，因为如果只是少量异常样本，问题还可以归因于 scorer 偶发偏差；但作者展示的是组合空间里存在大量此类序列。

第三类是重评测结果。作者用 distributional metrics 重新评估近期非 AR 模型后，得到的进展图景与 gen-PPL 下的结论不同。哪些模型真正更接近人类文本分布，哪些只是更会迎合 AR scorer，在新协议下被重新区分开。对读者来说，最值得看的不是某个模型绝对名次，而是“同一批模型在两套指标下排序如何变化”。这直接揭示了旧指标的误导程度。

如果从实验设计角度看，文章还有两个细节值得记住：一是数据集选了 LM1B 和 OpenWebText，覆盖较规范与较开放的文本分布；二是作者没有只批评指标，而是给出可复现的对照基线和替代 protocol，这让结论更扎实。
summary.reading_guide:
建议先读 Introduction 和作者对 gen-PPL 的问题定义，确认他们批评的不是“AR scorer 不够强”，而是“指标与目标错位”。然后重点看构造 naive samplers 的章节，以及展示样本文本的图表或案例。这里最能建立直觉：为什么这些文本读起来差，但 scorer 仍给高分。接着看 re-benchmark 部分，关注同一组模型在 gen-PPL 与 distributional metrics 下的排序变化。若时间有限，优先看三类内容：1）gen-PPL 与 empirical entropy 的定义和局限；2）零参数反例的构造逻辑；3）推荐的新评测协议及其结果。

值得深挖的点有三个。第一，distributional metrics 在文本空间里依赖什么表征，是否会引入新的 representation bias；第二，两样本距离对 sample size、长度分布、解码温度是否敏感；第三，这套批评是否同样适用于一些常见的 AR 生成评测代理，比如用更强 judge LM 打分。做新型 LM 的人可以把这篇文章当成“评测 sanity check 清单”。在自己报结果前，先问一句：指标到底在奖励什么。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets a basic but underexamined issue in non-autoregressive text generation: whether generative perplexity (gen-PPL) is a valid proxy for unconditional generation quality. The answer developed through the full paper is no. Gen-PPL evaluates generated samples under a frozen autoregressive scorer, usually GPT-2 large, and reports token-level negative log-likelihood. That quantity measures how predictable a sample is to the scorer, not whether the sample is grammatical, coherent, semantically meaningful, or distributionally close to human text. The central problem is therefore not a small mismatch but a structural one: there exists a large combinatorial set of low-quality sequences that are still highly predictable under the scorer, so progress measured by gen-PPL can be badly misranked.
summary_en.importance: Its importance is mainly methodological. A large fraction of recent diffusion LM, masked/any-order LM, and continuous flow LM work has relied on gen-PPL as the headline metric because exact likelihood is hard or intractable under these paradigms. If a metric can be beaten by zero-parameter, intentionally naive samplers that produce visibly poor text, then many published comparisons only show better compatibility with the scorer’s local preferences, not better language modeling. For pretraining research, this matters because evaluation shapes optimization pressure. Once a field starts tuning architectures, samplers, and decoding schedules against a flawed proxy, it can drift toward the wrong target. The paper’s contribution is not a new model but a correction to the measurement layer, and that is substantial enough to affect future experimental protocol in non-AR language modeling.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The paper proceeds in three stages. First, it reframes gen-PPL conceptually. A frozen AR scorer assigns high probability to sequences that are locally predictable under its learned conditional structure. That is not equivalent to text quality. Quality includes long-range semantic consistency, discourse structure, information content, and human plausibility. A sequence can be easy for the scorer to continue token by token while still being globally poor. The commonly paired empirical unigram entropy guardrail does not fix this, because it only filters out crude low-entropy collapse. It does not prevent sequences that use a reasonably broad vocabulary but combine tokens in shallow, low-quality ways.

Second, the authors build explicit counterexamples. This is the core technical move. They construct a suite of zero-parameter, deliberately naive samplers that do not learn a text distribution at all, yet achieve extremely strong gen-PPL. The exact sampler designs matter less than the broader point: by directly exploiting what the scorer finds predictable, one can manufacture outputs that score well while remaining incoherent to a human reader. This demonstrates that the failure is in the metric definition, not in a particular model family.

Third, they propose a replacement evaluation protocol centered on distributional comparison rather than scorer-based token likelihood. Instead of asking whether a generated sequence is easy for an AR model to predict, they ask whether generated samples statistically resemble human-written samples. The paper recommends distributional metrics such as MMD and energy distance, drawing from two-sample testing and divergence estimation. The key shift is from single-sample scoring to comparing generated and reference distributions. That aligns much better with the actual goal of unconditional generation and is harder to game through local predictability hacks.
summary_en.experiments:
The most important experimental result is the existence proof: on LM1B and OpenWebText, the zero-parameter naive samplers achieve gen-PPL numbers competitive with or better than recently published diffusion and flow-based language models, while maintaining non-degenerate empirical entropy. So this is not a trivial collapse case where the sampler repeats a few tokens. It passes the standard entropy guardrail and still produces poor text. That directly invalidates the common interpretation of low gen-PPL as evidence of high-quality generation.

A second important result is the clear decoupling between human-perceived quality and gen-PPL. Through examples and quantitative comparisons, the paper shows that sequences ranked highly by gen-PPL can be semantically weak or incoherent. This is not presented as a rare pathology but as a broad failure mode induced by the metric.

A third result comes from re-benchmarking recent non-AR models under distributional metrics. Once evaluated by sample-distribution similarity rather than scorer predictability, the picture of progress changes. Models that looked strong under gen-PPL do not necessarily remain strong, and models that better match human text distributions can be separated from those that merely exploit the scorer. The most informative thing to inspect is not the absolute ranking itself, but how rankings change between the old and new protocols.

From an experimental design standpoint, two details are worth noting. The paper uses both LM1B and OpenWebText, covering different text regimes, and it does more than criticize: it provides reproducible adversarial baselines plus an alternative protocol.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Start with the introduction and the formal discussion of what gen-PPL actually measures. The key point is that the paper is not arguing that GPT-2 is too weak as a scorer; it is arguing that the metric is misaligned with the target. Then read the section introducing the naive samplers and inspect the sample outputs carefully. That is where the intuition becomes concrete: why obviously bad text can still look good to the scorer. After that, move to the re-benchmarking section and compare model rankings under gen-PPL versus distributional metrics.

If time is limited, focus on three things: the definition and limitations of gen-PPL plus empirical entropy, the construction logic of the zero-parameter counterexamples, and the proposed distributional evaluation protocol. The most useful deeper questions are: what representation space the distributional metrics rely on, whether those metrics are sensitive to sample size or length distribution, and whether similar criticisms apply to other judge-model-based proxies used in language generation. For anyone working on new LM paradigms, this paper is best read as an evaluation sanity check before trusting benchmark tables.

recommendation.zh: 必须读。它不是在改模型，而是在拆你可能一直信的指标；若你做 diffusion/flow LM，先停下看它怎么 hack gen-PPL，再决定后面实验该不该重跑。
recommendation.en: Must read. It does not improve a model—it breaks a metric you may have been trusting; if you work on diffusion/flow LMs, inspect the gen-PPL hack before believing any leaderboard.

paper.title: Plug-and-Play Guidance for Discrete Diffusion Models via Gradient-Informed Logit Correction
paper.abstract: Controllable generation with discrete diffusion models is often hindered by high computational overhead or the need for retraining. In this paper, we present \underline{\textbf{G}}radient-\underline{\textbf{I}}nformed \underline{\textbf{L}}ogit \underline{\textbf{C}}orrection (\textbf{GILC}), a plug-and-play framework that efficiently estimates guidance signals by repurposing the pretrained denoising network as a variational proxy. To circumvent the gradient instability inherent in high-dimensio

summary.core_problem: 离散扩散模型的可控生成现有方案存在局限：分类器/无分类器引导、微调等方法需要额外训练阶段，泛化性差且计算成本高；现有即插即用引导方案受离散空间不可微特性限制，存在梯度不稳定、计算开销大、引导效果有限的问题。
summary.importance: 为离散扩散模型提供了一种无需重新训练的通用可控生成范式，对离散扩散在语言、生物序列等领域的落地应用有直接参考价值；其利用预训练去噪网络作为变分代理、直接修正logit的思路对离散生成模型的引导技术设计有启发。
summary.technical_approach: 提出梯度感知logit修正（GILC）即插即用引导框架：1. 将引导任务重构为估计中间状态的预期未来奖励值函数的梯度，复用预训练去噪网络作为变分代理进行值估计，无需额外训练组件。2. 结合Gumbel-Softmax和直通估计器维持离散空间的梯度流，同时引入无雅可比更新机制直接修正干净预测logit，解决离散空间梯度不稳定问题。3. 建立与策略梯度的形式化关联，让框架可以同时处理可微和不可微奖励函数。
summary.experiments: 在DNA序列设计、蛋白质序列工程、多模态分子生成三个跨领域任务上进行验证，GILC在样本质量和计算效率上均显著优于其他无训练的离散扩散引导方法，同时性能与基于微调的方法相当。
summary.reading_guide: 重点阅读引言部分的现有方法局限分析、方法部分的logit修正机制和策略梯度关联推导，附录A的相关工作对比可按需查阅，预计阅读时间25分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing controllable generation methods for discrete diffusion models have clear limitations: classifier/classifier-free guidance and fine-tuning require additional training stages, leading to poor generalizability and high computational cost; current plug-and-play guidance methods suffer from gradient instability, prohibitive computational overhead and limited steering effectiveness due to the inherent non-differentiability of discrete spaces.
summary_en.importance: This work provides a general training-free controllable generation paradigm for discrete diffusion models, with direct reference value for practical applications of discrete diffusion in domains like language and biological sequences. The ideas of reusing the pretrained denoising network as a variational proxy and directly correcting logits offer inspiration for the design of guidance techniques for discrete generative models.
summary_en.technical_approach: The Gradient-Informed Logit Correction (GILC) plug-and-play guidance framework is proposed: 1. The guidance task is reframed as estimating the gradient of the expected future reward value function from intermediate states, reusing the pretrained denoising network as a variational proxy for value estimation without additional training components. 2. The Gumbel-Softmax trick and Straight-Through estimator are combined to maintain gradient flow in discrete spaces, while a Jacobian-free update mechanism is introduced to directly correct clean prediction logits, resolving the gradient instability issue in discrete spaces. 3. A formal connection to policy gradients is established, enabling the framework to handle both differentiable and non-differentiable reward functions.
summary_en.experiments: Validated across three cross-domain tasks: DNA sequence design, protein sequence engineering, and multimodal molecular generation. GILC significantly outperforms other training-free discrete diffusion guidance methods in both sample quality and computational efficiency, and matches the performance of fine-tuning-based approaches.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on the analysis of limitations of existing methods in the introduction, the logit correction mechanism and policy gradient connection derivation in the method section. The related work comparison in Appendix A can be consulted as needed. Estimated reading time: 25 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 离散扩散即插即用引导的设计思路对研究diffusion LM推理控制有参考价值，重点看§3的无雅可比校正机制。
recommendation.en: The plug-and-play guidance design for discrete diffusion is informative for diffusion LM inference control research; focus on the Jacobian-free correction mechanism in §3.

paper.title: Knowledge Editing in Masked Diffusion Language Models
paper.abstract: Knowledge editing aims to update or correct factual knowledge in a language model. A widely used approach, locate-then-edit, does this in two steps: it first localizes a fact within the model, then edits the weights there. To date, such methods have been developed exclusively on autoregressive models (ARMs). Whether their underlying assumptions hold for masked diffusion models (MDMs), which model text bidirectionally and generate by iterative denoising rather than next-token prediction, remains

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文研究的是一个很具体但有代表性的问题：AR 语言模型上的 locate-then-edit 知识编辑方法，能不能直接迁移到 masked diffusion language model（MDM）上，以及如果不能，真正卡住的是“知识存在哪里”还是“生成过程怎么走”。作者没有停留在“把 ROME/MEMIT 搬过去试一试”，而是把问题拆成两层。第一层是定位层面：MDM 的事实回忆是否也集中在 early-to-mid layer、last subject token 的 MLP 上。第二层是执行层面：即便编辑位置相同，迭代去噪生成会不会让编辑在多 token 目标上失效。全文的核心结论是，位置假设可以迁移，但编辑效果不能直接迁移；MDM 的主要问题不是记忆位置变了，而是单状态拟合的编辑更新无法覆盖去噪过程中经历的一串 partial-mask states。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的意义主要有三点。第一，它给 diffusion / masked LM 这条非 AR 范式补上了一块机制分析：至少在 factual recall 的局部化上，MDM 和 ARM 比想象中更接近，说明某些“Transformer MLP 作为关联记忆”的解释并不依赖 next-token 训练目标。第二，它指出了一个很有价值的范式差异：同样的参数编辑，在 AR 中有效，在 MDM 中会随着目标 token 长度增长而系统性退化，原因来自生成轨迹而不是存储位置。这对理解 diffusion LM 的训练和推理接口很重要，因为它说明很多 AR 时代的方法不能只看网络结构兼容，还要看推理路径是否匹配。第三，它暴露了现有知识编辑 benchmark 的盲点：如果评测集以单 token object 为主，就会高估 MDM 上编辑方法的有效性。贡献量级上，这不是大规模系统工作，但在新型语言建模范式的可解释性和可编辑性上，信息密度很高。
summary.technical_approach:
技术路线分成三步，逻辑很完整。

第一步是把 locate-then-edit 框架尽量原样迁移到 MDM。作者比较了两类 AR 模型（LLaMA、Qwen）和两类 MDM（LLaDA、Dream），并尽量做 matched scale 对比。方法基础仍然沿用 ROME / MEMIT 的解释：Transformer MLP 的 down-projection 矩阵可视为线性关联记忆，last subject token 处的 up-projection activation 作为 key，value 编码 relation-object 信息；编辑就是在选定层的 MLP 权重上加入低秩或解析更新，使同一个 key 映射到新的 object 表征。对 MDM 的改动只限于适配 masked prediction，而不是重写编辑算法，这样实验结论更能回答“原有假设是否成立”。

第二步是做 causal tracing 和 edit-site sweep，区分“知识位置”和“编辑成效”两个问题。作者先用 causal tracing 看事实回忆对哪些层、哪些 token 位置最敏感，再系统扫描不同 token position 和 layer range 上的编辑效果。结果显示，即便 MDM 是双向建模、所有 token 都能看完整 subject，事实回忆最关键的位置仍然是 early-to-mid layer 的 last subject token MLP。这一点很关键，因为它说明 locate-then-edit 的位置假设并不是 AR 专属产物，而更像是 Transformer 在实体-关系检索上的一个稳定机制。
