paper.title: Self-Distilled Trajectory-Aware Boltzmann Modeling: Bridging the Training-Inference Discrepancy in Diffusion Language Models
paper.abstract: Diffusion Language Models (DLMs) have recently emerged as a promising alternative to autoregressive language models, offering stronger global awareness and highly parallel generation. However, post-training DLMs with standard Negative Evidence Lower Bound (NELBO)-based supervised fine-tuning remains inefficient: training reconstructs randomly masked tokens in a single step, whereas inference follows a confidence-guided, multi-step easy-to-hard denoising trajectory. Recent trajectory-based self-d

summary.core_problem: 这项工作解决 diffusion language model 后训练中的训练—推理不一致问题：训练时用 NELBO 做随机 mask 的单步重建，推理时却沿着置信度驱动的多步 easy-to-hard 去噪轨迹逐步解码。已有自蒸馏轨迹方法多用于压缩采样步数，能改善解码效率，但不一定提升完整 diffusion 解码下的模型能力，甚至可能带来性能下降。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的启发在于，它把 DLM 的后训练目标从“拟合答案 token”推进到“拟合推理时的熵结构”。这对非 AR 语言模型很关键：DLM 的能力瓶颈不只来自数据或模型规模，也来自训练目标是否能塑造正确的去噪顺序和不确定性地形。它不是新的基座预训练范式，但对 DLM 的 SFT、轨迹蒸馏、RL 替代目标设计有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 方法名为 TABOM，即 Trajectory-Aligned Optimization via Boltzmann Modeling。核心做法是先用基座 DLM 生成自蒸馏去噪轨迹，再把推理时的 unmask 分布建模为关于 token 理想预测熵的 Boltzmann 分布；低熵 token 应更早被确定，高熵 token 应更晚被处理。直接最小化全局 KL 难以操作，因此作者用 pairwise ranking surrogate 近似优化，要求轨迹中 token 的局部熵排序符合 easy-to-hard 解码顺序。相比普通 NELBO，这个目标不只是让模型重建被 mask token，而是让模型的熵梯度与实际解码过程一致。
summary.experiments: 实验基于 Dream DLM，在代码生成和数学推理上比较 ground-truth SFT 与 self-distilled trajectory SFT。代码数据从 Ling-Coder-SFT 随机采样 17K queries，数学数据来自 MixChain-Z-PRM12K；用 entropy-based decoding 生成有效自蒸馏轨迹，代码约 3.8K 条，数学约 5.1K 条。经验观察是，自蒸馏数据相对离线 GT 数据有更低优化障碍，但直接用标准 NELBO 微调只带来有限收益。TABOM 的实验主张是能把自蒸馏轨迹转化为更稳定的性能提升，同时保留 OOD 能力，缓解标准 SFT 常见的遗忘。作者还提出 Trajectory Discrimination Score，用来量化模型是否保留轨迹中的 token 级不确定性差异；Figure 2 和 Table 6 用于说明 TABOM 改变的是熵景观，而不是简单复用生成样本。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读 30–45 分钟。先看 Introduction 中对 NELBO、DLM 推理轨迹、RL 不适配性的分析，这是问题定义的核心。然后看 empirical observations 部分，重点理解 self-distilled data 为什么优化更容易、为什么 naive NELBO 仍然不够。技术部分优先读 Section 3.1 的 Boltzmann 建模和 Section 3.2 的 pairwise ranking 目标；实验部分看 Section 4.1 的性能与遗忘结果，以及 Figure 2、Table 6 对 TDS 的分析。

summary_en.core_problem: The work targets a concrete training-inference mismatch in diffusion language models. Standard NELBO-based SFT trains the model to reconstruct randomly masked tokens in one step, while inference follows a multi-step confidence-guided denoising path that reveals tokens from easy to hard.
summary_en.importance: Its main value for pretraining-oriented research is the objective-level view of DLM post-training. The paper argues that improving a DLM is not only about adding supervised targets or compressing sampling steps; the training loss should also shape the entropy ordering used at inference time. This is relevant to non-autoregressive language modeling, trajectory distillation, and possible alternatives to rollout-heavy RL for DLMs.
summary_en.technical_approach: The proposed method, TABOM, uses self-distilled denoising trajectories generated by the base DLM. It models the inference-time unmasking distribution as a Boltzmann distribution over ideal token-level predictive entropy, where easier low-entropy tokens should be selected earlier. Since the resulting global KL objective is not tractable in practice, the method uses a pairwise ranking surrogate that enforces local entropy order along the trajectory. This differs from ordinary NELBO fine-tuning because the target is not just token reconstruction, but alignment between the model’s uncertainty landscape and its actual decoding schedule.
summary_en.experiments: The experiments are conducted on the Dream diffusion language model for code generation and mathematical reasoning. The code setting samples 17K queries from Ling-Coder-SFT, and the math setting uses MixChain-Z-PRM12K. Entropy-based decoding yields about 3.8K valid self-distilled trajectories for code and about 5.1K for math. The paper reports that self-distilled trajectories have a lower optimization barrier than offline ground-truth data, but naive NELBO training gives only marginal gains. TABOM is reported to improve performance while preserving out-of-distribution capability and reducing forgetting. The Trajectory Discrimination Score is introduced to measure whether token-level uncertainty gaps along the denoising path are preserved; Figure 2 and Table 6 are the key references for this claim.
summary_en.reading_guide: A focused skim should take around 30–45 minutes. Start with the introduction for the mismatch between random masking and easy-to-hard inference, and for why outcome-reward RL is expensive and poorly aligned for DLMs. Then read the empirical observation section to understand why self-distilled trajectories help optimization but are insufficient under NELBO. The main technical parts are Section 3.1 on the Boltzmann formulation and Section 3.2 on the pairwise ranking surrogate. For results, prioritize Section 4.1, Figure 2, and Table 6.

recommendation.zh: 这篇值得看，因为它直指 DLM 最麻烦的 train-test mismatch；先看目标函数和 full-step decoding 结果，若提升只在压缩步数下成立，就当工程技巧看。
recommendation.en: Worth reading because it hits the core DLM train-test mismatch; inspect the objective and the full-step decoding results first—if gains only survive under compressed sampling, treat it as an engineering trick, not a modeling advance.

paper.title: DiffScore: Text Evaluation Beyond Autoregressive Likelihood
paper.abstract: Autoregressive language models are widely used for text evaluation, however, their left-to-right factorization introduces positional bias, i.e., early tokens are scored with only leftward context, conflating architectural asymmetry with true text quality. We propose masked reconstruction as an alternative paradigm, where every token is scored using full bidirectional context. We introduce DiffScore, an evaluation framework built on Masked Large Diffusion Language Models. By measuring text recove

summary.core_problem: 用 AR LM 的 left-to-right log-likelihood 做文本质量评估时，早期 token 只能看到左侧上下文，导致“位置偏置”（positional bias）与“方向不对称”（directional asymmetry）：评分里混入了架构因果掩码带来的信息不充分，而不完全是文本本身质量。论文要解决的是：能否用一种与生成质量更对齐、且天然双向的打分范式，替代 AR likelihood 作为通用 NLG evaluator。
summary.importance:
对预训练研究的价值不在于提出新训练目标，而在于把 diffusion/masked LM 的一个优势落到可量化的评估框架：同一段文本在不同 masking rate 下的“可恢复性”形成从局部流畅到全局一致的层级信号。这对两类工作有启发：
- diffusion/any-order LM：提供了一个更贴合其预训练目标（masked reconstruction/ELBO）的下游使用方式，而不是强行用 AR likelihood 的指标体系。
- 数据与训练动态：multi-timestep profile 把质量拆成不同上下文缺失程度下的曲线，可能用于诊断数据噪声、模板化、以及模型在局部/全局约束上的学习进度（虽然论文主要用于评估而非训练）。
summary.technical_approach:
DiffScore 把评估定义为 masked reconstruction：对候选文本在不同遮蔽强度下进行破坏，让模型用双向上下文去恢复被 mask 的 token；高质量文本应在多种 mask pattern 下都更“可恢复”。实现依托 Masked Large Diffusion Language Models（MDLLM），其 forward 过程是把 token 以概率 t 替换为吸收态 [M]，reverse 过程用无因果 mask 的 Transformer 预测被遮蔽位置。
- DiffScore-Zero：零样本，用 MDLLM 的 ELBO 作为分数。关键细节是 ELBO 里有 1/t 的重加权，用来抵消不同 t 下被 mask token 数量期望（约 tL）的变化，使不同 timestep 的贡献更可比。
- DiffScore-FT：不依赖 gold reference 的任务相关微调（论文强调“无参考”以隔离评估范式本身的贡献），把 evaluator 适配到特定任务分布。
- 诊断工具 1：multi-timestep quality profiles，把总分分解到不同 masking rate（t）上，形成曲线；低 t 更像局部流畅/短程一致性，高 t 更像全局结构/语义连贯。
- 诊断工具 2：bidirectional PMI decomposition，用双向条件概率构造 PMI 风格分解，把 fluency 与 faithfulness（或覆盖）拆成更独立的维度；论文主张这是 AR 框架结构上做不到的，因为 AR 的方向性会把两者耦合进同一个因子分解里。
与 BARTScore/GPTScore 的关键区别：不是换模型，而是换“评分因子分解方式”——从单一 left-to-right likelihood 变成跨遮蔽强度的可恢复性积分/分解，从而减少位置偏置与方向性伪影。
summary.experiments:
在 10 个基准（覆盖 summarization、MT、data-to-text）上：DiffScore-FT 在多数设置下优于 BARTScore；零样本条件下 DiffScore-Zero 优于 GPTScore（论文强调可复现、无需 API 与 prompt）。分析实验声称：位置偏置更低、方向一致性更强，并提供 profile/PMI 分解的可解释诊断。给定全文片段未包含具体相关系数（如 Kendall/Spearman）、分任务提升幅度、所用 MDLLM 规模与训练数据等关键数字；这些需要在实验章节核对，尤其是：
- DiffScore-Zero 用的 MDLLM checkpoint（参数量、训练语料、tokenizer）
- 与 AR evaluator 的公平性（是否同等规模/同等微调数据）
- profile 曲线在不同错误类型上的区分度（例如幻觉 vs 语法错误）。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议（约 35–60 分钟）：
- 先读 §1 和 §2.2，弄清 MDLLM 的 forward masking、reverse denoising、以及 ELBO 里 1/t 重加权的意义；这是 DiffScore-Zero 的核心。
- 重点看方法章节里“如何从多 timestep 聚合成单一分数”，以及 profile/PMI 分解的定义与实现细节（哪些条件概率、如何估计）。
- 实验部分优先找：与 BARTScore/GPTScore 的相关性对比表、位置偏置的定量度量方式、以及方向一致性（例如正反向评分一致性）实验。
- 如果只想抓住结论：看 Figure 1（方法直觉）+ 主要结果表 + 位置偏置分析小节即可。

summary_en.core_problem: Autoregressive (left-to-right) likelihood is widely used for NLG evaluation, but it inherently scores early tokens with impoverished context, creating positional bias and directional asymmetry. The paper asks whether text quality can be evaluated with a bidirectional, objective-aligned scoring paradigm that better reflects intrinsic recoverability/coherence rather than artifacts of causal factorization.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is primarily an evaluation paradigm, not a new pretraining objective. Its relevance to foundation-model pretraining is that it operationalizes a practical advantage of masked/diffusion LMs: scoring via masked reconstruction aligns with their training objective (ELBO / denoising) and yields multi-granularity signals across masking rates. The multi-timestep profile is also a potentially useful diagnostic lens for data/learning dynamics (local fluency vs global coherence), even though the paper applies it to evaluation rather than training.
summary_en.technical_approach:
DiffScore reframes evaluation as masked reconstruction. A candidate text is corrupted under varying masking rates, and a bidirectional model is asked to recover masked tokens; higher-quality text should be more confidently recoverable under diverse masking patterns.
- Backbone: Masked Large Diffusion Language Models (MDLLMs) with an absorbing mask token [M]. The forward process masks each token independently with probability t; the reverse model is a non-causal (bidirectional) Transformer predicting clean tokens at masked positions.
- DiffScore-Zero: zero-shot scoring using the MDLLM ELBO. A key detail is the 1/t reweighting term, compensating for the expected number of masked tokens (~tL) so that contributions across timesteps are comparable.
- DiffScore-FT: task-adaptive fine-tuning without gold references, intended to isolate the gain from the evaluation paradigm rather than reference-based supervision.
- Diagnostics: (1) multi-timestep quality profiles that decompose the score across masking rates (low t ≈ local fluency; high t ≈ global coherence), and (2) a bidirectional PMI-style decomposition to separate fluency vs faithfulness/coverage dimensions—argued to be structurally difficult for AR scoring due to directional coupling.
Core difference from BARTScore/GPTScore is not merely swapping models, but changing the scoring factorization: from a single left-to-right likelihood to a recoverability-based score aggregated over masking severities, reducing positional/directional artifacts.
summary_en.experiments: Across 10 benchmarks (summarization, MT, data-to-text), DiffScore-FT reportedly outperforms BARTScore in most settings, while DiffScore-Zero beats GPTScore in zero-shot evaluation, with the added benefit of being reproducible (open-weight MDLLMs, no API/prompting). The excerpt does not include the key numeric details (correlation metrics, per-task deltas, MDLLM size/checkpoint/data), which are important to validate: fairness vs AR baselines, the exact positional-bias metric, and whether profiles meaningfully separate error types (e.g., hallucination vs grammatical issues).
summary_en.reading_guide:
Skim plan (35–60 minutes):
- Read the Introduction and the MDLLM preliminaries to understand the masking/denoising setup and why ELBO with 1/t reweighting is the right zero-shot score.
- In the method section, focus on how scores are aggregated across timesteps and the exact definitions/estimators for the profile and bidirectional PMI decomposition.
- In experiments, prioritize the main correlation tables vs BARTScore/GPTScore, the quantitative positional-bias analysis, and the directional-consistency tests.
- For a fast pass: Figure 1 + main results table + the positional-bias analysis subsection.

recommendation.zh: 读 §方法和诊断图就够；它可能改变评估 loss 的默认选择，但成本和 evaluator 公平性要严查。
recommendation.en: Read the method and diagnostic plots; it may change the default choice of evaluation loss, but check cost and evaluator fairness carefully.

paper.title: How to Train Your Latent Diffusion Language Model Jointly With the Latent Space
paper.abstract: Latent diffusion models offer an attractive alternative to discrete diffusion for non-autoregressive text generation by operating on continuous text representations and denoising entire sequences in parallel. The major challenge in latent diffusion modeling is constructing a suitable latent space. In this work, we present the Latent Diffusion Language Model (LDLM), in which the latent encoder, diffusion model, and decoder are trained jointly. LDLM builds its latent space by reshaping the represe

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文解决的是连续潜空间 diffusion LM 的关键瓶颈：文本 latent 既要容易被扩散模型去噪，又要能稳定解码回 token。已有 latent diffusion LM 通常冻结一个预训练 encoder，把它的表示当作扩散空间；这样做训练简单，但 latent 并不是为 diffusion 目标优化的。直接端到端联合训练 encoder、diffusion model 和 decoder 又会带来退化，论文观察到的主要现象是生成多样性下降和 diffusion 质量变差。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的价值在于，它把“语言建模目标”和“表示空间构造”重新绑在一起。AR LM 的 token space 是固定的，离散 diffusion LM 也常受限于逐位置独立预测；连续 latent diffusion 如果要成为可扩展的语言建模范式，latent space 不能只是一个冻结 encoder 的副产物。LDLM 给出了一个可训练 recipe，说明 contextual latent 可以在联合训练中被塑造成更适合并行去噪的空间。贡献量级主要在建模范式和训练动态层面，而不是单一 benchmark 的增量改进。
summary.technical_approach: LDLM 使用两级编码。第一层是冻结的 GPT-2 token encoder，提取上下文 hidden states；第二层是可训练 latent encoder，把这些 hidden states 映射到 diffusion latent。扩散模型在该 latent 空间中做 Gaussian denoising，目标是从带噪 latent 预测干净 latent。解码也采用两级结构：先把 latent 解回语言模型表示空间，再映射到 token。关键点不是简单把 encoder 接到 diffusion model 前面，而是控制联合训练的梯度和重构约束。论文指出，朴素联合训练会让 latent 空间朝“扩散损失容易下降”的方向塌缩，但这种空间未必保留足够 token 信息，也未必支持多样生成。为此作者加入 MSE decoder loss，用连续表示重构约束稳定 decoder 与 latent geometry；同时加入 diffusion-to-encoder 方向的训练控制，避免扩散目标直接把 encoder 推到低信息或低多样性的解。这个设计和冻结 encoder 的 latent diffusion 不同：冻结方案依赖预训练表示的偶然适配性，LDLM 则让 latent encoder 在训练中重排表示，使其同时满足 denoising 和 decoding。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖 LM1B 和 OpenWebText。论文比较了多类文本 diffusion 空间，包括浅层 token embedding、冻结 contextual encoder 表示、以及联合学习的 contextual latent。主要结果是，联合学习的 contextual latent 在生成质量上优于这些替代方案，并且在同等或更好质量下比近期离散和连续 diffusion LM 快约 2 到 13 倍。消融重点显示：朴素端到端训练会产生低多样性样本；MSE decoder loss 对保持 latent 可解码性和训练稳定性有明显作用；diffusion 与 encoder 之间的梯度处理决定了模型是否会学到兼顾去噪与语义保真的 latent。论文还强调 few-step generation 的差异：离散 diffusion 每步通常按位置独立预测 token，少步生成质量容易受限；连续 latent diffusion 在最终解码前逐步细化整段表示，因此更适合并行修正。
summary.reading_guide: 建议精读 Introduction、Method、训练 recipe 和 ablation 部分。Introduction 里关于 discrete diffusion 的逐位置因子化问题，以及 frozen encoder latent 的局限，是理解论文动机的关键。Method 重点看两级 encoder/decoder 如何连接，尤其是哪些模块冻结、哪些模块训练。训练 recipe 和消融表需要细看：这里决定了“联合训练为什么会失败”以及“哪些约束让它重新可用”。实验部分建议重点看 LM1B、OpenWebText 主表、速度-质量对比图，以及不同 latent space 的比较。值得深挖的是 latent collapse 或低多样性背后的机制：扩散 MSE、latent 尺度、表示信息量、decoder 可逆性之间存在张力，这对后续设计非 AR 语言模型很有参考意义。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets the central failure mode of latent diffusion language models: the latent representation must be both denoisable by a diffusion model and reliably decodable into tokens. Prior systems usually freeze a pretrained text encoder and diffuse in its representation space. That is convenient, but the space is not optimized for diffusion. Naive end-to-end training of the encoder, diffusion model, and decoder also fails; the paper reports degraded diffusion quality and low-diversity generations.
summary_en.importance: The main relevance is in language modeling objectives and representation learning. If continuous diffusion is to be a serious alternative to left-to-right next-token modeling, the text latent space cannot remain an incidental byproduct of a pretrained encoder. LDLM shows that the latent space can be learned jointly with the generative objective, provided the training dynamics are controlled. This is a modeling contribution rather than a narrow benchmark improvement: it clarifies how denoising, decodability, and diversity interact in non-autoregressive text generation.
summary_en.technical_approach: LDLM uses a two-stage encoder. A frozen GPT-2 encoder first produces contextual hidden states. A trainable latent encoder then reshapes these hidden states into the continuous space used by Gaussian diffusion. The diffusion model learns to recover clean latents from noisy latents. Decoding is also staged: latents are mapped back toward the language-model representation space and then decoded into tokens. The important part is the training recipe. Directly propagating the diffusion objective through the whole encoder-decoder stack can produce latents that reduce denoising loss but lose useful information or diversity. The paper adds an MSE decoder loss to keep the latent space reconstructive and uses a controlled diffusion-to-encoder training path so that the encoder is shaped for diffusion without collapsing into a degenerate solution. This differs from frozen-encoder latent diffusion, where the model inherits a representation space trained for a different objective.
summary_en.experiments: The experiments are run on LM1B and OpenWebText. The paper compares shallow token embeddings, frozen contextual representations, and jointly learned contextual latents. The jointly learned latent space gives better generation quality than the alternatives and is reported to be about 2 to 13 times faster than recent discrete and continuous diffusion language models at comparable or better quality. The ablations are more informative than the headline numbers. Naive joint training leads to low-diversity outputs. The MSE decoder loss improves decodability and stabilizes the latent geometry. The way diffusion gradients interact with the encoder is critical: without this control, the learned space can become easy to denoise but poor for text generation. The results also support the paper’s broader claim that continuous latent diffusion is better suited to few-step parallel refinement than token-space discrete diffusion, where each denoising step often predicts positions independently.
summary_en.reading_guide: Read the motivation, method, and ablation sections carefully. The motivation section explains why discrete diffusion’s position-wise factorization limits high-quality few-step generation and why frozen encoder latents are not enough. In the method section, focus on which components are frozen, which are trained, and how the two-stage encoder and decoder are wired. The most important technical material is in the training recipe and ablations: those parts explain why joint training fails and which constraints make it work. In the results, prioritize the LM1B and OpenWebText quality-speed comparisons and the latent-space comparison tables. A useful follow-up question is how latent scale, reconstruction fidelity, denoising difficulty, and sample diversity trade off during training.

recommendation.zh: 应读训练 recipe 和 ablation；它把 latent LM 的失败点落到 joint training 动态，而不只是 tokenizer 选择。
recommendation.en: Read the training recipe and ablations; the useful signal is that latent-LM failure is about joint-training dynamics, not just tokenizer choice.

paper.title: Trajectory as the Teacher: Few-Step Discrete Flow Matching via Energy-Navigated Distillation
paper.abstract: Discrete flow matching generates text by iteratively transforming noise tokens into coherent language, but may require hundreds of forward passes. Distillation uses the multi-step trajectory to train a student to reproduce the process in a few steps. When the student underperforms, the usual explanation is insufficient capacity. We argue the opposite: the trajectory is the bottleneck, not the student. Each training trajectory is built through a chain of blind stochastic jumps with no evaluation

summary.core_problem: 离散流匹配（DFM）是可替代自回归LLM的新一代文本生成建模范式，但生成过程需要数百至上千次前向传播，推理速度比自回归模型慢多个数量级；现有少步蒸馏方案将教师模型的多步生成轨迹作为监督训练学生模型，但存在性能瓶颈：传统观点认为学生性能不足是模型容量不够，实际上瓶颈在于训练轨迹本身——轨迹构造过程中每个中间步的盲随机跳转会引入累积误差，劣质中间状态会传播到后续所有步骤，导致学生模型只能模仿存在偏差的低质量监督信号。
summary.importance: 首次将离散流匹配蒸馏的优化目标从学生模型容量转移到训练轨迹质量，突破了少步DFM的性能天花板；提出的导航塑形方法与现有蒸馏机制完全正交，可叠加在所有基于轨迹的离散生成蒸馏框架上，大幅缩小了少步非自回归生成模型与自回归LLM的推理速度差距与性能差距，为diffusion LM等非自回归范式的实际落地提供了关键支撑。
summary.technical_approach: 提出Trajectory-Shaped Discrete Flow Matching（TS-DFM），通过导航塑形机制优化训练轨迹的中间状态质量：1）生成感知能量罗盘：一个轻量级能量模型，基于生成相关的近负例（velocity near-miss negatives）训练，对部分生成的中间流状态的质量判别准确率达98.5%；2）序列到Token的两阶段导航策略：每个中间步生成K个候选续序列，先用能量罗盘全局选择最优候选，再基于速度置信度在token级别进一步优化；3）时间阈值τ：仅当流过程进行到足够晚的阶段、序列已形成初步语言结构时才激活导航塑形，避免早期无结构状态下罗盘无法有效判别的问题。所有塑形操作仅在训练阶段执行，推理阶段无额外开销。
summary.experiments: 在170M参数的语言建模任务上测试：采用均匀噪声源时，8步TS-DFM的困惑度达到56.1（以GPT-2为评估器），比FS-DFM降低36%，比1024步全步长教师模型还低32%，同时推理速度是教师模型的128倍；采用掩码源时，8步TS-DFM的性能是FS-DFM的5.6倍。TS-DFM超过Duo、SDTT等现有少步离散生成方法，在该领域取得最优困惑度。性能提升在GPT-2、LLaMA-2、LLaMA-3三个不同规模的评估器上均一致成立。训练阶段的塑形操作仅带来2.0-2.4倍的一次性训练开销。
summary.reading_guide: 精读§1和§2的动机分析部分，理解轨迹质量作为蒸馏瓶颈的核心论证；精读§3的导航塑形机制设计，重点关注能量罗盘的训练方法、序列到Token的两阶段选择策略、时间阈值τ的设计逻辑；§4的核心结果与跨评估器的泛化性实验、不同源分布（均匀/掩码）的性能对比需要重点关注；附录中的超参设置、候选数量K和阈值τ的消融实验可作为落地参考。

summary_en.core_problem: Discrete Flow Matching (DFM) is a new generation text generation paradigm that can replace autoregressive LLMs, but its generation process requires hundreds to thousands of forward passes, making inference speed orders of magnitude slower than autoregressive models. Existing few-step distillation schemes use the multi-step generation trajectories of the teacher model as supervision to train the student, but face a performance bottleneck: conventional wisdom attributes poor student performance to insufficient model capacity, but the actual bottleneck is the training trajectory itself—blind stochastic jumps at each intermediate step during trajectory construction introduce cumulative errors, and degraded intermediate states propagate to all subsequent steps, forcing the student to imitate biased low-quality supervision signals.
summary_en.importance: This work shifts the optimization target of discrete flow matching distillation from student model capacity to training trajectory quality for the first time, breaking through the performance ceiling of few-step DFM. The proposed navigation shaping method is fully orthogonal to existing distillation mechanisms and can be applied on top of all trajectory-based discrete generation distillation frameworks. It significantly narrows the inference speed and performance gap between few-step non-autoregressive generation models and autoregressive LLMs, providing critical support for the practical deployment of non-autoregressive paradigms such as diffusion LMs.
summary_en.technical_approach: Trajectory-Shaped Discrete Flow Matching (TS-DFM) is proposed to optimize the intermediate state quality of training trajectories through a navigation shaping mechanism: 1) Generation-aware energy compass: a lightweight energy model trained on generation-relevant velocity near-miss negatives, achieving 98.5% accuracy in judging the quality of partially generated intermediate flow states. 2) Two-phase sequence-to-token navigation policy: generate K candidate continuations at each intermediate step, first select the best candidate globally with the energy compass, then further refine it at the token level based on velocity confidence. 3) Time threshold τ: navigation shaping is only activated at sufficiently late flow stages when preliminary linguistic structure has emerged in the sequence, avoiding the problem that the compass cannot effectively discriminate among unstructured early states. All shaping operations are performed only during training, with no extra overhead at inference.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluated on 170M-parameter language modeling tasks: with a uniform noise source, 8-step TS-DFM achieves a perplexity of 56.1 (evaluated against GPT-2), a 36% reduction over FS-DFM and 32% lower than the full 1024-step teacher model, while being 128× faster than the teacher at inference. With a mask source, 8-step TS-DFM outperforms FS-DFM by 5.6×. TS-DFM outperforms existing few-step discrete generation methods such as Duo and SDTT, achieving the best perplexity in this field. Performance improvements are consistent across three evaluators of increasing scale: GPT-2, LLaMA-2, and LLaMA-3. Shaping operations during training only introduce a one-time 2.0–2.4× training overhead.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on the motivation analysis in §1 and §2 to understand the core argument that trajectory quality is the bottleneck of distillation. Read the navigation shaping mechanism design in §3 carefully, paying special attention to the training method of the energy compass, the two-phase sequence-to-token selection policy, and the design logic of the time threshold τ. Pay attention to the core results in §4, generalization experiments across evaluators, and performance comparisons across different source distributions (uniform/mask). Hyperparameter settings and ablation studies on candidate number K and threshold τ in the appendix provide practical references for implementation.

recommendation.zh: 真正有insight的工作——结论完全反常识：离散流匹配蒸馏的瓶颈是轨迹质量而非学生容量。能量罗盘导航方案简洁有效，6步击败基线16步的结果很有说服力，应纳入所有离散生成建模的设计考量。
recommendation.en: A genuinely insightful work—counterintuitive conclusion that trajectory quality (not student capacity) is the bottleneck in discrete flow matching distillation. Clean energy-compass navigation scheme; 6 steps beating baseline 16 steps is convincing. Should inform all discrete generative modeling design.

paper.title: Towards Closing the Autoregressive Gap in Language Modeling via Entropy-Gated Continuous Bitstream Diffusion
paper.abstract: Diffusion language models (DLMs) promise parallel, order-agnostic generation, but on standard benchmarks they have historically lagged behind autoregressive models in sample quality and diversity. Recent continuous flow and diffusion approaches over token embeddings have narrowed this gap, suggesting continuous state spaces are highly effective for language. In this work, we further close the autoregressive gap by modeling text as a continuous diffusion process over fixed-width binary bitstreams

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作要解决的不是“如何再做一个 diffusion LM”，而是连续扩散语言模型长期存在的两类耦合问题：一是生成质量和自回归模型之间仍有明显差距，二是很多看起来不错的 GenPPL 改善其实来自熵塌缩，即模型偏向安全高频 token，样本分布过窄。作者的切入点很明确：问题未必在于语言必须离散建模，而更可能在于状态表示、训练目标和采样器三者没有配平。为此，他们把文本从 token/embedding 空间改写为固定宽度 bitstream 的连续扩散过程，希望同时改善建模效率、输出头复杂度，以及采样时的熵控制。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的意义主要有三层。第一，它进一步支持了一个越来越清楚的判断：语言建模未必被 next-token AR 独占，连续扩散范式在合适表示和采样设计下，已经能进入 AR 的质量区间。第二，它把“采样器设计”从 diffusion LM 的次要工程细节，提升成决定质量-熵 Pareto 前沿的核心变量。文中最强的提升并不来自更大的模型或更复杂的目标，而是来自 entropy-rate grid 上的随机采样修正。第三，bitstream 表示把输出层从 O(V) 压到 O(log V)，这对大词表、长上下文、多模态离散 token 统一建模都很有启发，因为这类场景里 vocabulary head 往往是训练和生成的真实瓶颈。若后续结果可复现，这篇工作对 diffusion LM 的价值不只是“再提一点分数”，而是给出了一条更像可扩展预训练路线的设计组合：bit-level continuous state + residual posterior parameterization + entropy-aware stochastic sampler。
summary.technical_approach:
方法上有三个关键部件。

第一是 bitstream 表示。作者先把语义 token 编码成固定宽度二进制序列，每个 token 用 m 个 bit 表示。LM1B 上用 T=128、m=15；OpenWebText 上用固定 1024 个 code token、m=16。扩散不是在词嵌入或 simplex 上做，而是在这些 bit 的连续模拟值上做 variance-exploding Gaussian corruption。这样做的直接好处是输出头不再需要对整个词表做分类，而是对 bit 做紧凑预测；如果把 m 个 bit patch 成一个 sequence element，语义长度 T 不变，但每步输出复杂度从词表大小 V 变成 log V 量级。

第二是 matched-filter residual parameterization。单个 bit 在高斯噪声下的后验是有解析形式的，因此网络没必要重复学习“独立 bit 在噪声下如何恢复”这种容易写出公式的部分。作者把这个解析 posterior 先算出来，再让网络只预测 contextual residual，也就是上下文依赖带来的偏移项。这个设计和很多 diffusion/flow 模型里“把容易的部分解析化、把模型容量留给相关结构”的思路一致，但这里落在 bit posterior 上，针对性很强。它的价值不只是省参数，更重要的是把学习目标从低层噪声恢复，转向 token 间依赖和语义约束。

第三是采样器。作者反复强调，真正把前沿推上去的是 stochastic churn，而不是单纯的 deterministic probability-flow ODE。确定性采样已经能给出还不错的 GenPPL，但会过度收缩，导致 token entropy 偏低。为了解决这个问题，他们在 entropy-rate sampling grid 上加入 EDM 风格的 Langevin-type 随机修正，并比较了 full-band stochasticity 等设置。直觉上，这个 grid 会把求解器分辨率集中在 bit 不确定性快速消解的区域，而随机扰动在这些区域也最有效，因此能在不增加 NFE 的情况下把样本分布从“过于保守”拉回更接近真实数据熵。这个点很重要，因为它说明 diffusion LM 的评估不能只看 GenPPL，必须同时看 entropy，否则容易把 mode-seeking 误判成建模进步。

从与已有方法的区别看，早期离散 diffusion LM 更强调离散转移核；近期连续方法多在 one-hot embedding/simplex 上做 flow 或 diffusion。这里的不同在于：表示层退到 bit 级，输出头复杂度显著下降；目标层把独立 bit posterior 解析化；采样层明确围绕熵失真做修正，而不是只优化数值求解误差。这三点组合起来，构成了文章真正的新意。
summary.experiments:
实验里最关键的不是单点最优值，而是 GenPPL–entropy 前沿的整体移动。

在 LM1B 上，确定性 256-NFE 采样器达到 GenPPL 82.90、entropy 4.30，已经与先前连续 DLM 接近；加入 full-band stochasticity 后，在几乎匹配真实数据熵 4.31 的条件下，GenPPL 提升到 59.76。文中给出的对比是：LangFlow 报告的 GenPPL 为 92.24，而 AR baseline 为 66.70。也就是说，这个模型不仅比已有连续 DLM 明显更好，而且在匹配熵的前提下进入并超过了该 AR 基线所在区间。

在 OpenWebText 上，确定性采样得到 GenPPL 46.32、entropy 5.13；加入 full-band stochasticity 后提升到 GenPPL 27.06、entropy 5.26。对比 LangFlow 的 36.53（entropy 5.25），作者的方法在更少的 256 NFE 下完成了更好的前沿位置，而对方使用的是 1024 NFE。这个结果说明改进不只是“多采样步数换质量”，而是采样机制本身更合适。

效率方面，bitstream 设计带来很实在的系统收益。LM1B 规模下，相比匹配的 token-space 模型，峰值显存下降 1.6×，训练吞吐提升 2.3×。到 OpenWebText 规模，这个优势扩大到训练吞吐 3.3×、生成显存 19× 降低。这个趋势符合方法结构：词表越大、序列越长，O(V) 输出头越吃亏，bitwise head 的收益越明显。

从消融逻辑看，文章最值得注意的结论是：full-band stochasticity 是主要增益来源；deterministic sampler 虽然能给出不错的 GenPPL，但容易牺牲熵；entropy-rate grid 与随机修正是配套设计，不是两个独立小技巧。若正文和附录里还有 band-limited churn、不同 grid、不同 residual parameterization 的对比，这些部分会直接决定方法是否稳健，而不是只在某个采样配置上有效。
summary.reading_guide:
这篇适合按“表示—参数化—采样—评估”四条线来读。

先看 Introduction 和 Figure 2。重点不是记住数值，而是理解作者如何把问题定义成 GenPPL 与 entropy 的双目标，而不是单一困惑度优化。只要接受这个评估框架，后面很多设计就顺了。

然后看 Method 里 bitstream 表示和 matched-filter residual parameterization。这里要弄清两个问题：为什么 bit posterior 可以解析求；为什么让网络只学 residual 会更适合语言上下文建模。若附录给了推导，建议顺手看完，因为这是方法是否“只是换个编码”还是“真正改变学习负担分配”的分界点。

第三部分重点看采样器设计，尤其 entropy-rate grid、stochastic churn、continuous-time interpretation。这里是全文最有信息量的地方。建议对照 deterministic 与 stochastic 的前沿图一起看，理解作者所谓 over-contractive sampler 到底表现为什么现象。

实验部分优先看：1）LM1B 和 OpenWebText 的 GenPPL–entropy 曲线；2）NFE 固定时不同采样器的比较；3）效率表，特别是输出头带来的显存和吞吐变化。如果时间有限，30-40 分钟可以抓住主线；如果要判断是否值得复现，附录里关于采样超参、bit patching、解码方式和 entropy 估计方法必须细读。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets a specific failure mode of diffusion language models rather than proposing yet another variant. Continuous DLMs have recently improved, but they still tend to trail autoregressive models in sample quality, and some apparent gains in generative perplexity come from entropy collapse: the model becomes overly conservative and overproduces frequent tokens. The authors argue that the bottleneck is not simply “language must be modeled discretely.” Instead, the gap comes from a poor match between representation, objective parameterization, and sampler behavior. Their solution is to model text as continuous diffusion over fixed-width binary bitstreams, then redesign both the denoiser target and the sampler around that representation.
summary_en.importance: This matters for pretraining research in three ways. First, it strengthens the case that autoregressive next-token modeling is not the only scalable route for language generation. With the right continuous state space and sampler, diffusion can operate in the same quality regime. Second, it elevates sampler design from an implementation detail to a first-order modeling choice. The largest gains here come from entropy-aware stochastic correction, not from scaling the network or changing the training loss in a superficial way. Third, the bitstream formulation removes the vocabulary-sized output bottleneck and replaces it with a logarithmic bitwise head. That is relevant beyond text-only DLMs: large vocabularies, long contexts, and multimodal token spaces all suffer from expensive O(V) output layers. If the results hold up, the contribution is less about a benchmark bump and more about a plausible recipe for scalable non-AR pretraining: bit-level continuous states, analytic posterior factoring, and entropy-calibrated stochastic sampling.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The method has three main components.

First, the representation. Each semantic token is encoded as a fixed-width binary code of m bits, and diffusion is performed over continuous analog versions of those bits under a variance-exploding Gaussian corruption process. On LM1B the setup uses T=128 and m=15; on OpenWebText it uses a fixed 1024-code-token representation with m=16. The model denoises all positions in parallel from Gaussian noise. Compared with token-space or simplex-space diffusion, this changes the output layer fundamentally: instead of predicting over the full vocabulary, the model predicts compact bitwise quantities, reducing the output complexity from O(V) to O(log V) when bits are patched appropriately.

Second, the matched-filter residual parameterization. For an isolated bit corrupted by Gaussian noise, the posterior has a closed form. The model therefore does not need to spend capacity relearning that independent-bit denoising rule. The analytic posterior is computed explicitly, and the network predicts only the contextual residual on top of it. This is a targeted decomposition: the easy local denoising part is handled analytically, while the network focuses on dependencies induced by context and semantics. That is a stronger claim than a mere reparameterization trick, because it changes what the model is asked to learn.

Third, the sampler. This is the most consequential part of the paper. A deterministic probability-flow sampler is already competitive, but the authors show that it is over-contractive: it can improve GenPPL by shrinking sample entropy below the data distribution. To correct this, they introduce EDM-style stochastic churn with Langevin-like corrections, applied on an entropy-rate sampling grid. The intuition is that the grid allocates solver resolution to the region where bit uncertainty is actually resolved, and stochasticity is most useful in exactly that region. As a result, the model can move to a better GenPPL–entropy frontier without increasing the NFE budget.

Relative to prior work, the novelty is not just “continuous diffusion for language.” Earlier discrete DLMs focused on discrete transition kernels; recent continuous methods often diffuse over one-hot embeddings or simplex states. This paper instead moves to bit-level states, analytically factors out independent-bit posteriors, and treats entropy-preserving stochastic sampling as a core design principle.
summary_en.experiments:
The key experimental story is the movement of the GenPPL–entropy frontier, not a single best score.

On LM1B, the deterministic 256-NFE sampler reaches GenPPL 82.90 at entropy 4.30, already competitive with recent continuous DLMs. Adding full-band stochasticity improves this to GenPPL 59.76 at matched real-data entropy 4.31. The paper compares this against LangFlow at 92.24 and an autoregressive baseline at 66.70. So the gain is not achieved by collapsing entropy; it reaches the AR quality regime while maintaining healthy token entropy.

On OpenWebText, the deterministic sampler gives GenPPL 46.32 at entropy 5.13, and full-band stochasticity improves it to 27.06 at entropy 5.26. LangFlow is reported at 36.53 with entropy 5.25, using 1024 NFEs, whereas this method uses 256 NFEs. That suggests the improvement is not simply due to more solver steps.

The systems results are also notable. Relative to a matched token-space model, the bitstream setup yields a 1.6× reduction in peak memory and 2.3× higher training throughput at LM1B scale. At OpenWebText scale, the gains grow to 3.3× training throughput and a 19× reduction in generation memory footprint. This scaling trend is exactly what the architecture predicts: the larger the vocabulary and the longer the sequence, the more painful the dense vocabulary head becomes.

The most important ablation-level takeaway is that full-band stochasticity is the main driver of the improved frontier. Deterministic sampling can look good on GenPPL alone but tends to under-shoot entropy. The entropy-rate grid and stochastic correction appear to work as a coupled design, not as two unrelated tweaks. Any serious reproduction effort should inspect the appendix for sensitivity to churn bands, grid choice, residual parameterization, and entropy estimation.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Read this paper along four threads: representation, parameterization, sampling, and evaluation.

Start with the introduction and the main frontier plots. The important shift is conceptual: the paper evaluates diffusion LMs using both generative perplexity and sample entropy. Once that framing is clear, the rest of the design choices make more sense.

Then move to the bitstream formulation and the matched-filter residual parameterization. The critical question is why the independent-bit posterior can be handled analytically and why forcing the network to learn only the contextual residual should improve capacity allocation. If the appendix includes the derivation, it is worth reading carefully.

Next, spend time on the sampler section, especially the entropy-rate grid, stochastic churn, and the continuous-time interpretation. This is where the paper is most informative. Compare the deterministic and stochastic frontiers directly and ask what “over-contractive” means operationally.

In the experiments, prioritize: (1) the GenPPL–entropy curves on LM1B and OpenWebText, (2) fixed-NFE comparisons across samplers, and (3) the efficiency tables showing memory and throughput gains from the bitwise output head. A quick pass takes about 30–40 minutes. A deeper pass should include the appendix details on sampling hyperparameters, bit patching, decoding, and entropy measurement, because those determine whether the method is robust or narrowly tuned.

recommendation.zh: 值得看采样器的“熵率门控”思路：把随机性预算集中到高信息片段很可能是 DLM 追 AR 的关键，但需警惕只在 LM1B/小规模下成立。
recommendation.en: Read for the entropy-rate–gated sampler: allocating stochasticity only where information is high may be a real lever for DLMs, but treat the LM1B/small-scale evidence as a weak signal until replicated.

paper.title: Guidance Is Not a Hyperparameter: Learning Dynamic Control in Diffusion Language Models
paper.abstract: Classifier-Free Guidance (CFG) is a widely used mechanism for controlling diffusion-based generative models, yet its guidance scale is typically treated as a fixed hyperparameter throughout generation. This static design yields a suboptimal controllability and quality tradeoff, as the optimal degree of guidance varies across tasks and across different stages of the diffusion process, especially in NLP domain. We recast CFG scale selection as a sequential decision-making problem and propose to le

summary.core_problem: 扩散语言模型里 CFG（classifier-free guidance）的 guidance scale 通常被当作一个全程固定的超参，但扩散采样是分步的：不同 step 对“可控性 vs 生成质量”的需求不同，且不同任务的最优 guidance 行为也不同。论文要解决的是：能否把 guidance scale 的选择从静态调参，改成一个随扩散状态演化的序列决策问题，并用任务级奖励直接学出动态 guidance 轨迹。
summary.importance: 对“新型语言建模范式（diffusion LM）+ post-train 信号”的接口更相关：它把扩散采样中的控制变量（CFG scale）显式纳入 RL 优化，提供了一条把不可微/延迟的任务目标（关键词命中、情感一致、长度约束等）反馈到采样过程控制的路径。对基座预训练本身的直接影响有限（不改模型参数、不改预训练目标），但对 diffusion LM 的可控生成、以及“采样策略可学习化”这类方向有启发：很多被当作 sampling 超参的东西，其实可以被当作 policy 来学。
summary.technical_approach:
把每个扩散 step 的 guidance scale 视为离散动作：状态是当前扩散生成状态（随 step 演化的中间表示/噪声态，文中表述为 evolving diffusion state），动作为从一组离散 guidance scale 候选中选择一个值；整条采样轨迹结束后，根据任务定义给出 episode-level reward。用 PPO 训练一个 task-specific 的 guidance policy，学习“在不同 step 应该多强地依赖条件信息”。
论文强调学习的是任务级的典型 guidance 轨迹，而不是 per-instance 自适应（避免需要更细粒度的在线反馈、也降低对单条轨迹噪声的过拟合风险）。底座模型选用离散扩散 LM（LLaDA）。对比对象包括固定 scale 和一些启发式 schedule（如指数曲线、Beta 形状等），这些方法要么全局固定、要么与生成状态无关。
summary.experiments:
实验围绕三类 NLP 可控生成任务：关键词条件句子生成、情感控制风格迁移、长度控制改写；在 LLaDA 上进行。主要比较“学到的动态 guidance trajectory”与“固定 guidance scale / 手工 schedule”在可控性与质量上的权衡。
从引言可确认的结论是：静态 scale 存在结构性不匹配；RL 学到的轨迹在不同任务上呈现不同的 step-wise guidance 行为，并带来更好的 controllability–quality tradeoff。当前给出的全文片段未包含具体指标与数值表格，因此无法在不臆测的前提下复述提升幅度或统计显著性。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议（约 25-35 分钟）：
- 先看 Introduction 对问题设定的动机：为什么“固定超参”在扩散采样里天然不匹配，以及为什么启发式 schedule 不够。
- 重点看方法部分对 MDP 的定义：状态包含哪些扩散变量、动作空间如何离散化、reward 如何设计、PPO 的训练细节（episode 长度、探索、稳定性技巧）。
- 结果部分建议只抓两点：不同任务学到的 guidance 轨迹形状是否一致；以及与固定 scale/手工 schedule 的对比是否主要来自“早期更强/后期更弱”这类可解释规律。
- 如果要复现或迁移到别的 ddLM，优先核对：动作离散粒度、reward 的可计算性与噪声、以及 policy 是否与 base model 解耦（是否需要额外前向/开销）。

summary_en.core_problem: In diffusion language models, classifier-free guidance (CFG) is usually controlled by a single fixed guidance scale for the entire sampling trajectory. This is structurally mismatched with diffusion sampling: the optimal controllability–quality tradeoff can vary across diffusion steps and across tasks. The paper formulates guidance-scale selection as a sequential decision problem and aims to learn a dynamic guidance trajectory that optimizes task-level outcomes.
summary_en.importance: This is more about diffusion-LM sampling/control than core pretraining. The value is in making a common “sampling hyperparameter” learnable via RL under sparse, delayed, and often non-differentiable task rewards (keyword satisfaction, sentiment control, length constraints). It suggests a general pattern: for diffusion LMs, parts of the sampling procedure that are traditionally hand-tuned (CFG scale schedules) can be treated as policies and optimized directly for downstream controllability objectives, potentially improving robustness across tasks without manual schedule engineering.
summary_en.technical_approach: The guidance scale is modeled as a discrete action chosen at each diffusion step based on the current diffusion state. An episode corresponds to a full sampling trajectory; a task-specific reward is computed at the end of generation. A PPO-trained policy learns step-wise guidance decisions, producing task-specific guidance trajectories rather than per-instance adaptation (to reduce reliance on instance-level intermediate feedback and mitigate overfitting to noisy single-trajectory outcomes). The underlying generator is a discrete diffusion LM (LLaDA). Baselines include fixed guidance scales and heuristic schedules (e.g., exponential/Beta-shaped), which are pre-specified and state-agnostic.
summary_en.experiments: Experiments are conducted on three controllable NLP generation settings: keyword-conditioned sentence generation, sentiment-controlled style transfer, and length-controlled sentence rewriting, using LLaDA as the base ddLM. The evaluation focuses on the controllability–quality tradeoff, comparing learned dynamic guidance trajectories against fixed-scale CFG and hand-crafted schedules. The provided full-text excerpt does not include the quantitative tables/metrics, so specific numeric gains cannot be reported without guessing.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Skim plan (25–35 min):
- Read the Introduction for the core argument: why a single global CFG scale is a poor fit for step-wise diffusion dynamics, and why heuristic schedules are insufficient.
- In the method section, focus on the MDP specification: what constitutes the state, how the action space (guidance scales) is discretized, reward definitions per task, and PPO stabilization details.
- In results, look for: whether learned trajectories differ meaningfully across tasks, and whether improvements can be explained by interpretable stage-wise behaviors (e.g., stronger guidance early vs later).
- For reproducibility/transfer, verify the compute overhead (extra policy forward passes), sensitivity to action discretization granularity, and reward noise handling.

recommendation.zh: 做Diffusion LM可控生成优化的研究者可看§4的实验部分，动态CFG设计可迁移到其他扩散LM训练中
recommendation.en: Researchers working on controllable Diffusion LM generation can refer to §4 experiments for dynamic CFG design references for other diffusion LM training

paper.title: GPO-V: Jailbreak Diffusion Vision Language Model by Global Probability Optimization
paper.abstract: Diffusion Vision-Language Models (dVLMs), built upon the non-causal foundations of Diffusion Large Language Models (dLLMs), have demonstrated remarkable efficacy in multimodal tasks by departing from the traditional autoregressive generation paradigm. While dVLMs appear inherently robust against conventional jailbreak tactics, which we categorize as Fixed Prefix Optimization (FPO) (e.g., anchoring responses with "Sure, here is"), this perceived resilience is deceptive. Our investigation into the

summary.core_problem: 现有针对自回归VLM的越狱攻击方法对扩散范式的视觉语言模型（dVLM）失效，且dVLM的拒绝机制和潜在安全漏洞尚未得到系统分析。
summary.importance: 揭示了扩散多模态模型的安全对齐不能直接照搬自回归模型的思路，扩散的全局迭代生成特性带来了新的攻击面和对齐需求，为后续dVLM的安全对齐训练提供了明确的问题指向和攻击基线。
summary.technical_approach: 首先识别出dVLM的两种特有拒绝模式：立即拒绝（在掩码序列中反向生成终止token）和渐进拒绝（迭代初期生成肯定表述，后续逐步转向拒绝）。针对传统固定前缀优化（FPO）仅操纵序列开头、不适应扩散全局 refinement 特性的缺陷，提出全局概率优化（GPO）策略，直接调整整个生成序列的全局概率分布，最大化合规响应的概率同时最小化拒绝响应的概率，基于此构建GPO-V越狱攻击框架。
summary.experiments: 评估结果显示GPO-V的越狱成功率最高达到93.2%，远超过基于FPO的基线方法，验证了针对扩散全局生成特性设计的攻击方法的有效性。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读优先看引言部分对两种拒绝模式的定义和对比图示，方法部分GPO与FPO的核心差异，以及实验部分的成功率对比数据，预计阅读时间15-20分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing jailbreak attacks designed for autoregressive VLMs are ineffective for diffusion-based vision-language models (dVLMs), and the refusal mechanisms as well as potential security vulnerabilities of dVLMs have not been systematically analyzed.
summary_en.importance: It demonstrates that safety alignment for diffusion multimodal models cannot directly replicate approaches for autoregressive models. The global iterative generation property of diffusion introduces new attack surfaces and alignment requirements, providing clear problem orientation and attack baseline for future dVLM safety alignment research.
summary_en.technical_approach: Two distinct refusal patterns of dVLMs are first identified: Immediate Refusal, where the model generates termination tokens in a back-to-front manner in masked sequences, and Progressive Refusal, where the model produces affirmative tokens at early iterations then gradually shifts to refusal responses. Unlike conventional Fixed Prefix Optimization (FPO) that only manipulates the prefix of sequences, the proposed Global Probability Optimization (GPO) strategy directly adjusts the global probability distribution of the entire generated sequence, maximizing the likelihood of compliant responses while minimizing that of refusal responses. The GPO-V jailbreak framework is built upon this strategy.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluations show GPO-V achieves a maximum jailbreak success rate of 93.2%, significantly outperforming FPO-based baselines, verifying the effectiveness of attack methods tailored to the global generation property of diffusion models.
summary_en.reading_guide: For casual reading, first review the definition and illustration of two refusal patterns in the introduction, then the core difference between GPO and FPO in the methodology section, and the success rate comparison in experiments. Estimated reading time: 15-20 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 值得看的不是 jailbreak 数字，而是它把 dLLM 的拒答过程拆成两阶段；只看 refusal taxonomy 和 GPO 目标定义，就够你判断 diffusion LM 的安全 prior 要不要改。
recommendation.en: The useful part is not the jailbreak score but the two-stage refusal dynamics; read the refusal taxonomy and GPO objective to decide whether your safety prior for diffusion LMs needs updating.

paper.title: DiffRetriever: Parallel Representative Tokens for Retrieval with Diffusion Language Models
paper.abstract: PromptReps showed that an autoregressive language model can be used directly as a retriever by prompting it to generate dense and sparse representations of a query or passage. Extending this to multiple representatives is inefficient for autoregressive models, since tokens must be generated sequentially, and prior multi-token variants did not reliably improve over single-token decoding.   We show that the bottleneck is sequential generation, not the multi-token idea itself. DiffRetriever is a re

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作要解决的不是“检索能不能用 LLM 做”，而是一个更具体也更关键的问题：把语言模型当 retriever 时，单个代表 token 往往过于压缩，多 token 表示理论上更接近 late-interaction 检索器，但在自回归模型里，多 token 需要逐步生成，编码延迟随 token 数线性增长，而且先前工作里效果也不稳定。作者想验证，瓶颈到底是“多 token 表示本身没用”，还是“AR 顺序生成把这个想法做坏了”。他们给出的答案是后者：如果换成 diffusion LM，用并行 masked-position prediction 一次性读出 K 个代表位置，多 token 检索就能稳定带来收益。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的意义主要有两层。第一，它给 diffusion LM 提供了一个很贴近预训练目标的下游用法：不是把 diffusion backbone 当普通 encoder 做 mean pooling，而是直接利用其“并行填 mask”的原生接口来产出检索表示。这一点很重要，因为很多 diffusion LM 工作在评测时会退化成 BERT 式编码器，难以回答这种建模范式本身到底带来了什么。第二，这篇工作把“并行生成多个表示位点”这个能力和检索效果、延迟特性直接连起来，说明 diffusion/非 AR 范式的价值不只在生成，也可能体现在表示学习和 serving 形态上。贡献量级不在于提出全新检索框架，而在于把 diffusion LM 的训练-推理一致性优势落到一个可测、可复现、且和 AR 有清晰对照的任务上。
summary.technical_approach:
方法延续 PromptReps 的基本思路：通过提示词让模型“用几个词表示 query 或 passage”，然后从回答位置抽取 hidden states 作为 dense representation、抽取 logits 作为 sparse representation，再用这些表示去做检索打分。真正的改动集中在表示的产生方式。

对于 AR backbone，代表 token 是在 assistant 前缀后按从左到右生成的，生成多少个 token 就要跑多少步前向，成本随 token 数增加。对于 diffusion backbone，作者把 prompt 改写成固定长度，在末尾追加 K 个 [MASK] 位置和闭合 token，让模型在双向注意力下同时预测这 K 个位置。这样每个 mask 位都能看到完整前缀、其他 mask 位以及结束符，K 个位置的 hidden state 和 logits 可以在一次前向里同时读出。

这里有两个设计点值得注意。第一，作者强调自己是在“按模型预训练时的方式使用 diffusion LM”。这和 DiffEmbed、pplx-embed 这类把 diffusion 模型当 encoder 做池化的路线不同，后者没有真正利用 masked-position prediction 这个训练目标。第二，query 和 passage 的预算 Kq、Kp 需要预先固定，因为 diffusion 序列长度要先定下来；AR 则是变长生成。这个差异带来一个很实际的问题：固定预算是否浪费容量。作者后面专门分析了 deployable budget 和 oracle budget 的差距。

训练方面，除了 zero-shot 提示检索，作者还加了 contrastive fine-tuning，使 DiffRetriever 既能比较“原生提示式检索”，也能比较“训练后 retriever”。从论文描述看，整体 scoring pipeline 仍然尽量贴近 PromptReps，因此实验里的差异主要来自表示生成范式，而不是后端打分器被大改。
summary.experiments:
实验覆盖两类 backbone：AR 用 LLaMA3-8B、Qwen2.5-7B；diffusion 用 LLaDA-8B、Dream-7B。评测集包括 MS MARCO、TREC DL 2019/2020，以及 BEIR-7 这七个跨域数据集；同时看 zero-shot 和 supervised fine-tuning 两种设置。

结论很清楚。第一，多 token 对 diffusion backbone 是稳定增益，对 AR backbone 则不是。作者报告 multi-token DiffRetriever 在所有测试的 diffusion backbone 上都显著优于 single-token，而 AR 版本的 multi-token 没有稳定超过 single-token。也就是说，先前 PromptReps 多 token 不稳定，不足以否定“多代表位点”这个方向，更可能是被顺序生成的代价和噪声掩盖了。

第二，延迟收益来自并行解码，而不是 FLOPs 数量级变化。文中明确说明，从渐近 FLOPs 看，带 KV cache 的 AR 和 diffusion 都可随 K 线性增长；真正的差别在 wall-clock latency：AR 必须串行跑多次前向，diffusion 一次并行完成。Figure 1 是理解整篇文章最关键的图之一，因为它把“效果提升”和“延迟近似不变”放在同一个坐标系里。

第三，DiffRetriever 的优势在 zero-shot 和 fine-tuned 两种场景都能保留。作者指出，zero-shot 时基于 LLaDA 的 DiffRetriever 是对比系统里最强的；在 fine-tuning 后，基于 Dream 的 DiffRetriever 成为 BEIR-7 上整体最强的 retriever，超过 fine-tuned PromptReps、DiffEmbed 和 RepLLaMA。摘要里没有给出完整表格数字，但从正文结论看，这不是个别数据集上的偶然提升，而是跨 in-domain / out-of-domain 的一致趋势。

第四，预算选择是一个被低估的问题。作者做了一个“完美 per-query budget predictor”的 oracle 分析，发现如果能在冻结基座模型上按 query 自适应选择预算，在相同固定平均预算下，oracle 甚至能超过 contrastive fine-tuning 的固定预算方案，而且这一点在所有 backbone-benchmark 组合上都成立。这说明当前固定 Kq/Kp 的部署方式留下了明显性能空间，也提示未来可以把预算预测当成 retrieval-time policy 问题来做。
summary.reading_guide:
这篇适合泛读但要抓住几个关键位置。

先看 Introduction 和 Figure 1。这里基本把论文最重要的判断讲清楚了：多 token 想法本身成立，问题出在 AR 的顺序生成。Figure 1 同时展示效果和延迟，是整篇最值得先看的图。

然后看 Method 里的 §3.2 和 §3.3。重点不是 prompt 文案，而是两种 backbone 在“同样读 hidden state + logits”的前提下，只改变表示产生方式。要特别注意作者如何把 diffusion 的 K 个 [MASK] 位置接到 chat template 后面，以及为什么 closing tokens 也放进可见上下文。

实验部分优先看 zero-shot 与 fine-tuned 的主表，再看预算分析对应的小节。阅读时建议带着两个问题：一是 gains 是否主要来自多 token，还是来自 diffusion backbone 本身；二是固定预算是否已经接近最优。附录里关于 prompt wording（“a few words” 优于固定“三个词”）和 memory 限制下 AR fine-tuning token cap 的说明，可以快速扫一遍，帮助判断实验是否公平。

如果时间有限，30 分钟内可以读完主线：Introduction、方法图、主结果表、预算 oracle 分析。若想深挖，则重点看作者如何界定 latency 与 FLOPs 的区别，以及为什么把训练对齐的 retrieval-time objective 视为 DiffEmbed 类方法之外的另一条路线。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks a precise question: when using a language model directly as a retriever, is the failure of multi-token representative retrieval due to the idea itself, or due to autoregressive sequential decoding? Single-token PromptReps is efficient but heavily compressive. Multi-token representations should be closer to late-interaction retrieval, yet prior AR implementations were slow and did not consistently beat the single-token setup. DiffRetriever isolates this issue by moving to diffusion language models, where K representative positions can be predicted in parallel rather than generated one by one.
summary_en.importance: Its main value for pretraining research is that it evaluates diffusion LMs in a way that is aligned with their native training objective. Instead of turning a diffusion LM into a generic encoder with mean pooling, it uses masked-position prediction at retrieval time and reads out representations from those masked slots. That makes the comparison more meaningful: the gain is tied to the modeling paradigm, not just to backbone scale. The paper also shows a concrete systems-level implication of non-AR modeling: parallel multi-position representation extraction can improve retrieval quality without the sequential latency penalty of AR decoding. This is not a new retrieval paradigm by itself, but it is a clean demonstration of where diffusion-style pretraining can matter beyond text generation.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The overall recipe follows PromptReps. A query or passage is prompted in natural language, and the model is asked to represent it with a few words. From the model response, hidden states are used as dense representations and token logits as sparse representations; retrieval scoring is then performed against indexed passage representations.

The key change is how those representative tokens are produced. In the AR setting, representative tokens are generated left-to-right after the assistant prefix, so producing K tokens requires K sequential decoding steps. In the diffusion setting, the prompt is extended with K [MASK] positions plus closing tokens, and the model predicts all masked positions jointly under bidirectional attention. The hidden states and logits at those K positions are read out in a single forward pass.

Two design choices matter. First, the authors explicitly frame this as training-aligned usage of a diffusion LM. This differs from encoder-style baselines such as DiffEmbed and pplx-embed, which use the diffusion backbone more like BERT and do not exploit the masked prediction interface at inference time. Second, diffusion requires fixed sequence length, so query and passage budgets (Kq and Kp) must be chosen in advance, unlike variable-length AR decoding. The paper later shows that this fixed-budget choice leaves measurable headroom, motivating adaptive per-query budget selection.

The paper also adds a contrastive fine-tuning stage on top of the zero-shot prompted retriever. This is useful because it keeps the retrieval pipeline close to PromptReps while allowing a comparison between prompted retrieval and trained retrieval under the same representation-generation principle.
summary_en.experiments:
The study compares two AR backbones, LLaMA3-8B and Qwen2.5-7B, against two diffusion backbones, LLaDA-8B and Dream-7B. Evaluation covers MS MARCO, TREC DL 2019/2020, and BEIR-7, in both zero-shot and supervised fine-tuning settings.

The central empirical result is consistent: multi-token retrieval helps diffusion backbones and does not reliably help AR backbones. Multi-token DiffRetriever improves over the single-token variant on every tested diffusion model, while AR multi-token decoding shows no stable gain over the single-token baseline. This directly supports the paper’s thesis that the bottleneck is sequential generation rather than the multi-token retrieval idea itself.

The latency story is also important. The authors note that diffusion does not have an asymptotic FLOPs advantage over AR with KV caching; both scale linearly with K. The practical advantage is wall-clock latency: AR requires multiple sequential forward passes, whereas diffusion finishes in one parallel pass. Figure 1 is therefore central because it ties quality gains to nearly constant latency as K grows.

The gains transfer across settings. In zero-shot evaluation, DiffRetriever on LLaDA is reported as the strongest system among the compared methods, ahead of PromptReps on AR backbones and ahead of the encoder-style DiffEmbed baseline. After supervised fine-tuning, DiffRetriever on Dream becomes the strongest overall retriever on BEIR-7, outperforming fine-tuned PromptReps, DiffEmbed, and RepLLaMA. The paper text emphasizes that this is not a one-dataset anomaly but a repeated pattern across in-domain and out-of-domain benchmarks.

A particularly useful analysis concerns budget selection. With a perfect per-query budget predictor on the frozen base model, the oracle adaptive-budget setup exceeds contrastive fine-tuning under the same fixed average budget on every backbone-benchmark pair tested. This suggests that fixed Kq/Kp deployment leaves substantial effectiveness on the table and that adaptive retrieval-time budgeting is a serious follow-up direction.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Start with the Introduction and Figure 1. They contain the main claim of the paper in its cleanest form: multi-token retrieval is viable, but AR sequential decoding obscures its value. Figure 1 is the fastest way to understand both the effectiveness and latency argument.

Then read Section 3.2 carefully. The important point is not the prompt wording but the fact that both AR and diffusion variants read out the same kinds of signals—hidden states and logits—while differing only in how representative positions are produced. Pay attention to how the K masked slots are appended to the chat template and why the closing tokens are included in the visible context.

In the experiments, prioritize the main zero-shot and fine-tuned result tables, then the budget analysis section. Two questions are worth keeping in mind while reading: are the gains coming from diffusion as a backbone, or specifically from parallel multi-token extraction; and how suboptimal is a fixed representation budget? If time is limited, the mainline can be read in about 30 minutes: Introduction, method core, main tables, and the oracle budget analysis. The appendix on prompt wording and AR token caps is useful for checking fairness but not essential on a first pass.

recommendation.zh: 扩散LM在检索任务的落地尝试，仅查看§3方法部分和效果对比表即可
recommendation.en: Practical attempt of diffusion LM for retrieval tasks, only read §3 method section and performance comparison tables

institutions: The University of Queensland, Brisbane, QLD

paper.title: Flow Matching with Arbitrary Auxiliary Paths
paper.abstract: We introduce a new generative modeling framework, \textbf{Flow Matching with Arbitrary Auxiliary Paths (AuxPath-FM)}, which generalizes conditional flow matching by incorporating an auxiliary variable drawn from an arbitrary distribution into the probability path. Unlike prior methods that restrict auxiliary components to Gaussian noise, AuxPath-FM allows the variable $η$ to follow any distribution, producing trajectories of the form $X_t = a(t)X_1 + b(t)X_0 + c(t)η$. We theoretically demonstrat

summary.core_problem: 现有流匹配（Flow Matching）和随机插值方法将路径中的辅助随机变量限制为高斯噪声，无法利用更结构化的辅助信号直接塑造生成轨迹；同时条件生成中的标签/侧信息通常仅通过网络输入引入，不改变底层概率路径，限制了对生成动力学的控制能力。
summary.importance: 对扩散语言模型（diffusion LM）等连续时间生成建模范式有方法学启发——将辅助变量从高斯约束中解放出来，允许任意分布的辅助信号（如语义标签、结构化先验）直接嵌入概率路径设计，为条件生成提供了不同于classifier-free guidance的另一种控制途径：不是在网络层级调制，而是在轨迹层级进行原则性的动力学控制。
summary.technical_approach: 提出AuxPath-FM框架，构造形如 X_t = a(t)X_1 + b(t)X_0 + c(t)η 的生成轨迹，其中η是来自任意分布的辅助随机变量（不限于高斯）。论文证明该构造保持连续性方程，且训练目标与标准边际化公式兼容。核心贡献是从理论上解除了辅助变量的高斯限制，建立了更通用的流匹配目标。当η编码语义信息（如类别标签）时，标签引导直接内嵌于概率路径本身，而非通过网络输入间接施加。该框架统一并推广了随机插值、Schrödinger Bridge等现有路径方法。
summary.experiments: 提供的内容中未包含具体实验结果。论文重点在理论框架构建，通过数学证明展示了构造的正确性（保持连续性方程、训练目标与边际化公式一致），但未报告在图像、文本或其他模态上的生成质量对比实验。
summary.reading_guide: 重点看Section 1的动机分析和Section 3的方法定义，理解辅助变量η如何被引入概率路径以及为何这不是简单的高斯推广。关注与classifier-free guidance等现有条件生成方法的区别——路径级控制 vs 网络级调制。预计阅读时间：25-30分钟。
summary.authors_note: 作者机构未在提供内容中标注。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing flow matching and stochastic interpolant methods restrict auxiliary random variables in the probability path to Gaussian noise, preventing the use of more structured auxiliary signals to directly shape generative trajectories. Meanwhile, conditioning in conditional generative modeling is typically applied only through network inputs, leaving the underlying probability path unchanged and limiting control over generative dynamics.
summary_en.importance: Methodological inspiration for continuous-time generative modeling paradigms such as diffusion LMs. By freeing auxiliary variables from the Gaussian constraint, arbitrary auxiliary signals (e.g., semantic labels, structured priors) can be directly embedded into probability path design, offering an alternative control pathway to classifier-free guidance—principled dynamical control at the trajectory level rather than network-level modulation.
summary_en.technical_approach: The AuxPath-FM framework constructs generative trajectories of the form X_t = a(t)X_1 + b(t)X_0 + c(t)η, where η is an auxiliary random variable from an arbitrary distribution (not limited to Gaussian). The paper proves this construction preserves the continuity equation and yields a training objective consistent with the standard marginal formulation. The core contribution is theoretically lifting the Gaussian restriction on auxiliary variables and establishing a more general flow matching objective. When η encodes semantic information such as class labels, label guidance is embedded directly into the probability path itself, rather than applied indirectly through network inputs. The framework unifies and generalizes existing path-based approaches including stochastic interpolants and Schrödinger Bridge methods.
summary_en.experiments: No concrete experimental results are included in the provided content. The paper focuses on theoretical framework construction, with mathematical proofs establishing the correctness of the construction (continuity equation preservation, consistency with marginal training objectives), but no generation quality comparison experiments on images, text, or other modalities are reported.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on Section 1 for motivation and Section 3 for the method definition, understanding how auxiliary variable η is introduced into the probability path and why this is more than a trivial generalization from Gaussians. Pay attention to the distinction from existing conditional generation methods like classifier-free guidance—path-level control versus network-level modulation. Estimated reading time: 25-30 minutes.
summary_en.authors_note: Author affiliations not stated in the provided content.

recommendation.zh: 流匹配的通用化改进，支持离散先验的设计，可作为Flow/Diffusion LM 建模范式的底层方法参考。
recommendation.en: Generalized improvement to flow matching with support for discrete priors, useful as underlying method reference for Flow/Diffusion LM paradigm research.

paper.title: Leveraging Pretrained Language Models as Energy Functions for Glauber Dynamics Text Diffusion
paper.abstract: We present a discrete diffusion-based language model using Glauber dynamics from statistical physics. Our main insight is that instead of trying to train a discrete state space diffusion model using Glauber dynamics with a uniform transition kernel as the forward process, one can set up an ``energy function'' based on pretrained causal/masked language models. When viewed as the stationary distribution, this energy function allows us to significantly improve the quality of the generated text. Inc

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文研究离散文本 diffusion LM 的一个核心瓶颈：常见 masked diffusion 或离散 diffusion 往往把均匀分布、unigram 分布或 mask-heavy 分布作为噪声端点，这个分布离真实文本太远，导致训练样本效率低、生成质量弱、采样过程需要补很多模型本来可以从预训练中获得的语言知识。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的价值在于，它把已有 pretrained LM 当成离散 diffusion 的 energy function，而不是只把预训练模型作为初始化或 teacher。这样做改变了 forward process 的设计：扩散链的 stationary distribution 不再是信息量很低的噪声分布，而是由预训练语言模型诱导的、更接近数据分布的能量模型。这个方向对非 AR 语言建模很重要，因为它提供了一条利用既有 AR / masked LM 训练投入来构建 diffusion LM 的路线，避免从均匀噪声到自然语言之间搭一座过长的桥。
summary.technical_approach:
论文采用 Glauber dynamics 构造离散状态空间上的扩散过程。状态空间是长度为 L 的 token 序列。Glauber dynamics 每次局部更新一个位置，并以某个能量函数定义的分布作为 stationary distribution。作者的关键选择是用 pretrained LM 定义能量函数，使目标分布形如 p(x) ∝ exp(-f(x))。相比使用均匀 transition kernel 或 mask-only forward process，这样的噪声端点保留了更多语言结构。

实现上，论文主要使用 UL2 风格模型作为 energy function。UL2 同时覆盖 causal generation、mask infilling 等目标，比纯 GPT-style causal LM 更适合放入需要局部重采样和条件填充的 Glauber diffusion 框架。作者从 UL2 权重初始化，再加入扩散时间相关变量，用适配 Glauber forward process 的 score-entropy loss 训练 diffusion model。附录还讨论了如何使用 GPT-style 模型作为 energy function，但主线选择 UL2，是因为它在双向填充和自回归生成之间提供了更自然的接口。
summary.experiments:
论文报告的实验覆盖语言建模质量、分布相似度、常识推理、结构化推理和 compute-normalized 采样效率。结果包括：无条件生成 perplexity 明显优于已有离散 diffusion LM；generative 和 zero-shot perplexity 接近同规模 AR 模型；MAUVE 分数改善；在 Winogrande、PIQA、SIQA、HellaSwag 等常识任务上相比 prior diffusion models 有竞争力或更好。

结构化推理部分，模型在 Sudoku 和 Zebra puzzle 上优于 masked diffusion LM，并且在不额外加入 token-order robustness 训练的情况下取得这一结果。采样效率实验使用 T5-Gemma 2B–2B backbone，在 reasoning 和 language tasks 上微调。单次 Glauber-UL2 generation 的成本约为 2L 次模型调用；在相同 compute budget 下，N=1 能匹配或超过 AR 模型生成两个独立候选的结果，N=2 时优势进一步扩大。全文片段没有给出具体 perplexity、MAUVE 或 benchmark 数值，因此不能补充精确幅度。
summary.reading_guide:
建议精读 forward Markov process 的定义、Glauber dynamics 的 stationary distribution 设定，以及 score-entropy loss 如何适配该过程。核心问题是为什么好的 base / noisy distribution 会降低 diffusion LM 的学习难度。这里不要只看“用了预训练模型”这一点，要看它是如何进入 Markov chain 的能量函数，而不是只作为参数初始化。

第二个重点是与 MDLM 的比较。论文认为 MDLM 的限制来自 forward process 和 noisy / stationary distribution 的设计，而不只是模型容量或训练技巧。建议看第 5 节中对 MDLM 的批评和对 Glauber dynamics 的动机说明。实验部分优先看三类表：perplexity 与 MAUVE、Sudoku / Zebra puzzle、compute-normalized best-of-N。预计精读需要 1.5 到 2 小时；如果只泛读，重点看 introduction、method 中 energy function 的构造、以及 best-of-N 实验即可。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses a central weakness of discrete diffusion language models: many existing methods diffuse toward a uniform, unigram, or mask-dominated distribution that is far from natural text. This makes the reverse process hard to learn, hurts sample efficiency, and leaves the model to relearn linguistic structure that is already available in pretrained language models.
summary_en.importance: The main contribution is to use pretrained language models as energy functions for discrete text diffusion, not merely as initialization or teachers. This changes the forward process. The stationary distribution of the Markov chain is no longer a low-information noise distribution; it is an LM-induced distribution that is closer to real text. For non-autoregressive language modeling, this is a useful design point: it reuses the compute already spent on AR or masked pretraining while giving diffusion models a better base distribution than uniform corruption.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The method builds a discrete diffusion process using Glauber dynamics. The state space is a length-L token sequence. Glauber dynamics updates local coordinates and samples according to a stationary distribution defined by an energy function. The paper sets this energy function using a pretrained language model, with a distribution of the form p(x) proportional to exp(-f(x)). This is different from masked diffusion processes that diffuse toward a generic masking distribution or from discrete diffusion with simple uniform transition kernels.

The main implementation uses UL2-style pretrained models. UL2 covers causal generation and mask infilling, which makes it a natural fit for local resampling and conditional updates in the Glauber framework. The diffusion model is initialized from UL2 weights, augmented with time-dependent variables, and trained with a score-entropy loss adapted to the Glauber forward process. The appendix sketches how GPT-style models can be used as energy functions, but UL2 is the cleaner choice because it already supports both left-to-right and infilling behavior.
summary_en.experiments:
The reported experiments cover unconditional generation, distributional quality, commonsense tasks, structured reasoning, and compute-normalized sampling. The model obtains better unconditional generative perplexity than prior discrete diffusion language models and is competitive with autoregressive models of similar size on generative and zero-shot perplexity. It also improves MAUVE scores and performs competitively with or better than prior diffusion models on Winogrande, PIQA, SIQA, and HellaSwag.

On structured reasoning tasks, the Glauber-UL2 model outperforms masked diffusion language models on Sudoku and Zebra puzzles without adding special training for robust token orderings. The compute-normalized best-of-N experiment uses a T5-Gemma 2B–2B backbone fine-tuned on reasoning and language tasks. A single Glauber-UL2 generation costs roughly 2L model invocations and matches or exceeds an AR model that generates two independent candidates under the same compute budget; the gap increases at N=2. The provided text does not include exact perplexity, MAUVE, or benchmark numbers, so precise margins should be checked in the tables.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Read the sections defining the forward Markov process, the Glauber stationary distribution, and the score-entropy objective. The key point is how the pretrained LM enters the Markov chain as an energy function, rather than simply providing initial weights. This is where the method differs most from standard masked diffusion language modeling.

The comparison with MDLMs is also worth reading closely. The paper argues that MDLM limitations come from the choice of forward process and noisy distribution, not only from model scale or training recipes. For experiments, prioritize the perplexity and MAUVE tables, the Sudoku and Zebra puzzle results, and the compute-normalized best-of-N study. A careful read should take around 1.5 to 2 hours; a quick read can focus on the introduction, the energy-function construction, and the best-of-N experiment.

recommendation.zh: 这不是又一个 diffusion LM 小修小补，而是把 pretrained LM 直接塞进能量函数；应立刻核查实验控制是否干净，若成立会改写你对 discrete diffusion 文本建模的设计空间。
recommendation.en: This is not another minor diffusion-LM tweak: it plugs a pretrained LM directly into the energy; audit the controls carefully, because if it holds, it changes the design space for discrete text diffusion.

paper.title: Predict-then-Diffuse: Adaptive Response Length for Compute-Budgeted Inference in Diffusion LLMs
paper.abstract: Diffusion-based Large Language Models (D-LLMs) represent a promising frontier in generative AI, offering fully parallel token generation that can lead to significant throughput advantages and superior GPU utilization over traditional autoregressive paradigm. However, this parallelism is constrained by the requirement of a fixed-size response length prior to generation. This architectural limitation imposes a severe trade-off: oversized response length results in computational waste on semantical

summary.core_problem: 扩散式LLM推理必须预先固定输出长度，导致padding浪费或截断重算的延迟尖峰；如何在给定算力预算下自适应选择生成长度。
summary.importance: 属于扩散LM的推理侧工程问题：把“长度预测”作为前置步骤来稳定延迟/吞吐；对做diffusion/any-order LM落地的人有用，但不触及预训练目标或建模范式本身。
summary.technical_approach: Predict-then-Diffuse：先用辅助模块AdaRLP预测响应长度，再按该长度运行D-LLM推理；强调模型无关、可在不改动主模型的情况下减少padding与重算。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出具体D-LLM类型（如D3PM/SEDD/MDLM等）、数据集、吞吐/延迟改善幅度与对比基线；需要看正文是否在不同长度分布与不同预算下做了干净评测。

summary_en.core_problem: Diffusion LLM inference requires a fixed output length upfront, causing padding waste or truncation-triggered recomputation and latency spikes; how to adaptively choose response length under a compute budget.
summary_en.importance: An inference-side engineering fix for diffusion LMs: adds length prediction to stabilize latency/throughput. Useful for deploying diffusion/any-order LMs, but not a pretraining/objective contribution.
summary_en.technical_approach: Predict-then-Diffuse uses an auxiliary Adaptive Response Length Predictor (AdaRLP) to estimate response length first, then runs diffusion inference at that length, aiming to reduce padding and avoid costly recomputation.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract lacks details on the specific D-LLM, datasets, baselines, and quantitative latency/throughput gains; the value hinges on clean evaluation across length distributions and budgets.

recommendation.zh: 这是扩散LM落地时绕不开的“固定长度”补丁；只看延迟/吞吐曲线与失败案例，别期待预训练层面的新东西。
recommendation.en: A practical patch for diffusion LMs’ fixed-length inference; skim the latency/throughput curves and failure modes—no pretraining insight here.

paper.title: Focus on the Core: Empowering Diffusion Large Language Models by Self-Contrast
paper.abstract: The iterative denoising paradigm of Diffusion Large Language Models (DLMs) endows them with a distinct advantage in global context modeling. However, current decoding strategies fail to leverage this capability, typically exhibiting a local preference that overlooks the heterogeneous information density within the context, ultimately degrading generation quality. To address this limitation, we systematically investigate high-information-density (HD) tokens and present two key findings: (1) expli

summary.core_problem: 扩散式语言模型（DLM）在迭代去噪中具备“全局建模”的潜力，但现有解码（尤其是带 CFG 的逐步填充/置信度驱动策略）呈现明显的局部偏置：更靠近已确定位置的 token 更容易被优先确定，导致模型忽视上下文中信息密度不均的事实——少量“高信息密度（HD）token”往往是推理与语义的锚点。论文要解决的是：在不改训练的前提下，如何在解码阶段识别并利用这些 HD token，提升 DLM 的生成质量，并进一步利用其“更早收敛”的动态特性加速解码。
summary.importance: 对预训练本身（目标函数/数据/优化）影响有限，但对“扩散 LM 的推断-训练接口”有直接启发：1）把 DLM 的错误更多归因于解码策略与去噪动态不匹配，而非模型容量不足；2）提出一种可操作的“信息密度视角”来解释 DLM 去噪过程中哪些 token 在起决定作用；3）给出训练无关（training-free）的改进路径，适合作为后续做法的基线：要么把这种 HD token 的偏置显式纳入训练目标（例如在训练时强化对 HD token 的一致性/稳定性），要么在推断时做更结构化的 token 调度。
summary.technical_approach:
核心思路是“自对比（self-contrast）地强迫模型围绕 HD token 去收敛”。论文先给出两条经验事实：
1）显式条件化 HD token 会提升质量：用 CFG 构造条件/无条件轨迹的对比，若优先保留/强调 HD token（Mask HD）比优先保留 LD token（Mask LD）更好。
2）HD token 有早收敛倾向：在迭代去噪中，HD token 更早稳定到最终取值。
在此基础上提出 FoCore：在去噪轨迹中动态识别“已收敛的 HD token”，将其暂时重新 mask，构造一个对比的负样本条件；然后对比原条件与“mask 掉 HD token”的条件下的 logits，用差分信号引导后续去噪，使模型在后续步骤更依赖这些核心 token（直观上是：如果把核心锚点拿掉，模型分布会变差；用这个差异作为引导，强化锚点的约束力）。
进一步提出 FoCore_A：利用 HD token 早收敛，一旦检测到其稳定，就在局部窗口内对稳定候选做并行解码，从而减少总去噪步数/墙钟时间。整体属于 decoding policy 的改造，不改参数、不加训练。
summary.experiments:
文中给出的关键数字主要集中在两类：
- 质量：在数学子域上，Mask HD 相对 Mask LD 的 Acc@1 稳定提升，示例包括 Prealgebra +2.07%（0.579→0.599）、Counting & Probability +1.48%，Algebra +0.76%，Precalculus +0.55%。这些结果用于支撑“HD token 确实是信息骨架”。
- 效率：FoCore_A 报告将单样本延迟从 20.76s 降到 8.64s（-58.4%），并带来 2.07× 的 decoding step reduction（相对标准 CFG）。
此外论文声称在 LLaDA 与 Dream 两类 backbone 上都能稳定提升，但在给定全文片段中未看到更完整的基准表格与方差/显著性信息；若全文包含更多任务（非数学）与不同长度设置，建议重点核对其泛化范围与失败案例。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议（约 20–30 分钟）：
- 先看引言里 Figure 1 的两个部分：1(a) 用具体推理例子解释 HD token 如何“定分支”；1(b) 的 Mask HD vs Mask LD 是整篇的因果动机。
- 重点找“HD token 的定义/识别准则”和“收敛检测”的实现细节：HD 是基于梯度/置信度/互信息/CFG 差分，还是基于启发式分数？收敛判据是 token-level argmax 稳定、还是分布熵阈值？这些决定方法可复现性与可迁移性。
- 读 FoCore 的算法段落时，抓住它到底在做哪一种 guidance：logit 差分如何注入（加权、温度、步长随 t 的 schedule），以及与标准 CFG 的关系（叠加/替换）。
- 读 FoCore_A 时，关注“并行解码窗口”的选择与错误传播：窗口太大可能引入不一致，太小收益有限；看是否有消融说明速度-质量折中。

summary_en.core_problem: Diffusion LMs can, in principle, leverage global context via iterative denoising, but common decoding policies (notably CFG-style iterative filling) exhibit a strong locality bias: tokens near already-denoised positions get over-prioritized. This clashes with the heterogeneous information density of natural language, where a small set of high-information-density (HD) tokens often act as reasoning/semantic anchors. The paper targets a training-free way to (i) exploit HD tokens to improve generation quality and (ii) use their early-convergence behavior to speed up decoding.
summary_en.importance: This is not a pretraining-method paper, but it is relevant to foundation-model research in two ways: (1) it attributes a meaningful portion of DLM quality loss to inference-time policy mismatch rather than model capacity, which matters when comparing AR vs diffusion paradigms; (2) it introduces an “information-density” lens that could be turned into training objectives (e.g., explicitly stabilizing anchor tokens earlier, or supervising denoising order); (3) it provides a practical, training-free baseline for diffusion-LM decoding improvements, useful before committing to costly retraining.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The method is built around self-contrast over HD tokens. The paper motivates two empirical observations: (a) explicitly conditioning on HD tokens improves accuracy (Mask HD beats Mask LD), and (b) HD tokens tend to converge earlier during denoising. 
FoCore then dynamically identifies converged HD tokens along the denoising trajectory, temporarily re-masks them to create a contrastive negative condition, and uses the logit difference between the original condition and the “HD-masked” condition as a guidance signal. Intuitively, if removing anchor tokens degrades the model’s distribution, the contrastive gap can be used to force subsequent denoising steps to stay anchored on those tokens.
FoCore_A is an acceleration variant: once HD tokens are detected as stable, it performs parallel decoding over stable candidates within a local context window, reducing the number of sequential denoising steps and wall-clock latency.
summary_en.experiments:
Key reported results in the provided content:
- Quality evidence via Mask HD vs Mask LD on math subdomains (Acc@1): Prealgebra +2.07% (0.579→0.599), Counting & Probability +1.48%, Algebra +0.76%, Precalculus +0.55%.
- Efficiency: FoCore_A reduces per-sample latency from 20.76s to 8.64s (-58.4%) and achieves a 2.07× reduction in decoding steps compared to standard CFG.
The paper claims consistent gains across LLaDA and Dream backbones; when reading the full paper, it is worth checking breadth beyond math, variance across seeds, and any quality regressions under longer contexts or different noise schedules.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Skim plan (20–30 minutes):
- Start with Figure 1: the qualitative “anchor token” example and the quantitative Mask HD vs Mask LD comparison are the causal motivation.
- Focus on how HD tokens are operationally defined and detected, and how “convergence” is measured (argmax stability vs entropy thresholds, etc.). These details determine reproducibility and transfer.
- In the FoCore algorithm section, track precisely how the contrastive logits are combined with CFG (additive vs replacement, weights/schedules over timesteps).
- For FoCore_A, look for ablations on the parallel window size and failure modes (inconsistency/error propagation), which govern the speed–quality trade-off.

recommendation.zh: 做 diffusion LM 的值得看：它把“哪些 token 先收敛、该不该被特殊利用”说成了可操作的 decoding prior；先看 HD token 分析和 FoCore 机制，效果数字先保留。
recommendation.en: Worth reading if you work on diffusion LMs: it turns “which tokens converge early and should be privileged” into an actionable decoding prior; read the HD-token analysis and FoCore mechanism first, and treat the gains as provisional.
